Umfazi lowo owawuya ezweni elimnyama, kufanele ahlanze izigqoko zakhe, begodu ahlanze umzimba wakhe ngamanzi; ngemva kwalokho uzongena entabeni.

Ingulube yomnikelo wesono, nobhontshisi womnikelo wesono, igazi labo lafakwa ezindaweni ezingcwele khulu ukuze kwenziwe ukuxoshwa, kumele lithunyelwe ngaphandle komkhosi; amasikhumba abo, nemifino sabo, nenyama sabo, kufanele kuqhunywe ngomlilo.
Owenza umlilo azozihlamba izigqoko zakhe, begodu ahlanze umzimba wakhe ngamanzi; ngemuva kwalokho uzoya esiteshini.
Le nyanga iyisishiyagalombili, ngomhla wesithupha wenyanga, kufanele niphumule; ngeke nisebenze umsebenzi othile, noma ngabe ungumdabu noma ngabe ungumhlali phakathi kwenu.
Ngokuba ngalolu suku nizocaciswa phambi kukaNkulunkulu, nizohlanzwa; kuzo zonke izigebengu zenu enhliziyweni kaYehova nizohlanzwa.
Usuku lokuphumula oluphelele luzobe lukhona kuwe; ngeke nidla ukudla. Lolu mthetho uhlala njalo.
Ubaba wakhe, umbhishobhi okhishwe ngesonka, owabekwa endaweni yakhe, uzoba ngumvikeli wabo; uzozigqoka izicathulo zelinen, izicathulo ezingcwele.
Uzolungisa indawo engcwele khulu, nesihlalo sokuhlangana, nesibingelelo; begodu uzolungisa abapristi, nomndeni wonke webandla, ukuze babe nguzimu wabo.
Lokhu kuzoba ngumthetho ohlala njalo kuwe, bona uphinde uhlanze izingane zakwaSirayeli ngazo zonke izigebengu zabo ngonyaka owodwa. Wakwenza njalo, njengombana ikosi abewisela umthetho uMoses.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
Usho ku-Aron, nakubo bonke oonyana bakhe, nabo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, usithi kubo: Le yindlela ikosi awisenzile ngayo:
Wonke umuntu waseSirayeli obulala inkomo, noma ingulube, noma imbuzi, ngaphakathi emgodini, noma ngaphandle kwawo,

begodu ayibeke emgwaqweni wesitezi sokuhlangana, ukuba inikezelwe njengomnikelo kukaNkulunkulu phambi kwendlu yakhe engcwele, lowo muntu uzoba necala lokuhlukunyezwa kwegazi; wahlukunyeza igazi, begodu lowo muntu uzosuswa phakathi kwabantu bakhe.

Begodu, uma abantu baseSirayeli banikela ngenyama sabo emgwaqweni, bazoyiletha kukaNkulunkulu; begodu, uma beyizibulala ezindaweni ezivulekile, bazozithatha ziye kumbhoshongo wendlu yokuphumula, bazinikeze umnikelo wokudla kukaNkulunkulu.
Umbingeleli uzobasusa igazi phezu kwesibopho seNkosi, esisemnyango wendlu yokuhlangabeza; begodu uzodlidliza isilonda, ibe ngumoya omnandi kuYehova.
Bazothi: "Akekho umuntu ophilayo ozonikela ngenyama yakhe ezilwaneni zezinkomo, abazithobela njengamabhishobhi; lokhu kuzoba ngumthetho ohlala isikhathi eside kubo, kanye nemindeni sabo.
Wathi kubo: Wonke umuntu waseSirayeli, noma wonke umhlali ohlala phakathi kwenu, uma enikela ngesonka esishiswayo, noma nganoma iyiphi enye insizakalo,
begodu angeke ayiveze emgwaqeni wesitezi sokuhlangana, ukuze ayinikeze ikosi, lowo muntu kufanele aphelelwe yizwe lakhe.
Uma kukhona umuntu waseSirayeli, noma umhlali ohlala phakathi kwenu, edla igazi naliphi na uhlobo, ngizobhekana nalo muntu, ngiwuqubuke emiphakathini yawo.
Ngokuba inhliziyo yomuntu ophilayo egazi. Ngininikeze igazi phezu isiqalo, ukuze uqinise wena nami. Yiye igazi, ngombana liyimpilo, bona uqinisa abantu nozimu.
Ngalokho ngitjho kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, Akunamuntu othile phakathi kwenu ozodla igazi; begodu noma ngubani ohlala ezweni eliphakathi kwenu, ngeke adle igazi.
Uma umuntu wesizwe samaSirayeli, noma umningi ohlala phakathi kwabo, ehlasela inkomo, noma ingulube, engadlalwa, kufanele aphuze igazi layo, begodu ayigqoke ngothuli.

Ngokuba inhliziyo yomuntu wonke yigazi lakhe; ngalokho ngitjho kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, Ningadlanga igazi lomuntu onke; ngombana inhliziyo yomuntu wonke yigazi lakhe; lowo okudlayo kufanele aphelelwe.

Wonke umuntu, noma ngabe uvela ezweni lakwaSirayeli, noma ngabe ungumhambi ohlala kulo mhlaba, uma edla isilwane esifile, noma isilwane esidlwengulayo, kufanele ahlanze izigqoko zakhe, ahlanzeke ngamanzi; uzobe unqunywe kuze kube semini, begodu ngemuva kwalokho uzohlanzekile.
Kodwana uma engahlanzi izigqoko zakhe, begodu ahlanze umzimba wakhe, uzoba necala.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
Uzokhuluma nabantu bakaSirayeli, usithi kubo: NginguYehova uzimu wenu.

Mhlawumbe ngeke nihambe ngendlela abayenzayo ezweni laseYiputa, lapho nihlala khona; noma indlela abayenzayo ezweni laseKanana, lapho ngizokulethela khona, ngeke nihambe ngayo, begodu amasiko abo ngeke niwalandele.
Nizigcine izimiso zami, nizilondoloze imithetho yami, niyilandele. Ngiye ikosi uzimu wenu.
Nizigcine izimiso zami nemithetho yami; umuntu ozenzayo, uzophila ngazo. Ngiye uzimu.
Akukho muntu phakathi kwenu ongeke afike emndenini wakhe, ukuze abe nendodana yakhe. Ngiye ikosi.
Umama wakho ngumama wakho, ngalokho-ke akufanele uvule ikhanda lakhe; umama wakho ungubaba wakho, ngalokho-ke akufanele uvule ikhanda lakhe.
Awunakufinyelela indodakazi yobaba wakho, ngombana lokhu kungenxa yokugxeka ubaba wakho.
Umama wakho, noma indodakazi yomkakhe, noma indodana yenkosikazi yakho, noma inkosikazi yowesifazane wakho, noma intombi yabazali bakho, noma ingane ezalwa ekhaya lakho.
Umfazi wendodakazi yakho, noma intombazane yenkosikazi yakho, akufanele ube nayo inkanuko; ngombana lokhu kuyingozi kuwe.
Umfazi wenkosikazi yobaba wakho, ozalwa ngubaba wakho, awudingi ukuwuveza umlomo wakhe; udadewabo yena.
Akufanele uthathe inkosikazi yobaba wakho, ngombana yena umndeni kababa wakho.
Umama wakho udadewabo, awukwazi ukubhekana nayo.
Uma uthandana nomfazi wenkosikazi yakho, akufanele ube nendodakazi yomndeni wakho.
Akufanele uthathe intombazane yomndeni wakho, ngombana indodakazi yomntwana wakho; akufanele uthathe intombazane yomndeni wakho, ngombana indodana yomntwana wakho.
Uma uthandana nomfazi wenkosikazi yakho, awukwazi ukufinyelela emlonyeni wakhe.
Uzothatha indodakazi yomntwana wakhe, noma intombi yomntwana wakhe, ukuze uthathe intombazane yakhe; ngombana bangamakhoboka akhe. Lokhu kuyingozi khulu.
Uma uthandana nomfazi, kufanele ube nendodakazi yowesifazane wakho. Uma uthandana nomfazi, kufanele ube nomfazi wenkosikazi yakho.
Ngalokho-ke, abesifazane, uma bekhulelwe, kufanele bagqoke izicathulo zabo zesifazane.
Uma uthandana nomfazi wenkosikazi yakho, awukwazi ukuba nendodakazi yakhe.
Uma kukhona umfazi emndenini wakho, ungamnikanga uMoleki; igama likaThixo wakho ngeke uliphuze. Ngimi ikosi.
Uma uthandana nomfazi, kufanele ube nomyeni wakhe begodu uma uthandana nomfazi, kumele ube nomyeni wakhe.
Ngalokho-ke, akufanele uhlangane nanoma iyiphi inhlanzi begodu ube nezinkinga ngaye. Abesifazane kufanele babeke isandla sabo kumuntu ophilayo ukuze babe nobudlelwane naye; lokhu kuyingozi enkulu.
Mhlawumbe ngeke nizihlanze ngazo zonke lezi zinto; njengombana izizwe ezi Uzinquma ukuzikhipha phambi kwenu, zazihlanza ngazo.
Begodu izwe lalimaza, ngathi ngiyiphoqelela inkohliso yayo; begodu izwe likhupha abantu bayo, njengokuba umuntu evuthayo.
Begodu nigcine imibandela yami, namasiko ami; ningakwenza lutho lwazo zonke lezi zinto ezingathandeki, noma ngabe ungumzali wasezweni, noma ngabe unomhlalaphansi phakathi kwenu.
Ngenxa yazo zonke lezi zinto ezingathandeki abantu ababehlala kulolu mhlaba phambi kwenu bazenza, begodu izwe lalimaza.
Uma niyiphazamisa izwe, lizokuxosha, njengokuthi laxosha isizwe esisekhona phambi kwenu.
Wonke umuntu owenza noma iyiphi yalezi izinto ezingathandeki, kufanele ahlukaniswe nabantu bakhe.
Kuze nigcine izimiso zami, bona ningazisebenzisi noma iyiphi yazo zonke izenzo ezingathandeki, ezakwenziwa phambi kwenu; begodu ningabi namanzi ngazo. Ngiye ikosi uzimu wenu.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
Uzokhuluma kubo bonke ibandla lakwaSirayeli, usithi kubo: Nibe bangcwele; ngombana ngingcwele mina, ikosi uzimu wenu.
Uzohlonipha wonke umuntu ubaba wakhe nomama wakhe, begodu uzogcina amalanga zami zokuphumula. Ngiye uzimu wenu ikosi.
Musani ukubhekana namathoyizi, nize nizilungiselele izinhlamvu ezibomvu zemimoya; ngingiNkosi uzimu wenu.
Uma ninikela ngenhlanhla umnikelo wokudla kukaNkulunkulu, kufanele uyinikeze ngendlela efanele, ukuze ivunyelwe.
Kuyodlalwa ngalolusuku lokunikela ngalo, noma ngosuku olulandelayo; kodwana uma kunezinto ezishisayo kuze kube ngusuku lwesithathu, kumele ziqhume emgodini.
Uma kukhona okudlalwa ngalo ngosuku lwesithathu, khona-ke kuyinto engathandeki begodu ayivunyelwanga.
Wonke umuntu ozodla wona, uzothwala inkohliso yakhe; ngenxa yokuthi wenza izinto ezingcwele zikaYehova zibe yizinyamazane zakhe; lowo muntu kufanele ahlukaniswe nabantu bakhe.
Uma uqoqa izithelo zezwe lakho, akufanele uqoqe kuze kuphele isiphetho sendawo yakho yokulima, begodu akufanele ubuye uqoqe imbewu ethosiwe.
Ngiyakutjela bona ngeke uthathe imbewu yewayini lakho, begodu ngeke uqoqe izithelo zayo ezifileyo; uzozishiya kulowo ohlwempu, nakwesolwandle. Ngiye uzimu wenu ikosi.
Musa ukudlwengula. Musa ukusho lutho. Musa ukukhohlisa.
Mhlawumbe nizokhuluma ngegama lami ngokungeqiniso, ningabi necala igama lami uzimu wakho. Ngiye ikosi.
Musa ukuphatha umngane wakho ngendlela engafanele, noma ukumdlwengula. Ungayigcinanga imali yomqashi ekuseni kuze kube ubusuku.
Mhlawumbe ngeke uphuze isidumbu, begodu ngeke ubeke ngaphambili umuntu omnyama into eyenza ukuba ahambe; kodwana uzogwema uzimu wakho. Ngimi ikosi.
Uma ulungisa, akufanele ube necala. Uma ulungisa, akufanele ukhethe omnyama; uma ulungisa, akufanele ukhethe onamandla.
Mhlawumbe ngeke ukhambe ukhuluma ngokungeqiniso ngezwe lakho, begodu angeke ubeke impilo yomngane wakho engozini. Ngimi ikosi.
Mhlawumbe ngeke ugweme inkosikazi yakho enhliziyweni yakho, kodwana kufanele ugweme umngane wakho phambi kwamehlo akho lapho ekhohlwa khona, ukuze ungabi nesibopho sesono sakhe.
Uzothanda umngane wakho njengokuba ukuthanda wena ngokwakho. Ngiye nginguYehova.
Gcwalisa izimiso zami. Ungadlalwa yizilwane ezimbili ezahlukene ndawonye. Ngalokho-ke, ungatshali isitshalo sakho ngezinhlobo ezimbili zembewu. Ungagqoki izingubo ezikhiqizwe ngezinto ezimbili.
Uma umuntu ehlangana nomfazi osemkhondweni wakhe, begodu angeke athengiswe, noma avunyelwe ukuba abe ngumuntu wesifazane, kufanele bagwenywe; kodwana ngeke bafa, ngombana yena akawesabikanga.
Uzoletha indodana yomnqumo kuYehova, emgwaqweni wesitezi sokuhlangana, ibe yisondlo sesono.
Uzothi umbingeleli, ngendodakazi yomnikelo wesono, ayenze inhlanhla kuye phambi koYehova, ngenxa yesono sakhe esenzayo; begodu isono sakhe sizotholwa.
Uma ufika ezweni begodu utshala noma yiluphi uhlobo lomnqumo, bheka izithelo zayo njengezi haramu; iminyaka emithathu izobe iyiharamu kuwe, ngeke nidle.
Ngomnyaka wesine, zonke izithelo zayo zizobe zingcwele, zibe yizipho zokubonga kuYehova.
Ngomnyaka wesishiyagalombili uzokudla umkhiqizo wayo, ukuze umnqumo wakhe ube mkhulu khulu kuwe. Ngiye uzimu wenu ikosi.
Ungadli noma yiluphi uhlobo lwenyama lapho igazi likhona. Ngalokho-ke, ungasebenzisi izimfihlakalo noma uzame ukuchaza okuzokwenzeka.
Ungagquma izinwele ezinhlangothini zekhanda lakho noma ungagquma izingcezu zembeba yakho.
Mhlawumbe nizozibulala, noma nizozishaya izandla zenu, noma nizozibophezela emilenzeni yenu; ngiyami ikosi.
Ungayiphazamisi inkosikazi yakho, uyenze ibe yindodana yowesifazane, ukuze izwe lize libe yindodana yowesifazane, liphele ngobubi.
Zigcineni amalanga zami zokuphumula, niyihlole indawo yami engcwele. Ngiye ikosi.
Musa ukubhekana nalabo abakhuluma ngezinkanyezi, noma nalabo abanezinhlamvu zezulu; ungaba khona kubo, ukuze bangakuhlanza. Ngiye ikosi uzimu wenu.
Uzohlala phambi kwamadoda amakhulu, uzoba nomhloni womuntu omdala; uzogwema uzimu wakho. Ngimi uzimu.
Uma uhlala nawe ezweni lakho umuntu ovela kwamanye amazwe, ngeke ugweme ukumbulala.
Uzothi kulowo ohlala eduze kwakho, njengomuntu owazalwa phakathi kwenu; uzomthanda njengokuba ukuthanda wena ngokwakho; ngombana nibe bangaphandle ezweni laseMiziphu. Ngiye uzimu wenu ikosi.
Ungakhohlisi uma ulinganisela ubude, isisindo noma inani.
Uzosebenzisa izilinganiso ezilungile, nezithako ezilungile, namaphakethe afanele, okushisayo namanzi. Ngiye ikosi uzimu wenu, owabasusa ezweni laseYiputa.
Nizigcine izimiso zami zonke, nemithetho yami yonke, niyenze. Ngiye ikosi.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,

Uthi uNdikhoyo kuMosis, 24"Uzokhuluma kubo bonke abantu baseSirayeli, uthi: 'Uma umuntu othile ezweni lakwaSirayeli noma phakathi kwabanye abahlali bezwe laseSirayeli anikela nganoma yisiphi isizukulwane sakhe emkhondweni kaMoleki, kufanele abulawe. Abantu bomhlaba kumele bagweme ukumbulala ngetshe.
Ngizobhekana nomuntu lowo, ngiwususe emphakathini wakhe, ngenxa yokuthi wamisa indawo yami engcwele, wanikela isizukulwane sakhe ku-Molekhi, ukuze aphuze igama lami elingcwele.
Uma abantu balo mhlaba bebona bona lowo muntu unikeza izingane zakhe ku-Molekh, begodu bangawubulalanga,
Ngizobhekana nomuntu lowo, nendlu yakhe; ngizowususa emphakathini wakhe, naye wonke umuntu olandela uMoleki, engiphula umthetho ngaye, ngiwususe.
Uma umuntu ebhekane nalabo abakhuluma ngezinto eziphilako, noma nalabo abazazelayo, engikhohlakele ngazo, ngizobhekana nomuntu onjalo, begodu ngiwususe emlandweni wakhe.
Bangcwele ke, nibe ngcwele; ngombana ngingiNkosi ikosi uzimu wenu.
Nizigcine izimiso zami, nizisebenzele; ngiyami ikosi owenza ukuba ngungcwele.
Uma umuntu ebulala ubaba wakhe noma umama wakhe, kufanele abulawe; ubaba wakhe noma umama wakhe usewubulale; kumele aphele.
Uma umuntu eqhatha ngenkosikazi yomunye umuntu, nenkosikazi yomngane wakhe, kumele bafa bonke, indodakazi nomfazi.
Uma umuntu ehlangana nendodana yobaba wakhe, ubekezela indodana yobaba wakhe; kumele babulawe bobabili. Kubo icala lokufa kwabo.
Uma umuntu ethandana nenkosikazi yakhe, kumele babulawe bobabili. Bakwenza okumbi khulu; ukubulala kwabo kuzoba yingozi sabo.
Uma umuntu exhumana nomfazi njengomuntu oxhumana nomfazi, khona-ke bobabili bakwenze okumbi khulu. Bazophoqwa ukufa. Ukufa kwabo kuzoba yicala labo.
Uma umuntu ethatha indodakazi yakhe noyise wakhe, kuyinto engalungile; kumele aqhunywe ngomlilo yena nodadewabo bonke, ukuze kungabekho okumbi phakathi kwenu.
Uma umuntu exhumana ngesondo nenyama, kumele abulawa, begodu kufanele ubulala nenyama nayo.
Uma uwesifazane ehamba kumuntu ophilayo ukuze abe nezenzo zocansi naye, kufanele ubulala lowo muntu kanye nomuntu ophilayo. Kudingeka bafa. Ukufa kwabo kuyiphutha labo.

Uma umuntu ethatha inkosikazi yakhe, indodana yobaba wakhe, noma indodana yomama wakhe, bese bebona ikhanda lakhe, kuyinto engalungile; kumele bakhululwe phambi kwamadodana abo; ubeke ikhanda lenkosikazi yakhe emlonyeni wakhe; bazothwala isono sabo.
Uma umuntu ehlangana nendoda ngesikhathi se-hajj yakhe, begodu waveza isisu sakhe, begodu intombazane yabonisa isisu sayo, khona-ke kufanele bahlukaniswe phakathi kwabantu babo.
Uma uthandana nenkosikazi yomama wakho, noma nenkosikazi yobaba wakho, kufanele ugweme ukuzibophezela kulezi zinto, ngombana lokhu kuyingozi empilweni yakho.
Uma umuntu ehlangana nomfazi wenkosikazi yomngane wakhe, umfana womngane wakhe usemfihlakele; bazothwala inkohliso sabo; bazofa bengenabantwana.
Uma umuntu ethatha indodakazi yomngane wakhe, kuyinto engcolileyo; umngane wakhe uphukile; ngeke babe nezingane.
Nizigcine izimiso zami zonke, nemibandela yami yonke, niyenze; ukuze izwe engikulethela lona bona lihlale kulo, lingakuxosha.
Musani ukuhamba ngezimiso zezizwe, engizozisa phambi kwenu; ngenxa yokuthi bazenza zonke lezi zinto, ngalokho ngazixolisa.
Ngitjho kuni, Nizoyithola izwe labo libe yikhaya lenu; begodu ngizokulinika libe yikhaya lenu, izwe elifulathelayo ubisi nojusi. Ngiye uzimu wenu ikosi, owazikhethela phakathi kwamazwe.

Uzokwazi ukuhlukanisa phakathi kwenyama ehlanzekile nenyama engahlanzekile, begodu phakathi kwezinyoni ezihlanzekile nezinyoni ezingahlanzekile, ukuze nize nigweme ukwenza inhliziyo yenu ibe yinhlekelele ngokudla nganoma iyiphi inhlanzi, noma izinyoni, noma izilwane ezihuquzela ngezinyawo, eniyihlukanisile kwenu njengezinto ezingahlanzekile.
Babe bangcwele ngami; ngombana mina, ikosi, ngingcwele, begodu ngiyabahlukanisa nisuka ezizwe zonke, ukuze nibe ngiye.
Umfazi noma umfazi, uma ekhuluma nalabo abafileyo, noma enquma ikusasa labo, kumele abulawe; kufanele abulawe ngetshe. Ukufa kwabo kuyicala labo.
Wathi ikosi kuMoses, Ukhulume nababhishobhi, oonyana baka-Aron, uthi kubo, Akufanele umbhishobhi abe nenyama yomuntu ophilayo phakathi kwabantu bakhe, ukuze ahlanzeke;
ngaphandle komngane osonhlalakahle: ubaba wakhe, indodana yakhe, inkosikazi yakhe, udadewabo,
noma inkosikazi yakhe engabhishi, uhlala ngaphasi kwakhe, ngombana angeke abe nomfazi; ngenxa yakhe angaba nesono.
Akudingeki bona ahlanze ubuso bakhe ngezinto eziphathelene nomndeni wakhe, ukuze angasebenzi emisebenzini engcwele.
Abapristi ngeke baphuze ikhanda labo, noma baphuze amaphiko emilenze sabo, noma baphuze isisu sabo.
Bazobe bengcwele kuThixo wabo, bangabi namahloni igama lakhe; bazonikela ngenhlanhla yomlilo kaYehova, ukudla kukaThixo wabo; ngalokho bazobe bengcwele.
Angeke athathe indodana yowesifazane, noma indodana yowesifazane engahlanzekile, noma indodana yowesifazane eshaywe ngumfazi wakhe; ngombana yena ungcwele kuThixo wakhe.
Ngiyakwenza abe ngungcwele kuwe, ngombana unikeza ukudla kukaThixo wakho; kufanele abe ngungcwele kuwe; ngombana ngingcwele mina, ikosi, owenza nibe ngungcwele.
Uma indodakazi yompristi iphazamisa umndeni wayo, ibe yindodana yowesifazane, iphazamisa ubaba wakhe; kumele iqhutshwe emlilweni.

Omkhulu phakathi kwabazalwane bakhe, owafakwa phezu kwekhanda lakhe uphethiloli wokuncibilikisa, wahlukaniswa ukuba agqoke izicathulo zobungcwele bukambingeleli, ngeke avule izinwele zakhe, begodu ngeke aphuze izicathulo zakhe.
Akudingeki bona afike kumuntu ofile, begodu akudingeki bona abe necala ngenxa yobaba wakhe noma ngenxa yenkosi yakhe.

Akudingeki bona aphume endaweni engcwele, abe nobuhlungu, ukuze angabi yingozi indawo engcwele kaThixo wakhe; ngombana uphethiloli wokuncibilikisa uMoya kaThixo wakhe unesibhakabhaka phezu kwakhe. Ngimi ikosi.
Umfazi owenza umtshali-zimali kumele abe yindodakazi.

Akudingeki bona athathe indodakazi yowesifazane, noma intombazane eshaywe, noma intombazane engahlanjwanga, noma indodana yowesifazane; kodwana kufanele athathe indodakazi yowesifazane phakathi kwabantu bakhe.
ukuze agweme ukudlwengula izingane zakhe phakathi kwabantu bakhe. Ngiye ikosi owenza abe ngcwele.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
Uthi uHaroni, Uzokhuluma ku-Aron, utshilo bona: Wonke umuntu othile emndenini wakho, uma enephutha, angeke afinyelele ukunikela ngokudla kukaThixo wakhe, kuze kube yiminyaka yonke.
Wonke umuntu onenkinga empilweni yakhe, ngeke afike; noma omnyama, noma ophithizelayo, noma onobuso obudlwengulayo, noma obomvu,
akukho mntu onenyawo noma isandla esifile,

akukho umuntu onekhanda elihlanganisiwe noma oncane khulu, akukho muntu onezinkinga zesibhakabhaka, isifo sesikhumba esicasulayo, noma izilonda, begodu akukho muntu ongaba nengxenye yakhe yobumfihlo elahlekile.
Wonke umuntu ovela emndenini ka-Aron, umbingeleli, uma enephutha, angeke afike anikela ngezipho zomlilo zikaYehova; ngombana kukhona iphutha kuye; ngeke afike anikela ukudla kukaThixo wakhe.
Uzokudla ukudla kukaThixo wakhe, ukudla okungcwele khulu nokudla okungcwele.
Kodwana angeke afike emgodini, noma afike esibhedlela; ngombana kukhona okumbi kuye, ukuze angabi nento engcwele yami; ngombana ngimi ikosi oyenza ibe ngungcwele.
Wathi uMoses ku-Aron, nakubo bonke oonyana bakhe, nabo bonke amadodana aseSirayeli.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
Usho ku-Aron namadodana akhe, bona bagcine izinto ezingcwele zakwaSirayeli, abazinikela ngazo kimi; ukuze bangabi necala igama lami elingcwele: Ngiye ikosi.

Uzothi kubo, Uma kukhona umuntu othile emndenini wenu, uma esengenawo uthuli, efinyelela ezinhlamvini ezingcwele, abazinikela ngazo izingane zakwaSirayeli kuYehova, yena lowo muntu uzosuswa phambi kwami; ngiyami ikosi.

Nanoma ngimuphi umuntu emndenini ka-Aron, uma enegciwane, noma isifo sokuphuma kwegazi emlonyeni wakhe, ngeke aphuze izinto ezingcwele, kuze kube sengathi uhlanzekile; nanoma ubani othintana nento enobungozi ngenxa yokufa, noma umuntu onesifo sokukhishwa kwegazi emlonyeni wakhe,
noma wonke umuntu othinta isilwane esihamba ngezinyawo esenza abe mnyama, noma umuntu owenza abe mnyama nganoma iyiphi indlela,
uzobe engcolile kuze kube semini; angadla lutho olungcwele, ngaphandle kokuthi ahlanze umzimba wakhe ngamanzi.
Uma ilanga liphuma, uzohlanzwa; begodu ngemuva kwalokho angadla izinto ezingcwele, ngombana yikudla kwakhe.
Akudingeki bona aphuze inyama ethosiwe, noma ethosiwe izilwane ezifuywayo; ngombana lokhu kuzoba yingozi kuye. Ngiye ikosi.
Bazogcina imithetho yami, ukuze bangabi necala, baphile ngenxa yokuhlukunyezwa kwabo; ngiyami ikosi owenza babe ngcwele.
Wonke umuntu ongaphandle kwendlu kambingeleli angeke aphuze izinto ezingcwele; noma ngubani ohlala nombingeleli, noma ngubani osebenza naye, angazidla.
Uma ke umpristi ethenga umuntu ngemali yakhe, lo muntu uzokudla kiwo; nalabo abazalwa ekhaya lakhe nabo bazodla ukudla kwakhe.
Uma inkosikazi yompristi ishada nomuntu ongeke abe ngumpristi, ngeke akwazi ukudla izipho ezikhethekile ezisuka emithonjeni engcwele.

Uma indodakazi yompristi ibulawe, noma inqatshiwe, ingabi nendodana, yabuyela endlwini yobaba wakhe, iyadla ukudla kukababa wakhe, njengokuba wayencane; kodwana akukho muntu ongaphandle kwendlu yakhe ozodla kiwo.
Uma umuntu edla isonka esingcwele ngephutha, kufanele amnike umnikelo wesono esingcwele, kanye nengxenye yesihlanu.
Abaphazamisi kumele bagweme ukudlwengula izipho ezingcwele abantu bakaSirayeli abazinikela kuYehova.
ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuzidla, ukuze kube yingozi kubo; ngombana ngiyiNkosi eyenza ukuba ngcwele.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,

Usho ku-Aron, nabantwana bakhe, nabo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, usithi kubo: Wonke umuntu ovela ezweni lakwaSirayeli, noma onqunywayo phakathi kwabaseSirayeli, uma enikela ngenhlanhla yakhe emlilweni womlilo kaYehova, nokuba ngumnikelo wakhe wesivivinyo, noma yisipho sakhe esikhululekile.
Ukuze kuvunyelwe kuwe, kumele kube yindoda yengulube, inkomo, noma inkomo engenanto embi ngayo.
Musa ukunikela nganoma yini engekho kahle ngayo, ngombana ngeke ivunyelwe kuwe.

Uma umuntu enikeza umnikelo wokuthula kuYehova, kufaka phakathi izinkomo noma izingulube, ukufeza isibopho sakhe, noma njengesibopho esikhululekileyo, kufanele sibe silungile, ukuze kuvunyelwe; ngeke kube nephutha kulo.

Akufanele ninikeze ikosi isilwane esimnyama, noma esifile, noma esinamacala amancane, noma esinomkhuhlane, noma esinobuhlungu, noma esinamagciwane; akufanele nibeke ngazo zonke lezi zinto phezu kwesibingelelo, njengento yokunikela ngemlilo kukaNkulunkulu.
Ungakwazi ukunikela ngengulube noma inkomo enengxenye yesikhumba eside khulu noma esincane khulu, njengomnikelo onikezelwe ngokukhululekileyo, kodwana ngeke kuvunyelwe ukuba ugcine isinqumo.
Akufanele ninikeze ikosi isilwane esiboshwe, noma esibiwe, noma esilahliwe, noma esicutshiwe; ngeke nikwenze lokhu ezweni lenu.
Ngiyakutjela bona ngeke nizithathe kumuntu wesizwe, ukuze zibe ukudla kukaThixo wenu; ngombana kukhona okumbi kuzo, kunenkinga ngazo; ngeke zithandeke kuwe.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
Uma kuzalwa ingulube, noma inkomo, noma inkomo encane, izohlala ngosuku oluyisixhenxe noyise; kusukela mhla wesibhozo nangaphezulu kuzovunyelwa ukuba ibe yisonka esishiswayo ikosi.
Ungayibulala inkomo noma ingulube ngosuku olufanayo nengane yayo.
Uma ninikela ngomnikelo wokubonga kuYehova, nizonikela ngayo ngendlela efanele, ukuze ivunyelwe kuwe.
Kuyodlalwa ngalolusuku olulodwa; ngeke nishiye lutho kulo kuze kube ubusuku. Ngimi ikosi.
Zigcineni izimiso zami, nizisebenzele. Ngiye ikosi.
Mhlawumbe ngeke niphuze igama lami elingcwele, ukuze ngibhekwe njengongcwele phakathi kwabazalwane bakaSirayeli. Ngiye ikosi owenza kube ngcwele,
owazikhipha ezweni laseYiputa, ukuze ngibe uzimu wenu. Ngiye ikosi."
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
Ukhuluma kubo, usithi: Lawa masuku ami angcwele, amasonto kaYehova, okufanele nizimemezele njengezingqungquthela ezingcwele.

Amalanga eziyisishiyagalombili nizosebenza, kodwana usuku lwesine ngusuku lokuphumula, usuku lokuphumula oluphelele, usuku lokuhlangana olungcwele. Akukho msebenzi omele wenzeke ngalolu suku; liwusuku lokuphumula kukaNkulunkulu kiwo wonke amakhaya akho.
Lezi yizinsuku ezikhethekile zikaYehova, izingqungquthela ezingcwele, okufanele nizazise ngezikhathi zabo.
Usuku lwePasha lukaYehova luqala ngosuku oluyisishiyagalombili lwenyanga yokuqala, lapho ilanga liphuma khona.
Ngomhla wesishiyagalombili wale nyanga, usuku lwezithelo ezingenawo umhluzi kukaNkulunkulu; usuku oluyisixhenxe nidla izithelo ezingenawo umhluzi.
Ngosuku lokuqala, kuzoba khona isibingelelo esingcwele; ngeke nisebenze lutho olujwayelekile.
Amalanga eziyisithupha nizonikela ngenhlanhla ngomlilo kuYehova; ngosuku olusixhenxe kuzobe kukhona isibingelelo esingcwele; ngeke nikwenze msebenzi omusha.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
Ukhuluma kubo, uthi kubo: Uma nifika ezweni engikunika lona, begodu niyivuna imbewu yayo, nizoletha kumbingeleli inkomishi eyodwa yezinto zokuqala zembewu yenu.
Uzowushaya umquba phambi kweNkosi, ukuze uvunyelwe kuwe; ngosuku olulandelayo ngeSonto, uzowushaya umquba, ukuze uvumeleke kuwe.
Ngosuku olulodwa lokwethula inkomishi, kufanele ninikeze ingulube eneminyaka eyodwa ubudala, engabi necala, ibe yisonka esishiswayo kuYehova.
Nakho uzoba nesibopho sokudla, ilitha elilodwa lomhluzi omuncu oxhumene nophethiloli, njengomnikelo wokushiswa kuYehova, njengephunga elimnandi, kanye nelitha elilodwa lomhluzi wokudla.

Ungadla inkomishi, noma imbewu ethosiwe, noma imbewu ehlanzekile, kuze kube yilapho ninikela ngayo umnikelo wokudla kuThixo wenu; kumele kube wumthetho ohlala isikhathi eside phakathi kosuku nosuku, kuzo zonke izindawo zendlu yenu.
Ngosuku olulandelayo iSabhati, ngosuku lapho niletha khona inkomishi yengulube yokuthuthuka, nizobala izinyanga eziyisithupha.
Uzobala amalanga eziyisishiyagalombili, kuze kube usuku olulandelayo ngeSonto lesixhenxe; khona-ke uzoletha umnikelo wokudla wembewu entsha kuYehova.

Nakwezinye izakhiwo zendlu yenu, nizothola amakhowe amabili okudla okunqunyelwe umnikelo wokudla, afakwe i-epha yobisi oluhlanzekile, aphekwe nge-lemongrass; kuzoba ngumnikelo wokushiswa kuYehova, ovela emidlalweni yembewu yenu.

Nase ulungiselele, kanye nenyama, izinkomo ezimbili ezineminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ubudala, ezingabi nephutha, nomntwana omncane wesifazane owodwa, nezimvu ezimbili; zibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa kuYehova, kanye nomnikelo wazo wokudla, nama-odolo abo okuphuza, isipho esiqhutshwa ngomlilo, isiphunga elimnandi kuYehova.
Uzonikela ngobhontshisi owodwa njengomnikelo wesono, nezingulube ezimbili ezineminyaka eyodwa ubudala, zibe yizipho zoxolo.
Umbingeleli uzozisakaza izinkomo ezimbili, kanye nenyama yezinto zokuqala zokuvuna, phambi kweNkosi; zingcwele kuYehova, zizobe ziwumnikelo wokudla kambingeleli.
Kuzobe kukhona isibingelelo esingcwele kulolu suku; ngeke nikwenze umsebenzi ojwayelekile. Kuzoba ngumthetho ohlala isikhathi eside emindenini yenu yonke, kiwo wonke amadolobhana akho.
Uma nivuna izithelo zezwe lenu, ngeke nivune kuze kuphele isiphetho somhlaba wakho, begodu ngeke niqoqe imbewu ethosiwe; uzoyishiya yowesifazane nalowo ovela kwamanye amazwe. Ngiye ikosi uzimu wenu.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,

Uthi uNdikhoyo kuMosis, 21"Ukhulume nabantu bakaSirayeli uthi: Ngonyaka wesixhenxe ngomhla wokuthoma wenyanga kumele kube khona usuku lokuphumula oluphelele; kufanele kube nengqungquthela engcwele yokukhumbuza ngezingcingo.
Akufanele nikwenze umsebenzi ojwayelekile, kodwana ninikeze umnikelo wokushiswa kuYehova.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
Ngomhla wesishiyagalombili wale nyanga yesixhenxe, ngusuku lokuxoshwa, usuku lokulungisa; kumele kube khona isibingelelo esingcwele; kufanele niphumule, ninikeze umnikelo wokushiswa kuYehova.
Akukho msebenzi ozowenza ngalolusuku, ngombana ngusuku lokuxoshwa, ukuze ubuyiselwe kuYehova uzimu wakho.
Wonke umuntu ongeke ahlale engadla ukudla ngalolu busuku, kumele ahlukaniswe nabantu bakhe.
Nalowo wonke umuntu owenza umsebenzi onke ngalolu suku, ngiwususa emphakathini wakhe.
Akufanele nisebenze lutho. Le yimithetho uhlala isikhathi eside yomndeni wenu wonke, lapho nihlala khona.
Amalanga zeSabhati zokuphumula ezigcwele zizobe zikhona kuwe; ngeke nidle ukudla; kusukela ngemini yesithoba yenyanga, emini, kuze kube ekuseni, kumele nizigcine.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
Uthi uMosis kuSirayeli: "Kule nyanga yesixhenxe, ngomhla ka-15 wonyaka, amalanga eziyisishiyagalombili kuzoqala usuku lwezindlu zangasese loNkulunkulu.
Ngosuku lokuqala, kuzoba khona isibingelelo esingcwele; ngeke nisebenze lutho olujwayelekile.

Ngezinsuku ezisithupha ninikeze umnikelo wokushiswa kuYehova. Ngosuku lwesibhozo nibe nengqungquthela engcwele, ninikeze umnikelo wokushiswa kuYehova; kuyingqungquthela ekhethekile; ngeke nikwenze msebenzi ojwayelekile.

Lezi yizinsuku ezingcwele zikaYehova, omele nizimemezele zibe izingqungquthela ezingcwele, ukuze ninikeze umnikelo wokushiswa kukaNkulunkulu, isonka esiqhumayo, nesibopho sokudla, nezibopho zokudla, nezibopho zokuphuza, ngosuku ngalunye.
Lezo zinto zihlanganisa nezinsuku zokuphumula zikaYehova, nezipho zenu, nazo zonke izibopho zenu, nezibopho zenu ezithandekayo, niziveze kukaNkulunkulu.

Ngomhla wesishiyagalombili wenyanga yesixhenxe, lapho nizoqoqa khona izithelo zezwe, kufanele nigcine isikhumbuzo sikaYehova amalanga ezisithupha; usuku lokuqala kumele lube wusuku lokuphumula, begodu usuku lwesine kumele lube usuku lokuphumula.
Ngosuku lokuqala nizothatha ubisi oluhle lwezihlahla, amaqabunga omnqumo, namaqabunga akhanyayo, nama-willows asuka emfuleni; begodu nizojabulela phambi koYehova uzimu wenu amalanga ezisithupha.
Niyigcine amalanga ezisixhenxe ngonyaka wonke, ibe ngusuku lokuphumula kuYehova; kube yisinqumo esihlala isikhathi eside phakathi komndeni wenu wonke. Kunyanga yesithupha niyigcine.
Nihlale ezindaweni zokuhlala usuku oluyisixhenxe. Wonke umuntu ozalwa eSirayeli kumele ahlale ezindaweni zokuhlala,
ukuze bakwazi izingane zenu ngemuva kwenu, bona ngibeke amadodana aseSirayeli ezindaweni zokuhlala, lapho ngawakhipha ezweni laseYiputa; ngiyami ikosi uzimu wenu.
Wathi uMoses kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli ngezinsuku zosuku lokuphumula likaYehova.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
Uthi uMosis kuSolomoni: "Ubatshele abantu bakaSirayeli bona bakulethe uphethiloli ohlanzekile we-olive, okhishwe ngesandla, ukuze kwenziwe izibani, ukuze zihlale zishisa.

Esitezi sokubambisana, ngaphandle kwethenda elibhekene nebhokisi lesivumelwano, uAron kufanele agcine izibani zishisayo phambi koYehova, kusukela emini kuze kube ngasekuseni, njalo. Kuzoba ngumthetho ohlala isikhathi eside kubo bonke abahlobo bakho.
Uzogcina izibani zesibhakabhaka esihlanzekile, nsuku zonke, phambi koYehova.
Nciphisa umhluzi bese ubhaka izinkomishi ezingu-12, usebenzisa amakhilogremu amathathu omhluzi ngayinye.
Uzozibeka emgqeni owodwa, ezinhlanu emgqeni owodwa, phezu kwetafula legolide elihlanzekile phambi koYehova.
Uzobeka umnqumo ohlanzekile eduze komugqa ngamnye, ukuze kube yindawo yokukhumbula isonka, ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa kuYehova.
Ngosuku ngalunye lwesiSonto kumele kube khona umnikelo wokudla obekwe phambi kukaNkulunkulu, nsuku zonke. Kuye kwaba ngumthetho wamaSirayeli kuze kube sekupheleni.
Kuzoba ngukudla kuka-Aron, nokudla kwamadodana akhe; bazokula endaweni engcwele. Yinto engcwele khulu phakathi kwezinto ezitholwe ngomlilo kuYehova, isinqumo sabo esihlala njalo.
Kwabe kukhona umuntu umfazi waseSirayeli, begodu ubaba wakhe ubengumYiputa; waphuma waya phakathi kwamadodana kaSirayeli, kwaqala ukungqubuzana phakathi kwakhe nomfazi wesiSirayeli esikhungweni.
Wakhuluma unyana wale ndodakazi yaseSirayeli igama likaNkulunkulu, wathi: "Igama lami lihlanzekile." Bamwisela kuMoses. Igama lonina lalinguShelomithi, intombi kaDibri, waseDhani.
Babeka ngaphasi kwengcindezi, kuze kube yilapho ikosi awazise khona bona bakwenzeni.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
Uzokhipha umprofeti ngaphandle kwesiqhingi; bonke abakubonayo babeke izandla zabo phezu kwekhanda lakhe, begodu ibandla lonke ligweme.
Uzokhuluma kubo bonke amadodana aseSirayeli, ukusho bona, Wonke umuntu obulala uzimu wakhe, uzothwala isono sakhe.
Wonke umuntu okhuluma ngegama likaYehova, kufanele aphele; ibandla lonke kumele ligweme. Uma ekhuluma ngegama lakhe, noma ngabe ungumzweli, noma ngabe uzalwa kulo mhlaba, kufanele aphile.
Wonke umuntu obulala omunye umuntu kumele abulawa.
Wonke umuntu obulala inhlanzi yomuntu kufanele ayibuyisele, impilo ngempilo.
Uma umuntu ebulala umngane wakhe, kufanele kwenzeke kuye okufanayo nokwenza kwakhe:
ithambo elibusayo ngethambo elibusayo, intamo ngesandla, inkomo ngengulube; nanoma yikuphi ukudlwengula akwenzayo, kumele kwenziwe kuye.
Uma umuntu ebulala inhlanzi, kumele ayibuyisele; kodwana uma umuntu ebulala umuntu, kufanele abulawa.
Umthetho owodwa uzobe ukhona phakathi kwenu, phakathi komhlali nomuntu ozalwa kulo mhlaba; ngimi ikosi uzimu wenu.
Wathi uMoses kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, bathi: "Bamkhipha ngaphandle kwesiqhingi lowo obulalayo, bamwisela amatshe, wafa." Bakwenza njalo, njengombana ikosi abewisela umthetho uMoses.
Wakhuluma ikosi kuMoses emfuleni iSina, wathi,
Uthi uMosis kuSolomoni: "Ukhulume nabantu bakaSirayeli, uthi kubo: 'Uma nifika ezweni engikunika lona, izwe lizophumula, libe yiSabhati kaYehova.
iminyaka eyisishiyagalombili uzotshala iimila zakho, begodu uzomisa izivini zakho, begodu uzoqoqa imbewu yazo.

Kodwana ngonyaka wesixhenxe kumele ube wusuku lokuphumula oluphelele lwezwe, usuku lokuphumula kukaNkulunkulu; awukwazi ukutshala izihlahla zakho kulo nyaka, begodu awukwazi ukusika izimbali zakho zewayini.
Uma uvuna imbewu ekhula ngayo, ungayiqoqi, begodu uma uvuna izithelo zesihlahla sakho sewayini esingeke sihlolwe, ungaziqoqi; kumele kube ngunyaka wokuphumula kwezwe.
Wonke umkhiqizo ovela ezweni ngesikhathi sosuku lwakhe lokuphumula uzoba ukudla kwenu, nani nabangani bakho, nabangani benu, nalabo abasebenza ngemali yenu, nalowo ohlala phakathi kwenu.
Kuzoba yindawo yokudla yezilwane zakho, nezilwane eziphila ezweni lakho; konke okuvela kuyo kuzodlalwa.
Uzobala iminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili yesiSonto, iminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili kanye neminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalolunye.
Ngonyaka wesixhenxe, ngomhla wamashumi wenyanga yesishiyagalombili, uzophonsa isibhamu esinamandla; ngemini yokuhlanza, uzophonsa isibhamu ezweni lakho lonke.

Uzomisa unyaka oyisishiyagalombili, ube ngusuku olungcwele; uzomemezela inkululeko ezweni lonke, kiwo wonke umuntu ohlala kulo. Lo nyaka uzobe wumnyaka weshumi nesishiyagalombili kwenu; nizobuya niya ezweni lemindeni yenu, niye ezindlini zemindeni yenu.

Unyaka oyisishiyagalombili uzobe ngumnyaka weminyaka eyisishiyagalolunye kuwe; ngeke nitshale, begodu ngeke nikhulise lokho okukhulela ngokuzimela, begodu ngeke niqoqe izithelo zezimbali zesilimo esingenakulinywa.
Yiminyaka eyisishiyagalombili, ibe ngusuku olungcwele kuwe. Ukudla kwakho kufanele kube yizinto eziphilako zesihlabathi.
Kulesi sikhathi sonyaka omusha, wonke umuntu phakathi kwenu kufanele abuye ezweni lakhe.
Uma uthengisa izwe umngane wakho, noma uma uthenga izwe kuye, awudingi ukukhohlisa.
Uma uthenga kusuka kumngane wakho, hlela intengo ngenani leminyaka kusukela kwiJubilee edlule. Uzohlela izindleko zakhe zokuthengisa ngokuya ngenani lokudla okusele.
Uma kuneminyaka eminingi esele, intengo iyaphezulu. Uma kuneminyaka embalwa kuphela esele, intengo iyaphansi. Okusho bona uthengisa inani lezithelo.
Mhlawumbe nizokhohlisana, kodwana nigweme uzimu wenu; ngombana ngingiNkosi uzimu wenu.
Nizigcine izimiso zami, nizigcine imithetho yami, begodu nihlale ezweni eliphephile.
Izwe lizonikela ngembewu yayo, nidla ngokupheleleko inhliziyo yenu, nihlale khona niphephile.
Uma nithi, Sizodla kuphi ngonyaka wesixhenxe, uma singatshalanga, siyiqoqa kanjani imbewu yethu?
Ngonyaka wesishiyagalombili ngizokulethela insindiso yami phezu kwenu, ukuze izwe likhiqize izithelo zeminyaka emithathu.
Uma utshala ngonyaka oyisishiyagalombili, uzoqhubeka nokudla izithelo zakudala. Uzoqhubeka nokudla ukudla okudala kuze kube yilapho imbewu yonyaka wesithoba ifika.
Izwe alithengiswe kangako, ngombana izwe lingane yami; niyimihlali nabangani engangihlala nabo.
Kuyo yonke indawo ezweni lakho, kufanele uvumele bona izwe lithengiswe kabutjha.
Uma umuntu othile phakathi kwenu efisa ukuthengisa ingxenye yembewu yakhe, kufanele afike umngane wakhe ongasekho begodu athenge.
Uma engeke abe nomuntu ozoyithenga kabutjha, kodwana ekugcineni akwenze kahle begodu abe nemali eyaneleyo yokuyithenga kabutjha yena,
uzobala iminyaka edlule kusukela lapho athengise khona, begodu ubuyisele umuntu owathengisa kuye izindleko zeminyaka esele; bese ubuyela ezweni lakhe.
Uma engakwazi ukuyothenga, khona-ke le ndawo izohlala yomuntu othengise yona kuze kube yiminyaka yenkulumo enkulu; ngonyaka wenkulumo enkulu izobuyiselwa kuye, aze abuye ezweni lakhe.
Uma umuntu ethengisa indlu emzini onezindonga, uzoba nonyaka owodwa ogcwele ngemuva kokuthengiswa kwayo bona ayithengise kabutjha. Uzokwazi ukuyithenga emuva ngonyaka owodwa.

Uma kungekho ukubuyiselwa kulo nyaka wonke, khona-ke ikhaya elisemaphandleni elinezindonga lizohlala liyimpahla yomuntu othengayo, nomndeni wakhe ngemuva kwakhe, kuze kube yiminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili; ngeke libuyiselwe.
Kodwana izindlu ezindaweni ezingenazingqalasizinda, zibhekwa njengezitshalo zendawo yasendle; zingathengwa begodu, kufanele zibuyiselwe emkhosini wonyaka omusha.
Kodwana-ke, labo abaLevi bangathenga kabutjha izakhiwo zabo ezindaweni zabo zokuhlala.

Uma ikhaya likaLevi lithengiswe, begodu lingabuyiselwa emuva, noma yikuphi phakathi kwamadolobha abo, kufanele liphinde libuyiselwe emuva ngonyaka weshumi nesishiyagalombili; ngombana izindlu zezindawo zakwaLevi ziyindawo sabo yobunikazi phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli.
Kodwana imifula sabo, nezindawo zabo zokudlela ezijikeleze idolobhana labo, ngeke zithengiswe; ngombana yindawo sabo uhlala kuyo.
Uma umuntu esinye sezingxenye zenu etholakale emnothweni begodu engakwazi ukukhokhela izidingo zakhe, khona-ke umnikeze usizo; ahlale nawe njengomuntu ovela kwelinye izwe noma njengomhambi.
Musa ukuwubeka phezu kwakhe umshwalense, noma uthathe inzuzo kuye; kodwana ugweme uzimu wakho, ahlale phakathi kwakho.
Ungamnikezi imali ngemvuzo, begodu ungamthengi ukudla ukuze uthole inzuzo.
Ngiye ikosi uzimu wenu, owazikhuphule ezweni laseYiputa, ukuze ngikunike izwe likaKanana, ngibe uzimu wenu.
Uma umuntu esinye sezingxenye zenu efisa ukuhweba ngokwakhe kuwe, akufanele ukwenze abe ngumkhonzi.
Uzosebenza naye njengomuntu okhokhelwa umsebenzi, noma njengomhambi ohlala nawe; uzosebenzela wena kuze kube ngunyaka weminyaka emibili.
Uzokwazi ukuphuma kuwe, yena nobantwana bakhe, babuye emndenini wabo, bebuyela ezweni lababa babo.
Bami abantu bakaSirayeli, abakhonzi bam, abaye baphuma ezweni laseYiputa; ngeke bathengiswe njengamakhoboka.
Musa ukumlawula ngokubi, kodwana ukhathazeke ngoNkulunkulu wakho.
Amakhosikazi akho namadodakazi akho azovela ezizweni ezingcezu zenu; kuzona uzothenga amakhosikazi.
Nasezinganeni zabanye abantu abahlala phakathi kwenu, nizothenga kubo, nasezintwini zabo ezizalwa ezweni lenu; begodu bazobe yimpahla yenu.
Uzokwazi ukuzishiya zibe yimpahla yabantwana bakho ngemuva kwakho, bahlale besebenza kuwe nsuku zonke; kodwana ngeke ugweme ukuphatha abazalwane bakho ngesandla esibi.
Uma umuntu ovela kwelinye izwe, noma umuntu ohlala ezweni lakho, ethola ubuhle, begodu omunye wabangane bakho, uma ethola ububi, ethengisa yena kuye, noma kulowo muntu ovela kwelinye izwe.
Uma ethengiswe, khona-ke uzokwazi ukubuyiselwa emuva; omunye wabangane bakhe angawuthenga kabutjha.
noma umyeni wakhe, noma inkosikazi yakhe, noma omunye omndenini wakhe. Okanye uma ethola izimali, angazikhokhela.

Uzobala iminyaka yakhe, yena nomuntu owathengayo, kusukela ngonyaka lapho wathengisa khona ngokwakhe, kuze kube ngunyaka weminyaka eyisishiyagalombili. Intengo yokukhululwa kwakhe izomiswa ngokuya ngenani leminyaka, njengokuba wayekhokhelwa njengomsebenzi okhokhelwayo ngalo nyaka.
Uma sekusele iminyaka eminingi, kufanele abuyisele emuva ingxenye enkulu yentengo ayethengwa ngayo.
Uma ihlala iminyaka embalwa kuphela kuze kube yiminyaka yosuku lokuzalwa, kufanele ayibalo begodu abuyisele inani elincane, ngokuya ngeminyaka ekhona.
Kudingeka athathwe njengomsebenzi osebenza ngonyaka nonyaka. Kudingeka uqiniseke bona umnikazi wakhe akalawulanga ngaye ngokubi.
Uma engabuyiselwa nganoma iyiphi yalezi le, khona-ke kufanele aphume yena nezingane zakhe ngonyaka weminyaka eyisishiyagalombili.
Ngokuba izingane zakwaSirayeli ziyimisebenzi yami; ziyimisebenzi yami, ngazikhipha ezweni laseYiputa. Ngiye ikosi uzimu wenu.
Mhlawumbe ngeke nikwenze izigodlo-mlilo, noma nibeke isithombe esicwebezelayo, noma isibonisi, noma nibeke ezweni lenu itshe elicwebezelayo, ukuze nizibophezele kulo; ngombana ngimi ikosi uzimu wenu.
Zigcineni amalanga zami zokuphumula, niyihlole indawo yami engcwele. Ngiye ikosi.
Uma nihamba ngezimiso zami, nithobe imiyalo yami,
Ngizokulethela imvula ngesikhathi sayo, begodu izwe lizonikeza izithelo zayo, namajikijolo ezindaweni zomhlaba azonikela ngembewu yawo.

Uma uvuna izithelo zakho, uzozigcina kuze kube yisikhathi sokuvuna imbewu; begodu uma uvuna imbewu yakho, uzozigcina kuze kube yisikhathi sokulima. Uzokudla ukudla okugcwele, begodu uzohlala ezweni lakho ngokuphephile.
Ngizobeka ukuthula ezweni, begodu nizophumula, begodu akukho muntu ozokukhathaza; ngizosusa izinyamazane ezibulalayo ezweni, begodu umkhosi awuzodlula ezweni lenu.
Uzolandela izitha zakho, begodu bazobulawa ngekhebula phambi kwakho.
Abantu abahlanu phakathi kwenu bazolandela amakhulu, begodu abantu abangukhulu phakathi kwenu bazolandela amawaka angama-10. Abaphikisi bakho bazobulawa ngeqhwa phambi kwenu.
Ngizobhekana nawe, begodu ngizokwenza ube mkhulu, begodu ngizokwenza ukhule, begodu ngizogcina umnqophiso wami nawe.
Uzohlala udla izithelo zonyaka odlule uma ufuna ukuzihlanza ukuze wenze indawo yezitshalo ezintsha.
Ngizobeka ikhaya lami phakathi kwenu, begodu ngeke ngikushiye.
Ngizohamba phakathi kwenu, begodu ngizoba uzimu wenu, nibe abantu bam.
Ngimi ikosi uzimu wenu, owazikhuphule ezweni laseYiputa, ukuze ningabi ngabakhonzi babo; begodu ngibopha izintambo ezishisayo ezandleni zenu, ngakwenza nihambe ngekhanda liphakeme.
Uma ke ningangilalela, nikwenze la mazwi onke,
uma niyikhohlisa imibandela yami, noma ningathandabuzi izimiso zami, noma ningeke nigcine yonke imiyalelo yami, ukuze niphuze umnqophiso wami;

Ngizokwenza lokhu kuwe: ngizokulethela ubuhlungu obungenakulindeleka, isifo esibulalayo, negciwane elibulalayo, ukuze amehlo akho aphuze, begodu umoya wakho uphuze. Uzotshala isitshalo sakho ngaphandle kokudla, ngombana izitha zakho zizozidla.
Ngizobhekana nawe, begodu izitha zakho zizokunqoba; labo abakukhohlisayo bazokuba ngubukhosi bakho; begodu uzohamba, nakuba akukho ozokulandela.
Uma nami, nalokhu konke, ningilalelanga, ngizokuzibophezela kuni ngokuphindaphindiwe izikhathi ezisixhenxe ngenxa yezinkohliso zenu.
Ngizophula ikhono lakho eliphakeme, begodu ngizokwenza bona umoya ophezulu kwakho ube njengensimbi, angabi nemvula; begodu indawo engaphansi kwakho ibe namandla afana negolide.
Zonke izenzo zesandla sakho zizoba yingozi, ngombana izwe lakho alizosinikeza isitshalo sayo, namajikijolo akho ngeke athole ubisi lwawo.
Uma niqhubeka nihamba ngami, begodu ningathandanga ukungilalela, ngizokuzibophezela ekuphileni kwenu izibulala-zinambuzane izikhathi ezisixhenxe, ngokwezinkohliso zenu.
Ngizothumela phakathi kwenu izinyamazane zendabuko, zithathe izingane zenu, ziqhekeze izinkomo zenu, zibe nenani elincane kuwe; begodu imizila yenu izoba yindawo yokungena.
Uma, begodu ngemuva kwalezi zinto, ngeke nibuye ngami, kodwana nizoqhubeka nihamba ngokuphikisana nami;
begodu ngizohamba ngaphezu kwenu; begodu ngizokuhlasela nani kathathu namashumi asixhenxe ngenxa yezinsolo zenu.

Ngizokulethela inkohlakalo phezu kwenu, ngenxa yokuhlukunyezwa komnqophiso wami; begodu uma niphuma ezindaweni zenu, ngizothumela ubhubhane phakathi kwenu, begodu nizobekwa esidlangalaleni ezimpini zenu.
Kuze kube yilapho ngizokucisha khona inkomishi yenu yokudla, besifazane abalishumi baya kubhaka ubisi lwakho emgodini owodwa; begodu bazokubuyisela ngosayizi; uzokudla, kodwana ngeke uzidle.
Uma, ngalokhu konke, ningeke ningilalela, kodwana nizoqhubeka nihamba ngaphezu kwami;
begodu ngizohamba ngamehlo ami enhliziyweni yami; begodu ngizokuphoqelela amalanga ezisixhenxe ngenxa yezinto zenu.
Uzokudla inyama yamadodana akho namakhosikazi akho.
Ngizophula izindlu zenu eziphakeme, begodu ngizobopha izingosi zenu zomlilo, begodu ngizobeka izicubu zenu phezu kwezicubu zezicubu zezinhlamvu zenu, begodu ngizobuya ngami enhliziyweni yami.
Ngizozenza izifundazwe zenu zibe yizikhukhula, nezindawo zenu ezingcwele zibe yindawo elahlekile; begodu ngeke ngijabulele iphunga elimnandi lezinto zenu.
Ngizoyenza izwe lakho libe yindawo engenalutho, ukuze nabo bonke abasolwa bakho abafikayo ukuba bahlale kuyo, bakhathazeke.
Ngizokusakaza phakathi kwezizwe, begodu ngizokhipha ikhebula lami, ngizokulandela; izwe lakho lizoba yindawo elahlekile, namadolobha akho azoba yizikhukhula.
Ngazo zonke amalanga lapho izwe lihlala khona elingenalutho, nisezweni labangani benu, lizojabulela iminyaka yayo yesiSonto; izwe lizophumula, lizojabulela iziSonto zayo.
Isikhathi soke lapho ihlala khona ingasebenzi, izokwazi ukuphumula njengombana bekungazange kwenzeke eminyakeni yenu yeSabhati lapho nihlala khona.

Nalabo abasele phakathi kwenu, ezweni labathandi bakho, ngizobaphazamisa; begodu iphunga lembewu elifihliwe emkhathini lizobaphazamisa; begodu bazophazanyiswa njengephazamiseka kweqhwa, begodu bazowela, nakuba akukho ozowalandela.
Bazophoqeleka ukuba bahambe ngabanye, njengabahamba phambi kweqhwa, naphezu kokuba akukho ozowalandela; begodu ngeke nikwazi ukumelana nabaphikisi benu.
Uzofa phakathi kwezizwe, begodu izwe labathandi bakho lizokutholisa.
Nalabo abasele phakathi kwenu, bazophuza igazi labo ezweni labathandi benu, ngenxa yobubi babo, begodu ngenxa yobubi bamababa abo.
Bazovuma ubugebengu babo, nobugebengu bamababa abo, ngokwenza okumbi ngami, begodu behamba ngokuphikisana nami;
begodu, uma inhliziyo sabo ephakeme ihamba phasi, begodu bathathe ukuvinjwa kwabo ngenxa yobubi babo,
Ngizokhumbula isivumelwano sami noYakobi, begodu isivumelwano sami noIsake, begodu isivumelwano sami noAbrahamu; ngizokhumbula nezwe.

Izwe lizoshiywa libe yindawo elahlekile ngenxa sabo, lijabulele amalanga zayo zokuphumula, uma lihlala lilahlekile ngaphandle kwabo; begodu labo bazozizwa beshonile ngenxa yobugebengu babo, ngenxa yokuthi bagweme izimiso zami, begodu bazixolele izenzo zam.
Nokho nalapho, lapho bekhona ezweni lababushizi babo, ngeke ngibaphuze, noma ngibabandezele, kuze kube wukuphela kwabo, kuze kube wukuphelelwa umnqophiso wami nabo; ngombana ngiwuYehova uzimu wabo.
Ngizokhumbula, ngenxa sabo, umnqophiso wami nababa babo, abebephuma ezweni laseYiputa phambi kwezizwe zonke, ukuze ngibe uzimu wabo; mina uzimu.
Lawa amalungiselelo, namasiko, nezimiso, akhuluma ngazo ikosi emfuleni iSina, ngesandla sikaMoses, phakathi kwakhe nomndeni kaSirayeli.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
Ukhuluma kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, usithi kubo: Uma umuntu enikela ngesipho esikhethekile, bona anikezele umuntu kuYehova, kufanele akhokhele ixabiso lakhe.
Uma umuntu eneminyaka engu-20 kuya ku-60 ubudala, isisindo sakhe kufanele sibe ngamaphesenti angama-50 wegolide, ngokuya ngenani elisemthethweni lendawo enhle.
Uwesifazane onobude obunjalo, ixabiso elisetshenzisiwe liyingxenye ezingu-30 zesiliva.
Kumuntu oneminyaka emihlanu kuya kwengu-20 ubudala, inani elisetshenzisiwe liyizingxenye eziyisishiyagalombili zegolide lowesifazane nozinhlamvu ezilishumi zomfana.
Ngengane eneminyaka engunyaka owodwa kuya kweyisihlanu ubudala, inani elisetshenzisiwe liyizingxenye eziyisishiyagalombili zesiliva lowesifazane kanye nezingxenye amathathu zegolide lentombazane.
Uma umuntu eneminyaka engu-60 ubudala noma ngaphezulu, ixabiso elisetshenzisiwe liyizinhlamvu ezingu-15 zesilivere kumuntu wesifazane kanye nezingcezu eziyisishiyagalombili kwabesifazane.

Uma umuntu encane khulu, angeke akwazi ukukhokha inani elilinganiselwe, kufanele afike kumbingeleli, begodu umbingeleli azolilinganisela; umbingeleli uzolilinganisela ngokuya ngalokho owenza isibopho.
Uma isinqumo siyinyama evunyelwe umnikelo wokudla kukaNkulunkulu, khona-ke noma iyiphi lenyama enikezwe ikosi izobe iyingcwele.
Akudingeki bona ayishintshe noma ayiguqule, engcono ngenye ebi noma ebi ngenye ebi. Uma eshintsha inyamazane enye ngenye, khona-ke inyamazane kanye nenyamazana elishintshiwe lizoba ngcwele.
Uma umnikelo wakho wokudla ube yinyama engalungile, engeke inikezelwe kukaNkulunkulu, kufanele uyiveze kumpristi.
Umbingeleli uzothi uma kulungile noma kubi, lokho okusho umbingeleli kumele kube yiqiniso.
Uma umnikazi efuna ukuyithenga kabutjha, kufanele akhokhele ixabiso layo kanye nengxenye yesithupha.

Uma umuntu enikela ngendlu yakhe ibe ngumnikelo ongcwele kuYehova, khona-ke umbingeleli uzoyilinganisela, bona iyilungile yini noma ayibi; njengombana umbingeleli egcizelela ngayo, njalo kufanele ihlukaniswe.
Uma lowo owanikela ngendlu efuna ukuyithenga kabutjha, kufanele akhokhele ixabiso layo kanye nengxenye yesishiyagalombili yazo, bese izobe yakhe.

Uma umuntu enikela ngengxenye yendawo yakhe yomndeni wakhe kuYehova, khona-ke kufanele ubalolwe ngokwenani lembewu elidingekayo ukutshala kuyo: amaphesenti ayisishiyagalombili esiliva ngamakhulu amabili amashumi amane amalitha embewu yeshubhu.
Uma enikeza indawo yakhe kunyaka we-Jubilee, inani eliphelele leset likhona.

Uma enikeza indawo yakhe ngemuva konyaka omusha, khona-ke umbingeleli kufanele alinganise intengo yayo ngokuya ngenani leminyaka elisele kuze kube ngunyaka omusha olandelayo; begodu ixabiso lakhe lizoncishiswa.
Uma lowo owanikela ngendawo efuna ukuyithenga kabutjha, kufanele akhokhele ixabiso layo kanye nengxenye yesishiyagalombili, begodu izobe yakhe.
Kodwana uma akayithenga kabutjha indawo, noma uma ithengiswe omunye umuntu, ayikwazi ukuthengwa emuva.
Uma isitshalo siphuma enyaka omusha, kufanele sibe ngcwele kuYehova, njengesitshalo esinikezwe umnikelo wokudla; kumele ibe yiyo yamaLevi.
Uma umuntu enikela kukaNkulunkulu indawo athengise yona, engase ibe yindawo yomndeni wakhe,
umbingeleli uzobala isilinganiso sayo kuze kube ngunyaka weminyaka eyisishiyagalombili. Umuntu kufanele akhokhele le ntengo ngalolusuku olulodwa, njengomnikelo ongcwele kuYehova.
Ngonyaka we-Jubilee, indawo izobuyela kumuntu owathenga yona kuye, umuntu obeyindawo yemindeni yakhe.
Zonke izibalo ezisetshenzisiwe kufanele zisebenzise ubunzima obusemthethweni bendawo engcwele, amasisindo ancane angama-20 kinanyana iyiphi ingxenye yegolide.
Kodwana umuntu angeke anikeze umzali wesifazane wenyama, ngombana umzali wesifazane nguwe ikosi; noma ngabe ingulube, noma ngabe inkomo, yiyo yoNkulunkulu.

Uma kuyinyama engahlanzekile, umnikazi ungayithenga kabutjha ngokukhokha ixabiso layo elisetshenzisiwe kanye nengxenye yesihlanu engaphezulu. Uma ingathengiswanga emuva, kufanele ithengiswe ngentengo yayo esetshenzisiwe.

Uma umuntu enikela ngokupheleleko kuYehova ngezinto zakhe, nokuba ngumuntu, noma ibe yinyama, noma ibe yindawo yomndeni wakhe, ngeke ithengiswe, begodu ngeke ibuyiselwe; yonke into enikezwe ngokupheleleko ngale le ingcwele khulu kukaNkulunkulu.
Uma umuntu enikezelwe ukufa, ngeke kubuyiselwe emuva; kumele abulawe ngokupheleleko.
Ishumi lazo zonke izinto ezikhiqizwa yizwe, nokuba yimbewu yezulu noma imbewu yomthi, liyilungelo likaYehova; lingcwele kukaNkulunkulu.
Uma umuntu efuna ukuthenga emuva noma iyiphi yeshumi lakhe, kufanele akhokhele ixabiso layo kanye nengxenye yesihlanu.
Ishumi elilodwa lengulube, neshumi elilodwa lembuzi, kanye neshumi elilodwa lazo zonke izinto eziphilako ezidlula ngezansi kwentambo yomlimi, uma zibalwa, zizongcwele kuYehova.

Umnikazi awudingi ukuhlukanisa olungile nobi, begodu awudingi ukuguqula noma iyiphi yazo. Uma eguqula enye, khona-ke isilwane kanye nalokho okushintshwe ngaso kuzobe kungcwele; ngeke zibuyiselwe emuva.
Lokho wumthetho ikosi abewisela ngawo uMoses kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, emfuleni iSina.
Num: Kwathi ngonyaka wesithathu ngemuva kokuphuma kwabo ezweni laseYiputa, ngomhla wokuthoma wenyanga yesibili, ikosi wathi kuMoses, emfuleni iSina, esitezi sokuhlangana, esithi,
Ukubalwa kwamadodana kaSirayeli konke, ngomndeni wabo, ngemindeni sabo; ukubalwa kwegama ngalinye lowesifazane, ngomlomo wakhe,
bonke abaneminyaka eyishumi nambili ubudala nangaphezulu, abakwaziyo ukuphuma emkhosini ezweni laseSirayeli; wena noAron nibala labo ngokwemikhosi sabo.
Umfazi oyedwa wesizwe ngayinye, umholi weqembu lakhe lemindeni yakhe, uzokusiza.
Lawona amagama amadoda azosebenza nawe: eRubheni, uElisuri unyana kaShedeure.
kuSimeoni, uShelumiyeli unyana kaZurishadai.
kuYuda, uNahshon unyana ka-Aminadabhi.
ku-Issakhar, uNathaneli unyana kaSuwari.
KwaZebulun, nguEliyaba unyana kaHeloni.
Ngabo oonyana bakaYosefu: ngaseEphrayim, uElishama unyana ka-Amihudi; ngaseManase, uGamaliyeli unyana ka-Pedasuri.
kuBhenjamini, uAbidan unyana kaGideoni.
KwaDani, nguAhiezer unyana ka-Ammisadai.
ku-Ashere, nguPagiyeli unyana ka-Okran.
KwaGadi, nguEliyasaphe unyana kaDeuyeli.
ENaphtali, ngu-Ahira unyana ka-Enani.
Lawa madoda athathwe engqungqutheleni, abe yibo abaphathi bezizwe zabazali babo; babe yibo abaphathi bemikhosi yamaSirayeli.
UMoses no-Aron bathatha labo madoda abizwa ngegama,

Kwathi ngomhla wokuthoma wenyanga yesibili, bahlangana bonke abantu; begodu babhaliswa ngokwemindeni sabo, ngezindlu zabazali babo; wonke umuntu oneminyaka eyishumi nambili ubudala nangaphezulu wabhalwa ngegama lakhe.
Wababala uMoses esiqhingi saseSinai, njengombana ikosi abemwisele umthetho ngawo.

NgoweRubhen, omkhulu kwabaSirayeli; bonke amadoda aneminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili nangaphezulu, abakwaziyo ukuphuma emkhosini, bahlukaniswa ngegama ngalinye, ngokwemindeni sabo, ngomndeni wabo.
Amadodana kaRubhen, labo ababalwa kubo, babe ngamaphesenti angama-46 namakhulu amane.
AbakwaSimeoni, bonke amadoda aneminyaka eyishumi nambili ubudala nangaphezulu, labo abakwaziyo ukuphuma emkhosini, ngamagama abo, ngokwemindeni sabo, ngomndeni wabo.
Amadodana kaSimeoni, labo ababalolwe kubo bayizinkulungwane eziyisishiyagalombili namashumi amathathu.
Kumadodana kaGadi, wonke umuntu oneminyaka eyishumi nambili ubudala nangaphezulu, ongakwazi ukuphuma emkhosini, wahlukaniswa ngegama lakhe, ngohlobo lwakhe nomndeni wakhe.
Amadodana kaGadi, labo ababalolwe kubo babe ngamaphesenti angama-45 namakhulu ayisishiyagalolunye.
Abafazi bakaSirayeli, bonke abaneminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili ubudala nangaphezulu, bonke abakwaziyo ukuphuma emkhosini, ngamagama abo, ngokwemindeni sabo, ngomndeni wabo.
Amanani abo, ababalolwe ezweni likaYuda, ayizinkulungwane eziyisishiyagalombili nesikhombisa namashumi mane.
Abafazi baka-Issakare, bonke abesifazane abaneminyaka eyishumi nambili ubudala nangaphezulu, bonke abakwaziyo ukuphuma emkhosini, bahlukaniswa ngegama ngalinye, ngokwemindeni sabo, ngomndeni wabo.
Amadodana ka-Issakhar, labo ababalolwe kubo, babe ngumakhulu amahlanu anamashumi amane namawaka amabili nane.

Ezweni lakwaZabuloni, ngomndeni wakwaZabuloni, ngamadodakazi abo, ngemindeni sabo, ngezindlu zabazali babo, ngokwezinani zabo, wonke umuntu oneminyaka eyishumi nambili ubudala nangaphezulu ongakwazi ukuphuma emkhosini.
Amadodana kaZebuloni, labo ababalolwe kubo beyishumi nambili nesishiyagalolunye amawaka nekhulu.

Ngomndeni wakwaSirayeli, ngomndeni ka-Efrayim, ngamadodakazi kaYosefu, aneminyaka eyishumi nambili ubudala nangaphezulu, bonke abakwaziyo ukuphuma emkhosini, bahlukaniswa ngezizwe zabo, ngemindeni sabo, ngokwemindeni sabo.
Amadodana ka-Ephrayimi, labo ababalolwe kubo belikhulu elinamakhulu mane.
Abafazi bakaManase, abahlukaniswe ngezizwe zabo, ngokwemindeni sabo, ngomndeni wakwababa babo, ngamagama abo, wonke umuntu oneminyaka eyishumi nambili ubudala nangaphezulu, ongaba khona ezweni.
Amadodana kaManase, labo ababalolwe kubo, babe ngamaphesenti angama-32 namakhulu amabili.
Ngabo bonke abazalwane bakaBhenjamini, wonke umuntu oneminyaka eyishumi nambili ubudala noma ngaphezulu, ongakwazi ukuphuma emkhosini, wabhalwa ngegama lakhe, ngamunye ngohlobo lwakhe nomndeni wakhe.
Amanani abo, ababalolwe ezweni likaBhenjamini, ayizinkulungwane eziyisithathu nesishiyagalombili namakhulu amane.
Abafazi bonke abaneminyaka eyishumi nambili ubudala nangaphezulu, bonke ababili abakwaziyo uku inteliga emkhosini, bahlukaniswa ngegama ngalinye, ngokwemindeni sabo, ngomndeni wabo.
labo ababalolwe kubo, ezweni likaDani, kwaba ngumakhulu ayisishiyagalombili anamashumi amabili nanye amahlanu.
Ngabo bonke abazalwane baka-Ashere, wonke umuntu oneminyaka eyishumi nambili ubudala nangaphezulu, ongaba khona ezweni, wabhalwa ngegama lakhe, ngohlobo lwakhe nomndeni wakhe.
Amadodana ka-Asere, labo ababhekwa kubo beyishumi nambili elilodwa nenkulungwane namahlanu.
Abafazi baka-Naphtali, bonke amadoda aneminyaka eyishumi nambili ubudala nangaphezulu, labo abakwaziyo ukuphuma emkhosini, bahlukaniswa ngegama ngalinye, ngokwemindeni sabo, ngomndeni wabo.
Amadodana kaNaphethali, labo ababalolwe kubo, kwaba ngumakhulu mane anamashumi amahlanu nathathu amawaka, anamakhulu amane.
Lokho kilabo ababalolwe nguMoses no-Aron, ngesandla samabhishobhi aseSirayeli alishumi elinambini, ngalowo mzali wesifazane.
Bonke abantu baseSirayeli abaneminyaka eyishumi nambili ubudala nangaphezulu, bonke abakwaziyo ukuphuma emkhosini, bahlukaniswe ngezindlu zababa babo.
Inani eliphelele lalingumakhulu ayisishiyagalombili, amashumi amathathu ananye amakhulu amane nesihlanu.
Kodwana amaLevi, ngokwesizwe sakwababa babo, awabalwa phakathi kwabo.
uzimu wathi kuMosesi,
Usukuzwe lwakwaLevi ungalibala, ungayihlanganisa nenani lamadodana kaSirayeli.

Uzobeka amaLevi esikoleni esingcwele, lapho kugcinwa khona umthetho womthetho wesivumelwano, nezinto zayo zonke, nezimpahla zayo zonke. Bazothwala isikolo esingcwele, nezinto zayo zonke; bazoyilungisa, begodu bazohlala ezindaweni ezishisayo ngaso soke isikhathi.
Uma itabernakele ihamba, labo abaLevi bazoyisusa, begodu uma ibekwe, labo abaLevi bazoyimisa; noma ubani ongeke afinyelele kuyo, kufanele abulawa.
Abantu bakaSirayeli bazomisa amatende abo, wonke umuntu esitezi sakhe, begodu ngaphasi kwesibhakabhaka sakhe, ngokwemikhosi sabo.

Kodwana amaLevi azohlala ezindaweni zokucampana ezijikeleze itente elingcwele, lapho kugcinwa khona umthetho womhlangano, ukuze kungabikho ubuhlungu phakathi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli; ngombana amaLevi kumele agcine itenti elisha.
Abantu bakaSirayeli bakwenza njalo, njengombana ikosi abewisela umthetho uMoses.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi noHaroni,

Abantu bakaSirayeli basuke behlala ezindaweni zokucampana ezijikeleze itente lengqungquthela, ngaphesheya kwayo; wonke umuntu ahlale ezindaweni zakhe zokucampana ngaphasi kwebhande lakhe, ngebhande lomndeni wakhe.
Ngasenyakatho, ngaphesheya kokuphuma kwelanga, kuzohlala itente likaSirayeli ngemikhosi yawo; begodu uNahashon, unyana ka-Aminadabhi, uzobe nguMengameli wabo bonke abantu baseSirayeli.
Iqembu lakhe lomkhosi linamaphesenti angama-74,000 namakhulu ayisithupha.
Ngasohlangothini lwawo kuzohlala isizwe sika-Issakha; uNethaneli, unyana ka-Zuare, uzobe nguMengameli wabo.
Iqembu lakhe lomkhosi linezinombolo ezingu-54, izikhulu ezine.
Usuku lomndeni wakwaZabuloni luzofika; umholi wabo bonke abantu bakaZabuloni uElibha, unyana kaHeloni.
Iqembu lakhe lomkhosi linezinombolo ezingu-57, izinkulungwane ezine.
Wonke umkhawulo wesitezi sikaYuda, ngokwemikhosi yawo, ngumakhulu amabili anamashumi asibhozo anesithandathu amawaka, namakhulu amane; bazohamba kuqala.
Ngasenyakatho-mpumalanga kuzoba khona isibhakabhaka somkhosi kaRubhen, ngokuya ngemikhosi yawo; begodu uMengameli wamaRubheni uzobe nguElisuri unyana kaShedeure.
Iqembu lakhe lomkhosi linamaphesenti angama-46,000 angu-500.
Kuzohlala eduze kwabo isizwe sakwaSimeoni; uShelumiyeli, unyana kaZurishaddai, uzobe nguMengameli wamadodana kaSimeoni.
Iqembu lakhe lomkhosi linezinombolo ezingu-59 namakhulu amathathu.
Usuku lwesizwe sikaGadi luzofika, begodu umholi wabo bonke abantu bakaGadi uEliasafo unyana kaRehuyeli.
Iqembu lakhe lomkhosi linezinombolo ezingu-45, izinkulungwane eziyisishiyagalombili.
Wonke amanani asesiteji sikaRubhen, ngokwemikhosi yawo, ngumakhulu amane anamashumi amahlanu ananye amawaka, namakhulu amane anamashumi mahlanu.
Begodu ikamelo lokuhlangana lizohamba, nesitezi sakwaLevi siphakathi kwezitezi. Ngokuya ngohlelo lwabo lokucampana bazohamba, wonke umuntu ezindaweni zakhe, ngasezinhlamvini zakhe.
Ngasenyakatho-ntshonalanga, kuzoba khona isibhakabhaka somkhosi kaEphrayimi, ngokuya ngamaqembu abo; uElishama unyana ka-Amihude ube yisikhulu samadodakazi kaEfrayim.
Iqembu lakhe lomkhosi linamaphesenti angama-40,.
Ngasenyakatho sabo kuzoba khona isizwe sikaManase; uGamaliyeli, unyana kaPedashuri, ube nguMengameli wabo bonke abantu bakaManase.
Iqembu lakhe lomkhosi linezinombolo ezingu-32 namakhulu amabili.
Usuku lomndeni kaBhenjamin luzofika; umholi wabo bonke abantu bakaBhenjamin uAbidan, unyana kaGideoni.
Iqembu lakhe lemikhosi linezinombolo ezingu-35 namakhulu amane.
Wonke amanani esiteji sika-Ephrayim, ngokwemikhosi yawo, yikhulu nesishiyagalolunye amaphesenti ayishumi nambili. Bazohamba bethathu.
Ngasenyakatho kuzoba khona isibhakabhaka somkhosi kaDan, ngohlobo lwamaqembu abo; uAhiezer unyana ka-Ammisadai ube yisikhulu samadodana kaDan.
Iqembu lakhe lomkhosi linezinombolo ezingu-62 nezigidi eziyisithupha.
Ngasenyakatho sabo kuzoba khona isizwe sika-Ashere; uPagiyeli, unyana ka-Okran, ube yisikhulu sabantu baka-Ashere.
Iqembu lakhe lomkhosi linezinombolo ezingu-41.
Usuku lwesizwe sikaNaphtali; umholi wabo bonke abantu bakaNaphtali, nguAhira unyana ka-Enani.
Iqembu lakhe lomkhosi linezinombolo ezingu-53 nezigidi ezine.
Wonke umkhawulo womkhosi kaDan wumakhulu amabili anamashumi amahlanu anesibhozo amawaka, namakhulu ayisishiyagalombili. Bazophuma abaphesheya, ngokwezibhamu zabo.

Lawa amalungu omndeni kaSirayeli, ngokubhaliswa kwabo ngokwemindeni sabo; labo bonke ababhaliswe ezindaweni zokuhlala zabo zonke, ngemikhosi sabo, kwaba ngumakhulu amathandathu, anamawaka amathathu, anamakhulu mahlanu, namashumi amane.
Kodwana amaLevi awabalwa phakathi kwabantu bakaSirayeli, njengombana ikosi abewisela umthetho uMoses.
Bakwenza njalo oonyana bakaSirayeli, ngokwezinto zonke awisenzileyo ikosi kuMoses; ngale le bamisa iziqhingi zabo, begodu ngale le basuka, wonke umuntu ngendlu yakhe nomndeni wakhe.
Lokho wumlando wamadodana ka-Aron noMoses, ngesikhathi ikosi ekhuluma noMosis emfuleni iSina.
Lawona amagama oonyana baka-Aron: uNadabu omkhulu, no-Abihu, no-Eleazarhi, no-Ithamari.
Baye bona oonyana baka-Aron, ababhishobhi abakhishwe ngamafutha omnqumo, abahlukaniswe ukuba babe ngababingeleli.

UNadabhi no-Abhihu bafa phambi koYehova, lapho benikela khona ngomlilo ongavunyelwanga, esiqhingini saseSinayi; babengenabantwana. Wathi uElazarhi no-Ithamari baphatha umsebenzi kambingeleli ngesikhathi uAron, ubaba wabo, ephila.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
Landisa isizwe sikaLevi, ubeke ngezansi kuka-Aron umpristi, ukuze basebenze naye.
Bazowenza umsebenzi wakhe, kanye nomsebenzi webandla lonke, esitezi sokuhlangana, besebenza emgodini ongcwele.
Bazobhekana nezinto zonke zesihlalo sokuhlangana, begodu basebenzele imisebenzi yabantu bakaSirayeli, besebenza esitezi esingcwele.
Uzobeka labo baLevi ku-Aron, nakubo bonke oonyana bakhe; bazobe bethathwe kiwo wonke amadodana aseSirayeli.
Uzobeka uAron nabenzana bakhe ukuba babe ngabapristi; begodu wonke umuntu ofika ezindleleni ezingcwele, kumele aphele.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
Bheka, ngithathe amaLevi phakathi kwamadodana aseSirayeli, ukuze abe yimi endaweni yalabo bonke abazalwa kuqala ezweni laseSirayeli; bami amaLevi.

ngombana bonke abazalwa kuqala bami. Ngosuku lapho ngibulala khona bonke abazalwa kuqala ezweni laseYiputa, ngazinikela mina bonke abazalwa kuqala eSirayeli, phakathi komuntu nenyama; banami: ngiyangiNkosi.
Wakhuluma ikosi kuMoses esiqhingini saseSina, wathi,
Linani labo abaLevi ngokwemindeni sabo, ngomndeni wabo; linani labo bonke amadoda aneminyaka emibili nangaphezulu.
Wababala uMoses, njengokuthi ikosi wamwisela.
Babo oonyana bakaLevi: uGershoni, noKohati, noMerari.
Lezi ziyimindeni yezingane zikaGershoni: uLibni noShimehi.
Izizwe zabantwana bakaKahati: uAmram, no-Izhar, no-Hebron, no-Uziyeli.
Abafazi bakaMerariya: uMahli noMushi; labo abafazi bamaLevi, ngokwemindeni sabo.
Ku-Gershoni bekukhona amabandla kaLibni noShimehi. Lawa ngamabandla eGershoni.
Inombolo sabo, bonke amadodana abo aneminyaka emibili ubudala nangaphezulu, yaba ngumakhulu asixhenxe, anamakhulu amane.
Imindeni yakwaGershoni izohlala esitezi sasentshonalanga, eduze kweTenda Elingcwele.
Umholi wemindeni yamaGershoni ube nguEliyasaphe unyana kaLayeli.
Esitezi sokubambisana, abaGershoni babe nesibopho sesitezi esingcwele, kanye nesitezi sayo, nokugqugquzela kwayo, nophahla lomngcele wesitezi sokubambisana;
kanye nezingqungquthela zendlu yangasese, nezingqungquthela zomngcele wendlu yangasese ojikeleze ikamelo elingcwele, nesihlalo somlilo, nezintambo; bakwenza yonke imisebenzi ephathelene nalezi zinto.
NgaseKohati bekukhona amaqembu amakhosikazi ka-Amram, no-Izhar, no-Hebron, no-Uziyeli; la maqembu emindeni yamaKohati.
Ngokubalwa kwabo, bonke amadodana abo aneminyaka emibili ubudala nangaphezulu, kwaba ngumakhulu asibhozo, anamakhulu ayisishiyagalombili; babe nesibopho sendawo enhle.
Imindeni yama-Kohati kufanele icamp engxenyeni esenyakatho yeTenda Elingcwele.
UMengameli wemindeni yamaKahati ube nguElizaphane unyana kaUziyeli.
Basebenza ngebhokisi lesinqumo, nethebulethi, nophahla lwesibani, nezibingelelo, namathuluzi asetshenziswa endaweni engcwele, kanye nesibuko; bakwenza yonke imisebenzi yazo.
UElazaru, unyana ka-Aron umpristi, ube yinhloko yamaLevi; waba nguMengameli wabo bonke labo abaphethe imisebenzi engcwele.
KuMerariya kwasuka amaqembu amakhosikazi kaMahli noMushi; la maqembu amakhosikazi kaMerariya.
Inombolo sabo, bonke amadodana abo aneminyaka emibili ubudala nangaphezulu, ibiyizigidi eziyisishiyagalombili nekhulu.
Umholi wezindlu zakwaMerari ube nguSuriyeli unyana ka-Abhihayili; behlala engxenyeni yasenyakatho yendawo yokuphumula.
Amadodana kaMerariya ayephatha ifenisha yendlu yokuphumula, nama-bars ayo, nama-postes ayo, nama-bases ayo, nezinto zayo zonke; bakwenza yonke imisebenzi ephathelene nazo,
kanye nezingqimba zendlu yangasese ezijikelezayo, nezikhundla zazo, namahlombe azo, namantambo.

UMoses no-Aron, nabantwana baka-Aron, bamisa amakamelo engxenyeni esenyakatho yendlu yokuphumula, phambi kwendlu yokuhlangana, lapho ilanga liphuma khona; begodu babe nesibopho esikoleni sabantu baseSirayeli. Wonke umuntu ofinyelele kuyo, kufanele aphele.
Wonke umkhawulo wamaLevi, amadoda aneminyaka emibili ubudala nangaphezulu, ababalolwe nguMoses noAron ngokuya ngemindeni sabo, ngomyalo kaYehova, kwaba ngamaphesenti angamashumi amabili nanhlanu.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi, Bhala bonke abazalwa kuqala amadodana aseSirayeli, kusukela emnyangweni wenyanga naphezu kwayo, uthathe inani lamagama abo.
Uzithathe iziLevi ngimi, endaweni yazo zonke izinkomo ezivula ibele ezweni lakwaSirayeli, nezilwane zakwaSirayeli, endaweni yazo zonke izinkomo ezivula ibele ezweni lakwaSirayeli: ngiyangiNkosi.
Wathi uMoses, njengokuba ikosi wamwisela umthetho ngawo, wababala bonke abazalwa kuqala ebantwini bakaSirayeli.
Inani eliphelele lamadoda azalwa kuqala eneminyaka yonyaka owodwa noma ngaphezulu, ahlukaniswe ngegama, kwaba ngamawaka ayishumi nambili namakhulu amabili nesishiyagalombili.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
Thola amaLevi endaweni yalabo bonke abazalwa kuqala ezweni lakwaSirayeli, nenyama yabantu bakaLevi endaweni yenyama sabo; begodu amaLevi azongiwo mina, ngiyami ikosi.
Bangaphezu kwabaLevi, abazalwa kuqala ezweni laseSirayeli, abangamakhulu amabili namashumi asixhenxe namathathu.
uqoqe amaphuzu amane egolide ngalinye, usebenzisa isisindo esisemthethweni sendawo engcwele, okungumashumi amabili amaphuzu amancane ngayinye.
Uzobeka izimali zokuthengwa kwazo zonke izifakazi ezingaphezulu, ku-Aron nabantwana bakhe.
Wafumana uMoses imali kilabo abazalwa kuqala, labo abangaphezu kwalaba baLevi ababehlala endaweni sabo.
Ngabo bonke abazalwa kuqala ezweni laseSirayeli, waqoqa isiliva elilodwa elinamakhulu amathathu, anamashumi ayisishiyagalombili anesihlanu, ngokwesisindo sendawo engcwele.
Nokho uMoses wanikela ngalolu zimali ku-Aron nabantwana bakhe, njengombana ikosi abewisela umthetho uMoses.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi noHaroni,
Linani lamadodana kaKahati phakathi kwaLevi, ngokwemindeni sabo, ngomndeni wabo.
Uzobala bonke amadoda, kusukela eminyakeni emashumi amathathu kuya kwezingu-50 ubudala, labo abaphumayo ukuba basebenze esitezi sokuhlangana.
Le yimisebenzi yamaKahati esitezi sokuhlangana; bazophatha izinto ezingcwele khulu, ukuze zigcinwe.
Uma isibhedlela sikulungele ukuhanjiswa, u-Aron nonyana bakhe kumele bafike, bakhuphule ifasitela elihlanganisiwe ngaphambilini, bagqoke ngaso isikhwama sesivumelwano.
Bazobeka phezu kwayo isigqoko sesikhumba esithambile, bese befaka phezu kwayo isikhwama sombala oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka esiqinile, bese befaka amabhodlela ayo okuthwala endaweni.

Bazobeka phezu kwetafula lenyama elibekwe phambi koNdikhoyo ingubo eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, begodu babeke phezu kwayo izitsha, nezipuni, namabhodwe, namabhodlela okudla okuphuzwako; umnikelo wokudla ohlala njalo uzobe ukhona phezu kwalo.
Bazofaka phezu kwalokho intambo ebomvu, bayigqoke ngesikhumba esihle, babeke izintambo zayo endaweni.
Bazothatha isiketi esiluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, bagqoke isihlalo somshado, nezibani zayo, namahhashi ayo, namabhodwe awo, nezitsha zonke zophethiloli ezisetshenziswa kuyo.
Bazoyigqoka nayo yonke imishini yayo ngendwangu yesikhumba esithambile, bese bayibeka emgodini wokuthwala.
Bazofaka phezu kwesibingelelo segolide isigqoko esibomvu, bazosigqoka ngesikhumba esihle, bese bebeka izintambo zayo endaweni yayo.
Bazothatha zonke izinto ezisetshenziswayo ekusebenzeni endaweni engcwele, bazigqoke ngendwangu eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, bazigqugquzele ngesikhumba esithambile, bazibeke emgodini wokuthwala.
Kudingeka bahlanze i-ashes kusuka ku-bronze altar bese befaka i-purple cloth phezu kwayo.
Bazobeka phezu kwayo zonke izimpahla zayo ezisetshenziswa kuyo, ama-pans, nama-forks, nama-spades, nama-basins; begodu bazofaka phezu kwayo isigqoko sesikhumba esimnyama, bese befaka izintambo zayo.

Uma u-Aron nonyana bakhe beqedile ukugqoka izinto ezingcwele, nanoma yiziphi izimpahla ezingcwele, lapho umkhosi ehamba khona, khona-ke abaKahati bazofika bazithwalereigni; kodwana ngeke baphuze izitho ezingcwele, ukuze bangafa. Lezo zinto ziyizinto zetekisi yokuhlangana, abakwaKahati bazozithwala.

U-Eleazaru, unyana ka-Aron umbhishobhi, uzobe enesibopho se-oyile yokukhanya, nefuthe elimnandi, nomnikelo wokudla oqhubekayo, ne-oyile yoku ukubhaka; izobe inesibopho sendlu yonke engcwele, nezinto zonke ezingaphakathi kuyo, nalapho kungcwele khona, nezimpahla zayo.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi noHaroni,
Umndeni wakwa-Kehati awudingi ukulahleka phakathi kwabaLevi.
Ukwenze lokhu kubo, ukuze baphile begodu bangafa, uma befinyelela ezingcwele khulu: uAron nonyana bakhe bazofika, babeke wonke umuntu emisebenzini yakhe, nabo bonke abebethwala.
Amadodana ka-Kehati angeke afike nakabona izinto ezingcwele, noma ihora elilodwa, ukuze bangafa.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
Uzobala nabangani bakaGershoni, ngokwemindeni sabo, ngezizwe zabo.
Uzobala bonke amadoda, kusukela eminyaka eyisikhombisa kuya kweyishumi nambili ubudala, abaphumayo ukuba basebenzele emkhosini.
Lokho wumsebenzi wemindeni yakwaGershoni, ngomsebenzi wabo, nokuthwala kwabo.
Bazothwala amafasitela ethempelini elingcwele, ikamelo lokuphumula, nokugqugquzela kwalo, nokugqugquzela kwesikhumba esimhlophe, kanye nophahla lomngcele wegumbi lokuphumula;

kanye nezingqungquthela zendlu yangasese ejikeleze ikamelo elingcwele, nesihlalo somlilo, nezingqungquthela zokungena kwendlu yangasese, nezintambo, nanoma yiziphi izinto ezisetshenziswa kulolu msebenzi. Bazosebenza kiwo wonke umsebenzi ophathelene nalezi zinto.
Wonke umsebenzi wamadodana kaGershoni, ukuthwala nanoma iyiphi enye imisebenzi sabo, kumele kwenziwe ngaphasi kwesandla sika-Aron nomndeni wakhe. Uzobe ukhuluma nabo ngomsebenzi wabo wokuthwala.
Lowo ngumsebenzi wemindeni yamaGershoni esitezi sokuhlangana, ngaphasi kwesandla sika-Ithamari, unyana ka-Aron umpristi, bazosebenza wona.
Linani lamadodana kaMerariya ngokwemindeni sabo, ngezindlu zabo.
Uzobala bonke amadoda, kusukela eminyakeni emashumi amathathu kuya kwezingu-50 ubudala, labo abaphumayo ukuba basebenze esitezi sokuhlangana.
Lezo zinto kumele bazithwale, njengengxenye yomsebenzi wabo esitezi sokuhlangana: izindonga zesitezi esingcwele, nezikhonkwane zaso, nezingcingo zaso, nezinqwaba zayo;

kanye nezingcezu zesibhedlela ezijikelezayo, nezisekelo zazo, namahlombe azo, namathumbu awo, namathuluzi abo onke, nanoma iyiphi into esetshenziswa ngazo; utshele wonke umuntu ngegama lakhe, bona yini okufanele ayithwale.
Lowo ngumsebenzi wezindlu zakwaMerari esitezi sokuhlangana, ngaphasi kokulawula kuka-Ithamari, unyana ka-Aron umpristi.
UMoses no-Aron, namadoda amakhulu ebandla, babala amadodana kaKahati ngokwemindeni sabo, ngezindlu zabazali babo.
Babala bonke abesifazane abaneminyaka engama-30 kuya kwengama-50 ubudala, labo ababengena ukusebenzela esitezi sokuhlangana.
Babalwa ngohlobo lwabo, bayizinkulungwane ezimbili namakhulu ayisishiyagalolunye namashumi amahlanu.
Lokho kwakungubo bonke abangamaKahati, abasebenza esitezi sokuhlangana; uMoses noAron babala labo, njengombana ikosi abewisela umthetho ngoMoses.
Amadodana kaGershoni abalwa ngokwezinhlanga zabo, ngomndeni wabo.
bonke amadoda asuka eminyaka eyimashumi amathathu kuya kweyishumi nambili, abafikayo ukusebenzela itente lokuhlangana
babalwa ngokwezinhlanga zabo, ngemindeni sabo; babe yizigidi ezimbili namakhulu amathandathu namathathu.
Lokho kwakungubo bonke abakwaGershoni, abasebenza esitezi sokuhlangana; uMoses noAron babala labo, njengombana ikosi abewisela umthetho.
Amadodana kaMerariya abalwa ngezizwe zabo, ngomndeni wabo.
bonke amadoda asuka eminyaka eyimashumi amathathu kuya kweyishumi nambili, abafikayo ukusebenzela itente lokuhlangana
babalwa ngokwezinhlanga zabo, begodu balinganiselwa ngamakhulu amathathu anamashumi amabili.
Lokho kwakungubo bonke abahlukaniswe izihlobo zakwaMerari; uMoses no-Aron babala, njengombana ikosi abewisela umthetho ngoMoses.
Wathi uMoses no-Aron, nabaholi bakaSirayeli, babala bonke labo abaLevi, ngokwemindeni sabo, ngomndeni wabo.
bonke amadoda asuka eminyakeni emashumi amathathu kuya kuminyaka eyisishiyagalombili, labo abafikayo ukwenza umsebenzi wokuphatha, nokuthwala emgodini wokuhlangana
amanani esiyisishiyagalombili yizinkulungwane eziyisithupha nesigamu.

Ngokungafani nalokho ikosi abewisela umthetho ngawo ngoMoses, babhekwa bonke abantu, begodu kwanikezwa wonke umuntu umsebenzi wakhe nempahla yakhe yokuthwala; babhekwa, njengombana ikosi abewisela umthetho ngayo uMoses.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
Uthi uMosis kuMoses: "Ubatshele abantu bakaSirayeli bona bakhuphe ngaphandle komkhosi, wonke umuntu onegciwane, nanoma ubani onegazi eliphuma emlonyeni wakhe, nanoma ubani ongcolile ngenxa yokufa.
Hamba, ushiye amadoda nabesifazane; ushiye ngaphandle kwekhampasi, ukuze bangabi nobuthi ekampheni, ngombana ngihlala phakathi kwabantu bam.
Wakwenza njalo uSirayeli, wabasusa ngaphandle kwesiqhingi, njengokuthi ikosi wathi kuMoses.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
Uthi kuSirayeli: Uma umuntu, indoda noma uwesifazane, esenza into engalungile ngomuntu wakhe nganoma iyiphi indlela, bakwenza ngokungemthetho phambi koYehova; lowo muntu uzobi.
Uma ushone isilwane, kufanele aqinisekise ubugebengu bakhe, begodu kumele abuyisele ngokupheleleko owinile, kanye nengxenye yakhe yesishiyagalombili, begodu kufanele anikeze lowo owinile.

Uma umuntu esefa, begodu angeke abe nendodana noma indodakazi ekwazi ukukhokhela umnikelo wakhe wokudla, khona-ke umnikelo wakhe wokudla uzobe wuweNkosi, uzonikezwa umbhishobhi, ngaphezu kwengulube yomkhonzi owawuzoyinikela ukuze alungise isono sakhe.
Zonke izipho ezingcwele ezikhethekile, abantu bakaSirayeli abazinikeza umbingeleli, zizobe ziye kuye.
Wonke umuntu unesibopho sokunikela ngezinto zakhe ezingcwele; kodwana konke okunikezwayo umbhishobhi kumele kube ngumbhishobhi.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
Uthi uMosis kuMoses: "Ukhulume nabantu bakaSirayeli, uthi kubo: Uma indodana yomntu ihamba icala, ingase ibe necala kuye.
Uma ethandana nomuntu othile, begodu indodakazi yakhe ayiqondi le nto; noma ngabe izinzipho zakhe zihlanzekile, kodwana asikho isiqiniseko salokho, nakuba akukho umshayeli ngaye, naye akagwetshwa.

Uma umyeni wakhe ethanda indodakazi yakhe, begodu ucabanga bona ibhinqa lakhe lithobile; noma uma umfazi enquma ukuba yindodana yenkosikazi yakhe, kodwana akayihloniphi inkosikazi yakhe; noma uma umfazi enquma ukuba ngumfazi wenkosikazi yakhe, kepha yena akabi nobuthi.

Uma kwenzeka lokhu noma lokho, kufanele athathe indodana yakhe aze ayiveze kumbingeleli; begodu kumele amnikeze umnikelo wakhe wokudla: ikhilogramu eyodwa nesishiyagalombili yoshizi oluhlanzekile. Akudingeki bona anikeze uphethiloli phezu kwayo, akudingeki ukuba anciphise umnqumo wayo; ngombana yisondlo sokudla sokujabula, isiphuzo sokuveza inkohliso efihlakele.
Umbingeleli uzoba nomkakhe, abeke phambi kukaNkulunkulu.
Uzobeka amanzi angcwele emgodini wokhuni, begodu uzothatha umhlabathi osuka eqhingini lendawo engcwele, awubeke emanzini.

Ubaba-ke uzomisa indodana yakhe phambi koYehova, avule izinwele zayo, abeke emlonyeni wakhe isiphuzo sokudla sezinkohliso, isiphuzo esidala ukulimala; begodu ubaba-ke uzobeka emanzini okunambitheka okumbi, abangela insindiso.

Ubaba-ke uzobatshela indodakazi yakhe, athi kuye: Uma kukhona umuntu ohlala nawe, begodu uma ungabi nento engekho emthethweni yomuntu wakho, ukuze ube nobuthi; khona-ke lawa amanzi aphuzayo, abangela ilangazana, angakubi kuwe.
Kodwana uma ukhohliwe ngesikhathi umshado wakho, begodu wahlanza ngokwakho ngokuhlala nomfazi ngaphandle kumfazi wakho...'
Ubaba-ke uzothi kulowo indodakazi, UYehova akwenze igama lakho libe yicala phakathi kwabantu bakho, begodu abe yisipho, uma ekwenza isibeleko sakho sibe sincane, begodu ikhanda lakho likhule.
Lawa manzi abangela ukubi afike ekhanda lakho, akwenze isisu sakho siphuze, begodu ibele lakho likhulule. Uwesifazane uzothi, Amen, kube njalo;
Umbingeleli uzobhala lezi zinkohlakalo ku-scrolling bese uhlanza amagama emanzini amnandi.
Uzothi kulowo umfazi bona aphuze amanzi abuhlungu, abangela ukubi; begodu amanzi azongena kuye, abe buhlungu.
Umbingeleli uzothatha emlenzeni wakhe isiphuzo sokudla sokuzethemba, azosiphakamisa phambi kweNkosi, aze asibeke esihlalweni sezulu.
Uzothatha isandla sakhe esigcwele saleyo mnikelo wokudla, njengento ephawulekayo, aze ayishise phezu kwesibingelelo; begodu ngemuva kwalokho uzodlalela indodana amanzi.

Uma ephukile, begodu ephikisane nomfazi wakhe, lapho edla amanzi abangela ukubi, azongena kuye, aze abe wubuhlungu obukhulu; isisu sakhe sizovuvuka, nesibeletho sakhe sizoba sincane; begodu igama lakhe lizoba yicala phakathi kwabantu bakhe.
Kodwana uma indodakazi yakhe ingabi necala, ihlanzekile, ngeke kube khona ukulimala kuyo, begodu izothola izingane.
Le mfundiso iphathelene nethando, bona uma indodakazi ihamba ngokungemthetho, ibe nendodakazi yakhe, begodu ihlanzeke,
noma uma umuntu nakabona indodana yakhe, begodu ethandane nayo; kufanele ayibeke phambi kweNkosi; khona-ke umbingeleli kumele akwenze konke okushiwo ngalolu mthetho.
Umyeni wakhe uzoba ngekho emthethweni, kodwana indodana yakhe izoba nomthwalo wecala.
Wathi ikosi kuMosesi,
Ukhuluma kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, usithi kubo: Uma umuntu, indoda noma indodakazi, esenza isibopho esikhethekile, ukuba nguNazirithi kuYehova,

Uzohlala engaphandle kwewayini nakwezinye iziphuzo ezishisayo; ngeke aphuze iviniga eyenziwe ngewayini nakwezinye iziphuzo ezishisayo; ngeke aphuze ijusi lezinkomo, begodu ngeke adla izinkomo, ezitshalile noma ezifile.
Wonke ubusuku obunguNaziri, ngeke aphuze lutho oluvela evinini, noma imbewu, noma isikhumba sayo.
