Uzohlonipha ubaba wakho nomama wakho, njengokuba ikosi uzimu wakho akuwisele umthetho ngawo; ukuze uhlale isikhathi eside, begodu kube lula kuwe ezweni ikosi uzimu wakho akunika lona.
Musa ukubulala.
Musa ukubhema.
Musa ukudlwengula.
Ungasho ubugebengu mayelana nomngane wakho enkantolo.

Ungayifuna indodana yomngane wakho; ungayifuna indlu yomngane wakho, noma indawo yakhe, noma umkhonzi wakhe, noma inkosikazi yakhe, noma inkomo yakhe, noma isikelemu sakhe, noma iyiphi into enomngane wakho.

Wathi ikosi la mazwi engqungqutheleni yenu yonke, ngezwi elikhulu, emfuleni ophakathi kwengcindezi yomlilo, nelanga, nobusuku obumnyama; akhenge akhulume lutho olwengeziwe, wabhala ngazo izinhlamvu ezimbili zamatshe, wamnika.
Kwathi lapho nikutholile khona ilizwi elivela ngaphakathi kwengcindezi, ngenkathi intaba iqhuma ngomlilo, kwafika kuyena bonke abaholi bezizwe zenu, namadoda amakhulu wenu.
nithi, UYehova uzimu wethu usibonise ubucwebe bakhe nobukhulu bakhe, sazizwa nezwi lakhe eningizimu yomlilo; namhlanje sibone bona uzimu ukhuluma umuntu, naye ephila.
Begodu manje, kungani sizofa? Le nto enkulu izonquma; uma siqhubeka sikhuluma ngezwi likaYehova uzimu wethu, sizofa.
Ingabe kukhona umuntu owaziyo ingoma yoNkulunkulu ophilayo ekhuluma phakathi kwengcindezi, njengokuba siyibonile, wahlala?
Chofoza wena, ulalele konke okushoyo ikosi uzimu wethu; bese ukhuluma nathi nganoma yini okusho yona ikosi uzimu wethu kuwe; sizolalela begodu siyigcine.
uzimu walalela izingcingo zenu, wathi: "Ngazizwa zonke izindaba ezikhuluma ngazo lezi zizwe kuwe; konke abakushoyo kulungile.
Ngiyafisa bona babe nenhliziyweni enjalo, ukuze bagcine imiyalo yami yonke, begodu bakhathazeke ngami njalo; khona-ke kuzobe kulungile kubo nabantwana babo kuze kube sekupheleni.
Chofoza lapha bese ukhuluma nabo bona babuye ezitolo zabo.
Kodwana wena, hlala lapha nami; ngizokutshela zonke izimiso, nezimiso zomthetho, nemithetho, ukuze uyifundise kubo, ukuze bayenze ezweni engiyabanika lona ukuba babe yintando sabo.
Uzobheka bona wenze konke ikosi uzimu wakho akuwisele umthetho ngawo; ungayisukanga kuyo ngasekunene noma ngasekhohlo.
Uzohamba yonke indlela ikosi uzimu wenu awawisele yona, ukuze niphile, begodu niphile kahle, nihlale isikhathi eside ezweni lenu elizoba impahla yenu.
Lezi yimiyalelo, nemibandela, nezimiso, ebengiwiselayo ikosi uzimu wenu ukuba ngizifundise; ukuze nizigcine ezweni lenu elidlulayo niyithathe njengentando yenu.

ukuze ugweme ikosi uzimu wakho, ugcine zonke izimiso zakhe nemiyalo yakhe engikhuluma ngayo kuwe, wena nezingane zakho, nezingane zezingane zakho, yonke imihla yokuphila kwakho; ukuze uzidelise amalanga.

Yize, isizwe sakwaSirayeli, ulalele, ugcine ukulalela; khona-ke kuzobe sekuhle kuwe, begodu uzoba wuhlanga olukhulu, njengokuthi ikosi, uzimu wababa bakho, wathi kuwe, ezweni elifulathelayo ubisi nenkukhu.
Lilalela, isiSirayeli; ikosi nguThixo wethu, ikosi kuphela.
Uzothanda ikosi uzimu wakho ngentliziyo yakho yonke, nangemphefumlo wakho wonke, nangentamo yakho yonke.
La mazwi, engikushoyo kuwe namuhla, uzowagcina enhliziyweni yakho.
Zifundise izingane zakho ngokucophelela. Xhumana ngazo uma uhlala ekhaya begodu uma uhamba ngezinyawo, lapho uphumula khona begodu lapho uvuka khona.
Uthi: "Uyibeke ezinyaweni zakho njengophawu, uyigqoke emilenzeni yakho njengenkundla yokukhumbula.
Uzozibhalela phezu kwezindonga zasekhaya lakho, nasezingcebeni zakho.
Uma ikosi, uzimu wakho, ekulethela izwe lakhe, awathi wabanika abazali bakho, uAbrahama noIsake noYakobi, ukuba likulethe kuwe, elizweni lezindawo ezinkulu nezihle, ongazikhiphi wena,
izindlu ezigcwele izinto ezinhle, ongazigcwalisanga, nezimpophoma ongaziqoqi, nezihlahla zezinkomo nezithelo ze-olive ongazitshalanga; bese udla begodu uphuze,
qaphela bona ungamkhohlwa ikosi, owakulethela ezweni laseYiputa, izwe lapho ubeyindodana yomsebenzi.
Uzogwema ikosi uzimu wakho, uzokhonza yena; begodu ngegama lakhe kuphela uzokwenza izibopho zakho.
Musa ukulandela amanye amadini, phakathi kwamadini ezweni elibhekene nawe.
ngombana ikosi, uzimu wenu, ophakathi kwenu, nguThixo onokwesaba; uma nilandela amanye amadini, khona-ke inhliziyo yakhe izogqugquzela phezu kwenu, begodu uzokucisha phezu komhlaba.
Mhlawumbe ngeke nizame ikosi uzimu wenu, njengokuba niyenzile eMasha.
Uzozigcina ngokuqinile imiyalo kaYehova uzimu wakho, namasiko akhe, nezimiso zakhe, awawisela kuwe.
Uzokwenza lokho okulungile, nokulungile emehloni kaYehova, ukuze kube lula kuwe, nifike niyithole izwe elingcono, ikosi abewisele lona ababuphikisi benu,
begodu uzokhipha bonke abaphikisi bakho phambi kwakho, njengombana wathi.
Uma nibuza izingane zenu kusasa, zithi, Ziyini lezi zinqumo, nalezi zimiso, nalezi umthethosivivinywa, okuthi ikosi uzimu wethu awawiselayo?
Uzothi kubo, Sibe ngabakhonzi bakaFaro eYiputa; kodwana ikosi wasikhipha eYiputa ngesandla sakhe esinamandla.
Wathumela ikosi izibonakaliso ezinkulu, ezibuhlungu, nezimangalo, eYiputa, kuFaro, nomndeni wakhe wonke, phambi kwamehlo ethu.
Wathi, "Sizofika ezweni lenu," waphuma khona, ukuze asize sifike kule lizwe, ukuze lithunyelwe kuthi, izwe ebelibhekwa ngabababa bethu.
Wathi ikosi kuthi, Sikwenze lezi mithetho zonke, sikhathazeke ikosi uzimu wethu, ukuze kube sekuhleni kwethu nsuku zonke, begodu agcine impilo yethu, njengokuba kwenzeka ngalolusuku.
Sizobe silungile phambi kukaYehova uzimu wethu, uma nje sibhekana nokwenza zonke lezi mithetho phambi kwakhe, njengokuba awiselayo.

Uma ikosi uzimu wakho ekulethela izwe okungena kulo ukulithola, begodu ekhuphula izizwe eziningi phambi kwakho: amaHeti, namaGirgasi, namaAmori, namaKanana, namaPerizi, namaHivi, namaJebusi, izizwe ezisixhenxe ezikhulu kunakho konke.
Uma ikosi uzimu wakho enikela ngazo phambi kwakho, uzinqobe, uzozibulala ngokupheleleko; ngeke ube nesivumelwano nabo, begodu ngeke ube nethando kubo.
Akekho umfazi phakathi kwabo, ukuze izingane zakho zingabi namadodakazi abo; begodu izingane zakho zingabi namadodakazi abo.
ngombana bazoshintsha izingane zakho, zisuka ekuphileni kwami, ukuze bakhonza izitha ezahlukene; khona-ke inhliziyo kaYehova izogqwala phezu kwenu, begodu uzokulahla ngokushesha.
Le yindlela okufanele niyenze ngayo kubo: Niphule izibingelelo zabo, niphula amatshe abo angcwele, niqonde ama-ashere abo, nikhulule ngomlilo izinhlamvu zabo.
ngombana wena uyisizwe esiyingcwele, esigqugquzelwe kuYehova uzimu wakho; ikosi uzimu wakho wakhetha wena ukuba ube yimpahla yakhe yangempela phakathi kwazo zonke izizwe ezikhona phezu komhlaba.
uzimu akakuthandeni wena, begodu akakukhetheli wena, ngombana ubukhulu bakho bungaphezu kwazo zonke izizwe; ngombana wena ubencane kunazo zonke izizwe.

Kodwana ngenxa yokuthi ikosi uzithanda, begodu ngenxa yokuthi wagcina ilizwi lakhe ebelikhuluma ngaye kubaba bakho, yena uThixounguNkulunkulu owenza bona niphume ngesandla esinamandla, ekusikhulula ekusebenzeni kwendlu ka-Farao, ukumkani waseYiputa.
Uzokwazi bona ikosi uzimu wakho, yena kuphela uzimu, uzimu othembekile, ogcina isivumelwano nethando labo abathandekayo kuye, nalabo abagcine izimiso zakhe, kuze kube yinkulungwane.
Kodwana ubuyisela labo abamxhwele, ebusweni babo, ukuwabulala; akhenge athathe isikhathi eside ukubuyisela labo abamxhwele, ebusweni babo.
Hamba, ugcine imiyalo yami, namasiko ami, nezimiso zami, ngizibeka phambi kwakho namhlanje.
Uma nilalela le mithetho, niyigcina, niyenza, ikosi uzimu wakho uzogcina kuwe isivumelwano nethando, njengombana atjhilo kwabababa bakho.

Uzokuthandela, uzokubambisana nawe, begodu uzokwenza ubeningi; uzokubambisana nawe ngezingane eziningi, nezithelo ezinhle, nembewu, newayini elisha, ne-olive oil; uzobambisana nezinkomo zakho ngezingulube, nezimvu zakho ngezinkomo, ezweni lakhe akhenge asho kubaba bakho ukuba akunike.
Uzobe ungcwele khulu ukudlula bonke abantu. Amadoda akho nabesifazane bakho ngeke bakwazi ukuba nezingane, begodu izilwane zakho ngeke zikwazi ukuzalwa.
uzimu uzokukhusela ezindaweni zonke zokugula; ngeke abeke phezu kwakho noma iyiphi yalezi zifo ezibi, owaziyo eYiputa, kodwana azozibeka phezu kwalabo bonke abakuxosha.
Uzozibulala zonke izizwe, ikosi uzimu wakho azenza phambi kwakho; ngeke ube nethando kubo, begodu ngeke ubambisene namathikithi abo; ngombana lokhu kuzokuba yingozi kuwe.
Uma ukhuluma enhliziyweni yakho, uthi: Izizwe lezi zinamandla kunathi; singazikhipha kanjani?
Musa ukuwakhathazeka; khumbula kahle konke okwenze ikosi uzimu wakho kuFaro, nakubo bonke abantu baseYiputa.

Amehlo akho akubona zonke lezi zinkinga ezinkulu, izibonakaliso, nezimanga, nesandla esinamandla, nomlenze oqinile, ikosi uzimu wakho awakhipha ngazo. Ngokusho kwalokho uzokwenza ikosi uzimu wakho kuzo zonke izizwe, ongazixolisa ngazo.
uzimu wakho, ikosi, uzobeka phakathi kwabo ukukhathazeka, kuze kube yilapho nalabo abafihlayo phambi kwakho belahleka.
Musa ukukhathazeka ngenxa sabo; ngombana ikosi uzimu wakho unguwe, uzimu omkhulu, onokwesaba.
uzimu wakho, ikosi, uzozisusa izizwe ezinjalo phambi kwakho, izingcezu ngezingcezu; awukwazi ukuzibulala zonke ngasikhathi sinye, ukuze izinyoni zeganga zingakukhululanga.
uzimu wakho, ikosi, uzozinikela phambi kwakho, azoziphazamisa khulu, kuze kube yilapho zikhululiwe.
Uzobeka emazulwini abo phambi kwakho, begodu uzobasusa amagama abo ngezansi kwezulu; akukho muntu ozokwazi ukubhekana nawe; uzowabulala bonke.

Uzozibulala ngomlilo izinhlamvu zemimoya sabo; ngeke ufune igolide noma isiliva elikhona kuyo, begodu akufanele lithathwe kuwe, ukuze lingaba yingozi kuwe; ngombana ikosi uzimu wakho unenkani ngalokho.
Ungayingenisi indlu yakho nanye yalezi zinto ezingathandeki, ukuze ungabi necala ngazo; kodwana ungayithandabuzi ngokuphelele, begodu uyenze ibe yingozi kuwe, ngombana iyinto engathandeki.
Hambani, nigcine yonke imiyalelo engikulethela yona namhlanje, ukuze niphile, nikhule, ningene, niyithathe njengentando yenu izwe ikosi abewisele lona ababuphikisi benu.

Uzokhumbula bona ikosi, uzimu wakho, wakulethela le minyaka emashumi mane yonke indlela esiqhingini, ukuze akuhloniphe, ukuze akwazi bona yini enhliziyweni yakho, noma ngabe uzogcina umthetho wakhe noma cha.
Wakucindezela, wakwenza ube nendlala, wakudlalisa nge-manna, ongayazi wena nababa bakho; ukuze akufundise bona umuntu akaphila ngokudla kuphela, kodwana ngawo wonke amazwi aphuma emlonyeni kaYehova.
Izigqoko zakho azisebenzisi isikhathi eside, begodu izinyawo zakho aziphuzi eminyakeni emashumi mane.
Uzokwazi ngokomoya wakho bona, njengobaba oqeqesha umntwana wakhe, ikosi uzimu wakho uqeqesha wena, begodu uyakuqeqesha.
Uzolalela imiyalo kaYehova uzimu wakho, uzohamba ngendlela yakhe ethandekayo, uzoba nomona.
ngombana ikosi uzimu wakho ekulethela izwe elilungile, izwe elinabantu abahamba ngezintaba nezimpophoma, amanzi aphuma emhlabathini ophansi, asuka emadolobheni nasezikhungweni.
izwe lengulube, neshubhu, namaviniga, nemifino, nama-granate; izwe le-olive oil, nemvubelo.
Uzokudla khona ukudla okunenani elikhulu, begodu awudingi lutho; kuzoba nensimbi emadolobheni ayo, begodu uzoba nobhedu ezindaweni zayo eziphakeme.
Uzokudla, uthobele, bese ubonga ikosi uzimu wakho ngenxa yezwe elingcono alikunike lona.
Hamba, ugweme ukukhohlwa ikosi uzimu wakho, ukuze ungagcinanga imiyalo yakhe, namalungiselelo akhe, nezimiso zakhe, engikhuluma ngazo kuwe namuhla.
Uma nidla, begodu nithobele, begodu nikhiphe izakhiwo ezinhle, begodu nihlale kuzo;
uma izingulube zakho nezinkomo zakho zikhula, uma isiliva lakho negolide lakho likhula, begodu zonke izinto zakho zikhula,
ungabi nomsindo, begodu ungayikhohlwa ikosi uzimu wakho, owenza ukuba uphume ezweni laseYiputa, izwe lapho ubeyindodana yomsebenzi.
Wakuholela ezweni elikhulu, elibuhlungu, elinabantu abamnyama, nama-scorpions, izwe elibandayo alinamanzi; wakwenza amanzi aphuma emhlabathini oqinile.
Wakudlalisa wena emfuleni nge-manna, engakaze bayiqonde imindeni yenu yababa, ukuze akuhloniphe, ukuze akuxhumane nawe, ukuze kube lula kuwe emazingeni adlule.
Ngalokho akufanele utshele inhliziyo yakho bona: "Ngiyithola lokhu ngesandla sami."
Uzokhumbula ikosi uzimu wakho; ngombana yena okunika amandla bona ube nobuningi, ukuze aqinise isivumelwano sakhe nababa bakho, njengombana kwenze ngalolu suku.
Uma ukhohlwa ikosi uzimu wakho, begodu ulandela izitha zabanye, uzisebenzele, uzibophezele kubo; ngikuqinisekisile wena namuhla, bona ngokuqinisekile uzobiwa.
Ngokungafani nezizwe, okuthi ikosi azilahle phambi kwenu, nizohlaliswa, ngenxa yokuthi ningawulalela amazwi kaYehova uzimu wenu.
Yithi, Isirayeli: Uzodlula namhlanje umlambo iYorodani, ungene ezweni lamazwe amakhulu khulu kuwe, namazwe anamandla kunawe, amadolobha amakhulu anezindonga ezifinyelela emkhathini.
Babantu abanamandla, abaphakade khulu; yibo abanganaki. Uwazi umlando wabo, begodu ufunde bona kwathiwa: Ngabe kukhona ongakwazi ukubhekana nabanganaki?

Uzokwazi lokhu namuhla, bona ikosi uzimu wakho, yena ohamba phambi kwakho, njengomlilo obulalayo; yena uzozibulala, begodu uzozicindezela phambi kwakho; wena uzozisusa, uzozicima ngokushesha, njengokuthi ikosi akutshelelayo.

Uma ikosi uzimu wakho ewazikhipha phambi kwakho, ungathi enhliziyweni yakho, uthi, Ngokuba ngilungile, ikosi ungingenise ukuze ngiyithathe lelizwe; kodwana ngenxa yokuthi la mazwe angcolile, ikosi uyawasusa phambi kwakho.

Akufanele ungene uthathe izwe labo ngenxa yobulungisa bakho, noma ngenxa yobuhlakani benhliziyo yakho; kodwana ngenxa yokuthi lezi zindawo ziyizwe ezibi, uzimu wakho, ikosi, uzozisusa phambi kwakho, ukuze aqinise igama lakhe ebelilisho kubaba bakho, uAbrahama, noIsake, noYakobi.
Uzokwazi bona uzimu wakho, ikosi, akakunikela wena leli lizwe elihle ukuze uligcine, ngenxa yobulungisa bakho; ngombana nibantu abanemilenze emide.

Khumbula, ungakhohlwa lutho, bona yini ekwenzeni ikosi uzimu wakho ahlukumezeke emhlabathini; kusukela ngosuku lokuphuma kwenu eYiputa, kuze kube sekufikeni kwenu kulo mhlaba, niye naphezu koNkulunkulu.
Nalapho emfuleni iSinayini, niyenzile ikosi agweme, ukuze akubize.

lapho ngiye ezweni eliphakeme, ukuze ngizithole izicwebezela zegolide, izicwebezela zomnqophiso owenzayo ikosi nani; ngahlala ezweni eliphakeme amalanga ezimashumi amane namahora amashumi mane; angidlanga ukudla, angiphuze amanzi.

Waminika ikosi izicwebezeli ezimbili zegolide, ezibhalwe ngesandla sikaThixo; nazo zonke lezi zinto ebezibhalwe ngazo, yimazwi onke akhuluma ngawo ikosi kuni emfuleni, phakathi kwengcindezi, ngosuku lokuhlangana kwenu.
Kwathi lapho kuphelile amalanga ezimashumi amane nemini eyisishiyagalombili, ikosi wanikeze izinhlamvu ezimbili zamatshe, izincwadi zesivumelwano.

Wathi ikosi kuye, Nquma, zula lapha ngokushesha; ngombana abantu bakho abawethula ezweni laseYiputa baphucukile; baphoqelekile ukuba bangabi nalokho engibawiselayo; benze isithombe esitsheni segolide.
Wathi begodu ikosi kuye, Ngibona abantu labo; bona, isandla sabo sinzima khulu.
Lahla mina, ngizowabulala, begodu ngisuse igama labo ngezansi kwesibhakabhakeni; begodu ngizokwenza ube yizwe elinamandla khulu, likhulu kunalo.
Ngase ngibuyele, ngakhuphuka emfuleni, begodu umlambo ugcwele umlilo; izicwebezeli ezimbili zomnqumo zazisemandleni ami.
Ngabheka, begodu ngabona bona ningene emthethweni kaYehova uzimu wenu. Niyenzile idolo elifana nenyama yomuntu; nisuka ngokushesha enhliziyweni yendlela ikosi awawiselayo.
Ngazithatha izicwebezelayo ezimbili, ngazisusa ezinyaweni zami, ngazibulala phambi kwamehlonu.

Kwathi lapho, ngase ngibeke ubuso bam phambi koYehova amahora angamashumi amane nezinsuku ezingamashumi mane; angidlanga ukudla, angiphuzi amanzi, ngenxa yobubi benu bonke obenyulile, engikwenzayo okumbi emehloni kaYehova, ukuze ngimkhuze.
Ngiye ngakhathazeka ngenxa yobuhlungu benhliziyo kaYehova, ngombana wayenethemba lokuthi uzokulahla; kodwana ikosi wandiphendula.
UYehova wagwema no-Aron, efuna ukumbulala; begodu ngathandaza ngo-Aron ngesikhathi salokho.
Ngiyithathe ingulube, leyo ndoda engalungile oyenzayo, ngiyishise emlilweni; ngayinciphisa, ngayithambisa ibe yimpuphu encane khulu, ngayibeka emifuleni ephuma emanzini entaba.
NaseTabera, naseMasha, naseKibrothi-hataava, nalapho niyenzile ikosi agweme.
Nalapho ikosi engithumelele khona eKadeshe-barnea, esithi, Yiya, niyithole izwe engikulethela. Kodwani, naphezu kwalokho, ningakholwanga emandleni kaYehova uzimu wenu, ningawulalelanga umlomo wakhe;
Ube uphikisana nozimu kusukela mhla ngikwazanga ukukubona.
Kwathi lapho, ngibeke ubuso bam phambi kukaNkulunkulu amahora angu-40 namasonto angu-40; ngombana ikosi wathi bona uzokususa.

Ngiye ngathandaza kuYehova, ngitjho, Kosi yami uThixouNkulunkulu, ungabi yingozi abantu bakho, abantu bakho abathandekayo, owabasindisa ngokunamandla akho amakhulu, owabakhipha eYiputa ngesandla sakho esinamandla.
Khumbula abakhonzi bakho, uAbrahama, noIsake, noYakobi; ungabonanga ikhanda labo bantu, noma ububi babo, noma ukudlwengula kwabo.

Uma kungenjalo, abantu belizwe owawusikhipha kulo, bangathi, Ngokuba ikosi akakwazanga ukuwangenisa ezweni awayewazinikela ngalo kubo, begodu ngenxa yokuthi wabakhohlisa, waphuma waya kubabulala emfuleni.
Bakho abantu bakho, abantu bakho abakhethiwe, owabakhipha ngamandla akho amakhulu, nangomlomo wakho onamandla.
Kwathi ngaleso sikhathi ikosi wathi kuye, Uzokhehla wena izinhlamvu ezimbili zamatshe, njengezinhlamvu zangaphambilini, ungene enhliziyweni yami emfuleni; begodu uzokwenza ibhokisi lemithi.
Ngizobhalela ezitsheni lezi amazwi akhona ezitsheni zokuqala, owazibophayo; bese uzibeka ebhokisini.
Kwathi ngakwenza ibhokisi lemithi ye-acacia, begodu ngazibopha izinhlamvu ezimbili zegolide, njengezinhlamvu zokuqala, ngaya efulethini, ngizithwale izicwebezela ezibini ezandleni zami.
Wabhala phezu kwazo izicwebezelayo, ngokusho kokubhala kwakhe kuqala, amazwi alishumi, awakhuluma ngawo kuni emfuleni, phakathi kwengcindezi yomlilo, ngosuku lokuhlangana kwenu; wanikela ngazo ikosi.
Ngiye ngabuyela, ngaphuma emfuleni, ngazibeka izibhengezo ebhokisini engikwenzayo, zihlala khona, njengokuba ikosi angiwisele umthetho.
Basuka e-Eshboni, idolobhana lakwaJahani, bahamba befika eMosera; khona lapho wafa uAron, wabanjwa khona; uEleazaru unyana wakhe waba ngumpristi endaweni yakhe.
Basuka khona bahamba befika eGudgoda, bese besuka eGudgoda befika eYotbata, izwe elinabantu abaningi.
Ngaleso sikhathi ikosi wahlukanisa isizwe sakwaLevi, ukuba sithathe ibhokisi lesivumelwano soNkulunkulu, bona sihlale phambi koThixo, sisebenzele, sibabaze ngegama lakhe, kuze kube manje.
Ngenxa lalokho, amaLevi angeke abe nengxenye phakathi kwazo zonke izizwe; ikosi nguwo umfelokazi wabo, njengokuthi ikosi uzimu wakho wathi kubo.
Ngase ngihlala enhliziyweni yentaba, nsuku nezinsuku ezingu-40 nobusuku obungu-40, njengokuthi ngangihlale khona ekuqaleni; begodu ikosi ungiphendula ngalo mzuzu wokugcina bona angakulahli.
Kwathi ikosi wathi kuye, Yiya, zulazisa labo bantu, ukuze bafike bathathe isibopho sezwe engisho ngaso kubaba babo bona ngizolibanikeza lona.

Manje ke, isiSirayeli, yini ofuna yona ikosi uzimu wakho kuwe? Bona ugweme ikosi uzimu wakho, ukhambe ngezinqumo zakhe, uthandane naye, usebenzele ikosi uzimu wakho intliziyo yakho yonke nomoya wakho wonke;
ukuze ugcine imiyalo kaYehova, nezimiso zakhe, engikhuluma ngazo kuwe namuhla, ukuze niphile.
Bheka, izulu, nezulu eliphakeme likaNkulunkulu wakho, kanye nephasi nanoma yini ekhona kiwo.
Kodwana-ke, ikosi wabathandela abahlengikazi bakho, wathandana nabo, wakhetha isizukulwane sabo phezu kwazo zonke izizwe, njengokuba kwenzeka namuhla.
Ngalokho shintsha inhlonipho yakho, begodu ugweme ukuba unqulo.

Ngokuba ikosi uzimu wakho, yena uzimu ongaphezu kwazo zonke izitha, noMlawuli ongaphezu kwazo zonke iziphathimandla; yena uzimu omkhulu, onamandla, onokwesaba; akabhekanga isizwe, athathenga inkokhelo.
Uthi: "Iqiniso liwukuthi, uMuhammadu S.A.W. unenhlanhla yokuphila isikhathi eside ezweni lakwa-Arabhu, begodu ubaba wakhe ungumuntu othembekile.
Nithandani nabangani benu, ngombana nibengabangani bami ezweni laseYiputa.
Uzogwema ikosi uzimu wakho, uzowukhonza yena; uzozibophezela kuye, begodu uzonikela ngegama lakhe.
yena uzimu wakho, owenza kuwe zonke lezi zinto ezinkulu, nezibuhlungu, amehlo akho azibonayo; yena uzimu wakho, owenza wena zonke lezi zinto ezinkulu, nezibuhlungu.
Abazali bakho bebengamashumi asixhenxe, lapho bekhuphuka eYiputa; kodwana manje ikosi uzimu wakho wakwenza nikhulu njengezinkanyezi zezulu.
Uzothanda ikosi uzimu wakho, ugcine izibopho zakhe, nezimiso zakhe, namalungiselelo akhe, nemiyalo yakhe yonke.

Kuze kube manje, khumbula izinto ozaziyo; ngombana angikhuluma nabantwana bakho, abangaziyo noma abazibonayo zonke izenzo zokuthi ikosi uzimu wakho akuhloniphe wena; babone ubukhulu bakhe, nesandla sakhe esinamandla, nesifuba sakhe esiqinile,
noma izibonakaliso, begodu izinto azenzayo eYiputa kuFaro, ukumkani waseYiputa, nezwe lakhe lonke.

Bathi: "Akekho umuntu owaziyo bona ikosi wakwenzani namaphoyisa aseYiputa, namabhayisikili abo, nama-carriages abo, lapho ephonsa khona amanzi eMfula iSundu phezu kwabo, lapho bekuzilandelana nabo; begodu ikosi wababulala bonke, kuze kube manje.
Akekho owabona lokho akwenzayo kuwe ezweni lezulu, kuze kube sekufikeni kwenu lapha,

begodu bona akwenzeni uDathani noAbironi, oonyana bakaElibha, baseRubheni, lapho izwe livula umlomo walo phambi kwamadodana kaSirayeli onke, lawathela, labo nabangane babo, nezindawo zabo zokuphumula, nezilwane zabo zonke.
Ngokuba izandla zenu zabona zonke lezi zinto ezinkulu, ikosi azenzayo.
Nizigcine zonke imithetho engikushoyo kuwe namuhla, ukuze nikwazi ukungena, niyithathe njengentando yenu izwe elidlula kulo, niyithathe njengentando yenu.
ukuze nihlale isikhathi eside phezu kwezwe, okuthi ikosi awasho bona azolibazisa ababuphikisi benu nabangani babo, izwe elishayelayo ubisi nengulube.
Ngokuba izwe okungena kulo ukulithola, alifana neYiputa, lapho niphuma khona; lapho ufaka khona isitshalo sakho, begodu uyihlanza ngesandla sakho, njengezihlahla zesitshalo.
Kodwana-ke, izwe odlula kulo ukulithatha liyilizwe lezintaba nezigodi ezidla amanzi asuka emkhathini.
Izwe ikosi uThixouNkulunkulu wakho eligqugquzela ngalo; amehlo akhe ahlala kiwo, kusukela ekuqaleni konyaka kuze kube sekupheleni konyaka.
Uma nje nizilungisa, nilalela umthetho ongiwisela wena namuhla, bona nithandane noYehova uzimu wenu, nikhonzane naye intliziyo yenu yonke nomoya wenu wonke;
Uzothumela imvula ezweni lakho ngesikhathi sayo, emveni kobusika nonyaka omusha, ukuze uqoqe izithelo zakho, newayini lakho elisha, ne-olive yakho.
Uzonikeza izithelo ezindaweni zakho, ukuze uzidle izinyoni zakho; uzokudla ngokupheleleko.
Khumbula bona ngeke ukhohlwe ukuba ushintshe ukukhonza begodu uthandane nabanye amasiko.

Uma nikwenza njalo, khona-ke inkohliso kaYehova izoqhuma phezu kwenu; uzovala izulu, ukuze kungabi nemvula, begodu umhlaba ungakhiqizi izithelo zakhe; begodu nizofa ngokushesha ezweni elimnandi ikosi akunika lona.
Ngalokho, gcinani le ncwadi engqondweni yenu, begodu uyibeke ezinyaweni zenu njengophawu, begodu uyigqoke emilenzeni yenu njengenkumbulo.
Zifundise izingane zakho. Xhumana ngazo uma uhlala ekhaya begodu uma uhamba ngezinyawo, lapho uphumula khona begodu lapho uvuka khona.
Uzozibhalela phezu kwezingqimba zendlu yakho, namasango akho;
ukuze nihlale isikhathi eside, ninezingane zenu, ezweni ikosi awathi abazakwabo bona azolibazisa ngalo, njengokuba izulu likhona phezu kwezwe.
Uma nje niyigcina le mithetho yonke engikulethela yona, bona niyithande ikosi uzimu wenu, nihambe ngendlela yakhe ethanda ngayo, niyibambe ngokuqinile;
khona-ke ikosi uzozisusa zonke lezi zizwe phambi kwakho, nawe uzozithola izizwe ezinkulu kunawe, ezinamandla kunawe.
Kusukela emfuleni i-Euphrates, kuze kube selwandle olukhulu, kuzobe yizwe lakho. Kuze kube yilapho uzobeka khona ingalo yakho, lizobe lizweni lakho.
Wonke umuntu ngeke akwazi ukumelana nawe; ikosi uzimu wakho uzobeka indlala yakho phezu kwazo zonke izizwe zelizwe, lapho uzoya khona, njengokuba wathi kuwe.
Bheka, namuhla ngizokulethela ukhetho phakathi kokusindisa nokufa.
Uma ulandela amazwi kaYehova uzimu wakho, engikushoyo kuwe namuhla, uzoba nokuthula.
Uma ningenakulalela imiyalelo kaYehova uzimu wenu, begodu nisuka endlela engikulethela yona namuhla, nilandele izitha zabanye awaziyo, khona-ke ningabi necala.
Uma ikosi uzimu wakho ekulethela izwe ohamba kulo ukulithola, uzobeka isivuno phezu komfula iGerizim, begodu usazise inkohlakalo phezu komfula iEbali.
Enyakatho-mpumalanga yeYorodani, lapho ilanga liphuma khona, ezweni lamaKanana ahlala emfuleni iYorodani, eduze kweGalgali, ngaphesheya kwezihlahla ezinkulu zeMore.
Ngokuba nihamba phezu kweYorodani, ukuze nifike nithathe isibopho sezwe ikosi uzimu wenu akunika lona; bese niyithatha isibopho sayo, nihlala kuyo.
qaphela bona ugcine zonke izimiso nemithetho engikunika yona manje.
Lawa amasiko nezimiso, okufanele nizigcine nizenza, ezweni ikosi, uzimu wababa bakho, akunike lona ukuba liyikhaya lakho, zonke amalanga wokuphila kwenu phezu komhlaba.
Uzobulala zonke izindawo, lapho izizwe ozakuzikhipha kuzo zikhonza khona amasiko abo, emadolobheni amahle, nasezindaweni eziphakeme, nangaphansi kwanoma ngimuphi umnqumo ogqamile.
Uzophonsa phasi izibingelelo zabo, uzobopha amatshe abo angcwele, begodu uzokhipha emlilweni ama-ashere abo; uzothosa izithombe zemikhosi sabo, begodu uzosusa amagama abo kuzona zonke lezi zindawo.
Ungawukhonzanga ikosi uzimu wakho, njengokuba bakhonza khona amadini abo.
kodwana ukhambe uye endaweni ongayikhetha ikosi uzimu wakho, phakathi kwezizwe zakho zonke, ukuze abeke khona igama lakhe; uzofuna indawo yokuhlala kwakhe, uye kuyo.
Niziveze khona izipho zenu zokungcola, neziboshwa zenu, nengxenye yeshumi yenu, nezibopho zenu, neziboniso zenu, nezibopho zenu ezithandekayo, nezibeleko zezinkomo zenu, nezibopho zengulube zenu.
Nidla khona phambi koYehova uzimu wenu, ninezingane zenu, nithokozele zonke izinto ozenzayo ngezandla zenu, ngenxa yokuthi ikosi uzimu wakho akubabazile.
Akufanele nikwenze njengombana sikwenza lapha namuhla, lapho wonke umuntu esenza konke okucabanga bona kulungile.
ngombana namanje ningafiki endaweni yokuphumula, ezweni ikosi uThixouNkulunkulu wenu akunika lona ukuba ngumhlaba.
Uma nje nidlula iJordani, nihlala ezweni ikosi uzimu wenu akunika lona ukuba liyikhaya lenu; begodu akunikeze ukuphumula kuzo zonke izitha zenu ezingqondweni zenu, ukuze nihlale niphephile.

Kulapho ikosi uzimu wakho ekhetha khona igama lakhe ukuba lihlale khona, uzozisa zonke izinto engikutshela ngazo: izipho zakho ezibomvu, nezipho zakho zokudla, nezipho zakho zeshumi, nezipho zakho eziphezulu, nanoma yiziphi izinto ezinhle khulu ozenzayo kukaNkulunkulu.
Nizothokozela khona phambi koYehova uzimu wenu, ninezingane zenu, nezingane zenu, nabangani benu, nabangani bezinkomo zenu, noLevi ohlala ezindaweni zenu, ngombana angeke abe nengxenye yakhe.
Khumbula bona angeke ubeke izipho zakho ezibomvu lapho ufuna khona.
Kuleyo ndawo ikosi azoyikhetha esinye sezizwe zakho, khona-ke uzozinikela khona; kuzo zonke izinto engikutshele ngazo, uzozenza khona.

Uzokwazi ukunyamalala, begodu udle inyama kiwo wonke amasango akho, ngokupheleleko isifiso senhliziyo yakho, ngokwesiqiniseko sokubambisana ikosi uzimu wakho akunika sona; ongcolileyo naye ohlanzekile uzokudla ngayo, njengokudla kwengulube noma ingulube.
Kodwana-ke, awudingi ukudla igazi lakhe; uzolisusa phezu komhlaba njengemanzi.

Akufanele udle kiwo wonke amasango akho, ishumi lembewu yakho, noma iwayini lakho elisha, noma uphethiloli wakho, noma okuzalwa kuqala kwezingulube zakho, noma izinkomo zakho, noma nanoma yisiphi isibingelelo sakho, noma izipho zakho ezithandekayo, noma isipho sakho esiphezulu.

Kodwana phambi koYehova uzimu wakho uzozidla, wena nonyana wakho, nendodana yakho, nomkhonzi wakho, nenkosikazi yakho, namaLevi asezindaweni zakho ezingaphakathi; begodu uzojabula phambi kukaNkulunkulu uzimu wakho ngazo zonke izinto ozenzayo.
Uzobhekana noLevi, ukuze ungamkhohlwa ngaso soke isikhathi lapho uhlala khona ezweni lakho.
Uma ikosi uzimu wakho ebanzisa izwe lakho, njengokuba wathi kuwe, bese ucabanga bona ufuna ukudla inyama, uthi, Ngifuna ukudla inyama; khona-ke ungadla inyama ngokuya ngenhliziyo yakho.

Uma indawo oyikhethayo ikosi uzimu wakho ukuba libekwe kuyo igama lakhe, isendaweni encane kuwe, khona-ke ungadla emifuleni yakho yonke, njengombana ngikuwisele umthetho ngayo, kusuka ezilwaneni zakho zengulube noma zezinkomo, ongazinika ikosi.
Uzokudla ngayo, njengombana udla ngayo inkomo noma ingulube; umuntu ongcolile nomuntu ohlanzekile bazodla ngayo.
Kodwana uqiniseke bona awudlanga igazi, ngombana igazi liyimpilo. Awudingi ukudla inhliziyo kanye nenyama.
Ungadlanga igazi. Uzolibazisa phezu komhlaba njengamanzi
Ungayidla, ukuze kube lula kuwe, nawe izingane zakho ngemuva kwakho; ngombana uzokwenza lokho okulungile emehloni kaYehova.
Uzothatha izinto zakho ezingcwele, nezibopho zakho, ukhambe uye endaweni ongayikhethela ikosi.

Uzonikela ngezipho zakho ezibomvu, inyama negazi, esibhedlela sikaYehova uzimu wakho; kodwana igazi lezinto zakho ezibomvu kumele litholwe eduze kwesibhedlela sikaYehova uzimu wakho; inyama yakho uzoyidla.

Hamba ugcine, ulalele la mazwi onke ngikutshela wona; ukuze kube lula kuwe, nawe izingane zakho ngemuva kwakho, kuze kube sesikhathi eside, uma wenza okulungile, nokulungile emehlo kaYehova uzimu wakho.
UYehova uzimu wakho uzozisusa zonke izizwe phambi kwakho, ezweni okungena kulo ukulithola; begodu uma uzinqobe, ube khona ezweni labo.

bhekana nabo, ukuze ungabi yingozi, ulandele indlela sabo, ngemuva kokulahleka kwabo phambi kwakho; begodu akufanele ubuze ngemithandazo sabo, uthi: Ngokufana nokuthi lezi zizwe zazenza kanjani imibhishobho yazo, sizokwenza kanjalo.

Ungamkhonzi ikosi uzimu wakho ngendlela sabo; ngombana konke okungathandeki kukaNkulunkulu, okungukuthi, izinto angeke azithandane ngazo, bakwenza ezingcweleni zabo; ngisho namadodana abo namakhosikazi abo bayawasindisa ngomlilo ezingcweleni zabo.
Hamba ubheke bona wenze konke engikushoyo kuwe. Ungayitholi lutho kuyo, begodu ungayisusa lutho kuyo.
Uma kukhona umprofeti noma umuntu ochaza iphupho, angavela phakathi kwenu begodu akubhekele uphawu oluyiqiniso noma umbono.
Uma kwenzeke izimpawu, noma isimanga, akhuluma ngazo, bese ethi, Siyalandela izitha zabanye, izitha ongazaziyo, begodu siyazikhonza;
ngeke ulalele umprofeti lowo, noma umphuphi lowo; ngombana ikosi uzimu wenu uyayihlola, ukuze akwazi bona nithandani ikosi uzimu wenu ngentliziyo yenu yonke, nangemphefumlo wenu wonke.
Uzolandela ikosi uzimu wakho, uzomkhathalela; uzogcina izimiso zakhe, uzozilalela; uzowukhonza yena, begodu uzozibophezela kuye.

Lo mprofeti, noma lo mphuphi, kumele abulawe; ngombana wakhuluma bona nizizwe ningakholwa kuYehova uzimu wenu, owenza ukuba niphume ezweni laseYiputa, ukuze nikhululwe endlu yobugebengu, begodu wafuna ukunisusa enhliziyweni yenu ekuhambeni enhliziyweni kaYehova uzimu wenu. Uzokhipha lokhu okumbi phakathi kwenu;

Uma udade wakho, noma unyana wakho, noma intombi yakho, noma intombazane yakho, noma umngane wakho othandekako, bafuna ukukhohlisa wena ngokufihlakeleyo, bathi, "Siye begodu sikhonza amanye amagugu," okuyinto awuzange wazi wena nababa bakho;
izitha zakwa-abantu abajikeleze wena, noma ngabe eduze noma kude, kusukela engxenyeni eyodwa yezwe kuya kwesinye.
Musa ukunikela kubo noma ukulalela kwabo. Ungazizwa ubuhlungu ngenxa sabo. Ngalokho-ke, akufanele ubagcine noma ubasize.
Uzowabulala ngaso soke isikhathi. Isandla sakho kufanele sibe sokuqala ukuwahlasela, begodu ngemuva kwalokho izandla zabantu bonke.
Uzobeka amatshe phezu kwabo, baphile; ngombana befuna ukukususa kuYehovaivelwe uzimu wakho, owakulethela ezweni laseYiputa, izwe lapho ubengumkhonzi.
Bazokwazi bonke isiSirayeli, bakhathazeke, begodu akukho muntu phakathi kwenu ozoqhubeka ekwenzeni lokhu okumbi.
Uma ukhuluma ngalinye lamadolobha akho, akunika wona ikosi uzimu wakho ukuba uhlale kiwo,
Ngokuba kwaphuma phakathi kwenu abantu ababi khulu, ababekhohlisa abantu basendaweni sabo, bathi, "Thina sizokhonza amanye amagugu ngaphandle kwakho," ongakaze wazi.
Uma kwenzeka bona lokhu kuyiqiniso, begodu kuqinisekiswe bona lokhu okumbi kwenzeke phakathi kwenu,
kufanele ubulala bonke abantu balo dolobha ngeqhwa. Uzolimaza ngokuphelele, nanoma ubani ohlala kulo kanye nezilwane zalo.

Uzoqoqa zonke izinto ezithathwe kulo mzi, uzibeke phakathi kwedolobhana lakhe elivulekile; uzowuphonsa umlilo lo mzi wonke, nanoma yini ekhona kiwo, ibe ngumnikelo wokudla kuYehova uzimu wakho; kumele ibe yindawo yokuphazamiseka kuze kube sekupheleni, ngeke iphinde ibuyiselwe.
Akufanele nigcine lutho oluyigugu, ukuze ikosi ashintshe inhliziyo yakhe ebuhlungu, begodu anibonise inhlonipho nethando, begodu akusize bona nikhule khulu, njengombana wathi kubazali benu.
Uma nje ulalela izwi likaYehova uzimu wakho, bona ugcine zonke izenzo zakhe engikwenzayo namuhla, ukuze wenze okulungile emehlo kaYehova uzimu wakho.
Niye izingane zikaYehova uzimu wenu; uma umuntu efa, ningeke nigwebe ikhanda lenu, noma nigwebe isifuba senu.
ngombana wena uyisizwe esikhethekile, isizwe esingcwele kuYehova uzimu wakho; ikosi usazikhethela ukuba ube yimpahla yakhe ekhethekile phakathi kwazo zonke izizwe ezikhona phezu komhlaba.
Akufanele nidle noma yini engathandeki kuzimu.
Lezi yizinto eziphilako ongazidla: inkomo, nengulube, nobhontshisi,
i-deer, i-gazelle, i-roe deer, i-wild goat, i-ibex, i-antilope, kanye ne-mountain sheep.
Ungadla noma yiluphi uhlobo lwenyama elinekhanda elihlukaniswe ngamaphiko amabili begodu elinquma ukutya.

Kodwana phakathi kwazo zonke izinyoni ezinyamalalayo, noma ezinamakhopho aphindwe kabili, ngeke nidle i-engeli, noma ingulube, noma inkomo, ngombana zinyamalalayo, kodwana azinamakhopho aphindwe kabili; zizoba zimbi kuwe.
Ingulube nayo ingcolile kuwe. Inezinyawo ezihlukanisiwe kodwana ayidlanga ubisi. Ungadli inyama yazo noma udinge izicubu zabo.
Kuzo zonke izilwane eziphila emanzini, ungadla noma yini equkethe ama-fins nama-scales.
Uma kukhona okunye okungaba nezinhlangothi ezimbili noma amathathu, begodu kungase kube khona izinhlangothi ezimbili noma amathathu.
Ungadla noma iyiphi inkomo ehlanzekile.
Lezo ziyizinyoni ezingadlanga: i-eagle, ne-vulture, ne-osprey,
i-red kite, i-falcon, noma yiluphi uhlobo lwe-kite,
noma yiluphi uhlobo lwe-raven
i-ostrich, i-owl, i-seagull, noma yiluphi uhlobo lwehawk,
i-owl encane, i-owl enkulu, i-horned owl,
i-pelican, i-vulture, i-cormorant,
i-stork, noma yiluphi uhlobo lwe-heron, i-hoopee, ne-bat.
Zonke iinhlapi ezindizayo zingcolile kuwe. Ungazidla.
Kodwana-ke ungadla noma iyiphi inhlanzi ehlelekile.

Uma uthola into efile, awukwazi ukuyidla; ungayinika umngane wakho ohlala eziteshini zakho, bona ayidle, noma uyithengise kumngani wakho; ngombana wena ungumuntu ongcwele ohlukanisiwe kuYehova uzimu wakho. Awukwazi ukubhaka ingulube emlilweni womntwana wayo.
Ngawo wonke unyaka qiniseka bona ubeka phasi ingxenye yesishiyagalombili yazo zonke iimila ozikhiqizayo emithini yakho.

Uzokudla ishumi lembewu yakho, newayini lakho elisha, nophethiloli lwakho, kanye nalabo abazalwa kuqala emihlambini yakho yamadodakazi akho, namakati akho, phambi koYehova uzimu wakho, endaweni akhetha kuyo ukuba lihlale khona igama lakhe; ukuze ufunde ukukhathazeka ngoYehova uzimu wakho yonke imihla.
Uma ikosi uzimu wakho ekubambisana nawe, khona-ke indawo akhetha ngayo igama lakhe izoba eduze khulu kuwe, begodu indlela ibe yindilinga khulu, ukuze ungayithutha khona inkomishi yakho yeshumi.
bese uyithengisa ngemali, uthathe imali yakho emlenzeni wakho, uye endaweni ikosi uzimu wakho azoyikhetha.

Uzothenga ngalemali yonke into oyifunayo inhliziyo yakho, inkomo, nengulube, newayini, neziphuzo ezishisayo, noma iyiphi enye into oyifunayo inhliziyo yakho; uzokudla khona phambi koYehova uzimu wakho, wena nomndeni wakho, begodu ujabulise.
ULevi, ohlala ezindaweni zakho zokudlela, ungawukhohlwa; ngombana yena akakho umfelokazi wakhe.
Ngokuphela konyaka ngamunye wesithathu, nizothola ishumi eliphelele lembewu yonyaka lowo, niyigcine emizini yenu.

Uzofika khona uLevi, ongeke abe nengxenye yakhe, nomunye umhlali, nomntwana omncane, nomfazi ezindaweni zakho zokungenisa izivakashi; bazodla begodu bathobele, ukuze ikosi uzimu wakho akubabazise ngaso soke isenzo sakho esiwenzayo.
Ekupheleni kweminyaka eyisithupha, kufanele ubuyisele emuva wonke ama-debt.

Lokhu kufanele kwenzeke: wonke umuntu odlulisa imali kumngane wakhe, umSirayeli, kumele alungise; akudingeki bona akhokhele umndeni wakhe noma isihlobo sakhe, ngombana isikhathi sokubuyiselwa kukaNkulunkulu sisholwe.
Ungacela ukukhokhelwa kwamanye amazwe, kodwana kufanele ubuyisele noma iyiphi inkontileka umngane wakho waseSirayeli edinga kuwe.
Akufanele kube khona umuntu ohlwempu phakathi kwakho; ngombana ikosi uzokubambisana nawe ngokukhulu, ezweni ikosi uzimu wakho akunika lona ukuba libe yilungelo lakho.
uma nje ulalela izwi likaYehova uzimu wakho, bona ugcine ukwenze la mazwi onke ngikuwisela wona namuhla.
ngombana ikosi, uzimu wakho, uzokubambisana nawe, njengombana ekushoyo; begodu uzodlulisa izimali ezizwe eziningi, kodwana wena awuzodlulisa. Uzolawula izizwe eziningi, kodwana azizokuphatha wena.

Uma kukhona umhlwempu phakathi kwabazalwane bakho, nganoma iyiphi idolobhana lakho, ezweni ikosi uzimu wakho akunika lona, ungabi nomsindo emlonyeni wakho, begodu ungagcini ngesandla sakho kulowo mhlwempu.
Ngaleyo le, ube nesandla esivulekile begodu ubanikeze ngokukhululekile konke okudingayo.

Hamba, ugweme ukuba kube khona imibono emibi enhliziyweni yakho, bona: "Unyaka wesixhenxe, unyaka wokubuyiselwa imali, usekude," begodu ugweme ukubopha umlomo wakho kilabo abampofu phakathi kwabazalwane bakho, abantu bakaSirayeli, ukuze ungawahlinzeki ngalutho; uma kungenjalo, bazokhala kuYehova ngenxa yakho, begodu ube nesono.
Uzonikela kubo ngokupheleleko, ungabi nenhliziyo ebuhlungu uma unikela; ukuze ikosi uzimu wakho akubabazise ngenxa lalokho kiwo wonke umsebenzi wakho, nakunoma yini oyenzayo.
Bazohlala abantu abahlwempu ezweni; ngalokho ngikuwisela umthetho, bona uvule isandla sakho kubo bonke abazalwane bakho, labo abahlwempu ezweni lakho, bomndeni wakwaSirayeli.
Uma ethe wathengwa kuwe umngane wakho, oHebhere, indodana noma indodakazi, begodu esebenza kuwe iminyaka emihlanu; ngonyaka wesixhenxe uzowushiya aphume emlonyeni wakhe.
Uma ninika izibopho zabo, akufanele nizishiye zisondelene.
Uzonikela kubo ngenyama yakho, nendawo yokudla kwakho, nomshini wakho wokucindezela iwayini; uzonikela kubo ngokuya bona ikosi uThixouNkulunkulu wakho akubhekele wena.
Uzokhumbula bona ube ngumkhonzi ezweni laseMisri, begodu ikosi uzimu wakho wamkhulula; ngalokho ngikutshela lokhu namuhla.
Uma ngabe umkhonzi wakho ekhuluma kuwe, ethi, Ngingakushiya, ngenxa yokuthi uthanda wena nomndeni wakho, begodu uthanda ukuphumula nawe.
bese uthatha isibhamu esijulile, uyibophe emlonyeni wakhe emnyango; begodu uzobe ngumkhonzi wakho nsuku zonke. Ngokufana nalokho wenze nomkhonzi wakho.

Akufanele ucabange bona kunzima ukukhulula umkhonzi wakho, ngombana iminyaka eyisishiyagalombili yomsebenzi wakhe ilingana neminyaka emithathu yomsebenzi womuntu okhokhelwa imali; begodu ikosi uzimu wakho uzokubambisana nawe kiwo wonke umsebenzi wakho.

Uzonikela kuYehova uzimu wakho wonke umfazi oqale ibele lakhe, phakathi kwezingulube zakho nezimvu zakho; awusebenzisi oqale ibele lakhe phakathi kwezilwane zakho eziphilako emisebenzini yakho, begodu awugqugquzeli oqale ibele lakhe phakathi kwezimvu zakho.
Uzozidla phambi koYehova uzimu wakho, wena nomndeni wakho, ngonyaka ngamnye, endaweni azoyikhetha.
Uma isilwane sinomthwalo, uma sithi sifile, noma simnyama, noma sinomthwalo othile omkhulu, ungawunikelanga kuYehova uzimu wakho.
Ezindaweni zakho zedolobha, nizokudla; lowo ongcolile nolowo ohlanzekile bangadla, njengokudla ingulube noma ingulube efile.
Kodwana-ke, awudingi ukudla igazi lakhe; uzolisusa phezu komhlaba njengemanzi.
Yenza iPasha kuYehova uzimu wakho enyangeni ka-Abib; ngombana ngonyaka ka-Abib ikosi uzimu wakho waphuma kuwe emazweni aseYiputa ekuseni.
Uzonikela ngoPasha kuYehova uzimu wakho, ngenyama yomntwana wakho noma ngenyama yenkomo yakho, endaweni ongayikhetha ikosi ukuba lihlale khona igama lakhe.

Akufanele uyidle nokudla okunamakhowe. Amalanga ezisixhenxe uzokudla ukudla okungamakhowe, ukudla kobuhlungu; ngombana uphuma eYiputa ngokusheshayo; ukuze uzicabangele amalanga zakho zonke, usuku lokuphuma kwakho eYiputa.
Akudingeki bona kube khona ukhilimu ezweni lakho lonke, amalanga ezisixhenxe; begodu inyama oyinikelayo ngemini yokuqala ekuseni, akudingeki ukuba ihlale kuze kube ngubusuku.
Awukwazi ukubhiyozela iPasha kuphi naphi ezindaweni zakho, okuthi ikosi uzimu wakho akunikeze kuzo.
Kulapho ikosi uzimu wakho ekhetha khona igama lakhe ukuba lihlale khona, lapho uzolibazisa khona ngobusuku, lapho ilanga liphuma khona, ngesikhathi sosuku lokuphuma kwakho eYiputa.
Uzoyibhaka, uyidle endaweni ikosi uThixouNkulunkulu wakho azoyikhetha; kusasa nizobuya ezindaweni zenu.
Amalanga eziyisishiyagalombili uzokudla ukudla okunamafutha ancane; ngosuku oluyisixhenxe kuzoba khona isibingelelo esigcwele kuYehova uzimu wakho; ngeke wenze lutho.
Bhala amaviki ayisishiyagalombili kusukela ngesikhathi uqala ukugoqa izithelo ezindlini.
Uzoyenza amalanga zosuku lokuphumula kuYehova uzimu wakho, ngomnikelo osuka enhliziyweni yakho; uzowunikela ngokuya ngezinhlanhla zeNkosi ikosi uzimu wakho awakulethela.

Uzowujabulela phambi kweNkosi uzimu wakho, endaweni akhetha kuyo ukuba lihlale khona igama lakhe, wena nonyana wakho, nenkosikazi yakho, nomkhonzi wakho, nomkhonzi wakho, noLevi ongaphakathi eziteshini zakho, nomunye umuntu, nowesilisa noma wesifazane, nomfazi noma isifazane esihlala phakathi kwakho.
Khumbulani bona nibe ngabakhonzi ezweni laseMisri, begodu nigweme ukwenza lokhu.
Uzokwenza usuku lwezindlu zokuhlala usuku oluyisixhenxe, lapho uzoqoqa khona izithelo zakho emgodini wakho, nobisi lwakho emgodini wokudla.
Uzowujabulela lo mcimbi wakho, wena nonyana wakho nonkosikazi wakho, umkhonzi wakho nonkosikazi wakho, nomLevi, nomningi, nomnaphakade, nendodakazi yowesifazane, abasezindaweni zenu.

Amalanga ezisixhenxe uzokwenza isikhumbuzo kuYehova uzimu wakho, endaweni ongayikhethela ikosi; ngombana ikosi uzimu wakho uzobabalisa zonke izithelo zakho, nemisebenzi yonke yezandla zakho, ukuze ube nethando olugcwele.

Amalanga amathathu ngonyaka uzovela wonke umuntu wakho umfazi phambi koYehova uzimu wakho, endaweni akhetha kuyo; emcimbini wokudla okungabhakiwe, nomcimbini wamaviki, nomcimbini wezindlu zangasese. Akukho muntu ozofika phambi kweNkosi ngesandla esisha.
Uzonikela wonke umuntu ngokuya ngamandla akhe, ngokwezinhlekelele ikosi uzimu wakho awakulethela.
Uzobeka abavikeli nabaphathi emindenini yenu, kiwo wonke amadolobhana akho, awanikayo ikosi uzimu wakho; bazophatha abantu ngokufanele.
Mhlawumbe ngeke ushintshe isinqumo, noma uthathe isikhalazo, noma uthathe inkokhelo; ngombana inkokhelo ivala amehlo owaziyo, begodu iguqula amagama abo abalungile.
Uzolandela inkohliso, inkohliso kuphela, ukuze uphile, begodu ube yilungu lezwe ikosi uzimu wakho akunika lona.
Uma ukwakha isibingelelo kuYehova uzimu wakho, akufanele ubeke itshe le-Ashera elinamatshe eduze kwalo;
begodu ngeke ubeke itshe elingcwele, ngombana ikosi uzimu wakho ubakhohlisa.
Awuzonikela kuYehova uzimu wakho inkomo, noma ingulube, enecala nanoma yisiphi isibopho; ngombana ikosi uzimu wakho uyayixosha.

Uma kutholakala umuntu, indoda noma indodakazi, ngaphakathi kwanoma iyiphi yezindawo zakho eziphakathi, ikosi uzimu wakho akunika zona, ekwenzeni okumbi ngamehlo kaYehova uzimu wakho, ephula isivumelwano sakhe;
Kuze kube sengathi baye bakhonza amanye ama-mighty, begodu babekezela kubo, noma ilanga, noma uLwezi, noma izinkanyezi ezulu, okuyinto ngiwavimbele.
Uma kuthunyelwe kuwe ngalolu daba, noma uma ukuzwa ngalolu daba, khona-ke uhlole ngokucophelela; begodu uma kuyiqiniso, uma kutholakale bona lokhu okumbi sekwenzeke eSirayeli,
khona-ke uthathe indodana noma indodakazi eyenze le nto embi, uyiveze emgwaqeni wedolobha lakho, uyitshele, aze afe.
Uma kukhona umuntu ofuna ukufa, kufanele abulawe ngokusho kwamasosha amabili noma amathathu; uma kukhona umuntu ofuna ukufa, kumele abulawe ngokusosha komuntu owodwa.
Amasosha kumele abe yibo abakuqala ukushaya ngombhoshongo lowo muntu, bese bonke abantu kufanele bahlanganyele kulo. Kuzosuswa lokhu okumbi phakathi kwenu.

Ezinye izingxabano ezifika phambi kwezinkantolo zakho zasendaweni zingaba nzima khulu bona uzigweme, njengezingxabano zokubulala, noma zokuthi ngubani onelungelo emdlalweni, noma zokulimala. Ngaleyo le uzithathele indawo ikosi uzimu wakho azoyikhetha.
Uzohamba ufike kubapristi, abaLevi, nommeli ozoba khona ngaleso sikhathi; uzobuza isinqumo sabo, begodu bazokutshela isiphetho sabo.
Uzosebenza ngesinqumo abakulethelayo, lapho ikosi ekhetha khona. Khumbula ukukwenza konke okuthe bakusho kuwe.
begodu ulandele imithetho sabo, kanye nesinqumo sabo, begodu akufanele ushintshe kusuka kwabo ngakwesokudla noma ngakwesobunxele.
Wonke umuntu, uma ehamba ngesandla sakhe esiqinile, begodu engawulalela umpristi, ohlala khona ekhonza ikosi uzimu wakho, noma ummeli, kumele abulawe; ngalokho-ke uzosusa okumbi ezweni lakwaSirayeli.
Begodu abantu bonke bazokubona, begodu bazokhathazeka, begodu ngeke baphinde babekezela.
Uma usufike ezweni ikosi uThixouNkulunkulu wakho akunika lona, ube yilungu layo, uhlala kulo; bese uthi, Sibeke ukumkani phezu kwethu, njengokuba zikhona izizwe zonke ezimi ngaso soke isikhathi.
Uma kunjalo, qiniseka bona uyakwenza ube ngukumkani lowo ikosi uzimu wakho ozowukhetha; kumele abe yindodana yakho; ngeke ubeke phezu kwakho umuntu ongaphandle, ongasekho phakathi kwabaSirayeli.
Akufanele ukumkani ahlanganise amahhashi amanengi, begodu abuyisele abantu eYiputa ukuze abe nemahhashi amakhulu; ngombana ikosi uthi kuwe: Awuzobuya ngaleyo le njalo.
Akudingeki bona athathe amadoda amanengi, ukuze inhliziyweni yakhe ingaphazamisi ikosi; begodu akudingeki bona agcine igolide nesilivere eningi.
Uma uhlala esihlalweni sakhe sobukhosi, kufanele abhale ikopi yalo mthetho encwadini yakhe, evela kwikopi eligcinwe ezinyaweni zabapristi abaLevi.
Uzoyigcina, begodu uzoyifunda yonke imihla yokuphila kwakhe, ukuze afunde ukukhathazeka kuYehova uzimu wakhe, bona agcine akwenze zonke izimiso zalo mthetho nalawo malungiselelo.

Akekho ozocabanga bona ungcono ukudlula bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, begodu angeke ashintshe isandla sakhe sokudla noma isandla sakhe sakwesobunxele; kodwana yena nomndeni wakhe bazolawula ezweni likaSirayeli iminyaka emide.
Abapristi abaLevi, bonke isizwe sakwaLevi, ngeke babe nengxenye ezweni lakwaSirayeli; bazodla iminikelo yokushiswa kaYehova, leyo yinxalenye sabo.
Bazobe bengathola izwe phakathi kwezizwe, ngombana ikosi nguye ozoba yingxenye sabo, njengokuthi wathi kubo.
Lokhu okuzothathwa ngababhishobhi kilabo abantu abanikela ngenhlanhla sabo, noma ingulube, noma inkomo: umlenze, nemilenze emibili, nesisu.
Banikeze nezinto zokuqala zembewu yakho, newayini lakho elisha, nophethiloli lwakho, nezingulube zakho ezincane.
Ngokuba ikosi uzimu wakho wakhetha labo, nabangane babo ngemuva kwabo, phakathi kwezizwe zenu zonke, ukuba bahlale bekhonza ngegama ikosi nsukuzonke.
ULevi angasuka kiwo wonke amadolobha aseSirayeli, lapho uhlala khona, afike endaweni ikosi azoyikhetha, ngenxa yothando lwakhe lokuya kuyo.
Ake asebenze khona ngegama likaYehova uzimu wakhe, njengabo bonke abazalwane bakhe abaLevi, abasebenza khona phambi kukaYehova.
Kudingeka athole inkontileka elinganayo yokudla, ngisho nakuba unemali evela ekuthengiseni izimpahla zomndeni wakhe.
Uma usufike ezweni ikosi uzimu wakho akunika lona, ungafundi ukukwenza ngokwezinto ezibi zazo zonke izizwe.
Akufanele kube khona umuntu phakathi kwenu onikela unyana wakhe noma intombi yakhe emgodini, noma okhuluma ngezinkanyezi, noma okhuluma ngezinhlamvu, noma osebenza ngesihluku, noma owenza izimanga,
noma enza izimanga abantu, noma ekhuluma namaphupho, noma uyisizi, noma ezama ukuxoxa nabantu abafileyo.
Wonke umuntu owenza zonke lezi zinto, ikosi uyazixosha; ngenxa yazo zonke lezi zinto ezingathandeki, ikosi uThixouNkulunkulu wakho ubasusa phambi kwenu.
Uzobe uthembekile ngokuphelele kukaNkulunkulu wakho.
Uma izizwe ozikhiphayo zilalela abantu abanezintshisekelo, nalabo abaivelisayo; kodwana ikosi uzimu wakho akakuvumele bona wenze lokhu.
uzimu wakho, ikosi, uzokulethela umprofeti ovela emiphakathini yakho, efana nami; yena nizomulalela.

Ngokuya ngento oyicelayo kuYehova uzimu wakho emfuleni iSina, ngosuku lokuhlangana kwenu, esithi, Akufanele siphinde sibe nezwi leNkosi uzimu wethu, noma siphinde sibone lomlilo omkhulu, ukuze singafa.
Wathi ikosi kuye, Kulungile lokho abakushoyo.
Ngizobavusa umprofeti phakathi kwabo, njengokho wena; ngizobeka amagama ami emlonyeni wakhe, azokhuluma nabo zonke izinto engikumwisela kuzo.
Uma umuntu engalalelanga amazwi ami, akhulumayo umprofeti ngegama lami, ngizowubeka engozini yena.
Kodwana umprofeti uma ekhuluma ngegama lami, into engingeke ngimwise bona akhulume ngayo, noma uma ekhuluma ngegama labanye abangcwele, lowo mprofeti kufanele aphele.
Uzothi, Ngabe singazi kanjani bona umlayezo awukho osuka kukaNkulunkulu?
Uma umprofeti ekhuluma ngegama lika-Yehova, begodu lokho akutjhoko akwenzeki, noma akwenzekile, khona-ke lo mbhalo awukho kukaNkulunkulu. Lo mprofeta ukhulume ngokuzinikela kwakhe; ungamkhohlwa.
UYehova uzimu wakho uzozibulala zonke izizwe, ezinika wena izwe labo; begodu uma uzinqobe, bese uhlala emizini sabo nasezikhungweni zabo.
ukhetheni imiphakathi emithathu enkingeni yenu, ezweni ikosi uThixouNkulunkulu wenu akunika lona ukuba lilungu lenu.
Uzozenza izitezi, uhlukanise izwe lakho, elikunika lona ikosi uzimu wakho ukuba libe yikhaya lakho, zibe yizingxenye amathathu; ukuze wonke lowo obulala umuntu ahambe esinye salezi zifunda.
Le yimithetho yomuntu obulala umuntu begodu ehamba khona ukusindisa impilo yakhe: kumele abulawe umngane wakhe ngengozi, ngaphandle kokuxosha kwangaphambili.

Njengesibonelo, umuntu angaya emfuleni nomngane wakhe ukusika umnqumo. Uma ecindezela i-ax ukuze akhuphule umnqumo, intamo ingahamba ngaphandle kwesandla begodu ihlasele umngane wakhe ibulala yena. Lo muntu angahamba kusinye salezi zindawo begodu agcine impilo yakhe.

Uma kungenjalo, umshado womuntu oshonile onesibopho sokuxolisa umbulalayo ungamlandela ngejubane. Uma uhambo lude, angamuthola begodu amhole, nakuba umuntu akafanele ukufa, ngombana akhenge athande umngane wakhe ngaphambi kwalokho.
Ngalokho ngikutshela bona ukhethe izifunda amathathu.
uzimu wakho, ikosi, akwenze izwe lakho libe likhulu khulu, njengombana atjhilo kwababa bakho, begodu akunikeze lonke izwe lakhe, njengombana atjhilo kubo.

uma nje ugcina ukwenzela zonke lezi mithetho, ngikuwisela umthetho ngayo namuhla, bona uyithande ikosi uzimu wakho, ukuba ukhambe phambi kwakhe yonke imihla; khona-ke uzozikhethela ezinye izizwe amathathu, ngaphandle kwalezi zithathu.
Uzokwenza lokhu, ukuze umuntu ongenacala angafa ezweni ikosi uzimu wakho akunika lona bona ube yintando yakho; begodu ungabi necala lokufa kwakhe.
Uma kukhona umuntu othandana nomndeni wakhe, efihlakele, efuna ukuwubulala, bese ehamba esinye salezi zifundazwe.
begodu, uma efika emzini wakhe, amaphoyisa azothumela ukuwathola, ukuthatha kuye ngaphandle komgwaqo, begodu wanikela kuye umlingani wakhe, ukuze agweme ingozi yokuphila.
Akufanele ukhathazeke ngaye, kodwana kufanele uhlanze isizwe sakwaSirayeli ekufakeni abantu abangenacala, ukuze kube lula kuwe.
Ungayihambisanga imikhawulo yomngane wakho, eyabe ibekwe yimiphakathi yangaphambilini kwakho, ezweni ozoba nalo, ezweni ikosi uzimu wakho akunika lona ukuze ulithathe.
Umshayeli owodwa akakwazi ukukhombisa umuntu bona unecala, noma enze inkohlakalo. Ubufakazi bokuthi isinqumo sizothathwa ngemilomo yabantu ababini noma abathathu.
Uma umshushisi okhohlisayo uhlala phezulu ukusola umuntu ngecala,
labo bantu ababili ababhekene necala kumele bahlale phambi kukaYehova, phambi kwabavikeli nabasenkantolo abazobe bekhona ngesikhathi salokho.
Uma kubhekwa bona lo mshushisi ungumkhohlisi, ekhuluma ubuxoki mayelana nomunye wesizwe samaSirayeli,
bese ungenza kulowo okhuluma ngokungeqiniso, njengokuthi lowo okhuluma ngobugebengu wayefuna ukukwenza komunye umuntu. Uzosusa okumbi phakathi kwenu.
Nabo bonke abanye abantu bazokubona, begodu bazokhathazeka; ngeke kube khona umuntu ozoqhubeka ekwenzeni lokhu okumbi phakathi kwenu.
Akufanele ukhathazeke ngabo. Ubuhlungu kufanele bulinganise necala: impilo ngempilo, inhliziyo ngenhliziyo, izinyo ngezinyo, isandla ngesandla, ingalo ngenyawo.
Uma usuya empilweni yokulwa nabaphikisi bakho, bese ubona amabhayisikili, namabhasi, nomphakathi omkhulu kunawe, ungabakhohlwa; ngombana ikosi, uzimu wakho, owakulethela ezweni laseYiputa, unguwe.
Uma ufuna ukungena emdlalweni, umpristi kufanele afike ngaphambilini begodu akhulume nomndeni.
Uzothi, Lila, isiSirayeli; namuhla niphumani ukubhekana nabaphikisi benu emdlalweni. Ungabi nenhliziyo ebuhlungu, ungabi nomoya, noma ukhathazeke, begodu ungabi nomsindo ngenxa sabo.
Ngokuba ikosi uzimu wenu, yena ohamba nani; yena ozobhekana nabahlukumezayo ngenxa yenu, ukuze akusindise.
Bathi abaphathi kubo bonke abantu, bathi, Ingabe kukhona umuntu owenza indlu entsha, begodu angayilungiseleli? Uzobuyela ekhaya lakhe; kungase kube wukufa emkhosini, begodu omunye umuntu ayenze.
Ingabe kukhona umuntu otshala iviniga, akayidla isithelo sayo? Uzobuyela ekhaya lakhe; noma ngabe uzofa emkhosini, begodu omunye umuntu uzokudla isithelo sayo.
Ingabe kukhona umfazi owazibophezela kuye, kodwana akhenge azinikele kuye? Ake ahambe ekhaya lakhe; noma ngabe uzofa emdlalweni begodu omunye umuntu azonikela yena.
Uma kukhona umuntu okhathazekile, noma elahlekile ithemba lakhe, kufanele ahambe ekhaya, ukuze nabangani bakhe abazobe belahleka ithemba labo.
Uma abaphathi beqedile ukukhuluma nemikhosi, kufanele bakhethe abaholi abazoyiongoza.
Uma uhamba ukuhlasela idolobha, kuqala unikeza abantu bayo isiqiniseko.
Uma bekuvuma, begodu bekuvulela wena amasango abo, khona-ke bonke abantu abakhona bazobe bengabasebenzi bakho, basebenze kuwe.
Uma bengeke bakulethe isiqiniseko kuwe, begodu bangakuhlasela, khona-ke hlanganisana nabo bese uqala ukuwahlasela.
Uma ikosi uzimu wakho ekulethela phambi kwakho, uzobulala wonke umuntu okhona ngeqhwa.

Kodwana izifazane, nezincane, nezilwane ezifuywayo, nanoma yini ekhona kulo dolobha, uzozithatha wena; uzozidla zonke izimpahla zobugebengu obusuka kuma-aphoyintimenti akho, okuthi ikosi uzimu wakho akunikeze zona.
Uzokwenza njalo namadolobha onke asendaweni engaphandle kwakho, amadolobha angaba yiyo imiphakathi yezwe elinokude nawe.
Kodwana ezindaweni zezizwe, azininika ikosi uzimu wakho ukuba zibe yindawo yakho yokuhlala, ungashiyanga lutho oluphilayo.
Uzozibulala ngazo zonke izinto, amaHeti, nama-Amoreti, namaKanana, namaPerizi, namaHivi, namaJebhusi, njengombana ikosi uzimu wakho akuwisele umthetho.
ukuze bangakufundisi bona nilandele zonke izinto ezingathandeki, abazenzayo kumathikithi abo; begodu nigweme ikosi uzimu wenu.

Uma ubhekene nedolobha begodu uhlasele isikhathi eside ukulithatha, akusho bona ungalimaza izihlahla zayo ngokuzisusa nge-axe. Ungadla izithelo zazo, ngalokho-ke akufanele uzisuse. Ingabe izihlahla zesihlabathi abantu, ukuze uhlasele?
Uma nje ungazi bona imithi yakho ayikhiqizi ukudla, ungayisusa, uyisebenzisele ukwakha izindlu zokugqugquzela lo mzi obhekene nawe empilweni, kuze kube yilapho iwela.
Uma kutholakala umuntu obulawe, eshonile emhlabathini, ezweni ikosi uzimu wakho akunika lona ukuba ube yintando yakho, begodu akukho muntu owaziyo bona ubani owabulala.
Abaphathi bakho nabameli bakho kumele baphume begodu balinganise ubude obusuka kulowo mphefumulo kuya ezifundeni ezincane.
Ngalokho-ke, abaphathi bedolobhana elinabantu abaningi kufanele bathathe inkomo encane engakaze isebenze begodu engakade igqoke intambo.
Kuyadingeka bona bagweme umlambo ohambayo, lapho izwe alizange lihlolwe noma lisetshenzisiwe khona. Kulesi siqhingi kufanele baphula intamo yengulube encane

Bazofika ababhishobhi, oonyana bakaLawi; ngombana ikosi uzimu wakho wabakhethe ukuba basebenze naye, begodu ukuba babembezele ngegama lakhe; nabo bazobe belungisa zonke izingqungquthela, nanoma yisiphi isinqumo secala.
Lapho-ke bonke abaphathi bedolobhana elibhekene nenyama kumele bahlanze izandla zabo phezu kwengulube encane ohlangothini lwayo lwaphucuka emfuleni.
Bazothi: "Asikho isandla sethu esibulala lo muntu, begodu amehlo ethu awabonile lokhu kwenziwa.
Kosi, usindise abantu bakho isiSirayeli, owabakhululayo; ungawafaki engozini abantu bakho isiSirayeli, ukuba babulala umuntu ongenacala. Bazokhululwa ngenxa yokubulala kwabo.
Ngaleyo le nizohlanza inhliziyo yenu, ningabi necala lokubulala umuntu ongeivele; ngombana nikwenze lokho okulungile emehlo kaYehova.
Uma usuya empilweni yokulwa nabaphikisi bakho, begodu ikosi uThixouNkulunkulu wakho awazinikela kuwe, bese uthatha abantu abafileyo;
ungabona phakathi kwabafileyo indodakazi ebukekayo, uthandane naye, begodu ufuna ukumshada.
Yazisa ekhaya lakho. Uzodinga ukuba ahlanze ikhanda lakhe begodu athathe izicubu zakhe,

begodu ugqoke izicathulo zakhe, lapho uthethwe; begodu kufanele ahlale ekhaya lakho, begodu ukhathazeke ubaba wakhe nomama wakhe usuku lonke; begodu ngemva kwalokho ungaya kuye, ube indodana yakhe, naye abe indodana yakho.

Uma ungathandanga yena, vumelani bona ahambe lapho efuna khona. Ungamthengi ngemali, noma ukwenze abe ngumkhonzi, ngombana uyamkhohlisa; kodwana uma uthandana naye, vumelani bona ahambe lapho efuna khona.
Uma kukhona umuntu onezifazane ezimbili, ethandana nomunye wazo, kodwana engathandani nomnye wabo, begodu bazalwa naye izingane, khona-ke umfazi omdala uyisifazane ongathandeki.

Uma enikela ngempahla yakhe kubantwana bakhe, akufanele anikezele ilungelo lokuzalwa lokuqala kumntwana womyeni wakhe othandekako endaweni yomntwana womyeni wakhe ongathandani naye, owayengumzali wokuthoma.

Uzothatha unyana wakhe, umfazi angeke amthande, abe ngumzali wokuthoma, begodu uzomnika inkontileka ephindwe kabili yezinto zakhe zonke. Lo mntwana nguphawu lokuqala lwesiqiniseko sobaba wakhe, begodu ilungelo lomzali wokuthoma liwuwo.
Uma ngabe umuntu unendodana enobugebengu, engavumelani noyise noma nomyeni wakhe; begodu uma bemutshela, akawatholi amagama abo.
Ubaba wakhe nomama wakhe kumele bathathe yena, begodu babengele kuye abaphathi emgwaqeni wedolobha lakhe.
Bathi kumadodana edolobhaneni lakhe, Lo mntwana wethu ubuhlungu khulu, uivelele, akaze athobele ilizwi lethu; begodu udla khulu, usela.
Amadoda wonke edolobhaneni lakhe azomgqugquzela ngomlilo, aze aphele. Uzokhipha lokhu okumbi phakathi kwakho; bonke isiSirayeli bazokubona, begodu bazokhathazeka.
Uma umuntu esenza inkohlakalo efanele ukufa, begodu ebulawa, begodu isidumbu sakhe siboshwe emgodini,

ngeke ushiye umphefumulo wakhe ekhonjisiwe emgodini nsuku zonke, kodwana uzowufihla ngalolusuku olulodwa; ngombana wonke umuntu okhonjisiwe emgodini unqunywe nguzimu. Ngalokho awuzoyiphazamisa izwe ikosi uzimu wakho akunika lona bona libe yikhaya lakho.
Uma ubona inkomo noma ingulube yomngane wakho ehamba, ungaze uyenze bona awubonile. Kubalulekile bona uyibuyisele kumnikazi wayo.
Uma umnikazi ahlala eduze kwakho, noma uma awuyazi bona ngubani ophethe imoto, thola imoto bese uyigcina ekhaya kuze kube yilapho umnikazi efika efuna yona. Ngemuva kwalokho uyibuyisele.
Yenza okufanayo uma uthola inkomo sabo, isigqoko sabo, noma iyiphi enye into abayilahle. Ungazi bona awuyiboni.
Uma ubona inkomo noma ingulube yomngane wakho waseSirayeli iwela phasi emgwaqweni, ungaze ucabange bona awuzange uyibone. Qiniseka bona usiza umnikazi ukuba aphinde ayibeke phezulu.
Uwesifazane ngeke agqoke izicathulo zamadoda, begodu umfazi ngeke agqoke izicathulo zabesifazane; ngombana uzimu wakho, ikosi, unqume wonke umuntu owenza lokhu.
Uma uthola i-nest yezinyoni eduze kwendlela, emuthini noma ezweni, begodu umama uhlala phezu kwezilwane ezincane noma amaqanda, akufanele uthathe umama kanye nezingane.
Ungathatha izingane, kodwana uqiniseke bona ushiya umzali wakhe ahambe, ukuze konke kuqhubeke kahle nawe begodu ube nokuphila okude.
Uma ukwakha ikhaya elisha, kubeka umgwaqo omncane ngaphesheya kwesiivele, ukuze ungabi necala lokufa komnye umuntu uma ewela phasi.
Ungase ubeke izithelo ezimbili ezihlukene evinini sakho; ngombana uma ukwenza njalo, imbewu yakho yonke izolahleka, kanye nembewu oyithumeleyo, kanye nokudla kwevini.
Ungagqugquzeli ngengulube nebhontshisi eziboshwe ndawonye.
Ungagqoki izicathulo ezenziwe ngendwangu nelinen ethosiwe ndawonye.
Yenza ama-tassels emakhoneni amane we-cloak ogqoke.
Uma umuntu eshada indodana yendoda, uhlala naye, bese ebuyela emuva kuye.
Wathi: "Ngimshadele lo mfana, kodwana lapho ngiye embhedeni naye ngathola bona angeke abe yindodakazi." (Izwi lika-Allah lizwakala)
Ngemuva kwalokho ubaba nomama wesifazane kumele baveze isiqiniseko sokuthi wayeyindodakazi kubaholi bedolobha esitezi.
Ubaba wakhe uzothi kubo abaphathi, Ngimnike lo muntu intombi yami ukuba abe ngumkakhe; kodwana yena washintsha uhlangothi.

begodu, uma yena ukhuluma ngaye izinto ezibi, esithi: "Ngithole bona indodana yakho ayikho intombazane," khona-ke, lokhu kukhombisa bona indodana yami ayikho intombazane. Ngaleyo le, umzali wakhe kufanele wandise isigqoko phambi kwabaphathi edolobhaneni.
Abaphathi balo dolobhana kumele bathathe lo muntu bagweme.

Bazothi, "Uzokhokhelwa imali eyizinkulungwane zezinhlamvu zesilivere, begodu uzonikezwa ubaba wowesifazane; ngombana lo muntu waveza igama elibi kulowo wesifazane waseSirayeli. Uzohlala yena indodakazi yakhe; ngeke ayishiye yonke imihla yakhe.
Uma isinqumo siyiqiniso, begodu asikho isiqiniseko sokuthi indodakazi yakhe ibiyindodakazi,

khona-ke kufanele athathwe, afike emgwaqeni wendlu yakhe ubaba wakhe, begodu abantu edolobhaneni lakhe kumele bagweme kuye ngetshe, ukuze aphele; ngombana yena wakwenza okumbi ezweni lakwaSirayeli, ukuba nomfazi emndenini wakhe ubaba wakhe. Ngaleyo le uzosusa iphutha phakathi kwenu.
Uma kwenzeka umuntu etholakale egqugquzela indodana yomyeni wakhe, kufanele bafa bonke, indodana nomfazi; ukuze ususe okumbi ezweni laseSirayeli.
Uma umuntu ehlangana nomfazi osemncane, ongasekho emzini wakhe, begodu abulawe naye, bese ethola bona umndeni wakhe unenhlanhla.

Uzobeka labo bobabili emgwaqeni wale dolobhana, ubeke amatshe phezu kwabo, bafe. Ubeke intombazane ngaphasi kwamatshe ngenxa yokuthi yahlala edolobhaneni, begodu akhenge anikeze insindiso; nomfazi ngaphasi kwamatshe ngenxa yokuthi wamisa indodakazi yomuntu ozayo; ukuze ususe okumbi phakathi kwenu.
Uma umuntu ehlangana nomfazi osemshadweni, emzini wakhe, bese umnyanzela ukuba ahlale naye, khona-ke lowo owenza lokhu kuphela ozofa.
Akufanele ukwenze noma yini kulesi sifazane, ngombana ayikho inkohliso yakhe efanele ukufa. Le nkinga ifana nomuntu obulala umngane wakhe,
ngombana indodana yakhe yatholakale ezweni. Uwesifazane okhulelwe wakhala, kodwana kwakungekho muntu ongamsiza.
Uma umuntu ehlangana nomfazi osemncane, ongasekho emshadweni wakhe, wathatha indodakazi yakhe, wahlala naye, begodu batholakale.
Uzokhokhela ubaba wakhe amashekeli amashumi mahlanu egolide, begodu uzomshada naye, ngenxa yokuthi wamkhohlisa; ngeke amshiye isikhathi esigcwele sokuphila kwakhe.
Akufanele umuntu athathe indodana yobaba wakhe, angeke akhohlise ubaba wakhe, abe naye.
Akunamuntu ophindwe, noma ohlukaniswe izitho zakhe zocansi, angafika engqungqutheleni kaYehova.
Wonke umuntu ozalwa ngendodana yowesifazane, ngeke afike engqungqutheleni kaYehova; ngisho nomndeni wabo, kuze kube yiminyaka eyishumi, ngeke afike.
U-Amoni noma u-Mowabi angeke afike engqungqutheleni kaYehova; ngisho nohlobo lwawo oluyishumi ngeke lifike kulo.
ngenxa yokuthi bekungakuhlanganiseni ngenyama namanzi emgwaqeni, lapho niphuma eYiputa; begodu baqasha uBhileham, unyana kaBeore, wasePethore eMesopotamia, ukuba akulambe.
Kodwana ikosi, uzimu wakho, akafuni ukulalela uBhileham; kodwana ikosi, uzimu wakho, waguqula lo mthetho ube wusizo kuwe, ngombana ikosi, uzimu wakho, ukuthanda wena.
Uma uphila, akufanele uzame ukuwasiza bona babe nokuthula noma baphumelele.
Uma uthandana nomuntu wase-Edom, ungamthandeki; uma uthandana nomuntu waseMisiya, ungamthandeki; ngombana uhlala ezweni labo.
Nabantwana abazalwa kubo, kuze kube yiminyaka emithathu, bangaya engqungqutheleni kaYehova.
Uma nisesiteshini sokulwa nabaphikisi bakho, hlalani kude nanoma yini eyenza ukuba nibi.
Uma kukhona umuntu phakathi kwakho ongeke ahlanzeke, ngenxa yento ekwenzekile kuye ekuseni, kufanele aphume ngaphandle kwekhabhinethi, ahlale khona.
Kodwana uma kufike ubusuku, kufanele ahlanzwe ngamanzi, begodu lapho ilanga liphuma khona, angabuya esitezi.
Kube khona indawo ngaphandle kwekamva lapho ungaya khona egumbini lokugezela.
Nciphisa i-shovel kanye namathuluzi akho. Uma usuya egumbini lokugezela, xhuma umngcele ngale nto, bese uvala izidakamizwa zakho.

ngombana ikosi, uzimu wakho, ehamba phakathi kwekhabhinethi yakho, ukuze akulondoloze wena, begodu abeke phambi kwakho izitha zakho; ngalokho ikhebhini lakho kumele libe lingcwele, ukuze angabona lutho olubi phakathi kwenu, aze ahambe.
Uma umkhonzi esuka kumnikazi wakhe, begodu wafika kuwe ukuphepha, awukwazi ukubuyisela kuye umnikazi wakhe.
Uzohlala phakathi kwenu ezweni lakhe, lapho ethanda khona; begodu mna-ke angeke nimubisele.
Akukho mntu wesiSirayeli umfazi noma umfazi ongase abe ngumqambi wethempeli.
Ungayingenisi imali yowesifazane, noma izimali zowesifazane, endlwini kaYehova uzimu wakho, ukuze ukhokhele noma iyiphi induduzo; ngombana ikosi uzimu wakho unokuthobeka kubo bonke.
Mhlawumbe uzoba nemali, noma ukudla, noma iyiphi enye into ongayithola imali ekhokhwayo.

Uzokwazi ukuthatha inzalo kumuntu ongaphandle kwezwe, kodwana akufanele uthathe inzalo emndenini wakwaSirayeli; khona-ke ikosi uzimu wakho uzokubambisana nawe kiwo wonke umsebenzi wakho, ezweni okungena kulo ukulithola.
Uma usenza isibopho kuYehova uzimu wakho, ungabi nesikhathi sokuyifeza; ngombana ikosi uzimu wakho uzoyifuna kuwe, ukuze ungabi nobubi, uma ungayenzanga.
Kodwana uma ukhetha bona ungakwenza isivumelwano, ngeke ube necala.
Uma ukhuluma bona uzokwenza konke lokhu, qiniseka bona uyakwenza; ngombana uma ubeke isibopho kukaNkulunkulu wakho ngomlomo wakho, kufanele uyigcine.
Uma ufika ezindaweni zewayini zomngane wakho, ungadla izithelo eziningi njengombana ufuna, kodwana akufanele ubeke lutho emgodini.
Uma usuya ezindaweni zokudla zenkosikazi yakho, ungakwazi ukuqoqa imbewu ngesandla sakho, kodwana awudingi ukuqoqa izithelo zayo ngesiqhingi.
Uma umuntu eshada indodakazi, begodu engathandani nayo, ngenxa yokuthi wafumana icala elibi ngaye, khona-ke ubhalela isitifiketi sokuzibophezela, wamnika, wamshiya ekhaya lakhe.
Ngemuva kokushiya indlu yakhe, angaba nguwesifazane wesifazane.
uma umfazi wakhe wesifazane ebuyela kuye, abhalele incwadi yokwahlulela, amnikeze yona, amshiye ekhaya lakhe; noma ngabe umyeni wakhe wesifazane uzofa.

Umfazi wakhe wokuthoma, owawumshiya, ngeke aphinde abe ngumkakhe; ngombana yena wanyamalala, ngombana lokhu kungenxa yobubi ebusweni bukaYehova. Ngalokho-ke ngeke ubeke izwe elinikwe nguYehova uzimu wakho ukuba libe yikhaya lakho.
Uma umuntu ekhulelwe, akufanele adluliselwe emkhosini noma abe nomsebenzi othile. Ngonyaka owodwa ukhululekile ukuba ahlale ekhaya begodu enze indodana yakhe entsha ijabulise.
Ngalokho-ke, akufanele uthathe amatshe emishini amabili, noma ngisho namatshe emishini aphezulu kuphela, njengenkokhelo yezimali. Lokhu kuzothatha indlela yokuphila yomntu.
Uma umuntu etholakale ethatha umngane wakhe waseSirayeli, ekwenza abe ngumkhonzi, noma ethengisa umkhonzi wakhe, lowo othatha umkhonzi kufanele aphele; ngalokho-ke uzosusa okumbi phakathi kwenu.
Uma kwenzeka kuvela isifo esibi, kufanele ucabangele khulu bona wenze konke okuzokuzifundisa amaLevi, abapristi; kumele ucabangele bona wenze konke ongangibawiselayo.
Khumbula lokho ikosi uzimu wakho akwenze kuMireyamu, ngesikhathi niphuma eYiputa ngendlela.
Uma udlulisa umngane wakho noma yini, ungangeni ekhaya lakhe ukuze uthathe into abanika yona njengenkokhelo.
Uhlale ngaphandle, begodu uvumele umuntu ofuna ukuwudlulisa bona akulethe kuwe.
Uma umuntu ehlwempu, akufanele ukhambe ukuphumula ngenkathi ugcina isiqinisekiso sabo.
Ngiyakucela, uphinde ubabuyisele izicathulo zabo ngaphambi kokuphuma kwelanga, ukuze baphumule kuzo; khona-ke bazokubambisana nawe, begodu uzimu wakho, ikosi, uzobona bona wenza kahle.
Uma ufisa ukuba umqashi wakho, noma umqashiivelwa wakho, noma ilungu lakho, noma isivakashi sakho esihlala ezindaweni zakho zokuqasha, akufanele ube necala.
Uzobanika umholo wabo ngosuku ngalunye, ngaphambi kokuphuma kwelanga; ngombana bangamahlwempu, begodu bafuna umnikelo wokudla; ukuze bangaze bekhala kuwe kuYehova, nawe ube nesono.
Abazali bangafa ngenxa yomsebenzi owenza izingane zabo, begodu izingane zingafa ngenxa yomsebenzi owenza abazali babo. Wonke umuntu uyafa ngenxa yesono sakhe.
Ngalokho-ke, akufanele uthathe inkontileka ngemali encane, begodu akufanele uthathe inkontileka ngemali enkulu.
Uzokhumbula bona ube ngumkhonzi ezweni laseMisri, begodu ikosi uzimu wakho wakukhulula khona; ngalokho ngikutshela bona wenze lokhu.

Uma uvuna izithelo zakho ezweni lakho, bese ukhohlwa iqoqo elilodwa lembewu, ungabuyeli ukulithola; uyishiye kulowo ongaphandle kwezwe, nengane yomama, nomfazi; ukuze ikosi uzimu wakho akubabazise kiwo wonke umsebenzi wezandla zakho.
Uma uvuna izithelo zakho ze-olive, akufanele uphinde uhlele amaqabunga akho; kufanele ushiye okushiwo kulowo ohlala ezweni elilodwa, noyemalume, nomfazi.
Uma uvuna izithelo evinini sakho, awukwazi ukugibela ivini lakho kathathu; uzozishiya kulowo ovela kwamanye amazwe, nengane yomalume, nendodakazi.
Uzokhumbula bona nibe ngabakhonzi ezweni laseMisri; ngalokho ngikutshela bona wenze lokhu.
Uma abantu bekhala, kufanele bathathe icala enkantolo, begodu abameli bazothatha isinqumo ngecala. Bamele bamemezele bona umuntu ongekho emthethweni ulungile kanti lowo owinile akalungile.
Uma umuntu owinile efanele ukudlwengula, khona-ke ummeli kufanele ambeke phasi begodu amdlwengula phambi kwakhe, ngenani lemicibisholo elinganayo necala lakhe.
Akufanele umqokeleli agweme ukubulala abantu abangumashumi amane; uma ekwenza ngaphezu kwalokho, khona-ke umndeni wakho uzogxekwa phambi kwakho.
Musa ukuvala umlomo wengulube ukuze uyivimbele ekudleni ngenkathi icindezela izithelo.

Uma kukhona abazalwane abaphila ndawonye, begodu omunye wabo efa ngaphandle komntwana, indodakazi yakhe ayidingi ukushada umuntu ongaphandle kwemindeni sabo. Umfazi wendodakazi yakhe kumele atshade naye begodu enze umsebenzi wakhe njengenkosikazi.
Umfazi oneminyaka eyisishiyagalombili ubudala uzothatha igama lomyeni wakhe owafa, ukuze igama lakhe lingacishiswe emaSirayeli.

Uma umuntu engathandanga ukumnika indodakazi yomngane wakhe, khona-ke indodana yomngane wakhe izoya esiphethweni somnyango kwabakhulu bedolobha lakhe, ithi, Umngane wami wesifazane akafuni ukubeka igama lomfana wakhe wesifazane eSirayeli; akafuni ukungifeza inkontileka yomndeni.
Bazothi labo abakhulu edolobhaneni lakhe, bamwise, bakhulume naye; begodu uma eqhubeka esithi, Angifuni ukumnika indodakazi,

udadewabo wowesifazane kufanele afike kuye phambi kwabaholi, aphuze isigqoko sakhe esingaphansi kwenyawo lakhe, aphuze emlonyeni wakhe, begodu akhulume, athi, Kunjalo okuzokwenziwa umuntu ongeke alungise ikosi yakhe.
Ngaleso sikhathi, umndeni wakhe uzoziwa eSirayeli njengo "umndeni womntu umfazi wezinkinobho zakhe zasuswa."
Uma abantu bephikelelana, begodu indodana yomunye wabo ifike isindise umfazi wakhe kulowo omphilela yena, yafinyelela yawubamba umyeni wakhe ngemisipha yakhe,
udinga ukucima isandla sakhe. Ungakhathazeki ngaye
Musa ukuthwala izinto ezimbili ezihlukene emgodini wakho, eyodwa enzima nenye elula.
Musani ukubeka endlwini yenu imilinganiselo emibini, enye enkulu nenye encane.
Uzosebenzisa izilinganiso ezilungile, nezilinganiselo ezifanele, ukuze uhlale isikhathi eside ezweni ikosi uzimu wakho akunika lona.
Ngokuba ikosi uzimu wakho unqume wonke umuntu owenza izinto ezinjalo, wonke umuntu onecala.
Khumbula lokho akwenzayo ama-Amaleki kuwe, lapho usuka eYiputa, ngendlela yakho.
begodu, lapho ukhathazekile begodu elahlekile, bahlangana nawe emgwaqeni, begodu wahlasela bonke abancane, begodu akhenge agweme uzimu.

Uma ikosi, uzimu wakho, ekunika isikhala kusuka kiwo wonke amagugu akho asendaweni yakho yonke, ezweni ikosi, uzimu wakho, ekulethela wena ukuba liyilungelo lakho lomhlaba, uzowususa umqondo ka-Amaleki ngezansi kwesibhakabhakeni. Musa ukukhohlwa!
Uma usufike ezweni ikosi uThixouNkulunkulu wakho akunika lona bona libe yikhaya lakho, usayithola, ube khona kulo;
thola izithelo zokuqala zazo zonke izinto ozivuna ezweni ikosi uzimu wakho akunika lona, uzibeke emgodini, uye endaweni ongayikhetha ikosi uzimu wakho ukuba lihlale khona igama lakhe.
Uzohamba ufike kumpristi ozoba khona ngaleso sikhathi, uthi kuye, Ngitjho namhlanje kuYehova uzimu wakho, bona ngifike ezweni ikosi abewisela iziboshwa zethu ukuba lisinike.
Umbingeleli uzothatha ibhokisi esandlani sakho, awubeke phambi kwesibingelelo sikaYehova uzimu wakho.

Uzothi phambi kweNkosi ikosi uzimu wakho, Ubaba wami waba nguSirayeli ohamba ngezinyawo, wafika eYiputa, wahlala khona, yena nomndeni wakhe, abantu abambalwa kuphela; waba khona lapho abe yizwe elikhulu, elinamandla, elinabantu abaningi.
Kodwana amakhosikazi ase-Egypt wakwenza nathi kabi, begodu wakwenza ukuba sihlupheke, begodu wakwenza sisebenze kanzima njengezinja.
Sacela ikosi, uzimu wakwababa bethu; waphendula ikosi izingcingo zethu, wabona ukuhlupheka kwethu, nomsebenzi wethu onzima, nokuthi sacindezelwa.
Wathi ikosi wasikhipha eYiputa ngesandla esinamandla, nomlenze oqinile, ngothando olukhulu, ngezibonakaliso nezimanga.
Wenza bona sifike kule ndawo, wasisinika leli lizwe, izwe elishayela ubisi nojusi.
Manje ke, Kosi yami, ngikulethela imbewu yokuqala yezwe ongisinika lona; ubeke isitsha phambi koYehova uzimu wakho, ukhonze, uyeke ukuthandaza kuye.
Uzojabulela zonke izinto ezinhle ikosi uzimu wakho awakulethela wena nomndeni wakho, nawe, nalabaLevi, nalowo ohlala phakathi kwenu.

Ngomnyaka wesithathu, owunyaka wezingxenye ezilishumi, uma uqedile ukunikela izingxenye eziyishumi zazo zonke izimpahla zakho zokutshala, uzozinikeza umLevi, nomhlali wasemiphakathini, nowesimo sezulu, namadodakazi; bazodla ezindaweni zakho zokungena, baphuze.

Uzothi kuYehova uzimu wakho, Ngithathe endlwini yami izinto ezingcwele, ngazinikela kumaLevi, nomuntu ovela kwamanye amazwe, nomnaphakade, namadodakazi, njengokuba uxhumane nami; angishintshi emthethweni wakho, noma ngiwukhohlwe.

Ngingeke ngidle ngaleso sikhathi, uma sengifile; begodu ngingeke ngisuse ngaleso sikhathi, uma sengingcolile; begodu ngingeke ngibeke ngaleso sikhathi kilabo abafileyo. Ngitholele izwi likaYehova uzimu wami; ngakwenza konke okungiwisela umthetho ngalo.
Thola ezulu, endaweni yakho engcwele, begodu ubambise abantu bakho baseSirayeli, kanye nezwe elisinike lona, njengokuthi washo kubaba bethu, izwe elishayela ubisi nojusi.
Namhlanje ikosi uzimu wakho ukuwisela umthetho, bona wenze la malungiselelo nalawo mthetho; uzowagcina, uzowalungisa ngentliziyo yakho yonke, nomoya wakho wonke.
Namhlanje ukhuluma bona ikosi abe nguThixo wakho, begodu ukuba ukhambe ngezinqumo zakhe, begodu ugcine izimiso zakhe, namalungiselelo akhe, nezimiso zakhe, ukuze uzithobe.
uzimu usaziveza namuhla bona uzoba abantu bakhe, ube yindawo yakhe ekhethekile, njengombana wathi, ukuze ugcine zonke izimiso zakhe.
Uzokwenza uphakame ngaphezu kwazo zonke izizwe azenzayo, ukuze ube yintandokazi, negama, nobuhle; uzobe ngumuntu ongcwele kuYehova uzimu wakho, njengokuthi washo.
UMoses namadoda amakhulu aseSirayeli bamisa abantu, besithi, Nigcine yonke imiyalo yami engikhuluma ngayo namuhla.
Ngosuku lapho nidlula khona iJordani, nifike ezweni ikosi uThixouNkulunkulu wenu akunika lona, kufanele nibeke phezu kwazo amatshe amakhulu, nizigqoke ngeqhwa.

Uzobhalela phezu kwazo zonke izindaba zalo mthetho, uma udlula, ukuze ufike ezweni ikosi uzimu wakho akunika lona, izwe elifulathelayo umnqumo nemvubelo, njengokuthi ikosi uzimu wababa bakho wathi kuwe.
Uma nidlula iJordani, nizibeke ezitsheni lezi, njengombana ngikuwisela umthetho ngayo namuhla, emfuleni uEbhali, nizihlanganise ngeqhwa.
Uzokwakha khona isibingelelo kuYehova uzimu wakho, isibingelelo samatshe; ngeke usebenzise isandla sakho sensimbi kiwo.
Uzokwakha isibingelelo sikaYehova uzimu wakho ngezintaba zesizwe, ezingezitsheliwe; uzonikela phezu kwayo izipho zokudlwengula kuYehova uzimu wakho.
Uzonikela khona izipho zokuthula, uzozidla, ujabulise phambi koYehova uzimu wenu.
Uzobhalela ematsheni owazibeke khona zonke izithiyo zalesi mthetho, uzibhalele ngokucacile.
Wathi uMoses, nalaba bapristi abaLevi, kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, besithi: Yihlazani, nikhulume, abantu bakaSirayeli; namuhla niye waba ngabantu bakaYehova uzimu wenu.
Uzolalela ilizwi likaYehova uzimu wakho, ugcine imiyalo yakhe nemithetho yakhe, engikuwiselayo namuhla.
UMoses wamisa abantu ngalolusuku olulodwa, wathi,
Uma nidlula iJordani, basuke behlala phezu komfula uGarizim, ukubambisa abantu: uSimeoni, noLevi, noYuda, noIssakha, noYosefu, noBhenjamin.
Lawa madodakazi azohlala emfuleni i-Ebhali, ukuze abeke izimangalo: uRubhen, noGadi, noAsere, noZebuloni, noDani, noNaphtali.
Lawa maLevi azothi kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli,

Kubi nakakhulu lowo owenza isigodlo, noma ukhonkolo, noma igolide, begodu amise endaweni efihlakeleyo; ngombana yimisebenzi yezandla zomuntu osebenza ngesandla, begodu ikosi unquma ngayo. Baphendule abantu bonke, bathi, Ameni.
Kubi umuntu okhohlisa ubaba wakhe noma umama wakhe; begodu abantu bonke bazothi, Amen.
Uma umuntu eshintsha umkhawulo wenkosikazi yakhe, ulahlekile; begodu abantu bonke bazothi, Amen.
"Kubi khulu uma umuntu ehamba ngendlela engalungile umuntu omnyama." Bathi abantu bonke, "Amen!"
Ubi umuntu ongeke alungise isinqumo somuntu ongaphandle kwezwe, noma udadewabo, noma umkakhe; begodu abantu bonke bazothi, Amen.
Utholwe umuntu ohlala nomfazi kababa wakhe, ngombana ukhohlisa ubaba wakhe. Bathi bonke abantu: Amen.
Uma umuntu ethandana nanoma iyiphi inhlanzi, ulahlekile; begodu abantu bonke bazothi, Amen.
Uma umuntu uhlala nenkosikazi yakhe, noma ibe yindodana yobaba wakhe, noma ibe yindodana yomama wakhe, uzobiwa. Abantu bonke bazothi, Amen.
Uzophazamiseka lowo ohlala nenkosikazi yakhe; abantu bonke bazothi, Amen.
Kubi umuntu obulala umngane wakhe ngokufihlakeleyo. Bathi bonke abantu, Amen.
Utholwe wonke umuntu othatha umshwalense, ukuze abulala umuntu ongenacala. Bathi abantu bonke, Amen.
Utholwe wonke umuntu ongeke agcine amazwi lawa mthetho, akwenze; begodu abantu bonke bazothi, Ameni.

Uma nje ulalela ngokupheleleko izwi likaYehova uzimu wakho, bona ugcine ukwenze zonke izimiso zakhe, engizokuwisela umthetho ngazo namuhla, khona-ke ikosi uzimu wakho uzokwenza ube phezulu phezu kwazo zonke izizwe emhlabeni.
Zizofika kuwe zonke lezi zipho, zibe nawe, uma ulalela izwi likaYehova uzimu wakho.
Uzoba ngcwele edolobhaneni, begodu uzobe ngcwele ezweni.
Uzosindisa izingane zakho, nezitshalo zezwe lakho, nezingulube zezilwane zakho eziphilako, nezimbuzi zezinkomo zakho, nezimvu zezinkomo zakho, nezingulube zamakati akho.
Ibhokisi lakho kanye nebhodlela lakho lokubhaka lizosindisa.
Uzobe uhlanzekile uma ufika, begodu uzobe uhlanzekile lapho uphuma.
uzimu uzokwenza bona izitha zakho ezikuhlaselayo zihlaselwe phambi kwakho; zizofika kuwe ngandlela eyodwa, kodwana kuzohamba kude nawe ngandlela yesithupha.
uzimu uzobambisana nawe ezindaweni zakho zokugcina ukudla, nakwazo zonke izinto ozenzayo; uzimu uzimu wakho uzokubambisana nawe ezweni lakhe alikunika lona.
uzimu uzokwenza ube ngumuntu ongcwele kuye, njengombana ekusho kuwe, uma ugcina izimiso zikaYehova uzimu wakho, uhamba ngezinqumo zakhe.
Begodu kuzobona zonke izizwe zezulu bona wena ukaNkulunkulu, begodu bazokukhathazeka ngawe.
uzimu uzokwenza ube nezingane eziningi, nezilwane eziningi, nokudla okuningi, ezweni lakhe ikosi abewisela iziboshwa zakho ukuba likulethe.
