uzimu uzovula izulu, indawo yakhe yokugcina izinto ezinhle, ukuze asize imvula ezweni lakho ngesikhathi sayo, begodu asindise yonke imisebenzi yezandla zakho; uzodlulisa izizwe eziningi, kodwana wena awuzodluliswa.
uzimu uzokwenza ube yinhloko yakho, hhayi ibe yimpumputhe yakho; uzoba phezulu kuphela, awunakho ukuwa phasi; uma nje ulalela imiyalo kaYehova uzimu wakho, engikulethela yona namuhla, ukuze uyigcine.
Ungagcini nje ngokudla noma ngokwesobunxele, ekuphileni kwakho nganoma yisiphi isinqumo ngisibeka phambi kwenu namhlanje, ukuze ulandele izitha zabanye, uzikhonza.

Kodwana uma ungeke ulalele izwi likaYehova uzimu wakho, ukuze ugcine ukwenze zonke izimiso zakhe nezibopho zakhe, engikulethela wena namhlanje, kuzofika phezu kwakho zonke lezi zibulala-zinambuzane, zizokufinyelela.
Uzobiwa emzini, begodu uzobiwa nasezweni.
Ibhokisi lakho kanye nebhodwe lekhofi lizophazamisa.
Abantwana bakho bazobiwa, kanye nembewu yezwe lakho, nezingulube zezinkomo zakho, namaqanda emvubelo yakho.
Uzophazamiseka uma ufika, begodu uzophazamiseka lapho uphuma.

uzimu uzothumela phezu kwakho ukubi, nokungabaza, nokuphazamiseka kiwo wonke umsebenzi owenzayo, kuze kube yilapho uphela khona, begodu ube sengozini ngokushesha, ngenxa yobugebengu obukwenzele ngami.
uzimu uzokwenza izifo ezibulalayo zixhunywe kuwe, kuze kuphoqeleke bona ukhululwe ezweni okungena kulo ukulithola.
uzimu uzokushaya ngobuhlungu, nokushisa, nokuvuvukala, nomlilo, nesimo sezulu esibandayo, nokulimala kwezithelo zakho, nezifo ezibulalayo; zizokuzilandela kuze kufike ukuphelelwa.
Isibhakabhaka esiphezulu kwekhanda lakho sizoba segolide, begodu umhlaba ongaphansi kwamadolo akho uzoba sensimbi.
Kusukela emkhathini, ikosi uzama ukuthutha inkungu nothuli phezu kwezwe lakho, kuze kube yilapho uphela khona.
uzimu uzokwenza bona uhlaselwe ngamehlo abasolwa bakho. Uzofika kubo ngendlela eyodwa, kodwana uzokushiya ngezindlela eziyisithupha; begodu uzoba wumbono obuhlungu kiwo wonke amazwe asezulu.
Izicubu zakho zizoba ukudla kwazo zonke izilwane eziphilako, nezilwane zeganga, begodu ngeke kube khona umuntu ozoziphoqa bona zihambe.
uzimu uzokushaya ngezinhlayiya zaseYiputa, nezilonda, nezingqungquthela, nobuhlungu obukhulu obungenakulinywa.
uzimu uzokushaya ngobuhlungu benhliziyo, nokungabonakali, nokuphazamiseka kwengqondo.

Ngobusuku obuphakathi uzozizwa indlela yakho eduze njengomuntu omnyama emthunzini. Awuzophumelela kinanyana yini oyikwenzayo. Usuku ngalunye uzoba nesimo esibi begodu uzalwe, begodu akukho muntu ozokusiza.
Uzobhishizwa indodakazi, kodwana omunye umuntu uzoyithatha, begodu uzoba nomfazi; uzokwakha indlu, kodwana awuhlali kuyo; uzotshala iviniga, kodwana awukwazi ukuyodla inyama yayo.

Inkomo yakho izotholwa phambi kwakho, kodwana awukwazi ukuyidla; ibhokhwe lakho lizothathwa kuwe, ngeke libuyiselwe kuwe; amaqanda akho azonikezwa izitha zakho, begodu angeke kube nomuntu ozozikhulula.
Amadodakazi akho namakhosikazi akho azonikezwa isizwe esisha, begodu amehlo akho azophuza ngenxa sabo yonke imihla; kodwana ngeke kube khona amandla akho.
Abantu ongabazi bazodla imbewu yezwe lakho, kanye nento osebenzele ngayo. Uzophathwa ngokubi begodu ucindezelwe yonke ubomi bakho.
Izinto ozibonayo zizokushaya umlomo.
uzimu uzokushaya izinyawo zakho nemilenze yakho ngezinhlungu ezibuhlungu, ezingapheli; kuzoqala ezindaweni zamehlo akho kuze kube phezulu kwekhanda lakho.
uzimu uzokulethela wena nokumkani owenzayo phezu kwakho, ezweni elingaziwo wena nababa bakho; khona-ke uzokhonza khona izitha zabanye, imithi negolide.
Uzobe sewubuhlungu, ube yizinkondlo, ube yindawo yokugxekwa phakathi kwazo zonke izizwe lapho ikosi ezokuthumela khona.
Uzotshala izithelo eziningi ezindaweni zakho, kodwana uzovuna okuncane, ngombana izinyosi zizozidla.
Uzotshala izihlahla zezinkomo, begodu uzozilungisa; kodwana ngeke uphuze iwayini, begodu awukwazi ukuqoqa amazambane, ngombana izinyosi zizozidla.
Uzothola izihlahla ze-olive ezweni lakho lonke, kodwana ngeke usebenzise i-olive; ngombana izithelo ze-olive zizophuka.
Uzozala oonyana nabenzana, kodwana ngeke ube nabo; ngombana bazothunyelwa empilweni.
Izinyoni zizodla zonke izihlahla zakho, nezithelo zezwe lakho.
Abakwamanye amazwe abahlala phakathi kwakho, bazokhuphuka phezulu begodu phezulu phezu kwenu; kodwana nizowela phasi begodu nizowela.
Bazokudlulisa wena, kodwana wena awukwazi ukudlulisa kubo; bazobe yinhloko, begodu wena uzobe uyisisu.

Begodu kuzofika phezu kwakho zonke lezi zinhlamvu, zikulandelela, zikufinyelela, kuze uphele; ngenxa yokuthi awuzange ulalele izwi likaYehova uzimu wakho, ukuba ugcine imiyalo yakhe, nezimiso zakhe, awawisele kuwe.
Lezo zinto zizobe ziyiphawu, nobufakazi kuwe kanye nabangane bakho bosuku oluzayo.
uzimu wakho, ikosi, akakusebenzeli ngothando nokuzijabulisa, ngenxa yokudla kwakho konke.

Uzokhonza izitha zakho, okuthi ikosi azithumelele kuwe; uzokudla ukudla, begodu uzophuza amanzi, begodu uzogqoka impahla emnyama, begodu uzolahlekelwa yizinto zonke. Uzobeka intambo yensimbi emlenzeni wakho, kuze akukhulule.
UYehova uzokulethela phezu kwakho izwe elivela kude, ezindaweni eziphesheya kwezilwandle zezulu; lizophuma lihamba njenge-eagle; lizoba yizwe ongeke uqonde ulwimi lwalo.
izwe elinobugebengu obungabonakali, elingeke lihloniphe umuntu omdala begodu alikwazi ukuxolisa umuntu omncane.
izodla izingulube zenyama yakho, nembewu yezwe lakho, kuze uphele; ngeke ishiye kuwe inkukhu, noma isiphuzo sewayini, noma uphethiloli, noma izinkomo zakho, noma amaqanda akho, kuze uphele.

Uzobhekana nezindawo zakho zokungena zonke, ezweni lakho lonke, kuze kube yilapho izindonga zakho eziphakeme neziqinile, ongazithembela kuzo, ziwela phasi; begodu uzobhekana nezindawo zakho zokungena zonke, ezweni lakho lonke, ikosi uzimu wakho akunika lona.
Uzokudla izingane zakho, inyama yamadodana akho namadodakazi akho, awakulethela ikosi uzimu wakho, ngenxa yobuhlungu obukhulu obungaba khona lapho umshayeli wakho ekwenzela wena.
Nakuba umuntu othandekako phakathi kwakho, noma ngabe mkhulu kangakanani, ngeke agweme udadewabo, noma indodakazi yakhe, noma izingane zakhe.
Angeke abagibele omunye wabo inyama yabantwana bakhe, ongayidla; ngombana lokhu kuphela okuzoshiywa kuye, ngenxa yobuhlungu obuzokucindezela ngawo umshayeli wakho ezindaweni zakho zonke.
Umfazi othandekako phakathi kwenu, othandekako ngokwanele bona angeke azame ukugoqa umhlaba ngenyawo lakhe, ngeke abe nethando lomndeni wakhe othandana naye noma unyana wakhe noma intombi yakhe.
Uzokudla ngokufihlakeleyo imbewu yebele lakhe, nezingane zakhe azazile; ngombana ngeke abe nokudla okunye, ngenxa yobuhlungu obukhulu obuzokwenza ubuxoki bakho ezindaweni zakho eziphakathi.
Uma ningazibophezela ekwenzeni zonke izithiyo zalo mthetho obhalwe kulo ncwadi, ukuze nigweme leli gama elingcwele, elithakazelisayo, ikosi uzimu wenu;
khona-ke ikosi uzokulethela wena nomndeni wakho izinkinga ezinkulu, izingqinamba ezikhulu nezihlala isikhathi eside, nezifo ezinkulu nezihlala isikhathi eside.
Uzokuletha phezu kwakho zonke izifo zesiYiputa, ongazethemba ngazo; zizokuthobeka kuwe.
Nazo zonke izifo, nazo zonke izinkinga, ezingabhalwe encwadini yalo mthetho, ikosi uzoziletha phezu kwakho, kuze kukhululwe.
Nakuba bekukhona phakathi kwenu abantu abaningi njengezinkanyezi ezisemathunjini, nizoshiywa nincane khulu, ngenxa yokuthi awazitholanga amazwi kaYehova uzimu wakho.

Ngokungafani nalapho ikosi ethanda khona ukukwenza kahle nikhule, ngaleyo le uzothanda khona ikosi ukuba nikhulule niphele; begodu nizoqhutshwa ngaphandle kwezwe okungena kulo bona niyithathe njengentando yenu.
uzimu uzokusakaza phakathi kwezizwe zonke, kusukela engxenyeni eyodwa yezulu kuya kwesinye sazo; khona-ke uzokhonza khona amanye amasiko, ongawazi wona wena nababa bakho, imithi netshe.
phakathi kwazo zonke izizwe, ngeke uthole isikhala, noma indawo yokuphumula kwenyawo lakho; khona-ke ikosi uzokunika khona inhliziyweni ekhathazayo, namadolo akhathazayo, nomoya othakazelisayo,
Impilo yakho izohlala ingozi. Uzogcwele ubuhlungu ekuseni nakusihlwa, ungaqinisekanga bona uzophila.
Uzothi ekuseni, Ngiyethemba bona kube yimini; begodu ekuseni, Ngiyethemba bona kube yimini; ngenxa yobuthakathaka obugcwele intliziyo yakho, nezimo ozibona ngamehlo akho.

uzimu uzokubuyisela eYiputa ngezinqanawa, ngendlela engikusho ngayo bona ngeke uphinde ukhambe kuyo; khona-ke uzothengisa wena nomndeni wakho izitha zakho njengezikhonzi namadodakazi, kodwana akuzobakho othenga.
Lawona amazwi omhlangano, ikosi awawisela umthetho ngawo uMoses, ukuba akwenze nabantu bakaSirayeli ezweni laseMowabi, ngaphezu komhlangano obewenza nabo emfuleni iSina.
UMoses wababiza bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, wathi kubo: Amehlo wenu akubona konke okwenze ikosi ezweni laseYiputa kuFaro, nakwabo bonke abaphathi bakhe, nezwe lakhe lonke.
Wabona izinkinga ezinkulu, izibonakaliso ezimangazayo, nezimanga ezinkulu.
Kodwana-ke, ikosi akakubeni nani intamo eqondayo, noma amehlo ebonayo, noma izindlebe ezikhulumayo, kuze kube manje.
Kwaba iminyaka emashumi mane ngikuholela ezweni elimnyama; ngaleso sikhathi izigqoko zakho azisebenzi, nezicathulo zakho azisebenzi emilenzeni yakho.
Ukudla kwenyama, noma utshwala, noma isiphuzo esiphuzayo, ningawadla; ukuze nikwazi bona yena ikosi uzimu wenu.
Uma nifika kulo mhlaba, uSihoni ukumkani waseHeshboni, noOgi ukumkani waseBhashani, baphuma bezama ukusihlasela; kodwana sawanqoba.
Siyithathe izwe labo, salibanika amaRubheni, namaGadi, kanye nengxenye yesizwe sikaManase, ibe yindawo sabo.
Hamba ugcine amazwi la mazwi, ukuze uphumelele konke okwenzekayo.
Nihlala namuhla phambi koYehova uzimu wenu, nina abakhulu benu, nezizwe zenu, namadoda amakhulu wenu, nabaphathi bakho, bonke amadodana aseSirayeli;
kanye nezingane zakho, namabhishobhi akho, nabangani bakho abahlala emigodini yakho, abavuna imithi yakho, nabathwala amanzi akho.
Uhlala lapha, ukuze ungene emthethweni noYehova uzimu wakho, emthethweni owenza nawe namuhla, ukuze aqinise izibopho zakhe.
Wakwenza wena namhlanje ube ngumuntu wakhe, begodu yena abe uzimu wakho, njengokuthi wakhuluma kuwe, nababa bakho uAbrahama noIsake noYakobi.
Angikwenzanga lo mthethweni, ngethemba lakhe, nawe kuphela
abasekhona lapha nathi namuhla phambi koYehova uzimu wethu; begodu nalabo abangasekho lapha nathi namuhla, ngizokwenza kanjalo.
Niyazi bona sahlala kanjani eYiputa, nokuthi sahamba kanjani phakathi kwezizwe, ngandlela-thile sifike lapha.
Wabona izinto zabo ezithakazelisayo, nezitho zabo ezidumile zokhuni nodonga, igolide nesiliva.

Ngiyakuqinisekisa bona angeke kube phakathi kwenu indoda, noma indodakazi, noma inkosikazi, noma isizwe, eseziphendukile inhliziyo yayo kuYehova uzimu wethu namhlanje, ukuba ihambe isebenzele izitha zazo zonke lezi zizwe.

Uma umuntu onjalo ekhuluma ngamazwi alo mthetho, angeke abe nesiqiniseko esingokoqobo emlonyeni wakhe, athi: Ngizohlala ngiphephile, noma ngabe ngihamba ngendlela yami yobugebengu. Lokhu kuzoletha ukulimala ezweni elimanzi, kanye nezwe elisha.

uzimu ngeke avume ukuxolisa umuntu onjalo, kodwana ubuhlungu bakhe nethando lwakhe luzophuma kulowo muntu njengomlilo, begodu zonke izibulala-zinambuzane ezibhalwe kulolu ncwadi zizoba phezu kwawo; begodu uzimu uzocima igama lakhe ngezansi kwezulu.
UYehova uzowahlukanisa phakathi kwezizwe zonke zakwaSirayeli, abe yingozi kubo, ngokuya ngazo zonke izibulala-zinambuzane zesivumelwano ezibhalwe kulo ncwadi yomthetho.
Bazobona izingane zenu ezizayo ngemuva kwenu, kanye nomunye umuntu ovela ezweni elisendaweni ende, zonke izinkinga zezwe, nezifo ikosi abezithumelele kulo.

Izwe lonke lizoba wumlilo we-sulfure ne-salt; ngeke kube khona into etshalayo, noma ikhulayo, noma iyiphi inhlanzi ekhulayo. Kuzobe sengathi ukulimala kukaSodoma noGomora, noAdama noZeboyim, okwenzeke lapho ikosi abulala khona ngobuhlungu bakhe obukhulu.
begodu izizwe zonke zizothi, Kungani na ikosi ekwenze lokhu kule lizwe? Kungani na ubuhlungu bakhe bukhulu?
begodu bazophendula bathi, Ngenxa yokuthi bashiye umgomo kaYehova uzimu wababa babo, owenza nabo, lapho wabakhipha ezweni laseYiputa; ngenxa yokuthi bashiya umgomo kaYehova uzimu wababa babo.
Baye behamba, bakhonza amasiko amanye, bawukhonze, amadini abengawayazi; amadini angeke ikosi abewanikela kiwo.
Ngenxa lalokho, inkani likaYehova livutha phezu kwalolu lizwe, ukuze ahole kuyo zonke izibulala-zinambuzane ezibhalwe kulolu ncwadi.
Wabasusa ezweni labo, wabathulisa ezweni elilodwa, ngenxa yobuxoki nobubi obukhulu, kuze kube yilapho bakhona manje.
Izinto ezifihlakele ziyizinto zikaYehova uzimu wethu; kodwana izinto azivezayo, ziyizinto zethu nabantwana bethu kuze kube sekupheleni, ukuze sigcine zonke izenzo zalo mthetho.
Uma zonke lezi zivumelwano, nalezi zula, ngizibeke phambi kwakho, zifika kuwe, uzozikhumbula phakathi kwezizwe lapho ikosi uzimu wakho ezokusakaza khona.
Uma ubuyela kuYehova uzimu wakho, wena nezingane zakho, begodu umlalela ngenhliziyo yakho yonke, nangomphefumulo wakho wonke, ukuze wenze zonke izinto engikulethela umthetho ngazo namuhla;
begodu ikosi uzimu wakho uzokubuyisela ezindaweni zakho eziboshwe kuzo, begodu uzokuzinikela kuwe, begodu uzokuqoqa phakathi kwazo zonke izizwe, lapho awazihlukanisile khona.
Uma ngabe abathunywa bakho befika ekugcineni kwezwe ngezansi kwesibhakabhaka, uzokuqoqa khonakho ikosi uzimu wakho, begodu uzokubuyisela.
uzimu wakho, ikosi, uzokulethela izwe labababa bakho, ube yindawo yakho yobukhosi; uzokwenza kube ngcono kuwe, begodu uzokwenza ube mkhulu kunabababa bakho.
UYehova uzimu wakho uzoshintsha intliziyo yakho, nentliziyo yezizukulwane zakho, ukuze uyithande intliziyo yakho yonke, nomoya wakho wonke, uphile.
UYehova uzimu wakho uzozibeka zonke lezi zinto ezibi phezu kwazo zonke izitha zakho, abakuxoshayo, abakwenzayo.
Uzobuya ulalele izwi likaYehova, ugcine yonke imiyalo yakhe engikuwiselayo namuhla.

uzimu wakho, ikosi, uzokwenza uphumelele yonke imisebenzi yezandla zakho; uzokubambisana nawe ngezingane eziningi, nezilwane eziningi, nembewu eminingi. uzimu wakho uzophinde ajabulele ukukwenza okuhle kuwe, njengokuba wajabulela ukukwenza okuhle kubaba bakho,

uma unquma ukulalela izwi likaYehova uzimu wakho, ukuba ugcine izimiso zakhe nezibopho zakhe ezibhalwe kulo ncwadi yomthetho; uma ubuyela kuYehova uzimu wakho intliziyo yakho yonke nomoya wakho wonke.
Ngikuwisela umthetho wena namhlanje, akunzima kuwe, begodu angeke kube ngaphezu kwakho.
Akusezulu, ukuze ubuze: "Ubani ozoba phezulu esibhakabhakeni aze ayithole, begodu akhuluma nathi, ukuze sikwazi ukuyenza?"
Nakho akusenyakatho yolwandle, ukuze utshele: "Ubani ozodlula emivelweni yolwandle aze ayithole begodu ayifundise nathi, ukuze sikwazi ukuyilalela?"
Kodwana ilizwi likude khulu nawe, libe emlonyeni wakho, libe enhliziyweni yakho, ukuze uyenze.
Bheka, namuhla ngikubeke phambi kwakho phakathi kokuphila nokunethezeka, nokufa nokulahleka.

(Ngenxa yokuthi ngikutshela namuhla bona uthande ikosi uzimu wakho, ukhambe ngendlela yakhe, ugcine imiyalo yakhe, nezibopho zakhe, namalungiselelo akhe;) ukuze niphile nikhule, begodu ikosi uzimu wenu akuberekise ezweni okungena kulo ukulithola.
Kodwana uma inhliziyweni yakho ibuyela emuva, begodu ungakutholi ukulalela, bese ukhohlwa, ubhujiswa emathinini amanye, ukhonza kiwo;
Ngikuxwayisa wena namuhla, bona ngokuqinisekile uzolahleka; ngeke uhlale isikhathi eside ezweni odlula kulo umlambo iYorodani ukulithatha.

Ngitjho, ngisho bona, ngiyaziveza izulu nezwe njengamasosha phakathi kwenu namhlanje, bona ngimise phambi kwakho impilo nokufa, nokusindisa nokulahlwa; ngalokho-ke ukhethe ukuphila, ukuze uphile wena nabantwana bakho.

Uzokhetha ukuthanda ikosi uzimu wakho, uzowulalela umlomo wakhe, uzozibophezela kuye; ngombana ikosi ngukuphila kwakho, begodu uzokunika iminyaka eminingi phezu kwezwe ebelisho bona lizolibazisa obaba bakho, uAbrahama noIsakha noYakobi.
Wahamba uMoses, wakhuluma la mazwi kiwo wonke amaSirayeli.
Wathi kubo, Ngineminyaka engu-120 ubudala manje; ngeke ngikwazi ukudlula phambi kwenu ezweni lenu. uzimu uthe kuye: "Uzohamba ngaphezu kweYordan."
UYehova, uzimu wakho, yena ozodlula phambi kwakho; yena uzozibulala lezi zizwe phambi kwakho, nawe uzozinikela izwe labo. UYoshuwa, yena ozodlula phambi kwenu, njengombana ikosi atjhilo.
uzimu uzokwenza kubo, njengokuthi wenza kuSihoni noOgi, abaphathi bama-Amori, abewabulala nabo nezwe labo.
UYehova uzozinikela phambi kwenu, nikwenze kubo konke okungiwisela umthetho ngalo.
Beka amandla, ube namandla; ungakhathazeki, begodu ungagxeki ngenxa sabo; ngombana ikosi uzimu wakho uhamba nawe; akakushiyeli, akakushiya.

UMoses wabiza uYoshuwa, wathi kuye phambi kwamadodana aseSirayeli onke: "Beka isandla sakho esiqinile, begodu ube nethando olukhulu; ngombana wena uzongena nalabo abantu ezweni loNkulunkulu owawuthi kubaba babo bona azobanikela kulo; wena uzowahlukanisa phakathi kwabo ngokwemifelokazi.
uzimu, yena ohamba phambi kwakho, uzoba nawe; akakushiyanga, akakushiyelanga. Musa ukukhathazeka, ungabi nenhliziyo ebuhlungu.
Wabhala uMoses lo mthetho, wawunikeza ababhishobhi, oonyana bakaLawi, abathwala ibhokisi lesivumelwano sikaYehova, kanye nabaholi bonke baseSirayeli.
Wathi uMoses kubo, Ngokuphela konyaka owodwa oyisixhenxe, ngesikhathi sosuku lwezindlu ezifileyo, lapho kuphele khona iminyaka eyisithupha,
uma befika bonke isiSirayeli, ukuboniswa phambi koYehova uzimu wakho, endaweni akhetha kuyo; uzofunda lo mthetho emlonyeni wabo bonke isiSirayeli.

Zihlanganiseni abantu, amadoda nababhishobhi, namantombazane, nabantwana, nomuntu ovela kwamanye amazwe ohlala ezindaweni zenu, ukuze balalele, begodu bafunde ukukhathazeka kuYehova uzimu wenu, bona bagcine bayenze yonke imithetho yalomthetho.
Nabantwana babo, abangazi lo mthetho, bakwazi ukuwulalela, bafunde ukukhathazeka kuYehova uzimu wenu, yonke imihla engihlala ngayo phezu kwezwe elidlula eJordani, niya kuyo ukulithola.
Wathi ikosi kuMoses, Bona, usuku lwakho lokufa luyafika; thinta uYoshuwa, uye ekhempini yokuhlangana, ukuze ngimwise khona. Baye ke uMoses noYoshuwa, bahlala ekhempini yokuhlangana.
Wabonakala ikosi efulethini, emgodini wezulu; begodu izulu lahlala phezu komngcele wefulethi.

Wathi ikosi kuMoses, Bheka, uzolala nababa bakho; begodu izwe elinjalo lizongikhohlisa; lizolandela izitha zakwamanye amazwe ezweni elizoya kulo, lizomishiya, lizophula umnqophiso wami engiwenza nalo.

Ngosuku olulodwa ubuhlungu bami buzoqhuma phezu kwawo, begodu ngizowashiya, ngizifihla isithombe sami kubo, begodu bazophazamiseka; nezimo ezibi nezinkinga eziningi zizofika kuye; begodu uzothi ngalolu busuku, Ingabe lezo zinkinga azikho ngenxa yokuthi uzimu wethu akasekho phakathi kwethu?
Ngaleso sikhathi ngizofihla ubuso bam, ngenxa yobubi bonke obuzokwenza; ngombana bazobuyela emadini amanye.
Manje ke, bhala le ngithixo, uyifundise oonyana bakaSirayeli; bayenze ibe yingoma sabo, ukuze ibe ngumvikeli wami kubo.

Ngizowangenisa ezweni elifulathelayo ubisi nengulube, njengombana ngitjho kubaba bakhe, azodla begodu akhuleke; uzobhekana namagugu amanye, azowakhonza, begodu uzongikhohlisa, begodu uzophula umnqophiso wami.

Uma befika phezu kwabo izimo ezibi nezinkinga eziningi, khona-ke lesi singoma sizobe sikhona njengesivivinyo kubo; ngombana isizukulwane sabo asizosikhohlwa. Ngizi bona bacabangani namanje, ngaphambi kokuba ngibangenise ezweni engikhuluma ngalo.
Wabhala uMoses leli ngoma ngalolusuku, wafundisa oonyana bakaSirayeli.
Wathi ikosi kuYoshuwa, unyana ka-Nun, Ube nokuthula, ube nomsindo; ngombana wena uzowafaka amadodana aseSirayeli ezweni engikhuluma ngalo kubo ngesandla sami, begodu ngizobe nawe.
Waphela uMoses ebhala amazwi alo mthetho encwadini, kusukela ekuqaleni kuya kukuphela kwayo.
Wathi uMosis kilabo abaLevi, abebethwala ibhokisi lesivumelwano sikaYehova, wathi,
Niyithathe le ncwadi yomthetho, niyibeke ngaphesheya kwebhokisi lomhlangano kaYehova uzimu wenu; lihlale khona, libe yisisulu kuwe.
Ngiyazi bona wena uyisitha, begodu ikhanda lakho liqinile. Ngokuba manje ngiphila phakathi kwenu, nisitha ikosi; ngaphezu kwalokho, uma ngifa, ningasitha yini?
Zihlanganisani ngimi bonke abaphathi bezizwe zenu, nabaphathi bakho bonke, ukuze ngikhulume kubo la mazwi, begodu ngiveze izulu nezulu zibe yisisulu phezu kwabo.

ngombana ngiyazi bona ngemuva kokufa kwami, nizophazamiseka khulu, nisuka endlela engibawiselayo; begodu ingozi izofika kuwe ezinyangeni ezedlule, uma nikwenza okumbi emehloni kaYehova, ukuze niyandise ubuhlungu ngemisebenzi yezandla zenu.
Wathi uMoses ngamazwi onke la mazwi engoma leyo, waqala akhuluma kiwo wonke umkhosi wakwaSirayeli, kuze kube sekuphele.
Lilalelani, izulu, ngizokhuluma; lilalelani, umhlaba, amagama olomo wami.
Imfundiso yami ikhuphuke njengemvula, begodu amagama ami akhuphuke njengamanzi abandayo, njengemvula ehlanzekile phezu kweqhwa elisha, njengemimoya emikhulu phezu kwezitshalo ezincane.
Ngizokhuluma igama likaYehova, Nihloniphe ubukhulu bukaThixo wethu!
uzimu ngumlilo, begodu umsebenzi wakhe uphelele. Wonke umsebenzi wakhe ulungile. uzimu othembekile, akakwenzanga lutho olubi. Ulungile begodu ufanele.
Kodwana bakwenza okumbi kuye, ngenxa yobubi babo, begodu abazange babe izingane zakhe. Usuku lomndeni okhohlakeleyo, begodu ephindwe kabili.
Ingabe lokhu kungenxa yokuthi nikhokhela ikosi, abantu abakhohlakeleyo nabangacabangi? Akukabi yini yena uBawo wenu, owenza wena ukuba wakhe? Wakwenza, wakwenza.
Khumbula amalanga zangaphambilini, cabanga ngezizukulwane ezedlule. Buza ubaba wakho, begodu uzokutshela; buza abakhulu bakho, begodu bazokuchaza.
Ngombana lapho oNgcwele enikela khona izizwe ngezindawo zazo, lapho ehlukanisa khona imbewu yomuntu, wamisa umkhawulo wezizwe ngokwenani lamadodana kaSirayeli.
Ngokuba inkontileka kaYehova yiyo abantu bakhe; uYakobi, inkontileka yakhe ekhethiwe.
Wamuthola ezweni lesiqhingi, ezweni elingenalutho, elinabantu abaningi. Wamlinda, wabhekana naye. Wamuvikela njengawo wonke amehlo akhe.
Ngokufana ne-eagle ecindezela ikhaya layo, begodu ihamba phezu kwezingane zayo, wafaka amaphiko akhe ukuwaqoqa, wabathwala emilenzeni yawo.
UYehova kuphela owayemqondisa, akukho Nkulunkulu ongaphandle naye.
Wathi: "Uzohamba phezu kwezintaba eziphakeme zezwe, uzokudla izithelo zezintaba; uzokudla imbewu ephuma emhlabathini, nophethiloli ovela emhlabathini oqinile.
Ukudla kwakho kwakungubisi lwezinkomo, nobisi lwamakhoboka, nenyama yezinkomo, nenyama yobhontshisi, nenyama yomnqumo waseBhashani, nenyama yengulube engcono khulu; uphuze iwayini elihlanzekile.
Wakhula uJeshurun, wanyamalala. Ukhule waba mkhulu, ube nomthwalo omkhulu, wawugcwele ukudla; washiya uzimu owenzayo, wayalela iNtaba eyayimsindisa.
Bakwenza abe neze ngemikhosi yangaphandle, begodu bakwenza abe neze ngezinhlamvu zabo.
Banikela ku-demon, okungukuthi, hhayi uzimu, kubangcwele abazange bayazi, abangcwele abatsha abaye bavela nje, abangcwele abazange bakhathazeke ngabanye.
Ukhohlwe iRock owawungubaba wakho. Ukhohlwe uzimu owakuzalile wena.
Wakubona ikosi, wabakhohlisa, ngenxa yokuthi izingane zakhe, amadodana akhe namadodakazi akhe, babembuza.
Wathi, Ngizofihla ubuso bam kubo, ngibone bona kwenzekani ekugcineni kwabo; ngombana yimindeni ephindwe kabili, izingane ezingathembeki.

Bamimisa enhliziyweni yami ngezinto ezingaba nguThixo, bamimisa enhliziyweni yami ngezinhlamvu zabo ezingenalutho; ngalokho ngizomimisa enhliziyweni sabo ngezinto ezingaba yizwe, ngizomimisa enhliziyweni sabo ngezwe elingaqondi.
Ngokuba indlala yami umlilo waqala, oza kukhuphuka kuya ezingeni eliphansi, begodu uzokudla izwe kanye nemikhiqizo yayo, begodu uzomisa izikhulu zezintaba.
Ngizobeka phezu kwabo inhlekelele, begodu ngizisebenzisele zonke izinhlamvu zami.
Bazophuka ngenxa yokudla, begodu bazodla ngenxa yesifo esibulalayo; begodu ngizothumela phezu kwabo izilwane eziphila ezindaweni ezishisayo, nezinyamazane ezinobuthi ezihuquzela ngamanzi.
Ngaphesheya, ikhebula lizobulala izingane zabo. Kungaphakathi kwezindlu zabo, ubuhlungu buzohlasela. Amantombazane namantombazane amancane azofa, izinsana namadoda amakhulu anezinwele ezimnyama.
Ngithe ngizowasakaza ngaphesheya, begodu ngizisuse zonke izikhumbuzo zabo ezweni.
Ngiye ngikhathazekile, bona bangathi abasoli babo; bona bangathi abasoli babo, Ngamandla ethu sinqobe; uzimu akakwenzanga lokhu konke.'
Isirayeli yizwe elingenangqondo, akukho kuqonda kubo.
Uma bekufanele babe nengqondo begodu bakwazi lokhu! Uma bekufanele bacabange bona yini ezoba kwenzeka kubo ekugcineni!
Ingabe umuntu oyedwa angagqugquzela abantu abangu-1, noma ababili bangagibela abantu abangu-10 000? Uma iNtaba sabo ingabathengise, uma ikosi engawashiya.
Umlilo wabo awufana nomlilo wethu. Naphezu kokuxoshwa kwethu, bavumelana nalokho.
Imbewu sabo ivela ezindaweni zakwaSodoma, nasezintweni zakwaGomora; izithelo zabo zigcwele ubuthi, begodu amaqabunga abo abuhlungu.
Isiphuzo sabo sifana ne-poison yama-snake, i-venom ebulalayo yama-cobras.
"Angazigcinanga kanjani lezi zinto ezindaweni zami zokugcina?
Nginakho ukubuyisela, begodu nginakho ukubuyisa; ngesikhathi esifanele izinyawo zabo zizoba zimbi. Imini sabo yokulimala ifinyelele, nokufa kwabo kukhawulelwe kubo.
uzimu uzolungisa abantu bakhe, begodu uzobabaza abakhonzi bakhe, uma nakabona bona amandla abo aphelile, begodu akukho ozoshiywa, noma umkhonzi noma okhululekile.
Uzothi: "Yebo, kuphi amagugu abo, abaye behamba kiwo ngokuphephile?
labo abadla ubisi lwamabhishi abo, begodu baphuze iwayini lamabhishi abo? Lawa amasiko azovuka, azokusiza; azokuvikela!
Ngiyabona manje bona ngimi, ngimi kuphela; akukho uzimu othile ngaphandle kwami. Ngibulala, begodu ngiphila; ngidlwengula, begodu ngiphilisa; akukho muntu ongasindisa esandla sami.
Ngikhuphula isandla sami esibhakabhakeni, begodu ngibekele lokhu: Ngokuqinisekile, njengombana ngiphila kuze kube sekupheleni,
lapho ngizomisa khona ikhebula lami elikhanyayo, begodu ngiyithathele ukuxolisa, ngizobuya ngazo izitha zami, begodu ngizogwema labo abangikhohlisa.
Ngizokwenza amathonsi ami aphuze igazi, begodu isikhephe sami sidla inyama; igazi labo ababulawayo nalabo abathathwayo, kanye nekhanda labaphathi bobubi.
Yiba nomvuzo, nimazwe, nabantu bakhe; ngombana uzobuyisela labo ababulala abakhonzi bakhe, begodu uzobhekana nabaphikisi bakhe, begodu uzohlanza izwe lakhe nomndeni wakhe.
Wafika uMoses, noYoshuwa unyana ka-Nun, wabhala wonke amazwi alo ingoma, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukulalela.
Waphela uMoses ekhuluma la mazwi onke phambi kwabaSirayeli bonke,
Wathi kubo, Nizibeke engqondweni yenu zonke lezi zinto engikhuluma ngazo phambi kwenu namhlanje; nizitshele izingane zenu bona zihlole ukuzenza zonke izimiso zalomthetho.
La mazwi angeke abe lutho kuwe, ngombana yimpilo yakho; uma uwenza la mazwi, uzohlala isikhathi eside ezweni lenu elidlulayo iJordani, ukuze ulinqobe.
Wathi ikosi kuMoses ngosuku olulodwa, esithi,
Hamba ufike ezindaweni eziphakeme ze-Abarim, emfuleni weNebo waseMowabhi, obhekene neJericho, ubone izwe likaKanana, elinika oonyana bakaSirayeli ukuba libe yindawo sabo yokuhlala.
Uzofa phezu kwalo mntaba, lapho ufike khona, uzohlangane nabantu bakho abafile phambi kwakho; njengokuthi uAron, umngane wakho, washona emfuleni iHori, wahlangane nabantu bakhe.
ngombana ningikhohlise phambi kwamadodana aseSirayeli, ezindaweni zamanzi zeMeriba yaseKadeshe, esiqhingini saseZin; ningangingcwele phakathi kwamadodana aseSirayeli.
Uzobona izwe ngamehlo akho kuphela; ngeke ungene ezweni enginika lona oonyana bakaSirayeli.
Lokho wukubambisana kukaMoses, umuntu kaThixo, kwabaSirayeli ngaphambi kokuba aphele.

Wathi, uzimu uvela emfuleni iSina, waphuma phezu kwabo njengolanga oluvela eSeyiri; wakhanya kusukela emfuleni iParan; wafika namakhulu amawaka abantu abangcwele, nomlilo oqhumayo ngakwesobunxele kwakhe.
Uthanda abantu bakhe; bonke abangcwele bakhe bangaphakathi esandla sakho, behlabela emadolo akho, begodu wonke umuntu uthola amazwi akho.
UMoses wasinikeze imithetho, impahla yabantu bakaYakobi.
UYehova waba ngukumkani eJeshuruni, lapho behlangana khona abakhulu bomphakathi, zonke izizwe zakwaSirayeli.
URubhen aphile, angafanga; abantu bakhe bangase bancane.
Wathi kuYuda, uzimu, lalela inkulumo kaYuda, uyibuyisele kubo bonke abantu bakhe; ubhekane nabo ngezandla zakhe, umsize ekuphileni kwakhe nababi bakhe.
Wathi ngoLevi, Kosi, iThummim yakho ne-Urim yakho yiyo umkhonzi wakho othembekile; uyamcindezela eMasha, wagwema ngamanzi kaMeriba.
Wathi kubaba wakhe nomama wakhe, Ngingawakhathali. Akhenge akhethe uhlangothi lwabangane bakhe, noma lwabantwana bakhe; ngombana balalela amagama akho, bagcina umnqophiso wakho.
Bazofundisa uYakobi izimiso zakho, namasiko akho eSirayeli; bazonikela ngenkabi phambi kwakho, nezipho zokudlwengula phezu kwesiqalo sakho.
uzimu, usindise zonke izifiso zakhe, begodu uthande umsebenzi wezandla zakhe; cindezela imilenze yalabo abaphikisayo kuye; cindezela labo abangamkhathali yena, ukuze bangavumi ukuvuka.
Ngaye uBhenjamin wathi, Umfazi othandekako kuYehova ahlale ephephile naye; uNkosi igcina yena nsuku zonke, begodu umfazi othandekako kuYehova uhlala phakathi kwemilenze yakhe.
Wathi ngoYosefu, uzimu usize izwe lakhe ngezinto ezinhle zezulu eziivelwe phezulu, ngeqhwa, namanzi amahle angaphasi kwayo.
Ingabe inezithelo ezinhle khulu ilanga lizozisa begodu izithelo ezingcono khulu ngaso soke isikhathi,
ngemiklomelo engcono khulu yezintaba zakudala kanye nezimali zezingqimba eziphilako,

begodu ngezinto ezingcono emhlabeni, kanye nanoma yini ekhona kuyo, begodu ngothando lomuntu obonakala emgodini womlilo. Nazo zonke lezi zipho baphumule phezu kwekhanda uYosefu, phezu imilenze yowesifazane phakathi kwabazalwane bakhe.

Ubuhle bakhe bufana nengulube ezalwa kuqala; amakhopho akhe afana namakhopho omnqumo omnyama; ngazo uzozibulala izizwe, nazo zonke ezisentshonalanga yezwe. Lokho kuyizinkulungwane zamaphesenti kaEfrayim, nokho kuyizikhulu zamaphesenti kaManase.
Wathi ngoZebuloni, Yijabulise, oZebuloni, lapho uphuma khona; begodu wena, Issakare, ezindaweni zakho.
Bazobiza izizwe ziye emfuleni, begodu bazonikela khona ngezipho ezifanele; begodu bazodla ngezinto ezinhle zasezilwandle, nezimali ezifihlakele emhlabathini.
Wathi ngoGadi, Kubabaleke lowo owenza izwe likaGadi libe likhulu! UGadi uhlala khona njengosizi, ephuza isisu nekhanda.
Wakhetha indawo engcono khulu yezwe, begodu umnikelo wombuso wagcinwa kuye; lapho behlangana khona abaphathi bezinhlanga, walungisa isinqumo sikaYehova, nemithetho yakhe kwaSirayeli.
Wathi ngoDani, UDani ungumntwana wengulube, uphuma eBhashani.
Wathi ngoNaphtali, UNaphtali ugcwele inhlonipho kaYehova, begodu ugcwele isivuno sakhe; uzothola izwe enyakatho nasentshonalanga.
Wathi ngo-Asere: U-Asere ungcwele ukudlula bonke izingane; athandeke kubazalwane bakhe, begodu izwe lakhe libe likhulu nge-oyile.
Izingcezu zezingcingo zakho zibe yinsimbi nesiliva, begodu amandla akho abe nsuku zonke wokuphila kwakho.
Ayikho into efana nozimu kaJeshurun, ohamba phezu kwezulu ukuze akusize, ngaphezu kwezinkuni ngobuhle bakhe.
uzimu ohlala isikhathi eside uyisizinda sakho, begodu izinyawo zakhe ezihlala isikhathi eside zingaphansi kwakho; wakhipha umshayeli wakho phambi kwakho, wathi: "Khumbulana nabo!"
Bazohlala uSirayeli ephephile, begodu imbewu kaYakobi izohlala yona kuphela, ezweni lengulube newayini elisha, lapho isibhakabhaka sikhuphuka khona.

Kuhle wena, isiSirayeli! Ubani ofana nawe, abantu abasindiswe nguYehova? Nguye umgoqo wakho, nosizo lwakho, nekhebula lakho elikhanyayo. Abaphikisi bakho bazokuhlangula phambi kwakho; uzohamba phezu kwezintaba zabo.
Waphuma uMoses emazweni aseMowabi, wafika emfuleni iNebo, engxenyeni ephezulu yePisga, ebhekene neJericho; khona-ke ikosi wambonisa izwe lonke, kusukela eGiliyadi kuya eDani,
yonke iNaphtali, nezwe likaEphrayim noManase, nezwe lonke lakwaYuda, kuze kube selwandle oluphakathi,
iNtshonalanga enyakatho, kanye nofula lonke laseJericho, lo mzi wezintaba-mlilo, kuze kube yiSoari.
Wathi ikosi kuye, Le yilizwe engikhuluma ngalo ku-Abrahama, noIsake, noYakobi, ngathi, Ngizolibazisa izizukulwane zakho; ngikubonise ngamehlo akho, kodwana awuzodlula kuyo.
Wafa khona uMoses, umkhonzi kaYehova, ezweni laseMowabi, njengokuthi ikosi.
Wamu葬la emfuleni waseMowabi, ebhekene neBhete-peori; akukho muntu owaziyo isibhedlela sakhe kuze namuhla.
UMoses wayeneminyaka engu-120 ubudala, lapho efa khona; amazwana akhe ayemnene khulu begodu anamandla.
Bathi ke amadodana aseSirayeli: Silele uMoses ezindaweni eziseduze zakwaMowabi amalanga ezingama-30, kuze kube sekuphele isikhathi sokulingisa nokuzingela uMosis.
UYoshuwa unyana kaNune wagcwele umoya wolwazi, ngombana uMosis wayemise izandla zakhe phezu kwakhe; begodu abafundisi bakaSirayeli bamlalela, bakwenza njengombana ikosi abewisela umthetho uMoses.
Ngaleso sikhathi, akhenge akhuleke eSirayeli umprofeti ofana noMoses, owaziwa nguYehova ngamehlo akhe.
Wonke lo mqondiso, nololo phawu oludumile, ikosi wamthumela wona ukuba akwenze ezweni laseYiputa, kuFaro, nakwabo bonke abaphathi bakhe, nezwe lakhe lonke.
Akukho muntu owazibophezele ekwenzeni izinto ezimangazayo, ezifana nalezi azenzayo uMoses phambi kwabaSirayeli.
Josh: Kwathi, ngemuva kokufa kukaMoses, umkhonzi kaYehova, ikosi wathi kuYoshuwa, unyana kaNune, umkhonzi kaMosis:
Wathi, Umkhonzi wami uMoses usefile; ngalokho manje zulazula, uyeke lo mfula iYorodani, wena nomphakathi lowo wonke, ufike ezweni enginika lona oonyana bakaSirayeli.
Yonke indawo lapho nibeka khona inyawo lenu, ngiyikulethelani, njengombana ngitjho kuMoses.
Ukusuka esiqhingini, naseLibanoni, kuya emfuleni omkhulu i-Euphrates, yonke indawo yamaHithi, kuze kube lwandle olukhulu, lizoba yizwe lakho.
Akukho muntu ozokwazi ukubhekana nawe zonke amalanga zakho. Ngizobe nawe, njengokuba ngibe noMosesi; ngeke ngikushiye, begodu ngeke ngikushiye.
Uzobe unamandla, ube nobuqili; ngombana wena uzoba ngumqondisi wale ndoda, ukuze ithathe izwe engigunyazile ababa babo.

Uma nje unamandla, ube nethando olukhulu khulu, ulinde ukukwenza konke umthetho owawuthiwe nguMoses, umkhonzi wami; ungaseki kiwo ngakwesokudla noma ngakwesobunxele, ukuze wenze kahle lapho uhamba khona.
Le ncwadi yomthetho kufanele ihlale engqondweni yakho, begodu uyicabangele ekuseni nakusihlwa, ukuze ugcine ukwenze konke okubhalwe kulo; khona-ke uzophumelela, begodu uzophumelela.
Ngikutshele, uhlale uqinile, ube nenhliziyo enamandla; ungakhathazeki, begodu ungabi nomsindo; ngombana ikosi uzimu wakho ukhona nawe kiwo wonke amadolobha ohamba kiwo.
Wathi uYoshuwa kubaholi babantu: "Niyigcine le ncwadi.

Wathi, Yiya phakathi kwesikhashana, utshele abantu bona, Nilungiselele isidlo sakusihlwa; ngombana ngemuva kwezinsuku amathathu nizodlula ngaleyo Yordani, ukuze nifike niyithathe izwe ikosi uzimu wenu akunika lona.
Wakhuluma uYoshuwa nezizwe zakwaRubhen, nezizwe zakwaGadi, nengxenye yesizwe sikaManase.
Wathi, Khumbulani bona uMoses, umkhonzi kaYehova, wathi kuni, uzimu wenu, ikosi, wakunika isikhala, wamnika leli lizwe.

Izifazane zenu, nezingane zenu, nezilwane zenu zizohlala kulolu mhlaba, owabanikela wona uMoses ngaleso siqhingi saseJordani; kodwana bonke abantu bakho abanamandla bazodlula phambi kwabazalwane benu, begqoke izithuthi zabo, balungiselele ukuwasiza;

kuze kube yilapho ikosi abanika khona isiphumulo, njengabanikezayo niye, begodu nabo bathathe izwe ikosi uzimu wenu alibanikela ngalo; ngemva kwalokho nizobuyela ezweni lenu elihlala kulo, elinikeziwe ngalesi siqhingi sikaYoshuwa, umkhonzi kaYehova.
Baphendula uYoshuwa, bathi, Zonke izinto ozithumelele zona sizozenza, nalapho usithumelela khona sizoya.
Sizokulalela wena, njengombana sikwenzele uMoses ngazo zonke izinto; kodwana ikosi uzimu wakho abe nawe, njengokuba ube noMoses.
Wonke umuntu ongeke athobele umyalo wakho, begodu alalele amagama akho, uzofa; kodwana ube nokuthula, ube nomphefumulo onamandla.

UYoshuwa, unyana ka-Nun, wathumela abantu ababi abazobhekana naye eSitiyini, wathi kubo ngokufihlakeleyo: "Nihambe nibone izwe, kanye neJerikho." Baye bafika ekhaya lendodakazi yowesifazane okuthiwa nguRahabhi, bahlala khona.
Kwathi kwathunywa ukumkani waseJericho, kwathiwa, Bheka, abantu baseSirayeli bafika lapha kusasa, ukubheka izwe.
Wathumela ukumkani waseJericho ku-Rahabhi, esithi, Thola abantu abafike ekhaya lakho; ngombana bafika ukubheka izwe lonke.
Uwesifazane wathatha labo bantu ababi, wabafihla; wathi, Bafika kuyena abantu, kodwana angizange ngizi bona bavela phi.
Kuze kube yisikhathi sokuvala umgwaqo wedolobha, lapho kwafika khona ubusuku obumnyama, laba bantu basuka. Angikaze ngizi bona baye kuphi; landelana nabo ngokushesha, ungabathola."
Wathi, "Uzobona bona ngizozi. Uthe: 'Kulungile!'" Wayewathatha esitezi, wabafihla ngezansi kwezihlahla ze-linseed ayezibeke khona.
Bathi abantu bakakumkani, bewalandela ngendlela yolwandle lweYorodani; bese bephuma, kwavalwa isango..
Ngaphambi kokuba amaphoyisa aphumule, uRahabhi wanyuka waya kubo esitezi.
Wathi kubo, Ngiyazi bona ikosi wakunikezile leli lizwe; begodu inhliziyo yethu ihlukumezeke ngenxa yenu, nalabo bonke abahlali balesi siqhingi baphazamiseka ngenxa yenu.

Sithe sazi bona ikosi wenza amanzi eMfuleni oMthubi aphuke phambi kwenu, lapho niphuma khona eYiputa; begodu sithe sazi bona nani nakwenze kuSihoni noOgi, abaphathi ababi bama-Amori, ngaphesheya kweYorodani, bona ningawaphelisa kangako.
Kwathi lapho sazi khona, inhliziyweni yethu yalahleka, begodu inhliziyo yethu yalahleka ngenxa yenu; ngombana ikosi uzimu wenu, yena kuphela uzimu esibhakabhakeni phezulu, nasemhlabeni ngezansi.
Ngalokho manje, ngicela, bengitshele ngeNkosi bona uzongilungisa imindeni yami, njengobaki mina ngangikuhlelile wena; ngininikeze isibonakaliso esiqinisekile ngeqiniso.
bona uzosindisa impilo yobaba wami, nomama wami, nabangani bam, nezinganeki zami, namakhaya abo onke; ukuze usisindise ekufaneni.gorha.
Bathi abantu kuye, Impilo yethu ifana nokuphila kwakho; uma ungazitshela umuntu lutho ngale nto esiyenzayo, lapho ikosi esininika lona izwe, sizokwenza nawe ngothando neqiniso.
Wabakhuphula ngentambo ngefasitela; ngombana indlu yakhe yakhiwa esitezi sedolobha dolobha, yena ke wayehlala esitheni.
Wathi kubo, Yiya entaba-mlilo, ukuze bangakutholani labo abazokuzilandela; fihlakeni khona amalanga amathathu, kuze babuye labo abazozilandela; bese ke nihambe indlela yenu.
Bathi kuye, "Sizobe sikhululekile ngalesi sinqumo okwenze savuma.
Uma nje, uma sifika kulolu lizwe, ungayibopha le nhlanganisela emnyama kulethebhu ebesikhupha ngayo; bese ufaka ubaba wakho nomama wakho nabangane bakho, nemindeni yenu yonke ekhaya lakho.
Uma umuntu ephuma ekhaya lakho, ephuma emgwaqeni, uzofa ngecala lakhe, begodu sizohlala singenacala; kodwana uma kukhona okunye okumbi Dilini lakho, sizohlala singenacala.
Uma utshela omunye umuntu lokho esikwenzayo, khona-ke sizoba ngekho emthethweni owawunze sizizwe.
Wayethi, "Kube njalo njengombana usho." Wabasusa, basuka, waveza intambo ebomvu efasiteleni.
Baye befika emfuleni, bahlala khona amalanga amathathu, kuze kube sekuphele ukulandela kwabo; begodu labo abalandelana nabo bafuna yonke indlela, kodwana bangawatholanga.
Baphuma emadolobheni, badlula, befika kuYoshuwa, unyana kaNune; bakhuluma kuye konke okube sekwenzekile kubo.
Bathi kuYoshuwa, "uzimu umise izwe lonke esandla sethu; nalabo bonke abahlali balo mhlaba baphoqeleka ukuba bahambe ngenxa yethu."
UYoshuwa wavuka ekuseni, wasuka eSitimu, waya eYordan, yena nemindeni yamadodana kaSirayeli naye; bamisa khona isikhashana ngaphambi kokuba badlule.
Ngemuva kwezinsuku amathathu abaqondisi basuka ekamelweni
Wathi kilabo abantu: "Uma nibona abapristi, amaLevi, bethwala ibhokisi lesivumelwano sikaYehova uzimu wenu, khona-ke nizophuma ezindaweni zenu, niyilandele.
Kodwana gcina isikhala esingu-kilomitha eyodwa phakathi kwakho nebhokisi. Ungayifinyeleli eduze kwayo. Ngemuva kwalokho uzozi bona indlela " ehamba ngayo, ngombana awuzange ube ngale le ngaphambi."
Wathi uYoshuwa kubo bonke abantu, Buyiselani; ngombana ngoMsombuluko ikosi uzokwenza phakathi kwenu izinto ezimangazayo.
Wathi uYoshuwa kwababhishobhi, Nithathe ibhokisi lesivumelwano, nihambe phambi kwalabo abantu. Bayithatha, bahamba phambi kwabo;
Wathi ikosi kuYoshuwa, Namuhla ngizoqala ukukwenza ube mkhulu phambi kwamehlo eSirayeli bonke, ukuze bakwazi bona ngikhona nawe, njengokuba ngikhona noMoses.
Uzothi kubo ababingeleli abathwala ibhokisi lesivumelwano, Nithi, Uma nifika esiphethweni samanzi aseJordani, hlalani emfuleni.
Wathi uYoshuwa kubo bonke oonyana bakaSirayeli, "Njimani lapha, nilalele amazwi kaYehova uzimu wenu."
Wathi, Ngalokhu nizokwazi bona uzimu ophilayo usephakathi kwenu, begodu bona ngeke asuse phambi kwenu amaKanana, namaHeti, namaHivi, namaPerizi, namaGiregasi, namaAmori, namaJebusi.
Bheka, ibhokisi lesivumelwano soNkulunkulu wezwe lonke lizohamba phambi kwenu, lifike eJordani.
Ngokuba nithatheni abantu abalishumi elinambini eziqhingini zakwaSirayeli, umuntu ngamunye eqenjini ngalinye.
Uma nje izinyawo zababhishobhi abathwala ibhokisi likaYehova, uzimu kamhlaba wonke, zifinyelela emanzini eJordani, amanzi aphumayo azohlala, azohlala emgodini owodwa.
Basuka ke abantu ezindaweni zabo, badlula iJordani, nababambiqhaza abathwala isiqu sesivumelwano behamba phambi kwabo.
Kwaba yisikhathi sokuvuna, lapho iJordane idlula zonke izintaba zayo. Uma abapristi abathwali isiqubulo befika emfuleni, bese izinyawo zabo zifinyelela enkabeni yamanzi;

Kwathi lapho amanzi aphumayo ehla khona, wamisa ukuphuma kwakhe. Amanzi asuka emzini ka-Adam, osendaweni se-Zarethani, aqala ukungena emgodini owodwa. Amanzi asuka emgodini woMfula oMfushane aphela ngokupheleleko. Abantu badlula eJericho.

Abapristi abathwala ibhokisi lesivumelwano sikaYehova bahlala beqinile endaweni emnyama phakathi kweYorodani, begodu bonke isiSirayeli badlula ndawonye endaweni emnyama, kuze kube sekuphele abantu bonke.
Kwathi lapho abantu bonke beqedile ukudlula iJordani, ikosi wathi kuYoshuwa,
"Chofoza abantu abalishumi elinambini, umuntu ngamunye isizwe,
bese ukhuluma kubo, uthi, Nciphisani amatshe alishumi elinambini phakathi kweYorodani, lapho izinyawo zababhishobhi zahlala khona; nizithatheni nani, nizibeke endaweni yenu yokuhlala le busuku.
Wabiza uYoshuwa amadoda alishumi elinambini, ayewakhethela ezweni laseSirayeli, umfazi oyedwa ngaleso sizwe.
Wathi kubo uMoses, Ngeni ngaphambili kwebhokisi likaYehova uzimu wenu, nifike ephakathi kweYorodani; niyithathe "itshe" elilodwa ngalinye phezu komlenze wenu, isonto ngalinye lakwaSirayeli.
Lokhu kuzoba yiphawu phakathi kwenu, ukuze uma izingane zenu zithi, Ngosuku oluzayo: Ziyini lezi zinto?

Uzokhuluma kubo, usithi: "Ulwandle lweYorodani lwagcwala amanzi phambi kwebhokisi lesivumelwano sikaYehova; lapho lidlula eYorodani, amanzi lagwazwa; begodu amatshe lawa azoba ngumlando wamaSirayeli kuze kube sekupheleni."

Bakwenza ke oonyana bakaSirayeli njengokuthi uYoshuwa kubo; bathatha amatshe alishumi elinambini emaphakathi kweYordan, njengabesithi ikosi kuYoshuwa, isizwe ngayinye sithole itshe elinye; bazisa ezindaweni zabo zokuphumula, bamisa khona.
UYoshuwa wabeka begodu amatshe alishumi elinambini phakathi kweJordani, lapho abapristi abathwali ibhokisi lesivumelwano behlala khona; zikhona nanamuhla.
Bathi labo ababhishobhi abathwala ibhokisi, bahlala phakathi kweYorodani, kuze kube sekuphele konke ikosi abewisela umthetho ngalo uYoshuwa, njengombana uMosis abewisela umthetho ngawo uYoshuwa.
Kwathi lapho abantu bonke bedlule khona, ibhokisi. uzimu wadlula, kanye nababhishobhi, phambi kwamehlo kwabantu.
Badlula uRubhen, noGadi, nengxenye yesizwe sikaManase, begqoke izikhali, phambi kwamadodana aseSirayeli, njengokuthi uMoses wabatshele.
Badlula phambi kweNkosi, ezindaweni ezihlaba umxhwele zaseJericho, ukubhekana nokulwa, abantu abangumakhulu amane anamashumi amahlanu, abagqoke izibhamu.
Ngosuku olulodwa ikosi wavusa uYoshuwa phambi kwamehlo eSirayeli bonke; bagwema yena yonke imihla yakhe, njengokuba begweme uMoses.
Wathi ikosi kuYoshuwa,
Uthi uMosis kuMoses, "Ubatshele abapristi abathwala ibhokisi lemithetho yomthetho, bona bakhuphuke emfuleni iJordani.
Wathi uYoshuwa kubabhishobhi, Nikhuphuke eYordan.

Kwathi lapho ababhishobhi abathwala ibhokisi lesivumelwano sikaYehova bekhuphuka emfuleni, bese amadolo abo edlula endaweni encibilikayo, amanzi o Dilimane abuyela emuva, adlule phezu kwezintaba zayo, njengakuqala.
Baphuma abantu eYordan ngomhla wesithupha wenyanga yokuqala, bamisa isikhashana eGalgali, enyakatho-mpumalanga yeYericho.
Wathi uYoshuwa amatshe amabili alishumi elinambini, ababewathatha eYordan, wababeka eGilgal.
Wathi kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli, Kuze kube kusasa, uma izingane zenu zibuza abazali babo, zithi, Ziyini lezi zitshe?
sithi kubo, 'Israyeli wadlula iJordani endaweni emanzi.'
ngombana ikosi uzimu wenu wamisa umlambo iYorodani phambi kwenu, kuze nidlule, njengokuba wamisa ulwandle olumnyama phambi kwethu, kuze sidlule.
ukuze zonke izizwe zezulu zikwazi bona amandla kaYehova amkhulu, begodu ukuze nigweme ikosi uzimu wenu nsuku zonke.

Kwathi lapho bonke abaphathi bama-Amori, ababesenyakatho yeJordani, kanye nabo bonke abaphathi bama-Kanana abeselwandle, beva bona ikosi wamisa umlambo iYorodani phambi kwabantwana bakaSirayeli, kuze kube sethule; khona-ke inhliziyweni sabo yalahleka, begodu amehlo abo awakwazi ukuzivikela ngenxa yamaSirayeli.
Ngaleso sikhathi ikosi wathi kuYoshuwa, Yenza izinkomishi zamatshe egolide, uthathe isibopho samadodana kaSirayeli kabili.
Wathi uYoshuwa, ekwenzeni izibha>i zegolide, watholisa amadodana aseSirayeli endaweni ebizwa bona yiNtaba Yezinyamakazi.
Lokhu kwaba wukuthi, bonke abantu abaphuma eYiputa, bonke amadoda okulwa, babefile emfuleni, besuka ezweni elimnyama.
begodu bonke amadoda aphumayo eYiputa, babetholwe; kodwana labo abazalwa emfuleni, lapho besuka khona eYiputa, abatholwe.

Ngokuba iminyaka emashumi mane abantu bakaSirayeli behamba emifuleni, kuze kube sekuphele bonke abantu abanamandla okulwa ababephuma eYiputa; ngenxa yokuthi abazange balalela izwi likaYehova. uzimu waphakamisa isandla sakhe, wathi: "Asikubonile leli lizwe, elishayela ubisi nengulube, elizolimnika,"
UYoshuwa wathungatha oonyana babo, abewaphakamisa uzimu endaweni sabo; ngombana abazange bathweswe ithanga, ngenxa yokuthi bebengathethwa ngesandla.
Kwathi lapho abantu bonke betholwe khona, bahlala emgodini, kuze kube sekuphele ukwelashwa kwabo.
Wathi ikosi kuYoshuwa, Namhlanje ngiyisuse phezu kwenu inkohliso yama-Egipta; ngalokho kwabizwa igama lesi sifundazwe bona iGalgali, kuze kube manje.
Bathi, "Sizokwenza iPasha ngomhla wesishiyagalombili wenyanga, uma siphuma eGilgal, ezindaweni eziseduze neJerikho."
Kwathi ngosuku olulandelayo iPasika, badla ukudla okuvela ezweni, ubisi olungavuthwanga, nenyama ethosiwe.
I-manna yamiswa ngosuku ngemuva kokudla kwabo ukudla okuvela ezweni. Abantu baseSirayeli abazange babe ne-manna. Lo nyaka badla izithelo zaseKanana.

Kwathi lapho uYoshuwa ebhekene neJerikho, waphakamisa amehlo akhe, wabona umuntu esemile phambi kwakhe, eneqhwa. UYoshuwa waya kuye, wathi kuye, Ingabe wena uyingane yethu, noma uyingane yalabo abasengozini?
Wathi yena, Akunjalo; ngifika njengomkhuluwa womkhosi kaYehova. UYoshuwa wehla ngobuso bakhe phasi ezweni, wathandaza, wathi, Ingabe kukhona okuthile oyinkosi yami ofuna ukumtshela umkhonzi wakhe?
Wathi uNdunankulu womkhosi kaYehova, Thola izicathulo zakho; ngombana indawo ohlala kuyo iyingcwele. UYoshuwa wakwenza njalo.
Izingcingo zaseJericho zavalwa ngenxa yamadodana aseSirayeli; akukho muntu ophumayo, akukho muntu ophumayo.
Wathi ikosi kuYoshuwa, Thola, ngikulethe esandla sakho iJericho, nokumkani wayo, namadoda amakhulu ayo.
Hamba ujikeleze lo mzi kanye nabantu bakho bonke abahlaselayo. Yenza lokhu amalanga ezine.

Uzobeka abapristi abasebathathu bethwala amabhungane ayisixhenxe ekhanda lengulube phambi kwebhokisi lesivumelwano. Ngosuku lwesine, nizojikeleza lo mzi izikhathi ezisixhenxe; begodu abapristi bazophuza amabhungane.
Uma ubona bona baphuza iphoyinti elilodwa, khona-ke abantu bonke kumele baphuze iphoyinti elilodwa; khona-ke umgwaqo wedolobha uzowela phasi, begodu wonke umuntu uzongena kiwo.
UYoshuwa unyana ka-Nun wababiza ababhishobhi, wathi kubo, Nciphisani ibhokisi lesivumelwano, begodu ababhishobhi abayisithupha bathathe amabhungane phambi kwebhokisi likaYehova.
Wathi kubo bonke abantu, Yinikele, nijikeleze lo mzi, nalabo abagqoke izithukuthe zihambe phambi kwesibuko sikaYehova.
Kwathi, lapho uYoshuwa ekhuluma abantu khona, amabhishobhi asixhenxe, aphethe amabhungane esixhenxe, wadlula phambi koYehova, ephuza amabhuzane akhe; ibhokisi lesivumelwano soNkulunkulu lalandela.
Amadoda agqoke izikhali ayehamba phambi kwamabhishobhi aphonsa ama-trumpets, begodu umgwaqo ongezansi walandela ibhokisi. Le sikhathi soke ama-trumpets ahlala ephuca.
Wathi uYoshuwa kubo bonke abantu, Mhlawumbe ngeke nivuke, noma nikhuphule izingcingo zenu, noma nikhulume lutho, kuze kube yilapho ngikutshele khona bona nivuke; khona-ke nivuke.
Wabeka ibhokisi likaYehova lijikeleze lo mzi kabili; abantu babuyela esiteji, baphumula khona ekuseni.
UYoshuwa wavuka ekuseni, abapristi baphakamisa ibhokisi likaNkulunkulu.

Nabo ababhishobhi abayisixhenxe, abanezinhlamvu zezinhlamvu eziyisishiyagalombili, bahamba phambi kwebhokisi likaYehova, bephuza izinhlamvu zezinhlamvu; nalabo abagqugquzelayo behamba phambi kwabo, nalabo abasemuva belandela ibhokisi, bephuza izinhlamvu.
Ngosuku lwesibili bajikeleza idolobha kabili,. Babuyela esitezi esiphansi; bakwenza njalo usuku olune.

Ngosuku oluyisixhenxe, bavuka ekuseni, bajikeleza idolobha ngendlela efanako; kodwana ngaleso sikhathi bajikeleze izikhathi ezisixhenxe. Kwakungusuku olulodwa lapho bejikeleza khona izikhathi ezisixhenxe.
Kwathi ngesikhathi esiyisixhenxe, lapho ababhishobhi bephuza khona amaphoyinti, uYoshuwa wathi kubo bonke abantu, Bukelani! uzimu usekuletheleni lo mzi.

Lo mzi, nezinto zonke ezingaphakathi kiwo, kumele zihlukaniswe ngokupheleleko kukaNkulunkulu; kodwana uRahabhi umfazi, naye wonke umuntu ohlala ekhaya lakhe, kufanele agcinwe, ngombana wafihla labo abathunyelwe ngathi.
Uma uthatha noma yini yazo, uzoba yingozi emkhosini wakwaSirayeli; uma uthatha noma yini yazo, uzoba yingozi emkhosini wakwaSirayeli.
Yonke isiliva, negolide, nanoma yini eyenziwe ngobhedu noma ngensimbi, ingcwele kukaNkulunkulu; kufanele ifike emgodini kaYehova.

Baphoqa ababhishobhi bona baphuze amabhungane, abantu ke baphoqa. Bekuthe bezwa umsindo wamabhungane, baphoqa ngokukhulu, isakhiwo sawela phasi; bonke abantu baphoqeleka ukuba bafike ngokushesha, bathatha lo mzi.
Babulala ngaso soke isikhathi konke okukhona kulo mzi, amadoda nabesifazane, abancane nobudala, namakhoboka, nezingulube, nezinkomo, ngesandla sabo.
Wathi uYoshuwa kilabo bantu ababi, abaye babheka izwe, wathi, Ngeni endlwini yomfelandawonye, niyiphumeze yena nomndeni wakhe wonke, njengokuba nithe naye.
Baye baphuma, bakhipha uRahabhi, nobaba wakhe, nenkosikazi yakhe, nabangane bakhe, nabo bonke abawinile; bakhipha begodu imindeni sabo yonke, bababeka ngaphandle komkhosi wakwaSirayeli.
Bawuthutha wonke lo mzi, nanoma yini ekhona kiwo; kodwana isiliva, negolide, nezinto zesibhakabhaka, nezinsimbi, bazibeka emthonjeni wendlu kazimu.

UYoshuwa wagcina uRahabhi, indodakazi yowesifazane, nomndeni wakhe, nalabo bonke ababengowabo; yena wahlala phakathi kwabaSirayeli kuze kube ngalolu busuku, ngenxa yokuthi wafihla labo abathunyelwe nguYoshuwa ukubheka iJericho.

Kwathi lapho, uYoshuwa washaya abantu ngesandla, wathi: "Umuntu ozama ukwakha lo mzi, iJericho, kufanele abulawe phambi koYehova; umzali wakhe omkhulu kumele aphele uma emisa isisekelo sayo, nomntwana wakhe omncane kumele aphele uma emisa amasango ayo."
Waye ikosi noYoshuwa, wafumana igama elikhulu ezweni lonke.

Kodwana amakhosi aseSirayeli wathatha izinto ezingcwele, begodu uAchan, unyana Karmi, unyana Zabdi, unyana Zerah, esifundazweni saseYuda, wathatha ezinye zazo; ngalokho ikosi wagwema amaSirayeli khulu.
UYoshuwa wathumela abantu kusuka eJericho kuya e-Ai, elibhekene neBethe-aweni, enyakatho yeBhetelehem, wathi kubo: "Niya phezulu, niyibone izwe." Baye ke labo bantu babheka i-Ai.

Babuyela kuye uYoshuwa, bathi kuye, Akufanele abantu bonke bahambe; thumela amadoda angamashumi amabili noma amakhulu amathathu ezweni lase-Ai; ungagcini abantu bonke, ngombana kukhona abantu abancane.
Baye benyuka abantu abangaphezu kukamakhulu amathathu, babaleka phambi kwamadoda ase-Ai.

Amadoda ase-Ai abulala phakathi kwabo abantu abangumashumi amathathu anesithandathu. Bawalandela emnyango, bafika eShebarim, babahlasela emadolobheni aphansi; begodu inhliziyweni yabantu yaqhuma, yaba ngamanzi.
UYoshuwa waxosha izigqoko zakhe, wehla ngobuso bakhe phasi ezweni phambi kwebhokisi likaYehova kuze kube sebusuku; nadla rauna bonke abakhulu bakaSirayeli, babeka uthuli ezinyaweni zabo.

Wathi uYoshuwa, "Ngiyaxolisa, Kosi yethu ikosi, yini ekwenzeni wena ukudlulisa la maqembu abantu phezu kweJordani, ukuze usithumelele esihlalweni sama-Amori, bona asihlukumeze? Uma kungenjalo, singeke sahlala ngaphesheya kweJordani.
Kosi, yini engikushoyo manje, lapho isiSirayeli sibuye sihambe phambi kwababi bakhe?
Uma bekubona labo baseKanana, nalabo bonke abasezweni lonke, bazosibamba ngazo zonke izingcezu zethu, basuse igama lethu phezu komhlaba; yini ongayikwenza ngegama lakho elikhulu?
Wathi ikosi kuYoshuwa, Nquma; yini na isizathu sokuba ulele ngobuso bakho?
Amakhosi aseSirayeli abulawe; baphula umnqophiso wami, owawubatshela wona. Bathatha izimpahla eziboshwe ngokupheleleko, bephuza begodu bezifihla phakathi kwazo zonke izinto zabo. uzimu wathi kuMosis:

Ngenxa lalokho, abantu bakaSirayeli abakwazi ukumelana nababi babo; babuyela emuva, babaleka, ngombana nabo bahlukaniswe ngokupheleleko. Ngami ngeke ngihlale phakathi kwenu nsuku zonke, ngaphandle kokuthi nisuse konke okuhlukaniswe phakathi kwenu.

Hamba, ugcine abantu bengcwele; uthi kubo, Uhlale ungcwele kuze kube ngoMsombuluko; ngombana ikosi, uzimu kaSirayeli, uthe: Zikhona phakathi kwenu izinto ezilahlekile, isiSirayeli; ngeke nikwazi ukumelana nezitha zenu, kuze nizisuse.
Emini, bhekani phambili isizwe ngesizwe. Isizwe esikhethiwe nguYehova sizobhekana phambili ngomndeni ngomndeni. Umndeni okhethiwe nguYehova uzokubhekana phambili ngowesifazane nomfazi.
Uma umuntu etholakele enezinto ezilahliwe, uzothunyelwa emgodini, naye nezinto zakhe zonke, ngenxa yokuthi waphula isivumelwano sikaYehova, begodu wenza into engalungile eSirayeli.
Ngosuku olulandelayo ekuseni uJoshua wabeka isizwe sakwaSirayeli esihamba phambili ngesizwe ngayinye, begodu isizwe sakwaYuda sakhethwa.
Kwafika imindeni yakwaYuda, kwathathwa imindeni kaZera. Imindeni kaZera yafinyelela umuntu ngamuntu, kwathathwa inkosikazi kaZabdi.
Kwafika umndeni ka-Zabdi, umuntu ngamuntu; uthethwe uAkani unyana kaKarmi, unyana ka-Zabdi, unyana ka-Zeraha'i, wesizwe sikaYuda.
Wathi uYoshuwa ku-Akani, "Unyana wami, ngikucela bona unqume ukubonga ikosi, uzimu kaSirayeli, begodu unqume ukumhlonipha; khuluma ngalokho okwenze; ungangifihlanga.
Waphendula u-Akani uYoshuwa, wathi, Kweqiniso, ngifile kuYehova uzimu kaSirayeli; begodu ngakwenza njalo.

Ngabona phakathi kwazo zonke izinto ezithunyelwe, isigqoko esisha esivela eBhabheli, nesibhamu segolide esingamakhilogremu ayisishiyagalombili, nengilazi yesiliva engamakhulu amahlanu amakhilogramu; ngafuna ukuthatha lezi zinto, begodu zathathwa. Ngokuba zigcinwe emhlabathini enhliziyweni yami, igolide lingaphansi kwayo.
Wathumela uYoshuwa abathunywa, bahamba befika esitezi; kwabonakala bona lifihlakele esitezi sakhe, nemali ingaphansi kwayo.
Bazithatha esitezi, bazisa kuYoshuwa, nakwamadodana kaSirayeli onke, bazibonela phambi koYehova.

Wathatha uYoshuwa u-Akani unyana kaZera, negolide, namabhulukwe, nesibhamu segolide, namadodana akhe, namakhosikazi akhe, nezimvu zakhe, nezinkomo zakhe, nezingulube zakhe, netente lakhe, nazo zonke izinto zakhe, waya eGolini lika-Akhore, yena noSirayeli bonke.
Wathi uYoshuwa, "Uyini lo monakalo owenzayo kuthina? uzimu uzokwenza umonakalo kuwe namuhla." Amadodakazi aseSirayeli wonke ayemshaya ngetshe; amanye amaSirayeli ayemshaya ngomlilo.
Bamisa phezu kwakhe umquba omkhulu wamatshe, kuze kube manje; wabuyela ikosi emlilweni wakhe onamandla; ngalokho kwabizwa igama lesi sifundazwe bona iGoli lika-Akhori, kuze kube ngalolu busuku.

Wathi ikosi kuYoshuwa, Musa ukukhathazeka, ungabi nenhliziyo ebuhlungu; thola bonke abantu abahamba nawe, uye e-Ai; bona, ngikulethela phambi kwakho ukumkani wase-Ai, nabantu bakhe, nodolobha lakhe, nezwe lakhe.
Uzoyenza i-Ai nenkosi yayo, njengokuba wenza eJericho nenkosi yayo; kodwana namuhla uzoba nempahla yayo, nezilwane zayo, ukuze uzigcine wena; ubeke abantu ababhekene nawe emuva komzi.
UYoshuwa wamisa isandla sakhe, waya e-Ai, yena nomndeni wakhe wonke. Wakhetha uYoshuwa abantu abakhulu abangumakhulu amathathu, wabathumela ebusuku.
Wathi kubo, Nquma bona nizifihla eduze kwedolobhana, begodu nilinde; ningase nihambe kude nalo; nihlale nihlelekile bonke.
Ngizonyuka ngifike kulo mzi, mina nemindeni yami yonke; begodu uma abantu base-Ai bephuma bezibhekana nathi, njengokuthi bakwenze ngaphambilini, sizobaleka phambi kwabo.
Bazothutha phambilina, kuze kube yilapho siwasusa emzini; ngombana bazothi, Baphuma phambi kwethu, njengaleso sikhathi sangaphambilini.
bese uphuma ezindaweni zakho ezifihlakeleyo, uthathe lo mzi; uzimu wakho, ikosi, uzowunikela esandla sakho.
Uma sewuthathe lo mzi, uzowuphonsa emlilweni; ukwenze konke okushoyo ikosi. Lokhu ngikuwisele umthetho ngalo.
Wabasusa uYoshuwa, basuka behamba. Baye ezindaweni zabo ezifihlakeleyo, bahlala phakathi kukaBhethele ne-Ai, ngasenyakatho ye-Ai; kodwana uYoshuwa waphumula ngaloo busuku phakathi kwabantu.
Wavuka uYoshuwa ekuseni, waqoqa abantu, waya e-Ai, yena nabaholi bakaSirayeli.
Wahamba wonke amadoda amakhulu, wafinyelela edolobhaneni, wamisa isibhedlela esisenyakatho ye-Ai; kwabe kukhona umlambo phakathi kwabo nedolobha.
UYoshuwa wathatha abantu abangumakhulu amahlanu, wababeka emgodini phakathi kukaBhethele neAi, enyakatho yedolobha.
UJoshua waphuma ngaleyo busuku, waya efulethini. Amadodana kaJoshuwa ahlala endaweni yawo, iqembu eliphambili lisenyakatho yedolobha, kanti labo ababhekene nalo lisenyakatho.

Kwathi lapho ukumkani wase-Ai nakabona khona lokhu, waphuma ngokushesha emveni kwemini, yena namadodana akhe wonke, ukubhekana nabaSirayeli, ezindaweni ezibhekene neGoli laseYorodani; awazi bona kukhona abantu abafihlakele emuva komzi.
Wathi uYoshuwa, naye wonke amakhosi aseSirayeli, wacabanga bona banqobiwe; waphuma waya esiqhingini.
Baphuma bonke abantu base-Ai, balandelana. Balandelela uYoshuwa, besuka emzini, babuyela ezweni labo.
Akukho muntu osele eHayi, noma eBhetheleli, ongaphumanga ngemuva kwaSirayeli; bashiya lo mzi uvulekile, belandela iSirayeli.
Wathi ikosi kuYoshuwa, Nciphisa isibhamu esisesandlani sakho kuze kube yi-Ai; ngombana ngizosinika wena lo mzi. UYoshuwa waphakamisa isibhamu sakhe kuze kube yi-Ai.
Kwathi lapho ekwenzela khona lokhu, labo abafihlakele bavuka ngokushesha, baphuma befika enkabeni yedolobha, balimaza idolobha, balimaza umlilo.

Amadoda ase-Ayi abheka emuva, wabona bona umphunga wedolobha unyuka ezulu; kwakungasekho ithuba labo lokuphuma ngaso soke isikhathi; ngombana abantu bakaSirayeli abasuka ezweni laseGibhithe babuyela emuva.
UYoshuwa noSirayeli bonke bebona bona labo ababhekene nabo bathathe lo mzi, begodu bona umphunga uphuma kulo mzi; babuyela emuva, bahlasela abantu base-Ai.

Baphuma namadoda edolobhaneni labo, babhekana nabo; abantu base-Ayi babekwa phakathi kwabo, begodu amaSirayeli aye ngapha nangapha. Amakhosi aseSirayeli awabulala, kuze kube kungekho muntu ohlalayo, noma ongamshiya.
Kodwana ukumkani wase-Ai bawuthatha ephilayo, bamletha kuYoshuwa.

Uma isiSirayeli siqedile ukubulala bonke abantu base-Ai, ezindaweni zasemaphandleni, emhlabathini lapho bebengawalandela khona; begodu wonke umuntu washona ngeqhwa, sabuya isiSirayeli soke sabuyela e-Ai, sabulala bonke abakhona kuyo.
Bafa ngalolusuku abantu abangu-12 amadoda nabesifazane, bonke abantu baseAi.
UYoshuwa akhenge akhuphule isandla sakhe, ebesiphakamisa isibhamu sakhe, kuze kuphele wonke umuntu ohlala e-Ai.
Kodwana izinyoni, nempahla yedolobha labaSirayeli bayithathe yaba yibo; njengokuthi ikosi wathi kuYoshuwa.
Wathi uYoshuwa wayala i-Ai, wayenza ibe yindawo elahlekile kuze kufike lemini.

Wabeka ukumkani wase-Ayi emgodini, wahlala khona kuze kube semini. Usuku luphela, uYoshuwa wabatjela bona bathathe ikhanda lakhe, balifuthe emnyango wedolobhana, bakhiphe phezu kwalo inqwaba enkulu yamatshe, eyakhona namuhla.
Ngaleso sikhathi uYoshuwa wakwakha isibingelelo kuYehova, uzimu kaSirayeli, emfuleni i-Ebali,

njengombana uMoses umkhonzi kaYehova abewisela umthetho ngawo oonyana bakaSirayeli, (njengombana kubhalwa encwadini yomthetho kaMosis), isibingelelo samatshe agcwele, impahla yensimbi engangeni kiwo;kuba banikela phezu kwawo izipho zokuncibilika, nezibopho zokuthula kukaNkulunkulu.
Wabhala khona uYoshuwa incwadi yomthetho, owawubhalwe nguMoses, wabhalela ematsheni phambi kwamadodana kaSirayeli.

Wonke umndeni wakwaSirayeli, namadodakazi abo, nabaphathi babo, namajaji abo, behlala ngaso soke isibambo sesivumelwano sikaYehova, ngaso soke isibambo esibhekene nalaba bapristi baseLevi abathwala isibambo; ingxenye sabo yahlala eduze komfula iGerizim, nengxenye sabo yahlala eduze komfula i-Ebali. UMoses, umkhonzi kaYehova, wabatjela njalo, lapho abantu bakaSirayeli beqashwa khona.
Wafunda uYoshuwa wonke la mazwi omthetho, isipho sokubambisana nesilayezo, ngokwezinto ezibhalwe encwadini yomthetho.
Wafunda amazwi onke aMoses abewiselayo, akashiyenga lutho; wafunda kiwo wonke umhlangano wamaSirayeli, namabhishobhi, namadodakazi, nezingane, nezivakashi ezihlala phakathi kwabo.

Kwathi lapho bekubona bonke abavikeli enyakatho yeJordani, abavikeli ezindaweni eziphakeme, nabavikeli ezindaweni eziphansi, nalabo bonke abavikeli emfuleni omkhulu kuze kube yiLibanoni, abavikeli bamaHeti, nama-Amori, namaKanana, namaPerizi, namaHivi, namaJebusi.
Bahlangana ndawonye, bahlasela uYoshuwa nabaSirayeli.
Kwathi lapho abantu baseGibeoni beva bona uYoshuwa wenzani eJerikho naseHayi,
Bathi: "Siyibona le nto, kodwana asikho isizathu sokuba siyibone." Bathi: "Akukho sizathu sokuba siyibone." Bathi: "Kulungile.
Bagqo vindebe elisha elinezinkinobho nezicathulo zakudala. Inyama sabo yonke yayimanzi begodu ikhula.
Bafika kuYoshuwa esiteji, eGalgali, bathi kuye namadodana aseSirayeli, Sivela ezweni elisendaweni ende; sicela ukwenzele isiqiniseko sokuthula.
Bathi amadoda aseSirayeli kiwo wonke la maHivi, Kungathi wena uhlala eduze kwethu; kungani sizokwenza umhlangano nawe?
Bathi kuYoshuwa, "Siyimi abakhonzi bakho." Wathi uYoshuwa kuye, "Ubani wena? Uvela kuphi?"
Bathi kuye, Sivela ezweni elide khulu thina abakhonzi bakho, ngenxa yegama likaYehova uzimu wakho; begodu sazi zonke izinto zakhe, nazo zonke izinto azenzayo eYiputa,
kanye nalokho akwenze kwabakumkani abangu-2 bama-Amori ngaphesheya kweJordani, uSihon ukumkani waseHeshboni, noOg ukumkani wakwaBashani, owahlala eAshtarothi.
Bathi nathi abaphathi bethu, nabantu bonke bezwe lethu, Nithatheni isiphuzo sokuhamba, nihambe nihlangane nabo, rauze bona, Siyimikhonzi yenu; sicela niyenze sivumelwano nathi.
Lo mhluzi wawufudumele uma sawufaka ekhaya ngosuku lapho sisuka khona ukuze sifike kufike kuwe. Kodwana bona bona ukhipheka kanjani begodu umnyama kangako manjero.
Lawa mabhodlela omnqumo ayesha lapho sawugcwalisa khona, kodwana bheka bona aphukile kanjani. Amabhulukwe ethu nezicathulo zethu ziphukile ngenxa yohambo olude khulu."
Amadodakazi kaSirayeli athole ukudla kwabo, kodwana awabuza ikosi bona angakwenzani.
UYoshuwa wakwenza nabo isiqiniseko, wathi: "Sizobavumela ukuba baphile;" begodu abaphathi bezindlu zakwaSirayeli baphikisa bona bazoyigcina.
Ngosuku oluthathu ngemuva kokwenza lo mthetho, abaSirayeli bafunda bona labo bantu babe yimindeni sabo.
Basuka ke oonyana bakaSirayeli, bafika emini yesithathu emizini sabo: eGibehoni, naseKefira, naseBherothi, naseKiriyati-yearimi.
Amadodakazi aseSirayeli akhenge ahlasele, ngenxa yokuthi abaphathi babo babebaphikisa ngoNkulunkulu ikosi, uzimu kaSirayeli; abantu bonke ke baphuca-phuca phezu kwabo.
Baphendula abaphathi, bathi, Sithe sabaphikisa ngeNkosi ikosi uzimu kaSirayeli; ngalokho-ke namuhla asikwazi ukuwashaya.
Sizokwenza lokhu: Sizobagcina bephila, ukuze kungase kuthuthele phezu kwethu inkohliso ka-Allaah ngenxa yobuxoki bethu.
Bathi labo abakhulu, Bahlale bephila. Baye babe ngamahhashi, nabahleli amanzi kubo bonke abantu, ngokwesinqumo salabo abakhulu;
UYoshuwa wababiza abantu baseGibheyoni, wathi kubo, Kungani na bona nithi, Sihlala eduze kwenu? Nakho nihlala lapha phakathi kwethu.
Ngokuba manje niyindoda elahlekile; begodu kuzobe kukhona phakathi kwenu abakhonzayo, abavuna imithi, nabathwala amanzi ekhaya likaThixo wami.

Baphendula bathi kuYoshuwa, bathi, Ngokungafani nalokho okuthunyelwe kuthi, bona ikosi, uzimu wakho, wathi kuMoses, umkhonzi wakhe, ukuba aninike leli lizwe lonke, begodu ukuba aphelise bonke abantu balo, abasuka ezweni lenu; neze sikhathazekile khulu ngempilo yethu ngenxa yenu, sakwenza lokhu.
Ngokuba thina singaphansi kwesandla sakho; yenza nathi njengombana kubukeka sengathi kuyiqiniso kuwe.
Wakwenza njalo uYoshuwa, wabavikela phambi kwamadodana aseSirayeli, abawabulalanga.
Wathi uYoshuwa ngalolusuku lwawo, wabeka labo baseGibeboni ukuba babe ngamahhashi, nabenzi bamanzi abantu, nesihlalo sobukhosi sikaYehova, ezindaweni ezokhetha kuzo ikosi, kuze kube yilapho.

Kwathi lapho uAdoni-zedeki, ukumkani waseYerusalem, ekwazi bona uYoshuwa wathatha iAi, wayibulala ngokuphelele; njengombana akwenzele iJericho nokumkani wayo, njalo ayenzile iAi nokumkani wayo. Wafumana begodu bona abantu baseGibheyone bamisa uxolo nabaSirayeli, bahlala phakathi kwabo.
Wakhathazeka khulu, yena nomndeni wakhe; ngombana iGibeyon ibiyidolobha elikhulu, njengelinye lamadolobha asebukhosini, likhulu kunaye-Ai, begodu bonke abantu bayo babe ngamadoda amakhulu.
U-Adoni-zedekhi ukumkani waseYerusalem wathumela kuHoham ukumkani waseHebroni, noPiram ukumkani waseYarmuthi, noJaphia ukumkani waseLakishi, noDebiri ukumkani waseEgloni.
Wathi, Yeza, ningisize ngihlasele iGibehoni; ngombana yenze ukuthula noYoshuwa nabantwana bakaSirayeli.
Baphuma ke abaphathi bama-Amori ababili, abaphathi baseYerusalem, nabaseHebroni, nabaseYarmuthi, nabaseLakishi, nabaseEgloni, nabo bonke amabutho abo, bahlanganisana, bahlasela iGibheyon.

Bathumela abantu baseGibeoni kuYoshuwa esibhedlela eGalgali, bathi, "Ungayishiya isandla sakho emkhondweni wakho; ndiza ngokushesha usindise nathi, usizakale nathi, ngombana bonke abavikeli baka-Amori abahlala emadolobheni asezindulini bahlanganisana nathi."
Waphuma uYoshuwa eGileyadi, yena nomndeni wakhe wonke, nabo bonke abantu bakhe abakhulu.
Wathi ikosi kuYoshuwa, Musa ukukhathazeka ngabo; ngombana ngibamise esandla sakho; akukho muntu kubo ozokwazi ukumelana nawe.
UYoshuwa waphuma eGilgal, wahamba yonke ibusuku, wabathatha ngaso soke isikhathi.
UYehova wabaphazamisa phambi kwaSirayeli; bahlasela khulu eGibehoni, bewalandela ngendlela yokuya eBhetho-horoni, bababulala kuze kube yi-Azeka ne-Makeditha.

Baphuma ezweni laseSirayeli, besuka eBhethoroni, ikosi wabathulisa phezu kwabo imvula enkulu yeqhwa kusukela emkhathini, kuze kube se-Azeka; bafa. Abafile ngenxa yeqhwa babeningi ukudlula abafile ngesandla samaSirayeli.

UYoshuwa wakhuluma kuYehova ngosuku lapho ikosi enikela khona ama-Amori phambi kwamadodana kaSirayeli, wathi phambi kwamadodana kaSirayeli onke: "Ilanga, hlala phasi phezu kweGibehoni; inyanga, hlala phasi phezu koLwandle lwe-Ajaloni."

Ilanga lahlala khona, nenyanga yahlala khona, kuze kube yilapho isizwe sinqobe ubuxoki bayo. Lokhu kubhalwe encwadini ka-Yashar. Ilanga lahlala phakathi kwesibhakabhaka, lilinde usuku oluphelele ngaphambi kokuphuma.
Akubekho usuku olufana nalo, ngaphambi kwalo, noma ngemuva kwalo, lapho ikosi ephulaphule khona ingoma yomuntu njengaleyo; ngombana ikosi wayebhekana noSirayeli.
Wabuyela uYoshuwa, naye wonke amaSirayeli, esitezi esiphakeme eGilgal.
Ke kaloku labo bukhosi abahlanu baphuma, bafihlakela embuzweni waseMakeda.
Kwathi kwathunyelwe uYoshuwa, kwathiwa: Abakumkani abahlanu bafunwa befihlakele emgodini eMakedha.
Wathi uYoshuwa, Nciphisani amatshe amakhulu emlonyeni wale ngobo, nibeke khona abantu ukuba bagcine.
Kodwana-ke, musa ukuphumula; landelani izitha zenu, nihlasele ezinyaweni zabo; ningaze nizivumele zifike emizini sabo; ngombana ikosi uzimu wenu wazisa esandlani.
UYoshuwa namadodana kaSirayeli bahlasela ngamandla amakhulu, baphoqeleka ukuba bangabikho. Abambalwa abaphilayo babuyela emizini sabo enezindlu zangasese.
Baye bonke abantu babuyela kuYoshuwa esiteji, eMakeda, bephephile; kwakungekho muntu owaziyo lutho ngamadodana aseSirayeli.
Wathi uYoshuwa, Vula umlomo wale ngobo, niziveze kum labo bamabukhosi abanguhlanu.
Bathi ke, bathathe labo madodana amahlanu besuka emgodini: amakhosi aseJerusalema, ne-Hebrone, noYarmuthi, naLakishi, naEgloni.

Kwathi, lapho baphuma khona labo bakwaSirayeli kuye uJoshua, wabiza wonke amadoda aseSirayeli, wathi kubo abaphathi bemikhosi ababehamba naye: "Njimani nibeke izinyawojeli zenu ezinyaweni zalabo ababingeleli." Bafika ke, babeka izinyawojeli zabo ezandleni zawo.
Wathi kubo uYoshuwa, Musani ukukhathazeka, noma ukuba nenhliziyo ebuhlungu; zinikele, nibe nethando olukhulu; ngombana lokhu kuzokwenza ikosi ngazo zonke izitha zenu ongazinqoba.
UYoshuwa wahlasela labo bukhosi, wababulala, wababopha emathinini amane; babebopha emathinini kuze kube semini.

begodu, lapho ilanga liphuma, uJoshua wamisa ukuba bathathwe ngezansi izihlahla, begodu wabeka kubo emgodini lapho babefihle khona. begodu, amatshe amakhulu abekwe phezu umlomo womgodini, begodu kukhona kuze kube manje.

Wathatha uYoshuwa iMakedha ngalolusuku, wabulala ukumkani wayo ngeqhwa, naye wonke umuntu ohlala kulo mzi, wamqubula ngokuphelele; akhenge ashiye noma ngubani ophilayo. Wakwenza kukumkani weMakedha njengokuba wayekwenze kukumkani waseJericho.
Wahamba uYoshuwa, naye wonke amaSirayeli, esuka eMakedha waya eLibna, wahlasela.

UYehova wanikela iLibna nenkosi yayo esandla sakwaSirayeli; uYoshuwa wabulala wonke umuntu ohlala kulo mzi ngeqhwa, akhenge ashiye lutho oluphilayo. Wakwenza ukumkani walo njengombana wayekwenze kumkani waseJericho.
Wahamba uYoshuwa, naye wonke amaSirayeli, eLibna waya eLakishi, wamisa isibhedlela phezu kwayo, wahlasela.
Wabeka ikosi iLakishi esandleni sakwaSirayeli; uYoshuwa wayithatha ngosuku olulandelayo, wabulala wonke umuntu ohlala kuyo ngeqhwa, ngokwezinto zonke azenzayo eLibna.
Ngaleso sikhathi uHoram, ukumkani waseGezeri, waya eLakishi ukusiza; kodwana uYoshuwa wamshaya yena nomndeni wakhe, akhenge amshiye umuntu.
Wadlula uYoshuwa, naye wonke amaSirayeli, kusuka eLakishi waya eEgloni, wamisa isibhedlela phezu kwayo, wahlasela.
Bayithatha ngalolusuku olulodwa, babulala wonke umuntu okhona ngeqhwa; uYoshuwa wayisaphazamisa ngokupheleleko, njengombana wayeyenze eLakishi.
Waphuma uYoshuwa, naye wonke amaSirayeli, eEgloni waya eHebroni, wahlasela.

Bayithatha, babulala ukumkani wayo, nalabo bonke abakhona kuyo, namabhishi ayo, ngeqhwa; akhenge ashiye umuntu ophilayo, njengombana bekwenze ku-Egloni; bayenze ibe yindawo engcwele, nayo yonke into ekhona.
Wabuyela uYoshuwa, naye wonke amaSirayeli, wahlasela iDebiri.

Bawuthatha lo mzi, nokumkani wakhe, namadolobhana akhe; babulala wonke umuntu ohlala kiwo ngeqhwa; akhenge ashiye noma ngubani. UYoshuwa wenza kuDebiri nokumkani wayo njengokuthi wakwenza eHebroni, neLibna nokumkani wayo.

UYoshuwa wahlasela izwe lonke, indawo entaba-mlilo, neNtshonalanga enyakatho, nezindawo ezisempumalanga, neziqhingi, nazo zonke iziphathimandla zazo; akhenge ashiye umuntu ophilayo, wabulala konke okuphefumulayo, njengombana ikosi, uzimu kaSirayeli, abewisela umthetho.
Wawahlasela uYoshuwa kusukela eKadeshe-barnea kuya eGaza, nezwe lonke laseGosheni, kuze kube eGibeyon.
UYoshuwa wahlasela labo bonke abavikeli kanye nezwe labo ngasikhathi sinye; ngombana ikosi, uzimu kaSirayeli, wayebhekana noSirayeli.
Wabuyela uYoshuwa, naye wonke amaSirayeli, esitezi esiphakeme eGilgal.
UYabini ukumkani waseHazori, ekubona lokhu, wathumela kuYobhabhi ukumkani waseMadoni, nakumkani baseShimroni, nakumkani baseAkshaphi, wathi,
nakwabavukeli abasemadolobheni asenyakatho, ezindaweni ezisempumalanga yeJordani, ngaphesheya kolwandle lwaseGaliliya, nasezindaweni ezisenyakatho-ntshonalanga, nasezindaweni zaseDori ngasenyakatho.
Wathumela nakwa-Kanana enyakatho nentshonalanga, nakwa-Amori, nakwa-Hethi, nakwa-Perizi, nakwa-Yebhusi ezindaweni eziphakeme, nakwa-Hivi ngezansi komfula iHermon, endaweni yaseMizpa.
Baphuma nabo yonke imikhosi sabo, inqwaba enkulu yamabhishobhi, efana nezingcezu zeqhwa ezisentshonalanga yolwandle; namabhayisikili namahhashi amakhulu.
Lawa mabukhosi onke ahlangana, wamisa isibhedlela ezindaweni ezingaphansi kwamanzi aseMerom, ukubhekana noSirayeli.

Wathi ikosi kuYoshuwa, Ungabakhathazeki ngenxa sabo; ngombana ngoMsombuluko ngalolu sikhathi ngizowanikela bonke abafileyo phambi kwamadodana aseSirayeli. Izikebhe zabo uzozibopha izinyawo, nezithuthuthu zabo uzozishisa ngamanzi.
Wafika ke uYoshuwa, naye wonke amakhosi akhe, ngaso soke isikhashana kubo ezindaweni zamanzi aseMeromu, wahlasela.

Wabanikela ikosi esandla sakwaSirayeli. Bawahlasela, babalandela kuze kube yiSidon enkulu, neMisrephothi-mayim, naphezu kweGoli laseMizpa; babulala bonke abahlala kuyo, abazange bashiye muntu ophilayo.
Wathi uYoshuwa kubo, njengokuthi ikosi kuye: izikebhe zabo wazenza zinemilenze emide, begodu izithuthuthu zabo wazenza zinemlilo.
Kusukela lapho uYoshuwa wabuyela, wahlasela iHazori, wabulala ukumkani wayoyo ngeqhwa; ngombana uHazori ube yinhloko yalezi zizwe zonke.gorha.
Bawubulala wonke umuntu ogwini lwesibhakabhaka, bawuphelisa ngokuphelele; akukho lutho oluphilayo lwahlala khona; begodu uYoshuwa washiswa iHazori.
UYoshuwa wathatha zonke lezi zifundazwe, namadodakazi azo, wababulala ngeqhwa, wabasusa ngaso soke isikhathi, njengombana uMoses umkhonzi kaYehova abewisela umthetho.
Kodwana-ke, imiphakathi yamaSirayeli eyakhiwa phezu kwezimpophoma zawo, ayikho eye yashiswa yiSirayeli, ngaphandle kweHazori; uYoshuwa wawushisa.
Impahla yonke yalezi zifunda, nenyama sabo bonke abantu bayo, bayithatha yaba yimali sabo; kodwana wonke umuntu wababulala ngesandla sekhephu, kuze kube wukuphela kwento ephilayo, bengayishiya.
Wathi ikosi kuMosis, umkhonzi wakhe, bona akwenze njalo; wathi uMosis kuye uYoshuwa, begodu uYoshuwa wabaphulaphule. Akukho lutho lwazo zonke izinto awawiselayo ikosi uMoses.

Wathatha uYoshuwa leli lizwe lonke, indawo entaba-mlilo, nezweni lonke laseNtshonalanga, nezwe lonke laseGosheni, nezindawo eziphansi, neGoli leJordani, nendawo entaba-mlilo yamaSirayeli nezindawo zayo eziphansi,
kusukela emfuleni iHalaka, ohamba eSeiri, kuze kube nguBaali-Gadi, esivandeni yaseLibanoni ngezansi komfula uHermon; wathatha bonke abaphathi babo, wababulala.
Ngosuku olude uYoshuwa wabhekana nabo bonke abaphathi.
Akukho mzi owodwa owenza uxolo nabaSirayeli, ngaphandle kwabaHivi abahlala eGibehoni. AbaSirayeli bathatha wonke la madolobha ngempi.
UYehova wabacindezela intliziyo sabo, bahlasela amaSirayeli, ukuze aboshwe ngokuphelele, bangabi nesondlo, njengombana ikosi abewisela umthetho uMosese.
Ngaleso sikhathi uYoshuwa waya, wasusa ama-Anakhi emadolobheni amahle, eHebroni, naseDebiri, naseAnabi, namadolobheni amahle aseYuda, naseSirayeli onke; uYoshuwa wabaphazamisa ngazo zonke izizwe.
Akukho okunye okushiwo ngama-Anakhi ezweni lakwaSirayeli, ngaphandle kweGaza, neGathi, neAshdodi.
Wathatha uYoshuwa izwe lonke, njengokuthi ikosi kwathi kuMoses; wabanika uYoshuwa amaSirayeli izwe labo, ingxenye sabo, ngokwesizwe sawo. Izwe laphumula empilweni.

Nalaba bamakhosi ezweni labo, abasolwa ngamadodana kaSirayeli ngaleso siqhingi saseYorodani, ngasenyakatho-mpumalanga, abathathe izwe labo, kusukela emfuleni uArnoni kuya emfuleni uHermon, nezindawo zonke ezisempumalanga yesiqhingi seJordani:

uSihon, ukumkani wama-Amori, owahlala eHeshboni; wayelawula kusukela eAroeri, okungenani kwengubo ka-Arnon, naphakathi kwengubo, nengxenye yeGiliyadi, kuya emfuleni iYabhoki, umkhawulo wamadodana a-Amoni.
Walawula begodu umlambo waseJordani osentshonalanga, kusukela emfuleni weGalili kuya eMfuleni Wokufa, kuze kube yiBethi-yeshimothi, nakwesokunxele eduze kwePisga.
Bathathe begodu izwe lika-Ogi ukumkani waseBhashani, umfazi wesifazane, owahlala eAshtarothi noEdrei.
Wayelawula intaba iHermon, neSaleka, noBashan wonke, kuze kube yisiphezu seGeshuri neMaaka, naphezu kwengxenye kaGiliyadi, kuze kube yisiphezu kaSihon ukumkani waseHeshboni.
UMosis, umkhonzi kaYehova, nabantwana bakaSirayeli babewahlasela; uMosis, umkhonzi kaYehova, wabanika izwe labo labaRubheni, nabaGadi, nengxenye yesizwe sikaManase, ibe yindawo sabo.

Nalaba bamakhosi abawahlasela uYoshuwa namadodana kaSirayeli ngasenyakatho yeJordani, kusukela eBaali-Gadi emfuleni waseLibanoni kuze kube yilapho intaba iHalaka, enyukela eSeiri. UJoshua wabanika isizwe sakwaSirayeli indawo sabo yaba yinkontileka yazo;

Ihlanganisa izwe eliphakeme, nezindawo eziphansi zasenyakatho, nofula laseYorodani, neziqhingi zezulu, nesiqhingi samanzi abandayo, neNtshonalanga, izwe lamaHithi, nama-Amori, nama-Kananani, namaPerizi, namaHivi, namaJebusi.
ukumkani waseJericho, owodwa; ukumkani wase-Ai, eBetheli, owodwa;
ukumkani waseYerusalem, owodwa; ukumkani waseHebroni, owodwa;
ukumkani waseYarmuthi, owodwa; ukumkani waseLakishi, owodwa;
ukumkani wase-Egloni, owodwa; ukumkani waseGezeri, owodwa;
ukumkani waseDebiri, owodwa; ukumkani waseGeder, owodwa;
ukumkani waseHorma, owodwa; ukumkani waseAradi, owodwa;
ukumkani waseLibna, owodwa; ukumkani waseAdulamu, owodwa;
ukumkani waseMakeda, owodwa; ukumkani waseBhethele, owodwa;
ukumkani waseTaphua, owodwa; ukumkani waseHepher, owodwa;
ukumkani wase-Afeki, owodwa; ukumkani waseLasaroni, owodwa;
ukumkani waseMadoni, owodwa; ukumkani waseHazori, owodwa;
ukumkani waseShimron, uMeron, owodwa; ukumkani waseAkshaphu, owodwa;
ukumkani waseTaanakhi, owodwa; ukumkani waseMegido, owodwa;
ukumkani waseKedesh, owodwa; ukumkani waseYokneamu eKarmeli, owodwa;
ukumkani waseDori, ezindaweni eziphakeme zeDori, omunye; ukumkani wamaGoyim eGalgali, owodwa;
ubukhosi baseThirsa, omunye; kwabakho bonke abaholi abathathu nambili.
Kwathi lapho uYoshuwa eneminyaka emikhulu, uhlala iminyaka emininzi, ikosi wathi kuye, Ubaba, namuhla ubudala khulu, begodu izwe lisele liningi ukulinqoba;
Le yilizwe elisele, yonke imiphakathi yamaFilisti, namaGeshuri;

kusukela emfuleni i-Shihori, esiqhingini saseYiputa esisenyakatho kuze kube yisiqhingi se-Ekrona, esihlanganiswe njengezwe lakwaKananani. Kuhlanganisa nelizwe labaphathi beFilistijeli abahlanu eGaza, naseAshdodi, naseAshkeloni, naseGathi, nase-Ekroni, kanye nephasi wamaAvithi
Kwathi enyakatho-mpumalanga, izwe lonke lakwaKanana, kusukela eAraha, eliyindawo yamaSidoni, kuze kube yi-Afeki, kanye nesiqhingi sama-Amoreti;
begodu izwe labaseGibaleni, neLibanoni yonke enyakatho-mpumalanga, kusukela eBhaali-Gadi ngezansi komfula iHermon, kuze kube seHamati.

Ngizowasusa bonke abahlala emadolobheni amahle, kusukela eLibanoni kuze kube yiMisrephothi-mayim, wonke amaSidoni; ngizowakhipha phambi kwamadodana kaSirayeli; uqiniseke bona ngizobanika izwe labaSirayeli njengempahla sabo, njengombana ngikutshele.
Ngalokho manje uhlukanise leli lizwe phakathi kwezizwe eziyisishiyagalombili, nengxenye yesizwe sikaManase.
Ingxenye yamadodana kaManase, uRubhene noGadi, bathathe izwe, labo uMosis wabanike lona ngaphesheya koMfula iYorodani; uMosis, umkhonzi kazimu, wabanika lona.
Kusuka e-Aroere, enhliziyweni yomfula i-Arnoni, nedolobhana eliphakathi komfula, nalapho kungena khona yonke intaba se-Medeba, kuze kube yiDiboni;
kanye namadolobha onke kaSihon, ukumkani wama-Amori, owahlala eHeshboni, kuze kube yisiqhingi sama-Amoni.
begodu iGiliyadi, nephasi wamaGeshuri, namaMaaka, yonke intaba kaHermon, neBashana lonke, kuze kube yiSaleka;
izwe lonke lika-Ogi eBhashani, owahlala eAshtarathi noEdrei. Wabe ngumunye walabo abashisayo, uMoses wayewahlasela, wabasusa emazweni abo.
Amadodana kaSirayeli akhenge akhuphule abantu baseGeshuri nabaseMahaka; bahlala phakathi kwamadodana kaSirayeli kuze kube yimanje.
Kodwana isizwe sakwaLevi uMoses asikubenisile ingxenye; izipho ezishiswayo zikaYehova, uzimu kaSirayeli, ziyingxenye sabo, njengombana wathi kubo.
