Lokho wukuthi uMoses awanikeze isizwe sakwaRubheni, ngokwemindeni sabo:
Isifundazwe sabo saqala e-Aroere, esisenyakatho yeGoli le-Arnoni, nedolobhana eliphakathi kweGoli le-Arnoni, naleyo ndawo ibandayo yonke eya eMedebha;
kuze kube yiHeshboni, nezifunda zayo zonke eziseduze, ezindaweni zesihlabathi, iDiboni, neBamoth-bhaali, neBeth-bhaali-meoni,
neYahazi, neKedemothi, neMefaathi,
neKiriyatayim, neSibhama, neZerethe-shahari, emfuleni ophakeme,
iBhethe-peori, nezingqimba zePisga, neBhethe-jesimothi.

Nawo wonke amadolobhana ase-Ela, nezwe lonke likaSihon ukumkani wama-Amori, owahlala eHeshboni; ngombana uMoses wahlasela uSihon, nabaholi bakaMidiyani: uEvhi, noRekem, noZure, noHuri, noRebha, abaphathi belizwe, ababesebenza kuSihon.
Babulala noBhileham, unyana ka-Beore, owenza izimanga, ngeqhwa, phakathi kwalabo abafileyo.
Nasenyakatho yesifundazwe sakwaRubheni kwakunguMfula iYorodani. Lezo zidolobhana nezindawo zazo zaba yindawo yomndeni kaRubheni, ngokwemindeni yawo.
Lokho wukuthi uMoses awanikeze isizwe sikaGadi, ngokwemindeni yawo:
Izwe labo lakunguYaseri, namadolobha onke eGiliyadi, nengxenye yezwe lama-Amoni, kuze kube yi-Aroeri elibhekene neRabha.
Yasuka eHeshboni yafika eRamathi-mipha, neBethonim; yasuka eMahanayim yafika emfuleni waseDebiri.

Ezweni laseGibhithe bekukhona iBeth-harama, neBeth-nimra, neSukhothi, neZaphoni, konke okushiwo nguShehonu ukumkani waseHeshboni. Umkhawulo wayo onyakatho wawunguYorodani, kuze kube yilapho ulwandle lwaseGalilia luphele khona, enyakatho yeJordani.
Lezi ziyidolobhana, nezifundela zazo, ezinikezelwe isizwe sakwaGadi ngokwemindeni yawo.
Lokho wukuthi uMoses awanikeze isizukulwane esisodwa sakwaManase, ngokwemindeni sabo:
Umhlaba wabo wawusuka eMahanayim, waya kiwo wonke uBhashani, lonke izwe lika-Og ukumkani waseBhashani, nazo zonke izifunda zaseYairi ezinguBhashani, ziyizindawo eziyisishiyagalombili.
Ingxenye yeGiliyadi, kanye ne-Ashtarothi ne-Edreyi, imiphakathi yobukhosi ka-Og eBhashani, yanikezwa izingane zikaMakhi unyana kaManase, izingane zesigamu sabantwana bakaMakhi ngokwemindeni sabo.
Le lizwe uMoses walihlukanise, ezindaweni ezisempumalanga zakwaMowabi, ngaphesheya komfula iYorodani eJericho.
Kodwana isizwe sakwaLevi, uMoses akayinika indawo; ikosi, uzimu kaSirayeli, ungumzabalazo wabo, njengombana wathi kubo.

Wathi ke uMosis, ekhuluma ku-Israyeli, wathi: "Izwe laseKanana lahlukaniswa phakathi kwabaSirayeli; uEleazaru umpristi, noYoshuwa unyana kaNune, nabaholi bezindlu zakwababa babo, bahlukanise phakathi kwabo.
Bathi, "Sizothola izwe ngesandla sethu," njengombana ikosi abewisela umthetho ngoMosesi; banikela ngezandla zabo.
UMoses wabanika isizwe esisodwa nesishiyagalombili imindeni sabo, enyakatho-mpumalanga yeYorodani; kodwana kwabaLevi uMosis akhenge abanike phakathi kwabo.
AbaLevi abazange babe nengxenye ezweni, kodwana babenezifunda zokuhlala kuzo, nezifundela zazo ezibhekene nazo, ezakhiwe ngezilwane zabo nasezimpahla zabo.
Bahlukanise ke amadodana aseSirayeli izwe, njengombana ikosi abewisela umthetho uMoses.
Bafike abantu baseYuda kuYoshuwa eGalgali; wathi kuye uKalebe, unyana kaJefune, umKenizi: Uyazi into ebeyikhuluma ngayo ikosi kuMoses, indodana kaThixo, ngawe nami, eKadesi-barnea.

Ngineminyaka emashumi mane ngineminyaka, lapho uMoses, umkhonzi kaYehova, engumthumela khona kusuka eKadeshe-bar "iBarnea" ukuba ngibone izwe; ngabuya ngikhuluma ngeqiniso, njengombana kwakuyiqiniso emiphefumlweni yami.
Kwathi labo abaye bahamba nami, babangela bona inhliziyweni yabantu ibe buhlungu; kodwana mina ngalandela ikosi uzimu wami ngenhlonipho yami yonke.
Wathi uMosis kuye ngalolu suku, bona: "Izwe olubophele kulo lizobe likhona kuwe, nabantwana bakho, rauya; ngombana usulandela ikosi uzimu wami ngenhliziyo yakho yonke.

Ngabona bona ikosi ungigcine ngiphila iminyaka emashumi mane anesihlanu, njengombana wathi, kusukela kuleso sikhathi akhuluma ngaso kuMosese, lapho amaSirayeli ehamba esiqhingini; manje ngineminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili nesihlanu.
Ngiyaqhubeka nginamandla njengaleso sikhathi lapho uMoses ethumela khona, begodu manje ngizokwazi ukuphuma empilweni yami, njengokuba ngangikhona nalapho.

Ngiyakucela, nginike le ndawo entaba-mlilo, ikosi awathi ngami ngalolusuku; ngombana sekuyiqiniso bona usazi bona kukhona khona abantu bakaAnaki, nezifunda ezinkulu ezinezindlu zangasese; kodwana ngizowasusa ngesandla soNkulunkulu, njengombana atjhilo.
UYoshuwa wabambisa uKalebe unyana kaJefune, wamnika iHebroni ibe yindawo yakhe.
Ngaleyo le iHebroni yaba ngu Kalebu, unyana kaJefune, umKenizi, kuze kube manje; ngombana wayelandela ikosi, uzimu wakwaSirayeli, ngenhliziyo yakhe yonke.
Igama lika-Hebron kwakunguKirihati-arba, ngegama lika-Arba, indodana ka-Anaki; khona-ke izwe laphumula empilweni.
Izwe elinikezwa isizwe sakwaYuda, ngokwemindeni yawo, lifike enyakatho-ntshonalanga kuya emfuleni iEdomu, kuze kube yisiqhingi sikaZini, engxenyeni esempumalanga.
Umgwaqo wabo wasenyakatho uqala engxenyeni esenyakatho ye-Ocean Dead, ebhishi elibheke eningizimu.
wadlula enyakatho-ntshonalanga yeSkorpion Pass, waya eZin, wafika enyakatho-ntshonalanga yeKadesh Barnea, wadlula eHezron, wafika eAdar, wajika waya eKarka.
Wadlula e-Azmoni, walandela umlambo. Yaphela emfuleni. Lo mkhawulo ube yimikhawulo sabo yasenyakatho.
Umkhawulo wasenyakatho ube yiMfula oMfushane, kuze kube yimpuphu yeJordani. Umkhawulo wasentshonalanga wawuqala ebhishi laselwandle lapho iJordani iphuma khona.
wanyuka waya eBeth-hogla, wadlula eBeth-arabha ngasenyakatho, waya esitsheni sikaBohani unyana kaRubhen.
wadlula eDebiri, wasuka emfuleni i-Akhore, wabuyela ngasenyakatho waya eGalgali, obhekene nebanga eliphakeme le-Adummim, elasenyakatho yomfula; wadlula emanzini ase-En-shemesi, waphela e-En-rogeli.

Kusukela lapho umkhawulo unyuka waya emfuleni ka-Ben Hinnom, enyakatho yedolobha laseJebhusi elibizwa bona yiJerusalema; wafika esiphethweni somfula waseHinnom osesiqhingini saseNfensivi ngaseningizimu.
Kusuka phezulu komfula, umkhawulo wahamba waya emfuleni waseNeftoha, waya emadolobheni aseNtaba ka-Ephron, wehla waya eBhala (leyo yiKiriyati-yearimi).
Yasuka eBhala, yabuyela ngasenyakatho, ifike emfuleni uSeyiri; yadlula enkabeni yasenyakatho yomfula iYearimi (yena uKeshaloni), yawela eBhethe-shemesi, yadlula eTimna.
wadlula engxenyeni yasenyakatho ye-Ekroni, wehla waya eShikereni, wadlula emfuleni iBaala, wafika eYabneel, waphela elwandle.
Lo mkhawulo wasenyakatho usuka enkabeni yolwandle olukhulu. Lo mkhawulo waba yimiphakathi yamadodana kaYuda, ejikeleze izwe, ngokwemindeni yawo.
UYehova wamnika uKhalebe, unyana kaJefune, umfelokazi phakathi kwamadodana kaYuda, iKiriyati-arba (leyo yiHebroni), uArba owayengubaba kaAnaki, njengombana ikosi abewisela umthetho uYoshuwa.
UKalebe wakhipha eHebrone abaAnaki abathathu: uSheshai, noAhimana, noTalmai, izingane zika-Anaki.
Waphuma khona, wahlasela labo abahlala eDebiri (igama layo kwakunguKiriyati-seferi).
Wathi uKalebe, Uma umuntu ehlasela iKiriyati-seferi, bese uyithatha, ngizomunika intombi yami iAksha ukuba ngumkakhe.
Wayinqoba uOthniyeli, indodana kaKenazi, umngane kaKalebe; ke kaloku uKalebe wamnika inkosikazi yakhe i-Aksha ukuba ibe ngumkakhe.
Wayefika ku-Othniyeli, wamangalisa ubaba wakhe bona afune indawo yokulima. Waphuma enyangeni yakhe, wathi kuye uKalebe, Ufuna yini?
Wathi yena kuye, Ungisize; ngombana ungisizile izwe elinabantu abaningi, nginikeze begodu izimpophoma zamanzi " . Ke kalobe wamnika izimpophoma eziphezulu nezimpophoma ezisephansi.
Lokho wumhlaba owanikezwa isizwe sakwaYuda, ngokwemindeni yawo.
Nasenyakatho, ngaphesheya komfula i-Edom, bekukhona amadolobha abo: uKabseyeli, noEdere, noYagure,
iKina, neDimona, neAdada,
noKedeshe, noHasoro, noIthnani,
uZiphe, noTelemem, noBealothi,
iHazori-hadatha, neKeriyothi-hezroni, leyo yiHazori;
uHaman, noShema, noMolada,
uHazari Gadda, noHeshmoni, noBethe-pelethi,
uHazari-shuali, noBeershebha, neBiziyothiya,
noBhala, noIyim, noEzem,
uEltoladi, noKeshili, noHorma,
iSikelage, neMadmana, neSansana,
iLebhaothi, neShilhimu, neAyini, neRimoni; zonke izidolobhana zazimashumi mabini nanye nezifundazwe zawo.
Ezindaweni eziphansi zasenyakatho kwakuyi-Eshtaoli, neZora, neAshna,
iZanoa, neEnganimu, neTaphuwa, neEnamu,
neJarmuthi, neAdulami, neSokho, ne-Azeka,
iShaaraim, ne-Adithaim, neGedera (igama layo nguGederothayim), izidolobhana ezilishumi elinamihlanu nezifunda zawo.
begodu uZenan, noHadasha, noMigdali-Gadi,
neDilihane, neMizpa, neYokteyeli,
neLakishi, neBozkhathi, neEgloni,
i-Kabbon, i-Lahmas, ne-Kitlish,
neGederoti, neBhethe-dagoni, neNaama, neMakedha: izidolobhana ezilishumi elinamihlanu nezifunda zawo.
begodu iLibna, ne-Ether, ne-Ashan,
Iphtah, Ashnah, Nezib,
iKeyila, ne-Akzib, ne-Maresha: amadolobhana ayisishiyagalombili namabhishi awo.
Kwathi u-Ekron, namadolobhana awo, nezifunda zayo,
begodu konke okusenyakatho ye-Ekroni, eduze ne-Ashdodi, nezifundazwe zawo.
begodu iAshdodi, namadolobha ayo, nezifundela zayo; neGaza, namadolobha ayo, nezifundela zayo, kuze kube ufula lwaseMisri, nolwandle olukhulu.
Ezweni lezintaba kwakunguShamir, noJattir, noSokho,
neDana, neKiriyati-sana (leyo yiDebiri),
u-Anabhe, no-Eshtemohi, no-Anime,
iGosheni, neHolon, neGilohi: amadolobhana alishumi elinanye namabhishi awo.
bese iArabhu, neDumah, neEshan,
neJanim, neBeth-tappuah, neAfeka,
iHumetha, neKiriyati-arba (leyo yiHebroni), noSihore: imiphakathi eyisishiyagalombili nezifundela zazo.
begodu uMaoni, noKarmeli, noZipho, noJutha,
neJezreyeli, neYokdeyam, neZanoa,
iKayini, neGibeha, neTimna: izidolobhana ezilishumi nezifunda zawo.
begodu uHalule, noBeth-zur, noGedori,
Kwaba khona amadolobhana ayisishiyagalombili nezifundazwe zazo.
begodu iKiriyati-bhaali, (leyo yiKiriyati-yearimi), neRabha: izifundazwe ezimbili nezifundela zazo.
Esiqhingini kwakunguBeth-Arabha, noMiddin, noSekakah,
I-Nibshan, nedolobhana le-Salt, ne-En Gedi: amadolobhana ayisishiyagalombili namabhishi abo.
Kodwana abakwa-Yebhusi, abahlali eYerusalem, abangawasusanga amadodana kaYuda; ngalokho amaJebushi ayehlala phakathi kwamadodana kaYuda eYerusalem kuze kulesi sikhathi.

Umhlaba wabo umndeni kaYosefu wawusuka emfuleni iJordani, ngaseJericho, enyakatho-ntshonalanga yamanzi aphumayo aseJericho; wanyuka waya eJirekhi, waya esiqhingini nezindawo eziphakeme, waya eBhetheli.
Kusuka eBhetheleli, (leyo yiLuzi), kwadlula ezweni lama-Arhithi kuya ku-Atara.
wadlula ezweni lamaJaflethi, enyakatho-mpumalanga, waya eBeth-horoni eseningizimu, waya eGezeri, waphela emfuleni.
UManase noEphrayim, izingane zikaYosefu, bathathe izwe labo.
Le yindawo yama-Ephrayi, ngokwemindeni sabo; umkhawulo wabo enyakatho wawusuka ku-Ataroth Addar waya eBethoroni ophezulu,
Kusuka eMikmetathi, ngasenyakatho, waya emazweni asempumalanga, waya eTaanathi-shilo, wadlula kiwo, wafika eJanoa, ngepumalanga.
Wakhuphuka eYanoa waya e-Ataroti neNaara, wafika eJericho, waphuma eJordani.
NgaseTaphua, umkhawulo usuka enyakatho waya emfuleni iKanaha, waphela elwandle. Lowo ngumhlaba wesizwe sikaEphrayim, ngokwemindeni yawo.
Wazihlanganisa namadolobha onke, namadolobhana, ahlukaniswe uEphrayim, ezweni likaManase.
Abakanani abahlala eGezeri, abazange bazikhuphe; behlala iKanana phakathi kwamadodana ka-Ephrayi kuze kulesi sikhathi; baphinde babe yimisebenzi yomsebenzi.
Lolu mhlaba wabekwa isizwe sikaManase, umzali kaYosefu. UMakhire ubaba kaGileyadi, umzali kaManase; ngombana imindeni kaMakhire ibiyimikhosi enamandla khulu, yathola iGileyadi noBashan.

Le lizwe latholakale kwalabo abashiwo uManase, ngokwemindeni sabo: kwaba ngu-Abiezer, no-Heleki, no-Asriyeli, no-Shekem, no-Heferi, no-Shemida; labo bamadodakazi kaManase, unyana kaYosefu, ngokwemindeni sabo.

Kodwana uZelofehadi, indodana kaHeferi, indodana kaGileyadi, indodana kaMakhiri, indodana kaManase, akhenge abe namadodakazi, kodwana kwaba nezingane; begodu igama lamadodakazi akhe leli: uMahla, noNowa, noHogla, noMilka, noTirsa.

Bafike ku-Elazare umbingeleli, noYoshuwa unyana kaNune, nabakhulu, besithi, UYehova wathi kuMoses ukuba anikeze izwe phakathi kwabazalwane bethu. Wabanika ke uYoshuwa ilizwe phakathi kwabazalwane babo, njengombana ikosi abewiselayo.
Wafumana uManase amafelokazi alishumi, ngaphandle kweGiliyadi neBhashani enyakatho yeYorodani.
ngombana izingane zamadodakazi kaManase zathola indawo phakathi nabantwana babo; begodu izwe likaGiliyadi laliyindawo yamaSirayeli asendaweni yaseManase.
Isifundazwe sikaManase sasuka eAshere, safika eMikmetathi enyakatho-mpumalanga yeShekhemi, sadlula emazweni asentshonalanga kilabo abahlala eEntappuah.
Izwe elibhekene neTaphua lalinguManase; kodwana idolobhana laseTaphua, elingene emkhawulweni kaManase, linguEfraim.

Kwathi lapho umkhawulo ukhuphuka khona, wafika emfuleni iKana. Enyakatho yomfula bekukhona amadolobhana kaEfrayim, kodwana lakhiwa phakathi kwamadolobhana kaManase. Umkhawulo kaManase wawusuka engxenyeni yasentshonalanga yoMnyangweni, waya elwandle.

UEphrayim wafumana isifunda esisenyakatho, uManase wafumana isifunda esisentshonalanga; begodu umlambo wawuyimikhawulo yasenyakatho kaManase. Wafinyelela eAshere ngepumalanga, no-Issakare ngepumalanga.
Nasezindaweni zakwa-Issakha nezakwa-Ashere, uManase wafumana iBeth-shan, no-Ibleam, nalabo baseDori, nalabo baseEndori, nalabo baseTaanakhi, nalabo baseMegido, ngaye ngaye namabhishi akhe.
Amakhosi aseManase awakwazanga ukuhlasela amadolobhana lawo, ngombana amaKananani ayefuna ukuhlala ezweni labo.
Kwathi lapho amaSirayeli ekhula enamandla, wabeka abantu baseKanana ukuba basebenzele; kodwana akhenge awakhuphule.
Bathi amadodana kaYosefu kuYoshuwa, Kungani na usinike imbewu eyodwa kuphela yezwe, thina abantu abakhulu, ngombana ikosi uswelele khulu?
Wathi uYoshuwa kubo, Uma niningi khulu, begodu indawo entaba-mlilo kaEphrayimi incane kuwe; zulazelani ezweni lemithi, nizoqeda izihlahla zenu ezweni labasePerizi nabaseRefayi.

Bathi kubo, Le ndawo entaba-mlilo incane khulu bona siyifinyelele; begodu bonke abaKanani abahlala ezindaweni eziphansi banesithuthuthu sensimbi, nalabo baseBeth-shan nasezifundeni zaso, nalabo baseGoli laseJizreyeli.
Wathi uYoshuwa kubonyana bakaYosefu, kwa-Ephrayim nakwaManase, esithi, Nibantu abaningi, ninamandla khulu; ngeke nibe nengxenye eyodwa.
Begodu idolobhana eliphakeme elinabantu abafileyo lizoba lakho; ulihlanze, libe lakho lonke. Uzokhipha abantu baseKanana, nakuba banezithuthi zensimbi, begodu banamandla.
Ibandla lonke lakwaSirayeli lahlangana eShilo, bamisa khona itente lengqungquthela; begodu leli lizwe liyindawo sabo.
Kodwana izizwe ezisixhenxe zakwaSirayeli azikaze zithole inkontileka sabo yelizwe.
Wathi uYoshuwa kwabaSirayeli, Ngabe nizohlala isikhathi esingakanani, ngaphambi kokuba nihambe nithathe izwe, elinikeziwe nguYehova, uzimu wababa kwenu?
Khetha abantu abathathu eqenjini ngalinye. Ngizobathumela ukuba bahambe ngezwe begodu babhale incazelo yayo, bebonisa bona ingahlukaniswa kanjani. Bazobuya kimi.
Bazohlukanisa izwe libe yizingxenye ezisixhenxe; uYuda uzohlala ezweni lakhe elasenyakatho, nabangane bakaYosefu bazohlala ezweni labo elasenyakatho.
Babhaleni izingxenye ezisixhenxe, nizithumelele lapha kimi; ngizobeka khona isinqumo senu lapha phambi koNkulunkulu wethu ikosi.

Kodwana amaLevi angeke abe nengxenye phakathi kwenu, ngombana ukukhonza njengombingeleli kukaNkulunkulu kuyingxenye sabo; begodu uGadi, noRubhene, nengxenye yesizwe sikaManase, bathole imbewu sabo ngaphesheya kweJordán, enyakatho-ntshonalanga, oMoses, umkhonzi kaYehova, wabanika.
Wathi uYoshuwa kubo bonke abantu abasuka, wathi kubo: "Nihambe nizulazule izwe, nilibhale ngezansi; bese nibuya nami, ngizobeka izikhundla zenu lapha eShilo phambi koYehova."
Baye ke labo madoda bahamba izwe lonke, babhale la lizwe encwadini, ngedolobha ngalinye lihlukaniswe ngezingxenye ezisixhenxe; babuyela kuYoshuwa esibhedlela eShilo.
UYoshuwa wabeka isinqumo kubo phambi koYehova eShilo; uYoshuwa wahlukanisa khona izwe phakathi kwamadodana aseSirayeli, ngokwesizwe ngayinye.
Kwaphuma isizwe sakwaBhenjamin, ngokwemindeni yawo, isipho sokuqala; kwathi phakathi kwelizwe lakwaYuda nelizwe lakwaYosefu, kwakuyindawo sabo.
Ngasenyakatho, umkhawulo wabo wawuqala eJordani, wehla ngasenyakatho-ntshonalanga yeJericho, wadlula emadolobheni asentshonalanga, waphuma entaba-mlilo yaseBethe-Aweni.
Wadlula khona enyakatho-ntshonalanga yeLuz, leyo yiBetheleli; wahla waya eAtaroth-adare, emfuleni osentshonalanga yeBethoron esephansi.

Kusuka enhliziyweni ebhekene neBeth-horon, ngepumalanga, umkhawulo ujikeleza ngepumalanga kuze kube yilapho udlula khona eKiriyati-bhaali (lezo ziyiKiriyathi-yearimi), emzini wamaYuda. Lokho kwakuyingxenye yasempumalanga.
Icala lasenyakatho laqala esigabeni seKiriyati-yearimi ngasenyakatho, lifike emfuleni wamanzi kaNeftoha.
Kwathi lapho umkhawulo uphuma khona, wadlula engxenyeni esenyakatho yeGoli likaRephayimi, wafika esiqhingini saseHinom, ngepumalanga yedolobhana laseJebhusi, waya eEn-rogeli.
Wabuyela ngasenyakatho, waya e-En-shemesi, wadlula eGili-lothi, elibhekene ne-pass of Adummim, wakhuphuka etsheni likaBohani unyana kaRubhen.
Yaye yadlula engxenyeni yasenyakatho yendawo ebheke umlambo iJordani, yawela emfuleni.
Yathi yadlula enyakatho ye-Beth Hoglah, yaphela enyakatho yolwandle olufileyo, lapho iJordani iphuma khona. Lokho kwaba umkhawulo wasempumalanga.
IJordani yaba yimikhawulo engxenyeni esenyakatho. Lokho kwakuyimikhawulo yomhlaba obekwe izizwe zikaBhenjamin ngazo zonke izingcezu.
Isizwe sikaBhenjamin, ngokwenkundla yawo, bekukhona izidolobhana ezilandelayo: iJericho, neBethogla, neEmek-keziz,
neBhethe-araba, neZemarayimu, neBetheli,
uAvwimu, noPhara, noOfraha,
iKefari-amoni, neHofeni, neGiba: izidolobhana ezilishumi elinambini nezifunda zawo.
begodu iGibeboni, neRama, neBherothi,
iMizpa, neKefira, neMoza,
i-Rekem, i-Irpeel, i-Taralah,
Nase-Ela, naseHalephu, nedolobhana laseJebhusi (eliwuJerusalema), kanye noGibeha naKiriyati; izifundazwe ezilishumi elinamihlanu nezifundeni zazo. Lokho kwakuyindawo yabafazi bakaBhenjamin.
Iphutha lesibili laphuma lesizwe sakwaSimeoni, ngemindeni yawo; ilizwe labo liphakathi kwezwe likaYuda.
Izwe labo lahlanganisa iBeer-shebha, ebizwa nangokuthi iShebha, neMolada,
uHazari-shuhali, noBalahi, noEzem,
uEltoladi, noBethuli, noHorma,
iSikelage, neBeth-markabhothi, neHazari-Susha,
iBhethe-libaothi, neSharuheni: izidolobhana ezilishumi elinamithathu nezifunda zawo.
begodu i-Ayin, ne-Rimon, ne-Ether, ne-Ashan; bekukhona izifundazwe ezine nezifundela zawo.
kanye nezifunda zonke ezibhekene nalawo madolobhana, kuze kube yiBahalathi-beeri (lezo ziyiRama enyakatho). Lowo ngumhlaba wesizwe samaSimeoni ngokwemindeni yawo.
USimeoni wafumana indawo yakhe ezweni likaYuda, ngombana izwe likaYuda liningi khulu kunalo; ngalokho uSimeoni wafumana indawo yakhe phakathi kwezwe likaYuda.
Iphutha lesithathu laphuma kuZebuloni, ngokwemindeni yawo; umkhawulo wabo wafika eSaridi.
Wahamba enyakatho waya eMarala, wafinyelela eDabheshethi, wafika enkabeni yeJokneam.
Kusuka eSaridi yashintsha ibheke eningizimu, ifike ezweni likaKisloth-taboro, yadlula eDaberathi, yafika eJaphia.
Kusuka khona lapho yadlula enyakatho ifike eGathe-hepher, neEth-kazin, yaphuma eRimoni, yabuyela eNea.
Enyakatho, umgwaqo udlula eHannathon begodu waphela eValley of Iphtah El.
Kwabe kukhona iKathathi, neNahalali, neShimroni, neIdala, noBethelehemu; kwaba khona izidolobhana ezilishumi elinambini nezifunda zawo.
Lawa madolobhana namabhishi azo, yindawo kaZabuloni ngokwemindeni yawo.
Iphutha lesine laphuma ku-Issakare, ngohlobo lwawo.
Izwe labo lahlanganisa iJezreyeli, noKesulothi, noShunem,
uHapharayim, noSiyone, noAnaharathe,
iRabhithi, neKishiyoni, ne-Ebezi,
neRemethi, ne-Enganimi, ne-Enhada, neBeth-pazezi.
begodu umkhawulo ufike eTabhori, neShahazuma, neBethe-shemesi, waphela eYodhani; izidolobhana ezilishumi elinamihlanu nezifunda zawo.
Lezi ziyizindawo zezwe lakwa-Issakhar, ngohlobo lwazo, ngamadolobheni azo.
Iphutha lesihlanu laphuma lesizwe sakwa-Asheri, ngohlobo lwayo.
Izwe labo lahlanganisa iHelekathi, neHali, noBetheni, neAkshaphu,
I-Allammelek, i-Amad ne-Mishal. Enyakatho umgwaqo uthinta iCarmel noShihor Libnath.
Yasuka yajika ibheke emazweni asempumalanga, ifike eBeth-dagoni, yafinyelela eZebuloni, neGoli lika-Ifta-eli, yadlula eBet-emeki naseNeyeli, yafika eKabuli ngasekhohlo.
Yafika e-Abdon, ne-Rehoboth, ne-Hamon, ne-Kana, kuze kube yiSidon enkulu.
Kwathi lapho umkhawulo ujika waya eRama, wadlula eTire, idolobhana elinomgwaqo omkhulu; kwathi lapho ujika waya eHosa, waphela emfuleni, ezweni lase-Akzib.
Ihlanganisa begodu i-Ummah, ne-Afhek ne-Rehoboth. Kwabe kukhona amadolobhana ayishumi nambili nezifunda zawo.
Lezi zidolobhana nezifundazwe zazo, yizizwe zakwa-Asheri ngokwemindeni yawo.
Isinqumo sesishiyagalombili saphuma kuNaphtali, ngohlobo lwawo.
Umkhawulo wabo wawusuka eHelephu, no-Eden eZaanannim, waya eAdami-nekeb, neYabneel, wafika eLakumi, waphela eJordani.
Kwathi lapho umkhawulo udlula ngasenyakatho, waya eAznothi-tabhori, wafika eHukok; wafinyelela kuZebuloni emazweni asempumalanga, noAshere emazweni asentshonalanga, noYuda emazweni asentshonalanga.
Amadolobhana anezindlu zangasese aye yiSidimu, neZeri, neHamathi, neRakathi, neKinereti,
ne-Adama, ne-Rama, ne-Hazori,
noKedesh, noEdrei, noEnhazori,
I-Iron, neMigdal-eli, noHorem, naBeth-anathi, naBeth-shemeshi; izidolobhana ezilishumi elinamihlanu nezifunda zawo.
Lezi zidolobhana nezifundela zazo, izwe lesizwe sakwaNaphtali ngokwemindeni yawo.
Iphutha lesixhenxe laphuma isizwe sakwaDan, ngohlobo lwayo.
Izwe labo lahlanganisa iZora, ne-Eshtaoli, ne-Ir Shemesh,
iShaalabini, ne-Ayaloni, ne-Ithala,
ne-Elon, ne-Timna, ne-Ekron,
ne-Eltekeke, neGibhethoni, neBahalathi,
u-Yehude, noBhene-beraki, neGathi-rimoni,
NgiJarkon noRakkon, nendawo ebhekene neJoppa.

Kodwana abazalwane baka-Dan, bekhathazekile ngenxa yokuthatha izwe labo, bakhuphuka, bahlasela i-Leshemi, bayithatha, bayibulala ngeqhwa, bahlala khona. Baguqula igama le-Leshemi libe ngu-Dan, ngokusho kwegama lika-Dan ubaba wabo.
Lezi ziyizindawo zezwe lakwaDani, ngohlobo lwabo nohlobo lwabo; lezi zindawo nezifundela zazo.
Uma beqedile ukuhlukanisa izwe ngamafelokazi ayo, abaSirayeli banikeza uYoshuwa, unyana kaNune, amafelokazi phakathi kwabo.
Bamunika isixeko ebesicela, iTimnathi-seraha, ezindaweni eziphakeme zakwaEfrayim, njengombana ikosi abewisela umthetho ngawo. Wawukwakha lo mzi, wahlala kiwo.

Lawa amafelokazi omhlaba, alowo uElezare umbingeleli, noYoshuwa unyana ka-Nun, nabaholi bezizwe zakwaSirayeli, abawudlulisa ngezinhlamvu eShilo phambi koYehova, emgwaqeni wesitezi sokubambisana; begodu baqedile ukuhlukaniswa kwelizwe.
Wathi ikosi kuYoshuwa,
Uthi kuSirayeli: Bakhetheni imiphakathi yokuthula, engikhuluma ngayo kuwe ngesandla sikaMoses.
Noma ngubani obulala umuntu ngengozi, ngaphandle kokufunayo, kufanele ahambe esinye salezi zifunda, khona-ke uzobe esephephile lapho kusuka kumngane wakhe ofuna ukuthatha inkohliso.

Uzohamba esinye sezizwe, ahlale emgwaqeni wedolobha, aveze bona kwenzekani abaphathi bedolobha labo. Baze bathabathele kubo emazweni abo, babanike indawo yokuhlala phakathi kwabo; begodu uma befika emigwaqweni yedolobha nezindawo eziphakeme khulu zedolobha labo, bazothi: "Kungaba khona umuntu ophilayo ezweni lethu."
Uma umngane ofuna ukuxoshwa ewalandela, abaphathi kumele bangamnikela umuntu, ngombana babulala umngane wabo ngengozi begodu bebengabakhohlisa ngaphambilini.
Uzohlala kulo mzi kuze ahlale enkantolo phambi kwebandla, kuze kube sekufa umbingeleli omkhulu ozoba khona ngaleso sikhathi; bese uzobuya ezweni lakhe, emzini wakhe, lapho waphuma khona.
Bamisa khona iKedesh eGalili, endaweni entaba-mlilo yaseNaphtali, noShekheme endaweni entaba-mlilo yaseEfraim, neKiriyati-arba (leyo yiHebroni), endaweni entaba-mlilo yaseYuda.

Enyakatho-mpumalanga yeJordani, ngaphesheya kwezilwandle kweJericho, bakhetha iBeseri ezindaweni eziseduze zesihlabathi, ezweni lakwaRubheni, neRamoti eGiliyadi, ezweni lakwaGadi, noGolani eBhashani, ezweni lakwaManase.

Lezi ziyizindawo ezikhethiwe kubo bonke amadodana aseSirayeli, nalabo abavela kwamanye amazwe abahlala phakathi kwabo; ukuze wonke umuntu obulala umuntu ngengozi abe khona lapho, begodu angabulawa yindoda yakhe efuna ukubulala, ngaphambi kokuba enze isinqumo phambi komphakathi.
Bafika khona abaphathi bezindlu zakwaLevi ku-Elazare umpristi, noYoshuwa unyana kaNune, nabaphathi bezindlu zakwamadodana aseSirayeli.
Bathi kubo eShilo, ezweni laseKanana, bathi, uzimu utshele ngesandla sikaMoses, bona sinikezwe izidolobhakazi ukuze sihlale kuzo, nezifundela zazo ezibhekene nazo, ukuze sizigcinele izinkomo zethu.
Bathi ke oonyana bakaSirayeli, banikela kilabo abaLevi ezweni labo lezi zifundazwe nezindawo zazo zomhlaba, njengombana ikosi abewisela umthetho.
Kwaphuma isinqumo sokuqala emindenini yamaKahati; kwafika amaLevithi, oonyana baka-Aron umbingeleli, emazweni aseYuda, naseSimeoni, naseBhenjamini, izizwe ezilishumi elinamithathu.
Amanye amalungu omndeni ka-Ephrayi, kanye noDani naphezu kwengxenye yesizwe sikaManase wafumana izidolobhana ezingushumi.
Amadodana kaGershoni athole ezindaweni zomndeni wakwa-Issakare, nomndeni wakwa-Asere, nemindeni yakwaNaphtali, naphezu kwengxenye yesizwe sikaManase eBhashani, idolobhakazi elilodwa nesithathu.
Namadodana kaMerari, ngokwemindeni sabo, ayethola emazweni aseRubheni, naseGadi, naseZebulun, amadolobha ayishumi nambili.
Bathi ke abazalwane bakaSirayeli banikeza amaLevi la madolobhana kanye nezindawo zawo zokudlela, ngokuhluza, njengombana ikosi abewisela umthetho ngomlomo kaMoses.
Ezindaweni zakwaYuda nakwaSimeoni banikela ngamadolobhana alandelayo, a zavrwa ngezansi.
Baye badlula kubo oonyana baka-Aron, abasezinhlanganiso zakwaKehati phakathi kwabaLevi; ngombana isinqumo sokuqala saphuma kubo.
Babanika iKiriyati-arba, uArba owayengubaba ka-Anaki, ezweni lasendulo lakwaYuda, kanye nezindawo zayo zasendaweni ezungeze yona. (I-Kiritathi-arba iyi-Hebron.)
Kodwana izwe lemizana, nezindawo zokuhlala ezijikeleze lo dolobhana, ziye zanikezwa uKalebe, unyana kaJefune.
Wabanikeza oonyana baka-Aron, umbingeleli, iHebrone, umzi wokuthula kulowo obulala umuntu, kanye neLibna.
iYattir, ne-Eshtemoa,
i-Holon, neDebiri,
kanye ne vindebe lazo, no-Ayin, no-Juta, no-Bethe-shemesi; ngalezi zinhlanga ezimbili amadolobhana ayisithoba.
Ezweni likaBhenjamin banikela kubo eGibehoni, neGeba,
kanye noAnathothi namabhishi alo, neAlmoni namabhishi alo: izifundazwe ezine.
Ngazo zonke lezi zifunda, izizwe zika-Aron zababhishobhi zathola idolobhana elilodwa nesishiyagalombili kanye nezindawo zawo.
Amanye amaqembu emindeni yamaKahati, amakhosikazi kaLevi, wafumana izidolobhana ezisuka kwisizukulwana sikaEphrayimi.
Bathola iShekhemi, ezweni eliphakeme likaEphrayimi, umzi wokuphepha kulowo obulala umuntu, neGezeri;
kanye neKibsayim, neBethoron; ngayinye yazo izifunda zayo. Ziyidolobhana elinhlanu.
Ezweni lakwaDan, bathola i-Eltekeh, neGibbethoni,
ne-Aijaloni, ne-Gathi-rimoni; ngayinye yazo nezindawo zayo zokudlela: izidolobhana ezine.
Engxenyeni yesizwe sikaManase, iTaanakhi nezindawo zayo zokudlela, neGati-rimoni; izidolobhana ezimbili.
Wonke amanye amaqembu omndeni wakwa-Kehati wafumana idolobhana elilodwa kanye nezindawo zawo.
Nasezinhlanga zakwaGershoni, eziLevini, kwabe sekuyindawo yokuzivikela yomuntu obulalayo eGolani eBhashani, kanye neBe-eshtara; ngazo zonke lezi zidolobhana ezimbili.
Esifundazweni sika-Issakha, babe neKishiyon, noDaberathi,
iJarmuthi, ne-En Gannim, ngayinye sazo nesizinda saso; kwakungumadolobhana amane.
Ezweni lika-Ashere bathola uMishali, noAbdon,
neHelekathi, neRehobhi; ngayinye yazo izifunda zayo. Ziyidolobhana elilodwa.
Ezweni lakwaNaphtali kwaba nguKedesh eGalilile, idolobhana lokuzivikela lomuntu obulalayo, neHamothi-dor, neKarthani, ngazo zonke izifundazwe zayo; zimadolobha amathathu.
Ngazo zonke izizwe zakwaGershoni bekukhona idolobhana elilodwa nesishiyagalombili nezindawo zayo zokudlela.
Imindeni yama-Merari, okunye kwabaLevi, yathola ezweni likaZebuloni iYokneam, neKartha,
kanye neDimna, neNahalal; ngayinye yazo inendawo yayo. Ziyidolobhana elilodwa.
Ezweni lakwaRubheni bathola uBezere, noYahazi,
neKedemothi, neMefaathi; ngalinye lazo namagatsha alo: izidolobhana ezine.
Esifundazweni sikaGadi bathola iRamothi eGileyadi, idolobha eliphephile kulowo obulala umuntu, neMahanayim;
begodu iHeshboni neYazeri, ngazo zonke lezi zidolobhana ezine.
Ngazo zonke izizwe zakwaMerari, eziphakathi kwezizwe zakwaLevi, kwabe sekuyizindawo eziyisithupha.
Ngazo zonke izifundazwe zakwaLevi, ezweni lamadodana kaSirayeli, kwakuyizindawo ezingu-48 kanye nezifundela zayo.
Kuzo zonke lezi zifunda, ngayinye yazo inezindawo zomhlaba ezibhekene nazo. Le nto yayiqiniso kuzo zonke.
Wathi ikosi wabanika amaSirayeli izwe lonke, ebewaphikisa ngaso bona uzolibazisa ababuphikisi babo; balimaza la mhlaba, bahlala kiwo.

Wabanikeza ikosi isikhala ngaso soke isikhathi, ngokwezinto zonke awazinikela ngazo kubaba babo; kwakungekho muntu okwazi ukubhekana nabo phakathi kwabo bonke ababi; wabeka ikosi ababi babo bonke esandla sabo.
Akukho lutho lwamazwi amahle, awashoyo ikosi kubo bonke abantu bakaSirayeli; konke kwakwenzeka.
Wathi uYoshuwa, "Njengombana isizwe sikaRubhen, nesizwe sikaGadi, kanye nengxenye yesizwe sikaManase,
Wathi kubo, Nikwenze konke uMosis, umkhonzi kaYehova, awawisela umthetho ngawo, nimikele amazwi ami ngazo zonke izinto engikhuluma ngazo.
Ngalezo zinsuku eziningi, kuze kube ngalolusuku, ningawashiya abazalwane benu amaSirayeli; nigcineni umsebenzi kazimu, uzimu wenu, owawuthi ukwenze.

Ngiyabona bona ikosi, uzimu wenu, usandulela induduzo abazalwane benu, njengombana wathi; ngalokho-ke manje nibuyeni ezweni lenu elisemthethweni, elininikezwe nguMoses, umkhonzi kaYehova, ngasenyakatho yeJordani.

Kodwana ugcine ngokuqinile ukuba wenze imithetho, kanye nomthetho, okuyinto Moses wathi kuwe, ukuba uthande ikosi uzimu wakho, begodu ukhambe ezindaweni zakhe, begodu ugcine imiyalo yakhe, begodu ahlale engqondweni yakho yonke, begodu ukukhonza kwakhe ngenhliziyo yakho yonke, nengqondo yakho yonke.
UYoshuwa wabasabisa, wabasusa; basuka beya endaweni sabo.
UMoses wanikela isizwe esisodwa sakwaManase eBhashani, begodu uYoshuwa wabanika isiqhingi esifanayo nabangani babo ngepumalanga yeJordane. Nokho lapho uJoshua ebewathumela khona emakhaya abo, wathi:
Wathi, Yiya ekhaya lakho ngempahla yakho enkulu, nezilwane eziningi, nesiliva, negolide, nobhedu, nensimbi, nezigqoko eziningi; uhlukanise nabangani bakho ithonya lezinto ozenzayo ezinkingeni zenu.

Baye ke amaRubheni, namaGadi, nengxenye yesizwe sikaManase, besuka eShilo, ezweni likaKanana, babuyela eGileyadi, ezweni labo elihlala kulo, lapho babehlala khona, ngaphandle kwamadodana kaSirayeli, njengombana ikosi abewisela umthetho ngoMosese.
Bafika eGili-lothi, enhliziyweni yeJordani, ezweni laseKanana; bahlanganisa khona isibingelelo esisha, esikhulu khulu.
Bathe amaSirayeli ezwa abantu bathi, Bheka, uRubhen noGadi, nengxenye yesifundazwe sikaManase, bakwakha isibingelelo emgwaqweni waseKanana, enhliziyweni yoMfula iYorodani, ngaphesheya kwaSirayeli.
Kwathi lapho abantu baseSirayeli bekubona lokhu, ibandla lonke lahlanganisana eShilo, ukuba lizobe lihlasela.
Bathumela uPhinehasi, unyana ka-Elazare umpristi, ezweni laseGiliyadi, kwabaseRubheni, nabaseGadi, nengxenye yomndeni wakwaManase.
Bathumela naye abaholi abalishumi, umuntu oyedwa ezweni ngalinye lakwaSirayeli; wonke umuntu waba yinhloko yomndeni wakwaSirayeli.
Baye bafika eGileyadi kubo bonke abantu baseRubheni, noGadi, nengxenye yesizwe sikaManase, bathi kubo,
Ibandla lonke likaYehova lithi, Ingabe niyiphula umthetho kaThixo wakwaSirayeli? Ingabe namanje nisuka ekuphileni ukulandela ikosi, nikha isibingelelo, ukuze nigweme ukumnika?
Akukancane-ke kuthina ukulimala kwePeori? Kuye kulesi sikhathi samanje asikuhlanjwanga ngaso, ngenxa yobhubho elingenayo phakathi kwabantu bakaYehova.
Begodu manje nizobuya nisuka emzini kaYehova; ngombana uma namuhla niyiphula imithetho kaYehova, ngoMsombuluko uzoba nomsindo ngebandla lonke lakwaSirayeli.

Uma izwe lempahla yenu lingcolile, vuka nifike ezweni likaYehova, lapho ihholo likaYehova lihlala khona, niyihlukanise nathi; kodwana mthweleni ikosi, noma nani, ngokwakha isibingelelo esisodwa ngaphandle kwesibingelelo sikaYehova uzimu wethu.
Khumbula uAkani unyana kaZera, ngombana wakwenza okumbi ezintoni eziboshiwe; khona-ke kwafika inkohliso phezu kwebandla lonke lakwaSirayeli. Akhenge aphele yena kuphela ngenxa yakhe.
Waphendula uRubhene, noGadi, nengxenye yesizwe sikaManase, waphendula abaholi bezizwe zakwaSirayeli, wathi,
uzimu onamandla, ikosi! uzimu onamandla, ikosi; yena uyazi, begodu bakwazi naSirayeli. Uma sikwenze lokhu ngenxa yobugebengu, noma ngenxa yokungakholwa kukaNkulunkulu, ungasixoli namuhla.
Uma sakha lesi sibhedlela sokuba siyeke ukulandela ikosi, noma ukunikela phezu kwayo ngezipho ezibomvu, noma ngezipho zokudla, noma ngezipho zokusindisa, ikosi ngokwakhe agweme.
Ngalokho-ke sakwenza lokhu, ngombana sikhathazekile, bona bangathi izingane zenu ngosuku olulandelayo kuzingane zethu, zithi, Nini na phakathi kwenu noYehova uzimu kaSirayeli?

UYehova wenza iJordani ibe yimikhawulo phakathi kwethu nenu, nimadodana kaRubhen namadodana kaGadi; wena awunayo inkontileka nozimu. Ngaleyo le izingane zenu zingazisusa izingane zethu ekukhonzeni uNkosi.
Ngalokho sathi, Sizokwakha isibingelelo, hhayi izipho zokudlwengula, noma izinkondlo;

kodwana ukuze kube yisibonakaliso phakathi kwethu nabanye, kanye nezizukulwane zethu ezizayo, bona sikhonza ikosi phambi kwakhe ngezinsizakalo zethu zokudlwengula, namabhishi ethu, nezipho zethu zokuthula; ukuze izingane zenu zingaze zithi ngosuku olulandelayo kubantwana bethu, Ningenayo inkontileka noYehova.

Sathi ke, Uma bekhuluma nathi noma ngezingane zethu ngalolu hlobo kusasa, sizophendula bona: "Njengombana nibona isifanekiso sesibhedlela sikaYehova, ebesiyenziwe abazali bethu; ayizange ibe yisondlo esiqhumayo, begodu ayizange ibe yisondlo sokudla; kodwana ibilokhu ikhona njengobufakazi phakathi kwethu nenu.

Asikho isinqumo sethu bona sigweme uMoya oNgcwele, noma bona sibuyele emuva ngalesi sikhathi, ngokwakha isibingelelo esisha somnikelo wokushiswa, nomnikelo wokudla, noma isibingelelo, ngaphandle kwesibingelelo sikaYehova uzimu wethu esikhona phambi kwendlu yakhe.
Kwathi lapho uPhinehasi, indodana kambingeleli, namadoda amakhulu ebandla, abaphathi bezizwe zakwaSirayeli, beva amazwi amakhosikazi kaRubhen noGadi noManase, kwaba kuhle kubo.

Wathi kubo uPhinehasi, unyana ka-Elazare umpristi: Namhlanje siyazi bona ikosi unesibopho nathi, ngokuba ningabi nento engalungile ngaye ngalolu daba; manje nisindise oonyana bakaSirayeli emlonyeni kaYehova.
Wabuya uPhinehasi, unyana ka-Elazare umpristi, namadodana akhe, besuka eRubheni naseGadi eGiliyadi, babuyela kubo bonke abantu baseSirayeli ezweni laseKanana, bakhuluma nabo.
Bathokozela oonyana bakaSirayeli, babonga uzimu; begodu abazange baphinde bakhulume ngokuhamba nabo emkhosini, ukuze babhubhise izwe lakwaRubhen nakwaGadi, lapho behlala khona.
Bathi amadodana kaRubhen namadodana kaGadi igama lesibingelelo libizwa bona yiShati, besithi, LiyiShati phakathi kwethu, bona ikosi nguThixo.
Kwathi sekudlule isikhathi eside, ikosi wamisa amaSirayeli emlonyeni wababi babo bonke ababhekene nabo ngazo zonke amalanga. UYoshuwa ke wayekhulu khulu.
Wabiza wonke amaSirayeli, abakhulu babo, nabaphathi babo, namagoli abo, nabaqondisi babo, wathi kubo, Ngiye ngikhulu khulu.
Nabona konke okwenze ikosi uzimu wenu kuzo zonke lezi zizwe, ngenxa yenu; uINkosi, uzimu wenu, yena owabhekana nabo ngenxa yenu.
Bheka, ngikulethela izwe lezizwe eziseleyo, kanye nezizwe engizinqobile, kusukela emfuleni uYorodani kuze kube lwandle olukhulu enyakatho, ukuze lihlukaniswe phakathi kwezizwe zenu.
uzimu wakho, ikosi, yena ozozisusa phambi kwenu, uzozibulala; nizothola izwe labo, njengokuthi uzimu wenu, ikosi, wathi kuwe.
Ngiyakucela, uqiniseke khulu, ugcine ukukwenza konke okubhaliwe encwadini yomthetho kaMoses; ungasekhombi kuyo ngakwesokudla noma ngakwesobunxele.
Ungazihlanganisi nezwe elisele phakathi kwenu, begodu ungakhulumanga ngegama likaThixo wabo, noma wenze isipho ngazo, noma usebenzele, noma uzibophezele kubo.
kodwana niyibambe ngokuqinile izandla zenu kuYehova uzimu wenu, njengokuba nikwenza kuze kube manje.
uzimu wakhipha phambi kwenu izizwe ezinkulu, ezinamandla; akukho muntu okwaziyo ukubhekana nani kuze kube manje.
Omunye wenu unquma ukuhlasela abantu abangu-1; ngombana ikosi, uzimu wakho, yena obhekana nabo ngenxa yenu, njengombana atjhilo.
Ngalokho-ke, qaphela khulu bona uthande ikosi uzimu wakho.
Uma nje nibuya, nizibophezele ezindleleni zalezi zintokazi, ezikiweni zenu, begodu nizibophezele kubo, nizibophezele ngeqiniso;

kwazi bona ikosi uzimu wakho ngeke aphinde azikhuphule lezi zizwe phambi kwenu; kodwana zizoba yizinkundla zenu, nezingcezu zenu, nezicubu ezimilelweni yenu, kuze niphele ezweni elihle lezo ikosi uzimu wenu awakunika lona.

Manje ngizohamba ngendlela yomhlaba wonke. Uyazi ngenhliziyweni yakho yonke, nangemphefumulo wakho wonke, bona akukho lutho lwamazwi angcono onke ikosi uThixouNkulunkulu wakho awasho ngawe; konke kwafika, akukho lutho lwamazwi alungile aphume.

Kodwana, njengokuba zonke izithiyo ezilungileyo ikosi uzimu wenu awakhuluma ngazo zifike kuwe, njalo-ke uzoziletha phezu kwenu zonke izithiyo zakhe ezibi, kuze akukhulule nisuka kule lizwe elihle alinika lona.

Uma niphula umthethosivivinywa kaYehova uzimu wenu, owabawiselayo bona niwugcine, begodu niya kukhonza izitha zakwamanye amazwe, nizibophezele kuzo; khona-ke inhliziyo yoMoya oNgcwele merina phezu kwenu, nizophela ngokushesha ezweni elingcono alikunikezile.
UYoshuwa waqoqa zonke izizwe zakwaSirayeli eShekem, wababiza abakhulu bakwaSirayeli, nabaphathi babo, nabahlengikazi babo, nabangani babo. Bafika behlala phambi koThixo.

Wathi uYoshuwa kubo bonke abantu, Usho lokhu ikosi uzimu kaSirayeli: Ezweni elisentshonalanga yeMfula i-Euphrates bahlala ngaphambilini abazalwane benu, uTerah, ubaba kaAbrahama, noNahore; bakhonza) bekhonza izitha ezahlukene.
Ngathatha ubaba wenu uAbrahama ngaphesheya komfula, ngahamba naye ezweni lonke lakwaKanana, ngakwenza abe yizizukulwane eziningi, ngamnika uIsake.
Kwa-Isakha ngabanika uYakobi noEsau; kwa-Esau ngabanika intaba iSeyiri, ibe yindawo yakhe; kodwana uYakobi nomndeni wakhe bawela eYiputa.
Kwathi ngathumela uMoses noAron, ngahlasela iMisri ngezinto engizenzayo phakathi kwayo; begodu ngemuva kwalokho ngizikhipha.
Kwathi lapho ngikhipha khona abazali benu ezweni laseYiputa, nifika emfuleni; begodu abaMishi balandela emuva kwabo ngemoto, namabhayisikili, kuze kube eMfuleni Omnyama.

Baze bathandaza kuYehova, yena wabeka umnyama phakathi kwenu nabaseYiputa, waveza amanzi phezu kwabo, awashisa. Amehlo wenu akubona konke engikwenzele ama-Egyptians; begodu nihlala esiqhingini isikhathi eside.
Nginiholela ezweni lama-Amori, abehlala ngaphesheya kweYorodani; baphikisana nani, kodwana ngibanikela enhliziyweni yenu, ngiwabulala phambi kwenu, niyithathe izwe labo.
UBalaka unyana kaSipore, ukumkani wakwaMowabi, wehlisa isandla sakhe, wahlasela amaSirayeli; wathumela ebiza uBhileham unyana kaBeore, bona akulambe.
Ngathi angifuni ukulalela uBhileham; yena wabasazela, begodu wabasazela; ngawusindisa wena ebusweni bukaBalaka.
Wadlula uYorodani, wafika eJericho; abantu baseJericho baphikisana nani, nama-Amori, nama-Perizi, nama-Kananani, nama-Hethi, nama-Girgasi, nama-Hivi, nama-Yebhusi; kodwana ngawanikela esandla sakho.
Nami ngathumela izinyosi phambi kwenu, zazikhuphula, nazo zonke iziphathimandla ezimbili zesizwe sama-Amori; awuzange wenze lokhu ngeqhwa lakho, noma ngeqhwa lethu.
Nami ngabanikeza izwe elingeke nisebenze kulo, namadolobha angeke niwakhile, nihlala kiwo; nidla izimbali zesilimo sewayini nezithelo ze-olive engakaze nizithole.
Manje ke, nigweme ikosi, niwusebenzele intliziyo yenu yonke, nangokweqiniso; nisuse izitha abababa benu ababezikhonza ngaphesheya komfula i-Efrayi, naseYiputa, nisebenzele ikosi.

Uma kwenzeka bona kubuhlungu kuwe ukukhonza ikosi, khetheni namhlanje ofuna ukukhonza yena; noma ngabe izitha abazibophezela ngazo abazali benu ezweni elisentshonalanga yeMfula i-Eufrate, noma izithiyo zabaAmoreyi abahlala izwe labo; kodwana mina nomndeni wami sizokhonza uNkosi.
Baphendula abantu, bathi, Akufanele sishiye ikosi, sisebenzele amanye amadini.

uzimu wethu, ikosi, nguye owenza bona sikhuphuke nathi nababa bethu ezweni laseMisiya, ezweni lendlu yobugebengu; wazenza lezi zinto ezinkulu phambi kwethu, wagcina isinqumo sethu yonke indlela esihamba ngayo, phakathi kwazo zonke izizwe ezisidlula kuzo.
Ngokuba ikosi wakhipha phambi kwethu zonke izizwe, nama-Amori ahlala kulolu lizwe; begodu nathi sizokhonza ikosi, ngombana yena uzimu wethu.
Wathi uYoshuwa kubo bonke abantu, Ningeke nikwazi ukukhonza ikosi; yena uzimu ongcwele, uzimu onokwesaba; ngeke agweme ukwenqaba kwenu nobubi benu.
Uma nishiya ikosi, nikhonza amadini angaphandle, yena uzobuyela ekuphileni kwenu, begodu azokuphoqa ukuba nihlupheke, aze akulahle, ngemva kokuba ekwenzeni kahle kuwe.
Bathi ke abantu kuYoshuwa, Akunjalo; sizokhonza ikosi.
Wathi uYoshuwa, Niyibo abavikeli phezu kwenu, bona niwazikhethela ukuba nisebenzele ikosi. Baphendule bathi, Siyabe ngabavikeli;
UYoshuwa wathi kubo: "Ngalokho-ke, nisuse izitha zakwamanye amazwe eziphakathi kwenu, nibeke intliziyo yenu kuYehova uzimu kaSirayeli.
Bathi abantu kuYoshuwa, "Sizokhonza ikosi uzimu wethu, begodu sizowulalela.
Wakwenza uYoshuwa isivumelwano nabantu ngalolusuku, wabeka kubo izimiso nemithetho eShekem.
WabhalaDZI uYoshuwa lezo zinto encwadini yomthetho kaThixo, wathatha itshe elikhulu, wayimisa ngaphasi komnqumo omkhulu osendaweni engcwele kaYehova.

Wathi uMoses kubo bonke abantu, Thola, itshe leli lizobe ngubufakazi bethu; ngombana lalalela zonke izinto akhuluma ngazo nathi ikosi; begodu lizobe ngubufakazi benu, uma niyiphula umthetho kazimu wenu.
UYoshuwa wakhipha abantu, wonke umuntu ezweni lakhe.
Ngaleso sikhathi uYoshuwa, unyana kaNune, umkhonzi woNkulunkulu, wafa, eneminyaka engumakhulu ayisishiyagalombili.
Bamu葬le ezindaweni zakhe, eTimnathi-seraha, enhliziyweni yamazulu kaEfrayim, ngepumalanga yentaba iGaash.
AbaSirayeli bakhonza ikosi zonke amalanga wokuphila kukaYoshuwa, nazo zonke amalanga wokuphila kwabakhulu abaphila ngemuva kwakhe, ababebona konke okwenze ikosi kuboSirayeli.

Namahlombe kaYosefu, abebewathuthela kiwo amadodana aseSirayeli eYiputa, awabulale emfuleni iShekheme, kuleyo ndawo yomhlaba eyayithengiswe nguYakobi kubonyana bakaHamori udadewabo waseShekheme ngezimali ezingu-100 zegolide.
Wafa u-Eleazare, unyana ka-Aron; wabanjwa eGibeha, emfuleni owawunikezwe uPhinehasi unyana wakhe, ezindaweni eziphakeme zakwa-Ephrayi.
Judg: Ngemuva kokufa kukaYoshuwa, babuza amadodana aseSirayeli ikosi, bathi, Yikuphi isizwe esizohamba kuqala ukubhekana nathi namaKanani?
Wathi ikosi, UYuda kumele afike; bona, ngimise izwe esandla sabo.

Bathi amadodana kaYuda kumadodana kaSimeoni, abazalwane babo, besithi, Yiya nathi ezweni elithunyelwe thina, ukuze sihlangane nabantu baseKanana, begodu sihambe nawe ezweni lakho. Wahamba ke uSimeoni nabo.
Baphuma ke amaYuda, wabeka ikosi izandla zabo abaKanani nabasePerizi; babulala abantu abangumakhulu ayisishiyagalombili eBezeki.
Bathola khona u-Adoni-bezekhe, babhekana naye, bahlasela amaKanani namaPerizithi.
U-Adoni-bezeke wabaleka, kodwana balandela emuva kwakhe, bagwema izinyawo zakhe ezincane nezikhulu.

Wathi u-Adoni-bezekhe, "Inkundla yami igcwele amakhosana amashumi asixhenxe obukhosi, abanezinkinobho zezandla zabo kanye nezinkinobho zezinyawo zabo ezicutshiwe; baqoqa izibiyeli ngezansi kwetafula lami. uzimu ungikhokhela ngokufana nalokho engikwenzayo kubo." Bamuthwa eYerusalem, wafa khona.
Bahlasela iJerusalema, bayithatha, babulala abantu bayo ngeqhwa, bamisa umzi ngomlilo.
Ngemuva kwalokho, abantu baseYuda bakhuphuka babhekana nabaKanana abahlala ezindaweni eziphakeme, nasenyakatho-ntshonalanga, nasezintabeni eziphansi.
Bahlasela amaKanani ahlala eHebroni, (igama layo kwakunguKiriyati-arba), babulala uSheshai, noAhimani, noTalmai.
Basuka khona bahlasela abantu base-Debiri (igama layo kwakunguKiriyathi-seferi).
Wathi uKalebe, Uma umuntu ehlasela iKiriyati-seferi, bese uyithatha, ngizomunika intombi yami iAksha ukuba ngumkakhe.
Wayinqoba uOthniyeli, indodana kaKenazi, umngane omncane kaKalebe; ke kaloku uKalebe wamnika inkosikazi yakhe i-Aksha ukuba abe nguwesifazane.
Yafika ku-Othniyeli, yamangalisa ubaba wayo bona afune indawo yokulima; waphuma enyangeni yakhe, wathi kuye uKalebe, Ufuna yini?
Wathi yena kuye, Ungisize; ngombana ungisizile izwe elinabantu abaningi, nginikeze begodu izimpophoma zamanzi " . Ke kalobe wamnika izimpophoma eziphezulu nezimpophoma ezisephansi.

Baye bahamba namadodakazi kaMoses, amaKenithi, asuka edolobhaneni lezintaba-mlilo, kanye namadodakazi kaYuda, befika esiqhingini sikaYuda, ezweni laseNtshonalanga elibhekene ne-Arad; baye bahlala ndawonye nabo.
Kwathi kwadlula uYuda nabangane bakhe abasuka eSimeoni, bahlasela amaKanana ahlala eSephathi, babulala wonke lo mzi; ngalokho kwabizwa igama lakhe bona iHorma.
UYuda wahlasela begodu iGaza, ne-Ashkelon, ne-Ekroni, ngayinye nezwe layo elijikeleze.
Wabe ikosi noYuda; bathatha indawo entaba-mlilo, kodwana abakwazi ukuhlasela abantu abahlala ezindaweni eziphansi, ngombana babe nezithuthi zokulwa zensimbi.
Wabanika uKhalebe iHebroni, njengokuthi uMoses; wakhipha khona oonyana baka-Anaki abathathu.
Amadodana kaBhenjamini akhenge akhuphule amaJebhusi ahlala eYerusalem; ngalokho amaJebusi ayehlala phakathi kwamadodana kaBhenjamini eJerusalema kuze kufike lomhla.
Amakhosi kaYosefu afike eBhetelehem, ikosi waba nabo.
Bathumela abantu ukuba babhekane noBethelehi, okuthiwa ngaphambilini nguLuzi.
Babona abaphenyi umuntu ophuma edolobhaneni, bathi kuye, Sibonise indlela yokungena edolobhaneni, begodu sizokwenza wena ukuba uthande.
Wabakhombisa ke, babulala abantu bedolobha ngeqhwa; kodwana lo muntu nomndeni wakhe wonke wavumela bona ahambe.
Wahamba waya ezweni lamaHithi, wakhiwa khona umzi, wabiza igama lakhe bona iLuz; lelo liyigama layo kuze namuhla.
Kodwana-ke, uManase akhenge akhuphule abantu baseBeth-shan, nabaseTaanakh, nabaseDor, nabaseIbleam, nabaseMegido namadolobhana abo; kodwana abaKanani baqhubeka behlala kulolu lizwe.
Kwathi lapho amaSirayeli enamandla, wabeka abaKanani ukuba basebenzele; kodwana akhenge awakhuphule wonke.
No-Ephrayim akawasusanga amaKanana ahlala eGezeri; kodwana amaKanana ayehlala phakathi kwabo.
UZebuloni akawasusanga nalabo abahlali eKitroni, noma eNahaloli; behlala phakathi kwabo aBakanani, kodwana babe yimisebenzi yomsebenzi.
U-Asere akhenge akhuphule abantu abahlala eAkko, noma eSidon, noma eAhlab, noma eAkzib, noma eHelbah, noma eAfek, noma eRehobhi.
Bahlala abantu baka-Asere phakathi kwamaKanana ezweni labo, ngombana bebengabasusanga.
UNaphtali akawasusanga amadolobha aseBhethe-shemeshi, noma aseBhethe-anathi; bahlala phakathi kwabaKanani belizwe; kodwana abantu baseBhethe-shemeshi, nabaseBhethe-anathi, babe yimisebenzi sabo.
Begodu ama-Amori wacindezela abantu bakaDan ezindaweni eziphakeme, begodu akhenge abonise ukuba bakhuphuke emadolobheni.
Bathi ama-Amori: "Sizohlala emfuleni i-Heres, e-Ajalon ne-Shaalbim; kodwana uma izingane zikaYosefu zikhulu khulu, sizoba nomthwalo kuma-Amori."
Umgwaqo we-Amorites usuka eScorpion Pass kuya eSela nangaphezulu.

Waphuma umbingeleli kaYehova eGalgali waya eBokimi, wathi, Nginikhuphule nisuka eYiputa, begodu nginisize nifike ezweni engithembise ngamazwi obaba benu; begodu ngitjho, Angeke ngiphule umnqophiso wami nani, kuze kube yisikhathi esizayo.
begodu ningeke niyenze inkontileka nabantu balesi sifundazwe, kodwana nizophonsa phasi izibingelelo zabo. Kodwana-ke, ningamlalela; yini le nto eninikele kuyo?
Ngalokho ngitjho, Ngami ngeke ngibakhuphe phambi kwenu; bazobe yizicubu eenhliziyweni zenu, begodu amadini abo azoba yizinkundla kuwe.
Kwathi, lapho isithunywa sikaYehova sikhuluma ngalezo zinto kubo bonke amadodana kaSirayeli, abantu baphuma bekhala.
Babiza igama lesi sifundazwe bona iBokim, begodu banikela khona emkhondweni kuYehova.
Uma uYoshuwa eshiye abantu, basuka bonke amakhosikazi aseSirayeli, wonke umuntu ezweni lakhe.
Bakhonza ke abantu ikosi zonke amalanga wokuphila kukaYoshuwa, nazo zonke amalanga wokuphila kwabakhulu abaphila ngemuva kwakhe, ababebona yonke le nto enkulu kaYehova, ayeyenza kuboSirayeli.
UYoshuwa unyana kaNune, umkhonzi kaYehova, wafa, eneminyaka eyikhulu nesishiyagalombili.
Bamu葬le ezindaweni zakhe, eTimnathi-heresi, esiqhingini sakwaEfraim, esisenyakatho yenduli kaGaash.
Kwathi, ngemuva kokufa kwaleso sizukulwana soke, kwavuka isizukulwana esisha, esingamqondi ikosi, noma iyiphi into ayeyenza kuSirayeli.
Bakwenza ke oonyana bakaSirayeli okumbi emehloni kaYehova, bakhonza amaBaali.
Bashiya ikosi, uzimu wababa babo, owabasusa ezweni laseMizi-Yiputa, balandela izitha zamazwe asendaweni sabo, bakhonza izitha zamazwe asendaweni sabo; begodu babulala ikosi.
Bashiya ikosi, bakhonza uBahali ne-Ashtorethi.
UYehova, ngenxa yengcindezi yakhe yabaSirayeli, wabanikela esidlangalaleni ezandleni zabahlaseli, babulalana nabo. Wabathengisa ezimpini zabo zonke izinhlangothi; abakwazi ukumelana nabo.
Ngaso soke isikhathi lapho amaSirayeli ephuma khona ukubhekana nokulwa, isandla sikaYehova sakuba phezu kwabo, sababulala, njengokuthi washo kubo, begodu njengokuthi awaphikisile.
Wathi ikosi wavusa abavikeli, abaphathi, ababebasindisa kilabo abahlaselayo.

Kodwana-ke, abazange baphulaphule abehluleli babo; babengakholwa kuYehova, bekhonza izitha zakwamanye amazwe, bezinikela kuzo. Basuka ngokushesha endlela ababehamba ngayo ababuphikisi babo, belandela imithetho kaYehova; abangayisebenzisi indlela ababeya ngayo abuphikisi babo.

Kwathi lapho ikosi evusa khona ummeli kubo, ikosi ube nowemthetho lowo, wabasindisa emathunjini abo zonke amalanga wokuphila kommeli lowo; begodu ikosi wababaleka ngenxa sabo, njengombana bephuca ngaphasi kwalabo ababebacindezela, nalabo ababebaphazamisa.

Kodwana lapho ummeli efa, abantu babuyela emuva, begodu wakwenza okumbi khulu kunabazali babo. Balandela izitha zabanye, ukukhonza, nokuzibophezela kubo; abazange bayeke imicabango sabo emibi, noma indlela sabo engalungile.
UYehova wagwema amaSirayeli, wathi, Le lizwe liphumile isivumelwano sam, engiwisela ngaso ababuphikisi babo, bangangilalelanga.
Ngalokho-ke, ngeke ngiphinde ngikhuphe phambi kwabo noma iyiphi izwe elishiye uYoshuwa lapho efa khona.
Ngizozama ngabo isiSirayeli, bona bangagcina yini indlela kaYehova, behamba ngayo, njengokuthi ababa babo bahambe ngayo.
Ngalokho ikosi wabashiya labo mazwe; akawasusa ngokushesha, akawanikela esandlani sikaYoshuwa.
Lezi yizo izizwe ashiye ikosi ezweni, ukuze azibonele izinganekwane zakwaSirayeli, labo abazange badlule kiwo wonke amabhishobhi aseKanana.
Wakwenza lokhu nje ukuze afundise ukulwa ezizukulwaneni ezintsha zabaSirayeli abazange banqobe emdlalweni ngaphambili.
Abaphathi abahlanu beFilisti, nabenzi bonke baseKanana, nabaSidoni, namaHivi ahlala entaba yaseLibanoni, kusukela emfuleni iBaale-Hermon, kuze kufike eHamati.
Waze wabashiya, ukuze abhekane nabo amadodana aseSirayeli, bona bangawuphula kanjani umyalo kaYehova, owawuthi kubaba babo ngoMosesi.
AbaSirayeli bahlala phakathi kwamaKanana, namaHeti, namaAmoreti, namaPerizi, namaHivi, namaJebusi.
Bazala izingane zabo, banikela izingane zabo kubo; bakhonza amadini abo.
Bakwenza lokho okumbi emehloni kaYehova, bakhohlwa ikosi uzimu wabo, bakhonza amaBaali nama-Ashere.
Wagwema ikosi isizwe samaSirayeli, wabathengisa kuKushan-risathaim, ukumkani waseAram Naharaim, eMesopotamia; bakhonza amaSirayeli iminyaka esibhozo.
Bacela ikosi, wavusa umuntu wabasindisa, u-Othniyeli, unyana kaKenazi, umngane omncane kaKalebe.
UMoya kaYehova wehla phezu kwakhe, waba ngummeli wakwaSirayeli, waya emkhosini; ikosi wamnika esandla sakhe uKushan-risathaim, ukumkani waseAram; wabulala uOthniel.
Izwe laphumula iminyaka emashumi mane, kuze kube sekufa uOthniel unyana kaKenazi.
Baphinde bakwenza oonyana bakaSirayeli lokho okumbi emehloni kaYehova; ngenxa yokuthi bekwenze lokhu okumbi, ikosi waqinisa uEgloni ukumkani wamaMowabi phezu kwaSirayeli.
U-Egloni waqoqa nabo oonyana baka-Amoni nabangane baka-Amaleki, waya wahlasela isizwe samaSirayeli, bathatha idolobhana lezintaba.
Bakhonza amaSirayeli uEgloni ukumkani wakwaMowabi iminyaka eyisishiyagalombili.

Baphinde bathandaza oonyana bakaSirayeli kuYehova, wabeka kubo umsindisi, uEhude unyana kaGera, wesizwe sikaBhenjamini, indodana yokwesobunxele; bathumela kuye oonyana bakaSirayeli ukuba athathe inkontileka sabo ku-Egloni ukumkani wakwaMowabi.
U-Ehud wakwenza ikhebula elinobubanzi obuyimitha emibili, waligqugquzela emlenzeni wakhe wesobunxele ngezansi kwezigqoko zakhe.
Wanikeza umnikelo ku-Egloni ukumkani wakwaMowabi, owayengumuntu onzima khulu.
U-Ehude, lapho eqedile ukunikela, wathumela abantu abawuthwala.
Wabuyela emuva, waya eGilgal, lapho bekukhona khona ama-Astarte, wathi, "Nginento engifuna ukukusho kuwe, Kosi yami." Wathi ubukhosi: "Nquma!" Baphuma bonke abakhonzi bakhe.
U-Ehude wafika kuye, lapho uhlala khona ekamelweni elibandayo esitezi esiphezulu sendlu yakhe. Ujikelele u-Ehude, wathi: "Nginolwazi oluvela kuThixo kuwe." Ubukhosi besuka endaweni sabo,
U-Ehud wafinyelela ngesandla sakhe sasekhohlo, wasusa isikhephe ekhanda lakhe lasekunene, wayibeka emlonyeni womkakhe.
Naphezu kwalokho, isandla sayo safika ngemuva kwekhebula, begodu uphethiloli wavala phezu kwayo. U-Ehude akhenge asuse isigwebo, saphuma emlenzeni wakhe.
Waphuma ke u-Ehude, wavala imingcele yegumbi eliphakeme ngemuva kwakhe, wavala izintambo zayo.
Waphuma, wafika umkhonzi wakhe, wafumana iminyango yegumbi eliphakeme litshixiwe; bathi ke, Uzohlala egumbini eliphansi, ephumula.
Balinde kuze kube sengozini, kodwana yena akhenge avule amafasitela. Ngalokho bathathe isici begodu wavala. Kwakhona umnikazi wabo wahlala esitezi, efile.
Kusukela lapho, u-Ehud waphuma, waya eSeira, wadlula phezu kwezinhlamvu zesiliva.
Kwathi lapho efika khona, waphonsa isibhamu ezindaweni eziphakeme zakwaEfraim. Baphuma naye amadodana kaSirayeli emadolobheni aphezulu, no-Ehud ephethe kubo.

Wathi kubo, "Niya kulandelana nami; ngombana ikosi usandulela izandla zenu umnakwabo uMowabi." Baphuma belandela yena, bathatha iziqhingi zaseJordani ezibhekene neMowabi, abavumelanga umuntu bona adlule.
Ngaleso sikhathi babulala eMowabhi abantu abangumakhulu ayisishiyagalombili, bonke abesilisa abanothando; akhenge ahambe umuntu.
UMowabhi wabekwa ngaphasi kwabaSirayeli ngalolu suku, begodu izwe laphumula iminyaka eyisibhozo.
Ngemva kuka-Ehude kwafika uShamgari unyana kaAnathi, owabulala abantu bakaFilisti abangamakhulu amathandathu ngentambo yenkomo; naye wasindisa amaSirayeli.
Kwathi, ngemuva kokufa kuka-Ehude, baphinde bakwenza okumbi emehloni kaYehova.
Wabathengisa ikosi emkhosini kaYabini ukumkani wakwaKanana, owahlala eHazori; umphathi womkhosi wakhe wayenguSisera, owayehlala eHaroshethi Haggoyim.
U-Sisera wayenezimoto zensimbi ezingumakhulu asithoba, wahlasela amaSirayeli ngobuhlungu iminyaka eyishumi nambili. Baphoqa ikosi ukuba asize.
Ngaleso sikhathi uDebora, umprofeti, indodana kaLapidothi, wayelawula isizwe sakwaSirayeli njengommeli.
Wahlala ngaphasi komnqumo kaDebora, phakathi kweRama neBheteli, ezweni eliphakeme likaEfrayim. Bafika kuye amadodana aseSirayeli ukuba axazulule izinkinga zabo.

Wathumela wabiza uBaraka, unyana ka-Abinoamu, waseKedesh eNaphtali, wathi kuye, UYehova, uzimu kaSirayeli, uthi, Yiya uhlanganise abantu abangumakhulu ayisishiyagalombili abasuka eNaphtali noZebuloni, ubaveze emfuleni iTabori.
Ngizothikisa uSisera, umphathi wenkosi kaYabini, namabhayisikili akhe namadodana akhe, kuze kube emfuleni iKishon, ngiwubeke esandla sakho.
Wathi yena uBharaki, Uma usuya nami, ngizoya; kodwana uma ungahamba nami, angizokuhambe.
Wathi uDebora: "Kulungile, ngizohamba nawe; kodwana ngeke ube nobudumo kulolu hambo, ngombana ikosi uzonikela uSisera kuwesifazane." Wahamba uDebora noBharaki waya eKedesh.
UBharaki wahlanganisa uZebuloni noNaphtali eKedeshi; abantu abangumakhulu ayisishiyagalombili babemlandela, waya naye noDebora.
UHebhere, umKenisi, washiya amaKenithi, izingane zikaHobabu, udadewabo kaMoses, wamisa itente lakhe eduze kwe-altare eZaananim, enhliziyweni yeKedesh.
USisera wafumana bona uBaraka, unyana ka-Abinoamu, usefike emfuleni iTabhore.
USisera wahlanganisa zonke izimoto zakhe zensimbi, ezingumakhulu asithoba, nabantu bakhe bonke, kusukela eHaroshethe Haggoyim kuya emfuleni iKishon.

Wathi uDebora kuBharaki, Yiya; namuhla wusuku lapho ikosi abeke khona uSisera esandleni sakho. uzimu usehamba phambi kwakho. Waphuma ke uBharaki ezweni laseTabhori, namadoda amawaka ayisishiyagalombili emveni kwakhe.
Kwathi lapho ehamba khona uBaraka, ikosi wavusa uSisera, nazo zonke izimoto zakhe, nezwe lakhe, phambi kweqhwa likaBaraka. USisera wehla esihlalweni sakhe semoto, wabaleka ngenyawo.
UBaraka walandela izithuthi zokulwa, nomndeni kaSisera, waya eHaroshethe-ha-goyim; bonke abantu bakaSisera babulawa ngeqhwa. Akukho muntu osele.
USisera ke wabaleka ngenyawo, waya esitezi sikaJayeli, indodana kaHebhere umKenithi; ngombana kwakungukuthula phakathi kukaYabini ukumkani waseHazori nomndeni kaHebhere.
Waphuma uJayeli, wabhekana noSisera, wathi kuye, Ngeza, kosi yami, ngeze, ungabi nalo uloyiko. Wafika ke ekhempini yakhe, yathi yena, Yimi ngizowugqoka.
Wathi, "Nceda ungisize amanzi, ngombana nginomkhuhlane." Yavula ibhodlela lobisi, wamnika utshwala, waphinde wamgqoka.
Wathi kuye, Thola umngcele wesitezi; uma umuntu efika ebuza bona, Ingabe kukhona umuntu lapha? Uzothi, Akukho.

UJayeli, indodana ka-Hebhere, yathatha isibopho setente, namahhashi, yafika kuye ngezwi elincane; yena ke wayelele embhedeni, ehloniphekile khulu; wabeka isibopho phezu kwekhanda lakhe ezweni, waza wafa.
UBaraka wafika, elandela uSisera. Yayeli yaphuma ibhekane naye, yathi: "Thina, ngizokukhombisa umuntu ofunayo." Waphuma ke yena, begodu ngabona uSisera esefile, umkhonto wetente usesifuba sakhe;
Ngomhla owodwa uzimu wahlasela uYabini, ukumkani wakwaKanana, phambi kwabaSirayeli.
Amadodana kaSirayeli aqhubeka enamandla khulu kuYabini ukumkani wakwaKanana, kuze kube wukuphela kwakhe.
Kwathi ngalolusuku uDebora noBaraka unyana ka-Abinoam bakhuluma lo mdlalo, bathi:
Uma abaphathi baseSirayeli behamba phambili, begodu abantu bezinikela ngokuzithandela, thandani ikosi!
Yithi, ngikutsheleni, nikumkani; ngikukhulumeni, nibaphathi: Ngizongoma kuYehova, ngizokhuluma ngoNkulunkulu kaSirayeli.
Kosi, lapho uphuma khona eSeyiri, lapho usuka khona ezweni laseEdomi, izwe lalimaza, amazulu ashaya amanzi, namazulu ashaya amanzi.
Izingqimba zanyamalala phambi kweNkosi, eSinayi, phambi kweNkosi uzimu kaSirayeli.
Ezikhathini zika-Shamgar, unyana ka-Anath, ezinsuku zikaJayeli, izitezi ezinkulu zazingenalutho. Abahamba ngezinyawo behamba ngemizila emincane.
Ukuphila kwedolobhana kwamiswa e-Israyeli. Kwamiswa kuze kube ngifika, uDeborah, kuze kube ngifika njengomama e-Israyeli.
Bakhetha izitha ezintsha, kwafika ukulwa eziteshini zedolobha. Akukho isigqoko noma isikebhe esibonakale phakathi kwamaphesenti angamashumi amane aseSirayeli.
Intliziyo yami ihamba nabaphathi bakaSirayeli, abanikela ngokuthanda kwabo phakathi kwabantu. Lola ikosi!
Nibahamba ngezinkomo ezimhlophe, nihlala emigodini ehlelekile, nihamba ngendlela, cabangani ngalolu daba!

Bathi, Ngaphezu kwengxolo yabagibeli, ezindaweni zokugeza amanzi, bakhuluma ngezikhululo zeNkosi, izikhululo zabahlali bakhe baseSirayeli. Ake abantu bakaYehova bakhuphuka befika emigwaqeni yedolobha.
Khumbula, khumbula, uDeborah! Khumbula, khumbula, ubhale ingoma! Khumbula, uBaraka! Thola abasolwa bakho, unyana ka-Abinoam!
Kwathi labo abancane, abaseleyo, bawela kilabo abadume khulu; abantu bakaYehova bawela kum, behlasela labo abakhulu.
Bavela ku-Ephrayim, abasuka kuma-Amaleki; basuka eBhenjamin, nabo bonke abantu bakho. Bavela ku-Makhire, abaphathi, nabasuka eZebulun, labo abathwala isibhamu sokumkani.
Abaphathi baka-Issakare babe noDebora. U-Issakare ube noBaraka, ehamba emuva kwakhe ezweni. Emindenini yakwaRubhen bekukhona ukucabanga okuningi, nokubhekana ngenhliziyo.
Kungani na nihlala phakathi kwezindawo zokudla izinkomo, nilalela izingulube zezinkomo ezivuthayo? Emindenini yakwaRubhene bekukhona ukukhathazeka okuningi.
UGiliyadi wahlala enyakatho-mpumalanga yeJordani, begodu uDan, kungani uhlala eduze kwezinqanawa? UAshere wahlala emfuleni, wahlala emigwaqweni yakhe.
Kodwana abantu bakaZebuloni, kanye noNaphtali, babeka ubomi babo enhliziyweni sabo.
Bafika amabukhosi, babhekana nokulwa; babhekana nokulwa amakhosi aseKanana eTaanakhe, ngamanzi aseMegido; kodwana abathathenga imali yesiliva.
Izinkanyezi zabhekana nokulwa emkhathini, Zabhekana nokulwa noSisera ezindaweni zabo zezulu.
Umlambo i-Kishon wabasusa, umlambo omusha, umlambo i-Kishon. Yiya phambili, inkanuko yami, ube namandla!
Kwathi amakhowa emahhashi ahlaba umxhwele njengombana amahhashi akhe anamandla ehamba begodu ehamba.
Wathi uMoya oyiNgcwele: "Lahla iMeroshe, lahla abantu bayo ngokujulile; ngombana abafikanga ukusiza ikosi, ukuze basize ikosi ngalabo abanamandla.
Ungcwele phakathi kwabesifazane, uJayeli, indodana ka-Hebhere waseKeni; ungcwele phakathi kwabesifazane abahlala ezindlini.
Wacela amanzi, yena wamnika ubisi. Emgodini omuhle waletha i-cream kuye.
Wathatha ngesandla sakhe isibambo sesitezi, begodu ngesandla sakhe sokudla wathatha i-hammer yomqambi. Washaya uSisera, wehlisa ikhanda lakhe, waphula, waphuza icala lekhanda lakhe.
Enyangeni yakhe washaya phasi. Washona begodu wahlala khona. Enyangeni yakhe washaya phasi begodu washona. Kulapho washaya khona, lapho washona khona, efile.
Udadewabo kaSisera wabheka ngaphandle kwefasitela, waphuma emnyango, wathi, Yini bona imoto yakhe ithathe isikhathi eside ukubuya? Yini bona izingulube zemoto yakhe zihamba kancane?
Umfazi owaziyo khulu waphendula yena, begodu wayeqhubeka etshela ngokwakhe,

Bazothola begodu bahlukanise izinto abazithathele: indodana eyodwa noma ezimbili ngaye wonke umuntu, izicathulo ezimibalabala njengento elahlekile kaSisera, izicathulo ezimibalabala ezenziwe ngesandla, izinhlamvu ezimbili zezicathulo ezenziwe ngesandla zengalo yami, zonke zithathwe njengento elahlekile.
Ngalokhu, Kosi, baphile bonke abakhohlisi bakho; kodwana labo bonke abakuthandela, babe njengelanga lapho liphuma khona enamandla ayo. Nokho izwe laphumula iminyaka engamashumi amane.
Bakwenza ke oonyana bakaSirayeli okumbi emehloni kaYehova; wathi, Wabanikela esandleni sikaMidiyani iminyaka eyisithupha.
Aba-Midiyani babenamandla khulu begodu banzima, ngalokho-ke amaSirayeli akwenzela indawo yokuzifihla emadolobheni, ezindaweni zokugcina izinto kanye nezindawo eziqinileyo.
Ngaso soke isikhathi lapho abantu bakaSirayeli betshala khona izithelo zabo, amaMidiyani nama-Amaleki, nalabo abavela emazweni asempumalanga, bafika bahlasela.
Bamisa isibhedlela kulolu mhlaba, babulala izithelo, kuze kufike eGaza; abashiyanga noma yini ephilayo ezweni lakwaSirayeli, noma inkomo, noma ingulube, noma idlovu.
Bafika, nabo bonke abantu babo, nezilwane zabo, namakamelo abo, njengamakhoboka akhulu khulu; abakwazi ukulinganisa inani labo, namahhashi abo; bafika ezweni, belimaza.
UMidiyani wakwenza amaSirayeli abe mnyama khulu, ngaleyo le abaSirayeli baphoqa ikosi ukuba asize.
Uma amaSirayeli ekhala kukaNkulunkulu ngenxa Midian,
wathumela kubo umprofeti, wathi kubo: Uthi lokhu ikosi, uzimu kaSirayeli: Ngizikhuphule nisuka eYiputa, ezweni lendlu yomsebenzi.
Nginisindise ebusweni beMisiya, begodu ngabakhipha esihlalweni senu; ngibasusa phambi kwenu, ngabanika izwe labo.
Nami ngathi kuni, Ngiye ikosi uzimu wenu; ningazibophezeli izitha zakwaAmora, ezweni labo nihlala kulo. Kodwana-ke, ningamlalela.
Wafika uMoya oNgcwele, wahlala ngaphasi kwesihlahla sika-Ofra, esibe nguYowashi, ongumzali ka-Abiezer. UGideyon, unyana wakhe, wayewubhaka umnqumo emgodini wotshwala, efuna ukuwufihla kumaMidiyani.
Umbingeleli kaYehova wambona uGideyon, wathi kuye, uzimu unguwe, wena onamandla amakhulu.

Waphendula uGideyon, wathi, Ngikucela, kosi yami; uma ikosi esesikweni lethu, kungani sithole lezi zinto zonke? Zikhona yini zonke izinto ezimangazayo, obaba bethu abakhuluma ngazo nathi, bathi, uzimu akasisikhuphi ezweni laseYiputa? Kodwana manje ikosi usishiye, asisidlulise kumadodana kaMidiyani.
Wabhekana naye ikosi, wathi, Yiya ngesandla sakho esinamandla; uzosindisa amaSirayeli ezandla zikaMidiyani; ngiyakuthumela.
Wathi uGideyon, Ngiyabonga, Kosi yami; ngizosindisa kanjani isizwe samaSirayeli? Bheka, inkosikazi yami incane ukudlula bonke eManase, begodu ngiyindodana encane khulu.
Wathi ikosi kuye, Ngizobe ngikhona nawe; uzowabulala bonke abantu baseMidiyani njengamuntu owodwa.
(Gideon) waphendula wathi: "Uma uthandana nami, nginike uphawu lokuthi wena kuphela okhuluma nami.
Ngiyakucela, ungeke ukhambe, kuze ngibuye, ngithole isipho sami, ngisibeke phambi kwakho. Wathi ikosi, Ngizohlala, kuze ubuye.

Wathi uGideyon, ephuma ngaphakathi, wapheka ingulube encane, begodu wenza amakhowe angabi nenyama; wabeka inyama emgodini, namanzi ebhodweni, wazisa kulowo mqondisi phantsi kwesihlahla se-oak, wanikela ngazo.
Wathi yena uMoya oNgcwele kuye, Thola inyama nenyamakazi, uyibeke phezu kwalo mqolo, uthele isiphuzo phezu kwayo. UGideyon wakwenza njalo.
Wathi umbingeleli kaYehova, ngaso isiphelo sesandla sakhe, wacindezela inyama nenyamakazi; kwaphuma umlilo emhlabathini, wawudla inyama nenyamakazi. Umbingeleli kaYehova wehla, wahamba.
Wabona uGideyon bona iyindodakazi kaYehova, wathi, Akunjalo, Kosi yami uThixouNkulunkulu, ngibone indodana kaYehova ibhekene nemehlo.
Wathi ikosi kuye, Kulungile; ungakhathazeki; ngeke uphile.
Wakha khona uGideyon isibingelelo kukaNkulunkulu, wabiza igama layo bona: uzimu ngukuthula; likhona kuze kube yimanje eOfra yama-Abiezer.

Kwathi ngobusuku balo, ikosi wathi kuye, Thola inkomo yomshado kababa wakho, inkomo yesithathu, eneminyaka eyishumi nesishiyagalombili ubudala; phula isibingelelo sikaBahali, esibekiwe ngubaba wakho, uyeke itshe le-Ashera elikhona.
bese ukwakha isibingelelo esifanele kuYehova uzimu wakho, phezu kwalo mhlaba ophakeme; begodu uthathe inkomo yesithathu, uyinikeze njengesondlo somlilo, ngemithi ye-Ashera oyitshelile.

Wathi uGideyon, ethatha abantu abalishumi phakathi kwabangane bakhe, wakwenza njengokuthi ikosi kuye; kodwana wayekhathazekile ngenxa yomndeni wakhe, namadoda asedolobhaneni lakhe, wakwenza ngobusuku, akwenzenga ekuseni.
Bavuka abantu bedolobha ekuseni, babona bona isibingelelo sikaBahali sithunyelwe phasi, begodu i-Ashera engaphansi kwayo isiketsheziwe, nengulube yesithathu isetshenziswe esibingeleni.
Baze babuzana, bathi, Ubani owakwenza lo msebenzi? Ke kaloku, lapho befuna begodu bebuza khona, kwathiwa kubo, UGideyon unyana kaYoashi wenza lowo msebenzi.
Bathi abantu bedolobha kuYowashi, Thola unyana wakho ngaphandle, ukuze aphile; ngombana waphonsa phasi isibingelelo sikaBhaali, begodu wehlise i-ashere ekhona.

Wathi uYoashi kubo bonke abantu ababhekene naye, Ingabe nizobhekana noBahali? Ingabe nifuna ukumsindisa? Uma umuntu ebhekana noBahali, uzofa ekuseni; uma uBahali unguThixo, akwazi ukuxosha isandla sakhe, uma umuntu ephula isibambo sakhe.
Wabizwa uGideyon ngalolusuku ngegama elithi Yerub-bhaali, kusho bona: "UBahali abhekane naye," ngombana waphula isibingelelo sikaBahali.
Bahlangana bonke abantu baseMidiyani, namadodakazi aseAmaleki, namaSirayeli aseMpumalanga, badlula iJordani, bamisa isikhashana ezweni laseJezreeli.
Wafika uMoya kaYehova kuGideyon, waphonsa iphoyinti, wababiza abantu base-Abhiezer ukuba balandele.
Wathumela abathunywa ezweni lonke likaManase, wathi kubo: "Niya kumlandela," begodu wathumela ku-Ashere, noZebuloni, noNaphtali; bona nabo bafika ukubhekana naye.
Wathi uGideyon kuThixo, Uma ufuna ukusindisa amaSirayeli ngesandla sami, njengokuthi washo,

bheka, ngizobeka isikhumba sengulube esitezi sokudla; uma kuzoba khona umswakama ebusweni besikhumba kuphela, begodu indawo yonke ibe yimpuphu, khona-ke ngizokwazi bona uzosindisa amaSirayeli ngesandla sami, njengombana usho.
Nokho, lokhu kwakuyiqiniso. UGideyon wavuka ekuseni ngosuku olulandelayo, wacindezela i-fleece begodu wacindezela amanzi abandayo, isitsha esigcwele amanzi.
Wathi uGideyon kuThixo, uzimu, ungabi nobuhlungu ngami; ngizocela into eyodwa kuphela: ngizozama ingulube kathathu; ngenza ingulube ibe yindilinga, begodu izwe libe lindi.
Wakwenza uzimu njalo ngalolu busuku; ingulube kuphela eyashisa, kodwana yonke indawo yamanzi.
UYerub-bhahali, okunguGideyon, wavuka ekuseni, yena namadodana akhe wonke, bamisa isikhani eMfula iHarode. Isiqhingi sakwaMidiyani besingasenyakatho sabo, emfuleni, enhliziyweni yeMore.
Wathi ikosi kuGideyon, Abantu bakho baningi khulu kunami, ukuze ngibafake esandlani sabantu baseMidiyani; ukuze isiSirayeli singaba nomsindo ngami, sisithi, Sisindiswe ngesandla sethu.

Ngalokho-ke, khuluma emphakathini, usithi: Wonke umuntu okhathazekile, noma onqobile, kufanele abuye, aphume emfuleni iGiliyadi. Basuka abantu abangumashumi amabili nambili amawaka, behlala abantu abangumakhulu amathathu.

Wathi ikosi kuGideyon, Bakhona abantu abaningi khulu; zulazisa emazingeni amanzi, ngizowahlukanisela khona kuwe. Uma ngitjho, Lo mntu kufanele ahambe nawe, uzoya; kodwana uma ngitjho, Lo mntu ngeke ahambe nawe, ngeke ahambe.
Wathi uGideyon, wakhuphula labo abantu eduze kwamanzi; wathi ikosi kuye, Yahlukanisa labo abadla amanzi ngolimi lwabo, njengokudla kwenja, nalabo abaguquguqukayo ukudlela.
Abantu abangumakhulu amathathu baphuza amanzi, bewuletha ngezandla zabo emlonyeni wabo; bonke ababoshiwe babhujiswa ukudla.
Wathi ikosi kuGideyon, Ngalabo abantu abangumakhulu amathathu abaphuza amanzi, ngizokusindisa, begodu ngibamise amaMidiyani esandla sakho; wonke umuntu osele kufanele ahambe ezweni lakhe.
Wathi uGideyon, washiya labo abami baseSirayeli ezindaweni zabo, wagcina labo amashumi amathathu; bathatha ukudla kwabo, namahhashi abo. Isikhulu samaMidiyani sahlala ngezansi kwakhe emfuleni.
Wathi ikosi kuGideyon ngobusuku balo, Yiya zula eqenjini; ngombana ngilinikela emandleni akho.
Uma ukhathazekile ukuhlasela, zulazula esiteshini sakho kanye nomkhonzi wakho uPurha.

Wathi uSolomoni ku-Abhisalomu, "Njengombana ngikutshela lokho, lalela bona yini abakushoyo; uma bekwenza njalo, uzokwazi ukunqoba icamp." Waphuma yena noPhura, umkhonzi wakhe, wafika esiphethweni se-camp, lapho kwaba khona amaphoyisa.

Bakhona amaMidiyani, nama-Amaleki, nalabo bonke abavela emazweni asempumalanga, bemi emigwaqweni, bafana nezingqungquthela; begodu izingwegwe zabo zaziningi, zafana nenhlabathi enkabeni yolwandle; kwakungekho muntu owazibala.

Wafika uGideyon, lapho umuntu etshela umngane wakhe iphupho lakhe. Wathi, "Nginephupho, ngibona inkomishi yobisi lwesithelo sengulube isuka emgwaqeni waseMidiyani, yahlasela ihholo, lajika, liwela phasi."
Waphendula udadewabo, wathi, Akufanele kube yisandla sikaGideyon, unyana kaYowashi, umSirayeli; uzimu wabeka esandlani sakhe iMidiyani nesiteji soke.

Kwathi lapho uGideyon ekhuluma ngalolu phupho, nokuqonda kwalo, wehlise ikhanda lakhe, wathandaza, wabuyela esibhedlela sakwaSirayeli, wathi, Nquma; ngombana ikosi ubeke isibhedlela samaMidiyani esandla sakho.
Wawahlukanisa amadoda angumakhulu amathathu abe ngamaqembu amathathu, wanikela kiwo wonke umuntu iphoyinti, nebhodlela elisha lodonga, elinesibhakabhaka esingenayo.
Wathi kubo, Ningiboneni, nikwenze lokho engikwenzayo; uma ngifika esiphethweni sendawo yokucampana, niyenze ngokufana nalokho engikwenzayo.
Uma ngiphuza amaphoyinti, mina nalabo bonke abaye nami, niphuze ninamaphoyinti enhliziyweni yesitezi, nithi, uzimu noGideyon.

Wafika uGideyon, namadoda angumakhulu amabili ahamba naye, esigabeni sesitezi esiphakathi kobusuku, lapho beqala khona ukushintshana kwamaphoyisa; baphuza amaphoyinti abo, baphula izibhodlela ezisezandla zabo.
Baphuza amaphoyinti abo, baphula amabhodlela abo, bethatha izibhamu ngesandla sabo sokudla, namaphoyinti ngesandla sabo sesobunxele, bathi, Ikhebula likaYehova noGideyon!
Wahlala wonke umuntu endaweni yakhe, ngaso soke isiqhingi sakwaMidiyani; bonke abantu basemikhosini yakwaMidiyani babaleka, begwaza.

Kwathi lapho amabhungane angumakhulu amathathu ephuthuma khona, ikosi wenza bona amadoda asesitezi abuye abhekene namadodana akhe ngeqhwa; begodu izwe laphuma lihamba kuze kube yiBeth-shitha, liya eTserera, lifike esiphethweni se-Abele-mehola, eduze kweTabhatha.
Amadodakazi kaSirayeli asuka eNaphtali, naseAshere, nakwaManase wonke, ahlangana, alandela amaMidiyani.

UGideyon wathumela abathunywa ezindaweni eziphakeme zakwaEfraim zonke, esithi, Nciphisani ukubhekana nabaMidiyani, nithathe amanzi aseYorodani phambi kwabo, kuze kube yiBeth-bara. Baphuma bonke abantu baseEfrayim, bathatha amanzi aseYorodani kuze kube yiBeth-bara.

Bathatha namadodana ababili aseMidiyani, uOrebhi noZebhebi; babulala uOrebhi eqololweni laseOrebhi, noZebhebi emgodini wewayini waseZebhebi. Balandela amaMidiyani, baletha ikhanda lika-Orebhi noZebhebi kuGideyon, owayeseJordani.
Bathi abantu baka-Ephrayim kuGideyon, Yini le nto oyikwenzele thina? Kungani na bona, uma usuye ukubhekana neMidiyani, ungasibizanga? Baze bakhuluma naye ngothando.
Wabaphendula wathi kubo, Ngikwenze kuphi ngifana nani? Ingabe imbewu ye-Ephrayim engase ibe ngcono kunayo yonke imbewu yomndeni wami, uAbiezer?
uzimu wabeka ezandla zenu abaphathi baseMidiyani, uOrebhi noZebhebi; yini engikwazi ukuyenza ngaphezu kwenu? Wathi ke, Yaphela inkohliso sabo kuye.
Wafika uGideyon emfuleni iYorodani, wadlula, yena namadodana akhe amakhulu amathathu. Bakhulule khulu, kodwana baqhubeka nokulandela.
Wathi kubo bonke abantu baseSukhothi, Nize ninike abantu bami inkomishi yesonka; ngombana belahlekile, begodu ngilandela uZebha noZalmuna, abaphathi bakaMidiyani.
Bathi abaphathi baseSukhothi, Uthathe uZebha noZalmuna yini? Kungani na bona sinike inkomishi imindeni yakho?
Wathi uGideyon, "Uma ikosi enikela uZebha noZalmuna ngesandla sami, ngizodla inyama yenu ngezinkuni zesihlabathi nezingqimba."
Waphuma khona waya ePhenuyeli, wababuza ngale le; baphendule bona abantu baseSukhothi babephendula.
Wathi kubo bonke abantu basePhenuyeli, Uma ngibuya ngokuthula, ngizowuvala lo mbhoshongo.

UZebha noZalmuna babe eKarkore, nabo neqembu labo elinamaphesenti angama-15; laba bonke abashiwo emikhosini yamaSirayeli asenyakatho. Babulawa abantu abangumakhulu amabili anamashumi amahlanu abanokhebesi.
UGideyon wehla ngendlela yabahlali besitezi, enyakatho-mpumalanga yeNobha neYogbeha, wahlasela isizwe ngesithakazelo, sabona bona baphephile.
UZebha noZalmuna, amakhosi amabini aseMidiyani, basuka; yena ke wabalandela, wabathatha, wabulala imindeni sabo yonke.
Wabuya uGideyon unyana kaYoashi, esuka emdlalweni, wafika esiqhingini saseHeres.
Wathatha indodana esuka eSukhothi, wabuza umbuzo; yabhala kuye amagama abaholi beSukhothi, namadoda amakhulu abo, abeyizinkulungwane nesishiyagalolunye.

Wafika ke uGideyon kubo bonke abantu baseSukhothi, wathi, Bheka, kukhona uZebha noZalmuna; ningiphoxekile ngalokho, nithi, Ingabe sekuyisikhathi sokuthatha uZebha noZalmuna? Kungani na bona sinike inkomishi abantu bakho abakhubazekile?
Wathatha abakhulu bedolobha, wafundisa abantu base-Sukkoth isifundo ngokuwagwema ngezinhlamvu zomhlaba kanye nezingqimba.
Waphula begodu inkundla yasePhenuyeli, wabulala abantu bedolobha.
Wathi kuZebha noZalmuna, Ubani lowo muntu owabulala eTabhori? Baphendula bathi, Bafana nawe; wonke umuntu ubukeka njengendodana yomphathi.
Wathi uGideyon, Abazalwane bami bebengabantwana bakamama wami; njengombana ikosi ephilayo, uma nibagcinela ubomi babo, ngingeke ngikususe.
Wabhekana noYetere, unyana wakhe omdala, wathi, Ubulala labo; kodwana akhenge asuse ikhebula lakhe, ngombana wayeneminyaka encane, wakhathazeka.
Wathi uZebha noZalmuna, Thola, yenza wena; ngombana umuntu uhlukaniswa ngokunamandla akhe. Wafika uGideyon, wababulala, wathatha amatshe enyanga asuka ezindlebeni zazo izinkomo.
Bathi amadoda aseSirayeli kuGideyon, Uzolawula phezu kwethu wena, nonyana wakho, nonyana womntwana wakho; ngombana usisindise ebusweni bama-Midiyani.
Wathi kubo uGideyon, Ngizobe sengilawula phezu kwenu, naye unyana wami uzobe sengilawula phezu kwenu; ikosi uzoba ngumphathi wenu.
Kodwana yena wathi, "Nginesicelo esisodwa. Wonke ngamunye wenu nginike i-earring kusuka kuzinto ozithathele empilweni." Kwakungumthetho we-Ismailites ukuba agqoke ama-earrings wegolide.
Bathi: "Sizothanda ukuwanika." Ngalokho bakhuphula ihembe, begodu wonke umuntu wabeka umlenze phezu kwayo kusuka lokho athathe.
Ubunzima bezinhlamvu zegolide ebeziwu-20 amakhilogremu, ngaphandle kwemihlobiso nezingcezu nezicathulo ezibomvu ababezigqoka amakhosi aseMidiyani, kanye namabhande emilenze yamagcebo abo.
UGideyon wayenza igolide, wayibeka emzini wakhe e-Ofra; begodu bonke isiSirayeli babhikishela uzimu ngaleyo nto. Yaba yingozi kaGideyon nomndeni wakhe.
Ngalokho, iMidiyani yahlaselwa ngamadodana aseSirayeli, ayikwazi ukubuyela emuva. Ngosuku lokuphila kukaGideyon izwe laphumula iminyaka emashumi mane.
UYerubahali unyana kaYoashi wabuyela ekhaya lakhe, wahlala khona.
Waba nguGideyon oonyana bakhe abamashumi asixhenxe, ngombana wayenamadodakazi amanengi.
Uwesifazane wakhe, owahlala eShekem, wazala naye unyana, wathi igama lakhe nguAbimeleki.
Wafa uGideyon unyana kaYowashi, eneminyaka emihle yobudala; wabanjwa emgodini kaYowashi ubaba wakhe, eOfra yama-Abiezeriti.
Ke kaloku, ngemva kokufa kukaGideyoni, abaSirayeli babuyela ekuphileni okungalungile, bekhonza amaBaali, bamisa uBaale-berithi njengomdali wabo.
Bakhohlwa ikosi uzimu wabo, owabasindisa ezindaweni zabo zonke ezingqondweni.
Bathi: "Akekho umndeni kaYerubhahali, okunguGideyon, abawuthobele, ngenxa yezinto ezinhle zonke azenzayo kuSirayeli.
UAbhimeleki, unyana kaYerubahali, waya eShekem, kwabangane benkosikazi yakhe; wathi kubo, nakwabo bonke abazalwane benkosikazi yakhe, ethi,

Nibuze bonke abantu baseShekem, nithi, Kulungile yini kuwe, bona bonke oonyana bakaYerubahali abamashumi asixhenxe babe ngabaphathi bakho, noma umuntu oyedwa abe ngumholi wenu? Khumbulani bona nginyama yenu namafutha wenu.
Bathi abazalwane bakamama wakhe kubo bonke abantu base-Shekem, balandela uAbhimeleki; ngombana besithi, Uyindodakazi yethu.
Banikeza uAbhimeleki amashekeli esiliva ayishumi nesishiyagalombili, asuka ethempelini likaBhaali-berithi; waqasha ngawo abantu abakhohlisi, abengenangqondo, balandela.

Wafika endlwini yobaba wakhe, eOfra, wabulala abazalwane bakhe abamashumi asixhenxe, oonyana bakaYerubhahali, phezu kodonga olulodwa; kodwana uYothamu, unyana omncane kaYerubhahali, waphuma, wafihlakala.
Bahlangana bonke abantu baseShekhemi, nabaseBeth-Milo, esitezi esiphakeme esiseShekhemi, bakwenza uAbhimeleki ukumkani.
Bathi kuYothama, wanyuka esigabeni esiphezulu somfula iGarizim, wathi kubo, Ningilalelani, nibemi baseShekhemi, ukuze uzimu aniphendulele.
Ngosuku oluthile izihlahla zaphuma, zifuna bona zikhethene ukumkani kubo; zathi ezitshalweni ze-olive, Yiwe ube ngukumkani wethu.
Wathi umnqumo kubo, Ngizoshiya yini uphethiloli wami, obhekwa nguThixo nomuntu, ngiye ngaphesheya kwezihlahla eziphakeme?
Bathi amajikijolo omnqumo, Thola ube ngukumkani wethu.
Isihlahla somnqumo saphendula, sathi kuye, Ngizoshiya kanjani isithelo sami esimnandi nesihle, ngihambe ngihamba phezu kwezihlahla?
Bathi amatshe esihlahla somnqumo, Thola, ube ngukumkani wethu.
Isihlahla sikavini saphendula, sathi kuye, Ingabe ngizoshiya iwayini lami elisha, elithokozisa uzimu nomuntu, ukuze ngihambe ngaphesheya kwezihlahla?
Bathi izihlahla zonke kulowo mnqumo, Thola ube ngukumkani wethu.

Wathi umnqumo emathinini, Uma ngeqiniso nifuna bona ngibe ngukumkani wenu, nifike niphumule ngaphasi kwesithunzi sami; kodwana uma kungenjalo, khona-ke umlilo ungaphuma kumnqumo, ube yimoto yamatshe eLibanoni.
Manje, ngabe ukwenze ngokweqiniso, begodu ngenhliziyo ethembekile, lapho wenza khona uAbhimeleki ukumkani? Ingabe ube nobulungisa kuYerubhahali nomndeni wakhe? Ingabe wakwenza ngokufanele kuye?
Ngiyakhumbula bona ubaba wami wabhekana nokulwa ngenxa yenu, wamisa impilo yakhe engozini ukuze akusindise ku-Midyan.
