Kodwana-ke namhlanje nibuyele emndenini wakwababa wami, nibulala izingane zakhe eziyisixhenxe phezu kwetshe elilodwa, nakwenza uAbhimeleki, unyana wowesifazane wakhe, ukumkani phezu kwabahlali baseShekem, ngenxa yokuthi ungumngane wenu.
Uma ke, namuhla, nikwenzele uYerubhobhaali nomndeni wakhe ngokweqiniso, ngokuthembekile, khona-ke, uphile uAbhimeleki, naye aphile niphila.
Uma kungenjalo, khona-ke umlilo uphume eAbhimeleki, uvale abantu baseShekhemi nabaseBeth-Milo; begodu umlilo uphume ebantwini beShekhemi nabaseBeth-Milo, uvale uAbhimeleki.
Waphuma uYothamu, wabaleka waya eBeeri, wahlala khona; ngombana wayekhathazekile ngenxa ka-Abhimeleki udadewabo.
U-Abhimeleki waba ngukumkani phezu kwaSirayeli iminyaka emithathu.
Wathumela uzimu umphefumulo ombi, wabangela ukungqubuzana phakathi kuka-Abhimeleki namadodakazi aseShekem; babuya behlasela u-Abhimeleki.
Wakwenza njalo uzimu, ukuze igazi labo lamadodana ayishumi nesishiyagalombili kaYerubhahali libuyiselwe ku-Abhimeleki, odadewabo, owawabulala, nakwabemi baseShekem, ababemsizala ukukwenza.

Bathi abantu base-Shekem, ukuze bagweme ukubulalana naye, babeka abantu ezindaweni eziphezulu zezindawo eziphakeme, begodu bonke abahamba ngazo bewuthatha wonke umuntu odlula eduze kwawo; kwathunyelwe ku-Abimeleki.
UGaali unyana ka-Ebedi waya eShekhemi, yena nodadewabo; abantu baseShekhemi bathembela kuye.
Baphuma ezindaweni, baqoqa izithelo, bazenza zibe yizipho; bafika ethempelini likaThixo wabo, badla, baphuze, babulala uAbhimeleki.

Wathi uGaali unyana ka-Ebedi, Ubani uAbhimeleki, nobani uShekemu, bona sisebenze naye? Akukabi yini yena indodana kaYerubhahali, begodu akukabi yini uZebulu umphathi wakhe? Basebenzela indlu kaHamori, ubaba kaShekemu; kungani sisebenzele uAbimeleki?
Ngiyafisa bona labo bantu babe ngaphasi kwami, ukuze ngibasuse. Wathi ku-Abhimeleki, Zihlanganiseni bonke abantu bakho, niphume!
UZebulu, umphathi wedolobhana, lapho elalela khona amazwi kaGaali unyana ka-Ebedi, waphoqa khulu.
Wathumela abathunywa ku-Abhimeleki, esithi, Bheka, uGahali unyana ka-Ebedi nabazalwane bakhe bafika eShechem; bona, bewucindezela lo mzi phezu kwakho.
Ngalokho namhlanje ekuseni, wena namadodana akho kufanele nifike nifihle emazweni.
Ngobusuku, lapho ilanga liphuma khona, hlasela lo mzi; bese ubona bona uGaali namadodana akhe ephuma ukubhekana nawe, wenze kubo konke okusemandleni.
Waphuma uAbhimeleki ekuseni, naye wonke amakhosi akhe, wafihla eShechem, waba ngamaqembu amane.
UGaali unyana ka-Ebedi waphuma, wahlala emgwaqeni womnyango wedolobhana, lapho uAbhimeleki nomndeni wakhe bephuma khona ezindaweni zabo zokuzifihla.
Wabona uGaali, wathi kuZebulu, "Njengombana abantu bephuma emadolobheni," waphendula uZebulu, "ubona isithunzi samadolobheni, begodu ucabanga bona yibo abantu."
UGaali waphendula wathi, "Njengombana abantu bephuma ephakathi kwezwe, begodu iqembu elinye livela emgwaqweni osuka enkabeni yomnqumo. "
Wathi uZebulu kuye, Kuphi namuhla inkulumo yakho enkulu, othi, Ubani uAbhimeleki, bona sisebenzele yena? Ingabe bangaba yibo abantu obabambisana nabo? Thola uphume ubhekane nabo!
Waphuma uGaali, wathatha abantu baka-Shekem, wabhekana noAbhimeleki.
U-Abhimeleki wamlandela, uGaali wehla, washaya abantu abaningi, bawela kuze kube yilapho kungena khona isango.
Wahlala uAbhimeleki e-Aruma, begodu uZebulu wakhipha uGaali nabazalwane bakhe e-Shekhem, ukuze bangahlali khona.
Kwathi ngosuku olulandelayo, abantu base-Shekem baphuma ezweni; kwabikwa ke ku-Abhimeleki.
Wathatha abantu bakhe, wabahlukanise abe ngamaqembu amathathu, wafihla ezweni; begodu lapho nakabona abantu bephuma emzini, wavuka, wahlasela.
U-Abhimeleki neqembu lakhe lafika, lahlala emgwaqeni wokungena edolobhaneni; begodu amaqembu amabili ahlasela labo abasezindaweni zasemaphandleni, wababulala.
U-Abhimeleki wahlasela lo mzi ngalolusuku lonke, wawuthatha, wambulala wonke umuntu ohlala kiwo; wehlisa lo mzi, wayibhaka ngamanzi.
Kwathi lapho abantu baseSikheme, abasesitezi esiphakeme, bekubona lokhu, bafika ezindaweni eziqinile zendlu ka-Elberithi.
U-Abhimeleki wazwa bona bahlangana khona.

Wakhuphuka, yena namadoda akhe onke, waya emfuleni iSalmon; wathatha inkomishi yakhe, wamisa amaqabunga, wabeka ezinyaweni zakhe. Wathi kubo bonke abantu ababenabo, Yize, nikwenze lokho okubona bona ngikwenza.

Bathi bonke abantu, bamisa izihlahla, balandela u-Abhimeleki, babeka phezu kwendlu ephakeme, bayiphonsa emlilweni, nayo yonke idolobhana eliphakathi kwayo. Wafa wonke umuntu ohlala esitezi esiphezulu saseShekem, amadoda nabesifazane ayizinkulungwane.
U-Abhimeleki wahamba waya eThebhesi, wayiqoqa yonke, wayithatha.
Ngaphakathi kwedolobha bekukhona inkundla eqinile, begodu bonke abantu bedolobha, amadoda nabesifazane, baphuma kuyo, bavala isango labo, banyuka phezulu esitezi senkundla.
U-Abhimeleki waya esitezi esiphakeme, wahlasela isitezi esiphezulu. Wafika emgwaqeni wesitezi esiphakeme ukuze avule umlilo kuso;
Uwesifazane washaya itshe elikhulu lokugaya phezu kwekhanda lakhe begodu waphuca intamo yakhe.
Wathi kulowo omncane ophethe isibhamu sakhe, Nciphisa ikhebula lakho, usindise; ukuze abantu bangathi, Uwesifazane wabulala yena. Wathi lowo omncane wathi kuye, Usindise.
Babona amaSirayeli bona u-Abhimeleki ufile, basuka bonke ezweni labo.
Ngalokhu uzimu wabuyisela ku-Abhimeleki ububi bakhe, obukwenzela ubaba wakhe, lapho ebulala khona abazalwane bakhe abamashumi asixhenxe.
Begodu uzimu wababuyisela abantu baseShekhemi ngenxa yobubi babo bonke; kwafika phezu kwabo isibhamu sikaYothamu, unyana kaYerubahali.
Ngosuku luka-Abhimeleki, kwavuka uThola, indodana kaPhuha, indodana kaDodo, wabasindisa isizwe samaSirayeli; wayengumJuda wase-Issakare, wahlala eShamire, ezweni eliphakeme likaEphrayi.
Waphatha isizwe sakwaSirayeli iminyaka eyishumi nambili nesithathu; wafa, wabanjwa eShamiri.
Ngemva kwakhe kwavela uYahiri waseGileyadi, waba ngumthetho wakwaSirayeli iminyaka eyishumi nambili nambili.
Waba nezingane ezingu-30, abahamba ngezinkomo ezingu-30; balawula ezindaweni eziyisishiyagalombili zaseGiliyadi (zibizwa bona yizintaba zikaYahiri kuze kube namuhla).
Wafa uYahiri, wabanjwa eKamoni.

Baphinde bakwenza oonyana bakaSirayeli lokho okumbi emehloni kaYehova, bekhonza amaBaali, nama-Ashtorethi, nama-Aram, nama-Sidon, namaMowabi, namadodana ka-Amoni, namaFilisti; bashiya ikosi, bangawusebenzisi.
UYehova wagwema amaSirayeli, wabathengisa emaFilistini nakwa-Amoni.

Ngaleso sikhathi izizwe ezinjalo zahlasela, zabulala amadodana aseSirayeli, iminyaka eyisibhozo nesishiyagalombili, wonke amadodana aseSirayeli ahlala ngaphesheya koMfula iYorodani, eGiliyadi, ezweni lama-Amori.
Badlula namadodana ka-Amoni iJordani, bahlasela uYuda noBhenjamini noEfrayim; begodu amaSirayeli ahlupheke khulu.
Baphoqa ke oonyana bakaSirayeli kuYehova, bathi, Siwuhlwele wena; sishiye uzimu wethu, sakhonza amaBaali.
Wathi ikosi, Uma befika ama-Egyptians, nama-Amorites, nama-Ammonites, namaFilisti,
Aba-Sidoni, naba-Amaleki, nama-Maoni, baphoqeleka bona banikeze isandla sabo kuwe; begodu wena ukhala ngami, ngingakusindisi yini?
Kodwana-ke, ningishiya, nikhonza amasiko amanye; ngalokho-ke ngeke ngikusindise.
Chofoza emadini akho, awazikhethele wena; azokusindisa ngesikhathi sobuhlungu bakho.
Bathi ke oonyana bakaSirayeli kuYehova, Sifile; yenza nathi konke okulungile emehlo akho; kodwana manje sicela usindise.
Basusa izitha zakwamanye amazwe eziphakathi kwabo, bakhonza ikosi. uzimu akakwazi ukumelana nokubona isizwe samaSirayeli sihlupheka.
Amadodakazi ka-Amoni aqoqwa, wamisa isibhedlela eGileyadi; begodu amaSirayeli ahlangana, wamisa isibhedlela eMizpa.
Bathi abaholi bezizwe zaseGiliyadi, umuntu nomuntu, bona: Ubani na ozoqala ukulwa nabantu baka-Amoni, uzobe nguMengameli wabahlali bonke baseGiliyadi.
UJephthah waseGiliyadi ube ngumuntu onamandla amakhulu; ubaba wakhe wayenguGiliyadi, begodu udadewabo wayengumfana ohamba ngezinja.
Umfazi kaGileyadi wazala naye izingane, zakhula zikhulu; bakhipha uYephtha, bathi kuye, Awuzothola inkontileka emndenini wethu, ngombana ungumntwana wowesifazane wesizwe.
Waphuma uJephthah ezindaweni zabazalwane bakhe, wahlala ezweni lase-Tobhi. Bahlangana naye abantu ababi, baphuma nabo, behlasela.
Ngaleso sikhathi, ama-Amoni aqala ukulwa nabaSirayeli.
Kwathi lapho, abakhulu baseGiliyadi bahamba, ukuba babuyisele uJephthah ezweni laseTobhi.
Bathi kuye, Thola, ube ngumholi wethu, ukuze sihlangane nabantu baka-Amoni.
Wathi kubo uJephtha, Ingabe ningangixoli, nimimise endlwini yobaba wami? Kungani na ke bona nifike kimi manje, uma nisengozini?
Bathi kubo abakhulu baseGileyadi, Ngenxa lalokho sibuyela kuwe manje; phuma nathi, ubhekane nabantwana baka-Amoni, ukuze ube yinhloko yabahlali bonke baseGileyadi.
Wathi uJephthah, Uma ngibuyela wena ukubhekana namadodakazi ka-Amoni, begodu ikosi anginikela kiwo, ngabe ngizoba nguMengameli wenu?
Bathi abakhulu baseGiliyadi, UYehova uzoba ngubufakazi phakathi kwethu, uma singakwenza njalo njengombana uthi.
Wahamba uJephthah namadoda amakhulu eGiliyadi, abantu bakwenza abe yinhloko sabo, abe nguMengameli wabo; wakhuluma amazwi akhe wonke phambi koYehova eMizpa.
Wathumela uJephthah abathunywa kuye ukumkani wakwa-Amoni, esithi, Uyini umthwalo wakho nami, wukuthi wafika ukuhlasela izwe lami?

Waphendula ukumkani wakwa-Amoni abathunywa bakaJephtha, wathi, AbaSirayeli bathathe izwe lami, lapho bephuma eYiputa, kusukela eArnoni kuya eYabhoki, kuze kube yiJordani; ngalokho namuhla uphinde uzibuyisele ngokuzola.
UJephthah wathumela abathunywa emuva ukumkani wezingane ze-Ammon,
wathi, Lokhu kusho uJephthah: Isirayeli asithathenga izwe lakwaMowabi, noma izwe lakwa-Amoni.
Kwathi, lapho amaSirayeli ephuma eYiputa, bedlula emifuleni yaseGibhithe, bafike emfuleni oMnyama, bafika eKadeshi.

Bathumela abathunywa ukumkani wase-Edom, bathi, Sicela uvumele sidlule ezweni lakho; kodwana ukumkani wase-Edom akakutholi. Bathumela begodu ukumkani wakwaMowabi ngomthetho owodwa, naye akakuvumeli; ngalokho bahlala amaSirayeli eKadesi.
Basuka behamba esiqhingini, bajikeleza iEdomu neMowabi; badlula ngasenyakatho yeMowabi, bamisa isikhashana ngaphesheya kwe-Arnoni. Bengafika ezweni lakwaMowabi, ngombana i-Arnoni ibingumkhawulo wabo.
Wathumela amaSihoni, ukumkani wama-Amori, obehlala eHeshboni, wathi kuye: Size sihambe ngezwe lakho, sifike endaweni yethu.
Kodwana uShehoni akakholwanga kuSirayeli ukuba adlule ezweni lakhe; waqoqa wonke umkhosi wakhe, wamisa isibhedlela eYahazi, wabhekana noSirayeli.
Wabeka ikosi, uzimu kaSirayeli, uShehoni nomndeni wakhe wonke esandla sakwaSirayeli; babulala bonke abantu bakhe. USirayeli wafumana izwe lonke lama-Amori ahlala kulolu lizwe.
Bayithatha yonke, kusukela eArnoni kuya eYabhoki, nasuka esiqhingini kuze kube iJordani.
Ngokuba ikosi, uzimu kaSirayeli, wakhipha ama-Amori phambi kwabantu bakhe baseSirayeli; wena ke unelungelo elinjani lokuthatha indawo sabo?
Uzothatha yini lokho okunikezwa nguKemoshi, uzimu wakho? Ngalokho sizothatha konke okunikezwe nguYehova uzimu wethu.
Ungcono yini wena kunaBalaka, unyana kaSipore, ukumkani wakwaMowabi? Ingabe wabhekana namakhosikazi aseSirayeli, noma wabhekana nabo?
Iminyaka eyikhulu namashumi amathathu abantu bakaSirayeli behlala eHeshboni, nase-Aroeri, nezifundela zayo, namadolobhana onke asendaweni yaseArnoni; kungani ke ningazithola ngaleso sikhathi?
Ngingeke ngikubisele, kodwana wena ungenza okumbi, ngombana uhamba ngami. UYehova, ummeli, agweme namhlanje phakathi kwamadodana kaSirayeli namadodana ka-Amoni.
Nokho ukumkani wakwa-Amoni akhenge ayiqonde incwadi kaJephtha, eyamthumela yona.
Wafika uMoya kaYehova kuJephtha, wadlula eGiliyadi noManase, wadlula eMizpa eGiliyadi, wadlula namadodana ka-Amoni.
UJephthah wenza isibopho kukaNkulunkulu, wathi: "Uma unikela izingane zakwa-Amoni esandla sami,
noma yini ephuma emgwaqeni wasekhaya, ifike ngiyihlangane nami, uma ngibuya ngokuphephile ekuphileni namadodana ka-Amoni, izobe yiyo yeNkosi; begodu ngizoyinikela ibe ngumnikelo wokushiswa.
Wahamba uJephthah, wahlasela amadodana ka-Amoni; ikosi wabanikela esandla sakhe.
Wabulala izizwe ezingu-20, kusukela eAroeri kuya enkabeni yeMinithi, kuze kube yi-Abeli-kerami; wahlasela ngamandla amakhulu. Babekwa ngaphasi kwesandla samaSirayeli.

Kwathi lapho uJephthah efika ekhaya lakhe eMizpa, ngubani na ozophuma ahlangana naye, ngaphandle kwendodana yakhe, edanisa ngosayizi wezinkomo? Waye yena kuphela indodana yakhe. Akekho omunye unyana noma intombi.
Wakubona, waxosha izigqoko zakhe, wathi, Hayi, inkosikazi yami; ungenza buhlungu obukhulu, nobuhlungu obukhulu, ngombana ngibekele ikosi isibopho, begodu angeke ngiyiphule.
Wathi yena, Ubaba wami, ubulale ithemba kuYehova; ngenza kimi ngokufana nalokho okwenzelayo, njengombana ikosi ebeke emuva izimpi zakho ezizungeze oonyana baka-Amoni.
Wathi, "Nceda ungisize isikhalazo esisodwa kuphela. Nceda ungisize izinyanga ezimbili ukuze ngihambe emadolobheni nabangani bam begodu ngilile ngombana angikaze ngife."
Wathi, "Ungaya," wavumela ukuba ahambe iminyaka emibini. Wahamba naye nabangane bakhe ezindaweni eziphakeme begodu bakhala bona ngeke abe nendodana.
Wabuya ubaba wakhe ngemuva kwezinyanga ezimbili, wakwenza kuye njengombana atjhilo. Akekho umuntu umfazi ayengena naye. Kulokhu kwavela isiko ezweni lakwaSirayeli,
bona ngonyaka ngamunye izimfana zakwaSirayeli ziphuma ngezinsuku ezine, ukuze ziyikhumbula intombi kaJephtha waseGileyadi.

Amadodana ka-Ephrayim ahlanganisa amaqembu abo, adlula eZafoni, wathi kuYephtha, Kungani na bona ukhambe ukubhekana nabantu baka-Amoni, ungasikhombiseni bona sizohamba nawe? Sizovala indlu yakho ngaphakathi kwakho.
Waphendula uJephtha, wathi: Nginempi enkulu phakathi kwami nami nomndeni wami namadodana ka-Amoni; ngakubiza wena, kodwana awungisindisi ebusweni babo.
Uma ngibona bona ningangisizanga, ngabeka impilo yami enhliziyweni yami, ngadlula ngibhekane namadodakazi ka-Amoni; begodu ikosi wandisindisa. Ngabe ke kungani nifika namuhla ningihlasela?"
UJephthah waqoqa bonke abantu baseGiliyadi, wabhekana noEfrayim; begodu amadoda aseGiliyadi awahlasela, ngombana ama-Efrayim ayethi, Nibasubathi abasuka eGiliyadi, nisuka ku-Efrayim nakumaManase.

Amadoda aseGiliyadi athathe iziqhingi zeJordani eziya eEphrayim. Ngaso soke isikhathi lapho umuntu osuka ku-Ephrayim ekhuluma, ethi, Ngizodlula, amadoda aseGiliyadi ayembuza, ethi, Ingabe unguye u-Ephrayim? Uma esethi, Hayi,

Bathi: "Kulungile, sithi uSibholethe." Uma atjhilo bona uSibholethe, ngenxa yokuthi akakwazi ukuveza igama ngokucacile, bathatha yena, bambulala emfuleni iYorodani. Kwabulawa abantu abangumashumi amane nambili amawaka kuEfrayim ngalo mzuzu.
UJephthah waba ngummengameli wakwaSirayeli iminyaka eyisishiyagalombili. Wafa uJephthah waseGiliyadi, washiswa emzini waseGiliyadi.
Ngemva kwakhe, u-Ibzan waseBethelehemu waongoza isiSirayeli.

Waba namadodana amashumi amathathu, nezingane ezilishumi elinambini. Wabeka izingane zakhe esikoleni kwabanye abantu ngaphandle kwendlu yakhe; wafumana amadodana akhe amantombazane amashumi amathathu ngaphandle kwendlu yakhe. U-Ibsan waba nguMengameli wamaSirayeli iminyaka eyisithupha.
Wafa ke u-Ibzan, wabanjwa eBethelehemu.
Ngemuva kwakhe, u-Elon waseZabuloni waba ngummengameli wakwaSirayeli iminyaka elishumi.
Wafa uElon, wabanjwa eAyaloni, ezweni likaZebulun.
Ngemva kwakhe, uAbdon, unyana kaHileli, wasePirathoni, waba nguMengameli wamaSirayeli.
Wabe nabantwana abangumashumi amane, nabangani abangumashumi amathathu, abahamba ngezinkomo eziyisixhenxe; waphatha isizwe samaSirayeli iminyaka eyisibhozo.
Wafa uAbdon, unyana kaHileli, wabanjwa ePirathoni, eEphrayim, ezweni eliphakeme lama-Amaleki.
Baphinde bakwenza oonyana bakaSirayeli okumbi emehloni kaYehova; ikosi wabanikela esandla samaFilisti iminyaka emashumi amane.
Kwabe kukhona umuntu okuthiwa nguManawo, waseZora, wesizwe sakwaDan; indodana yakhe yayingenazo izingane, ayizange ikhule.
Wabonakala kuye umbingeleli kaYehova, wathi kuye, Thola bona awunabantwana; kodwana bheka, uzokhulelwa, begodu uzozala indodana.
Ngalokho qaphela bona ungadli iwayini, noma uphuze isiphuzo esinobuthi, begodu ungadla nanoma yini engalungile.

Begodu, bheka, uzokhulelwa, uzala indodana, begodu akufanele ikhanda lakhe lifinyelelwe ngentambo; ngombana lo mntwana uzobe Nazirithi kaThixo kusukela emlenzeni wakhe; begodu yena uzoqala ukusindisa amaSirayeli kusuka kumaFilisti.

Waphuma umfazi, waya kumuntu wakhe, wathi kuye, Kwangifika indodana kaThixo; yabona, isithombe sayo safana nesithunywa sikaThixo, samangalisa khulu; ngayibuza bona ivelaphi, naye angitshelanga igama lakhe.

Wathi kuye, Khona-ke uzokhulelwa, uzala indodana; ngalokho-ke ungadlanga iwayini noma isiphuzo esingcolileyo, begodu ungadli lutho olubi; ngombana lo mntwana uzobe nguNazireli kaThixo kusukela emlenzeni wakhe kuze kube yilapho efa khona.
Wathandaza uManawo kuYehova, wathi, Ngiyabonga, Kosi yami, bona umuntu kaThixo owathumelelayo aphinde afike kuthi, afundise bona sizokudla kanjani umntwana oza kuza.
uzimu waphendula uManawothi; begodu umprofeti kaThixo wabuya waya kumkakhe, lapho uhlala khona esivandeni; kodwana indodana yakhe, uManawothi, akhenge abe naye.
Wayehamba ngokushesha, watshela indodana yakhe, wathi, Yabona, lowo muntu owafika kwami mhla kathathu, uvela.
Wavuka uManawo, walandela indodana yakhe, waya kulowo muntu, wathi kuye, Ingabe wena owakhuluma nendodana yami? Wathi yena, Ngami.
Wathi uManawothi kuye, "Uma kwenzeka lokho okushoyo, yini okufanele siyenze ngokuphathelene nalo mfundi?"
Waphendula umbingeleli kaYehova, wathi, Inkosikazi yakho kumele ikwenze konke okungiwiselayo.
Akudingeki bona aphuze lutho oluvela emvini, begodu akudingeki bona aphuze iwayini, noma utshwala, begodu akudingeki bona aphuze lutho olubi; kumele agcine konke engikumwiselayo.
Wathi uManawothi kuyisengathi kaYehova, Nceda ulinde, kuze silungiselele wena inkomo encane.
Wathi uMoya oNgcwele kuye, Nakuba ngihlala, angidla ukudla kwakho; kodwana uma ulungiselela isiphuzo esiqhumayo, uyinike ikosi. UManawo awazi bona ube yikosi yoMoya oNngcwele.
Wathi uManawothi kuyisengathi kaYehova, Ithini igama lakho, ukuze sikwazi ukukuhlonipha uma kwenziwa amazwi akho?
Wathi, "Ngabe ubuza igama lami? Kuyinhle khulu ukukuqonda."
Wathi uManawo, athathe inkunzi yengulube, nomnikelo wokudla, wanikela ngazo kuYehova phezu komlilo. uzimu wenza into emangalisayo phambi kwamehlo kaManawo nomkakhe.
Kwathi lapho umlilo ekhuphuka emgodini wesitezi esiphakade, wanyuka umlingisi kaYehova emgodini. UManowa nomfazi bakhe bekubona lokhu, bawela phasi ngobuso babo.
Umbingeleli kaYehova akabonakali uManawothi nomfazi wakhe; ngaleso sikhathi uManawothi waqonda bona ube yimbingeleli kaYehova.
Wathi kunkosikazi yakhe: "Sizofa, ngombana sabona uzimu!"

Kodwana indodana yakhe yaphendula, ethi, Uma ikosi efuna ukusibulala, akakwazanga ukuba nesibopho sokudla kwethu nokuphuza kwethu; akakwazanga ukusibonisa zonke lezi zinto, noma ukusitshela konke lokhu.
Uwesifazane wazala indodana, wathi igama lakhe nguSamsoni. Wakhula, begodu ikosi wamsindisa.
Waqala uMoya kaYehova ukuba khona kuye eMahanaye-Dan, phakathi kweZora neEshtaoli.
Waphuma uSamsoni waya eTimna, wabona khona indodakazi yaseFilisti.
Wabuya, watshela ubaba wakhe nomama wakhe, wathi, Ngibona indodakazi yaseFilisti eThimna; namuhla niyithathe ngiyithathe ibe ngumfazi wami.

Wathi ubaba wakhe nonina kuye, Ingabe ayikho indodakazi efanele phakathi kwabangane bakho, noma phakathi kwabantu bethu bonke? Uzohamba yini wena kilabo baseFilisti abangenakutholwa, ukuze uthathe indodana? Wathi uSamsoni kuyise, Yithole yena kimi; ngombana uyayithanda.
Abazali bakhe babengazi bona lokhu kungenxa kaYehova, ngombana wayefuna ukubhekana nabaseFilisti; begodu ngaleso sikhathi amaFilisti ayelawula isizwe samaSirayeli.
Waphuma uSamsoni nobaba wakhe nomama wakhe, waya eTimna. Bafika emavinini aseTimna, kwabonakalisa ingulube encane isuka emgwaqeni, ikhuluma kuye.
UMoya kaYehova wehla phezu kuka-Shamshon, wamisa ingulube ngezandla zakhe ezimnyama, njengokuthi umuntu amise inkomo encane; kodwana akatshela ubaba wakhe, noma udadewabo, into ayeyenza.
Waphuma, wakhuluma nomkakhe, wathandana naye khulu.
Ngosuku oluthile, lapho ebuyela khona ukushada naye, washintsha indawo ukuze abhekane nenyama yengulube. Kuyo bekukhona inqwaba yamakhowe namafutha omnqumo.

Wathi, "Ingane yami," waphendula yena, "uma ngikutshela bona udadewethu u-Abhimeleki uthathe ingulube, ngizoyidla." Wathi, "Ubaba wami nomama wami bafuna ukuthenga ingulube, kodwana akhenge anitshele bona wathatha ingulube emlonyeni wengulube.
Waphuma ubaba wakhe ukuba abone indodakazi yakhe, wakwenza khona isidlo, njengokuba kwaba njalo phakathi kwamadodana.
Kwathi lapho abantu bekubona, bakhetha amadoda amashumi amathathu ukuba abe ngabangane bakhe.

Wathi kubo uSamsoni, Ngizokutshela inkulumo; uma ningichaza kulolu suku oluyisixhenxe lwesidlo sakusihlwa, ngizokunika izigqoko ezimhlophe ezingamashumi amathathu, nezicathulo ezahlukene eziyishumi nambili.
Uma ningangitshelanga, ngizodinga bona ninikele izicathulo ezingu-30 zesikhumba esimhlophe kanye nezigqoko eziyi-30 zokushintshana. Bathi ke kubo: Sebenzisa inkulumo yakho ukuze siyicabangele;
Wathi, Kusuka kulowo odla kwaphuma ukudla, begodu kulowo onamandla kwaphuma okumnandi. Kwaba zinsuku amathathu bengeke bakwazi ukuveza isixazululo.

Ngosuku oluyisixhenxe, bathi kubo indodana kaShamshon, Thola umyeni wakho ukuba acacisele iphupho lethu; uma engakwenzanga lokhu, sizokusindisa wena nendlu yobaba wakho ngomlilo. Ufuna ukusibulala yini bona uthumelele lapha?

Wathi indodana ka-Shamshon kuye, ethi, Ungikhohlisa; awuthandani nami; ubeke iphupho emphakathini wami, kodwana wawungazitshela. Wathi yena, Ngingeke ngikutshele ubaba wami noma umama wami; kungani ngikutshele wena?
Wathi yena, "Imini eyisishiyagalombili amalanga ezisixhenxe umkhosi. Ngosuku lwesine, waveza kuye, ngombana wayeqhubeka ukucindezela kuye, begodu waveza umbuzo wakhe abantu bakhe.

Ngosuku oluyisixhenxe, ngaphambi kokuba ilanga liphele, abantu basemzini bathi kuye: Yini emnandi kunamafutha omnqumo? Ingabe yini enamandla kunalelinyoni? Wathi kubo uSamsoni, Uma bekungaba sekuyintombi yami engenhla, ningeke nithole impendulo yombuzo wami.

UMoya kaYehova wehla phezu kwakhe, waya e-Ashkeloni, wabulala abantu abamashumi amathathu, wathatha izinto zabo, wabanika izigqoko zabo labo abachazayo isifinyezo; wabuyela ekhaya lakhe ubaba wakhe, enhliziyweni yakhe igcwele inkohliso.
Nokho indodana ka-Samson yanikezwa omunye wabalingani bakhe, owayengumuntu wakhe ongcono.
Kwathi lapho kuhlanzekile bona imbewu yengulube ivuna, uSamsoni wathatha inkomo encane, waya emndenini wakhe. Wathi, "Ngizoya ekamelweni lakhe." Kodwana ubaba wakhe akhenge amvumele ukuba afike.
Wathi: "Ngiyaqiniseka bona uyamkhohlisa, ngalokho ngamnika umngane wakho. Ingabe inkosikazi yakhe encane ayihle khulu? Nceda uyithathe endaweni yakhe."
Wathi kubo uSamsoni, Ngalokhu ngizobe sengilungile, uma ngenza okumbi kilabo baseFilisti.
Waphuma, wafumana izimvu ezimakhulu amathathu; wazibopha ingulube ngengulube, ngamadodakazi amabili, wabeka isibhakabhaka kulowo mntwana.
Wamisa amabhande, wakhipha izimvu ezihuquzela phambili phakathi kwezinkomo zakwaFilisti; wabulala izinkomishi zokudla okuthosiwe, nezinkomo ezihuquzela phambili, namachibi e-olive.

Bathi amaFilisti, Ubani owakwenza lokhu? Baphendula bathi, USamsoni, umngane wowesifazane waseTimna; ngombana indodakazi yakhe yanikezwa umngane wakhe. Baye ke amaFilisti, babulala yena nobaba wakhe ngomlilo.
Wathi kubo uSamsoni, Ngokuba nikwenze lokhu, ngeke ngiphumule, kuze kube yilapho ngibuyele ekuphileni kwenu.
Wabahlasela, wabulala abantu abaningi phakathi kwabo; waphuma ke, wahlala emgodini weqhwa lase-Etham.
Bafika amaFilisti, bamisa isibhedlela ezweni laseYuda, basakazeka eLehi.
Bathi abantu baseYuda, Yini na bona nifike nibhekane nathi? Baphendula bathi, Siye safika ukubopha uSamsoni, ukuze sikwenze njengombana esenze kuthi.

Kwathi abantu abangumakhulu amathathu baseYuda bahla embuzweni weqhwa lase-Etham, bathi kuShamshon: Awazi yini bona amaFilisti alawula phezu kwethu? Uthini lo msebenzi owenza kuthi? Waphendula uShamshon, wathi, Ngabe ngibasebenzela njengokuba bengisebenzele?
Bathi kuye, Sifike ukukubopha, ukuze sikunikeze isandla sakwaFilisti. Wathi uSamsoni, Ngicela, zinikele ngami bona ningangibulala nizo.
Bathi kuye, Siyavuma. Sizokubopha nje, begodu sizokulethela kubo; kodwana asikubulalanga. Bawubopha ngentambo ezimbili ezisha, bawuphakamisa ehlathini, waphuma lapho, waya ezweni laseSirayeli.

Wafika eLehi, kwathi amaFilisti aphuma emveni kwakhe, eshaya ngamandla. UMoya kaYehova wehla phezu kwakhe, begodu izibopho ezimilenzeni zakhe zashintsha zibe njengezinkuni ezishisayo, zisuka ezandleni zakhe.
Wafumana ikhanda elisha lengulube, walimaza abantu abangu-elilodwa ngalo.
Wathi uSamsoni, Ngiziguqule zibe izidumbu ngemilenze yengulube, ngizibeke izingcezu phezu kwezingcezu; ngemilenze yengulube ngabulala abantu abangumakhulu.
Kwathi lapho eqedile ukukhuluma, wakhipha ikhanda lakhe; ngalokho kwabizwa igama lesi sifundazwe bona iRamat-lehi.
Uthe: "Uwenzile umkhonzi wakho lo kubuyiso olukhulu; manje ngizofa yini ngendlala, begodu ngifike enhliziyweni yalabo abangenakulinganiswa?"

uzimu wavula indawo encane eLehi, amanzi aphuma kuyo. Lapho uSamsoni edla khona, amandla akhe abuyela emuva, begodu wayezizwa ephila kabutjha. Ngalokho kwabizwa bona i-En Hakkore, okusho bona i-Spring of the Caller. Ikhona eLehi.
USamsoni waphatha isizwe sakwaSirayeli iminyaka eyishumi nambili, ezikhathini zabaFilisti.
Ngosuku olulodwa uSamson wahamba waya eGaza, lapho nakabona khona indodakazi yowesifazane, waphuma wahlala naye.

Bathi abantu baseGaza, besithi, USamsoni usekhona. Bangabaleke khona ezindaweni ezishisayo, babhekane naye yonke ibusuku emgwaqeni wedolobhana; begodu bangene ngokuthula wonke ubusuku bonke, bathi: Uma kuphele isibhakabhaka sizowubulala.

USamsoni wahlala khona kuze kube sebusuku obuphakathi. Wavuka, wabamba amasango emnyango wedolobhana, namahlombe amabili, wavula amehlo akhe ngazo zonke izingxenye zawo; wazifaka ezinyaweni zakhe, wazisa phezulu emfuleni obhekene neHebrone.
Isikhathi esithileko ngemuva kwalokho, wathandana nomfazi eValley of Sorek okuthiwa uDelila.

Bafike kuye abaphathi bamaFilisti, bathi kuye, Khangela, uma ungamxhumanisa nawe, ukuze akutshele bona yikuphi amandla akhe amakhulu, nokuthi singawunqoba kanjani, ukuze sikwazi ukuwubopha, begodu sikwazi ukumsindisa; sizokunika wonke umuntu wethu amashekeli ayikhulu nesishiyagalombili egolide.
Wathi uDalilaya kuSamsoni, Ngicela, ngisazise bona yikuphi amandla akho amakhulu, nokuthi ungaboniswa kanjani.
Wathi uSamsoni kuye, Uma umuntu engibophe ngezingcezu eziyisixhenxe zezinkomo eziluhlaza, ezingabi ziqhekekile, khona-ke ngizoba mncane, ngifana nomuntu onje.
Bathi abaphathi bamaFilisti bakulethela izintambo ezimnyama eziyisixhenxe, ezingabi zimanzi; wagwema uDavide ngazo.

Wathi yena kuye, "Samson, amaFilisti baya phezu kwakho!" Kodwana wavala intambo yakhe ngesandla sakhe, njengokuba intambo ivala uma ifika ezungeze umlilo. Ngalokho isifihla-buso sekhono lakhe akhenge akwazi ukubona.
Wathi uDalida ku-Samsoni, Ungikhohlisa; bengixosha. Manje ke, ngikucela, utshele bona ungaboshwa kanjani.
Wathi, "Uma kukhona umuntu uveza ngamandla ngentambo ezintsha bona akhenge asebenzise, ngizobe encane njengenoma ubani."
Wathatha uDalida intambo ezintsha, wamkhonze ngazo. Wathi kuye, "AbaFilisti baya kuwe, uSamsoni!" Kodwana yena wasusa izintambo ezisuka emilenzeni yakhe, wazenza zibe yizintambo zocingo.

Wathi uDalilaya kuSamsoni, "Ungikhohlakele ngalezo zinsuku zonke, begodu ungikhohlisa; tshelani bona ungaxhunywa kanjani." Wathi yena kuye, "Uma unquma ukubopha izinwele zami ezisixhenxe emgodini wakho, bese uzicindezela ngezinkinobho, khona-ke ngizoba mkhulu njenganoma ngimuphi umuntu."
Wayehlala ephumula, wabeka izinwele zakhe emlonyeni wakhe, wazigqugquzela ngentambo. Yathi kuye: "USamsoni, abaFilisti baya kuwe!" Wavuka embhedeni wakhe, wakhipha intambo noboya bemikhono yakhe.
Wathi kuye, Ungathi kanjani bona, Ngikuthandela, uma ungenasiqiniseko ngami? Lokho wusuku lwesithathu bona ungikhohlisa, begodu awufuni ukungitshela isizathu sokuzinikela kwakho okukhulu.
Wayeqhubeka nokwenza ubuhlungu kuye ngosuku ngalunye kuze kube yilapho etholakale enesifo sokufa.

Wathi yena kuye, "Akukho mshini wokugqugquzela ikhanda lami; ngombana ngiyiNazirisi kaThixo kusukela enyameni yami; uma ngigqugquzelwe ikhanda lami, khona-ke amandla ami azondishiya, begodu ngizobe sengincane njenganoma ngimuphi umuntu."

Wabona uDalida bona waveza kuye zonke izinto zakhe, wathumela kubaholi bamaFilisti, esithi, Yeni namuhla; ngombana angitshela zonke izinto zakhe. Bafika khona abaphathi bamaFilisti, bethwala imali ngesandla sabo.
Yathi: "Uzohlala kuphi?" Wathi yena: "Ngizohlala kuphi?" Wathi: "Uzohlala kuphi?" Wathi: "Uzohlala kuphi?"
Wathi, USamsoni, abaFilisti baphikisa kuwe. Wavuka embhedeni wakhe, wathi, Ngizophuma ngalezo zinsuku zokuqala, begodu ngizikhulise; kodwana akawazi bona ikosi ubemshiya yena.
Bathi amaFilisti amthatha, baphuca imehlo akhe, bamthabatha waya eGaza, bamkhonze ngezingcingo zegolide, wabeka emgodini wokugcina izinto.
Kodwana-ke, izinwele ekhanda lakhe zaqala ukukhula begodu ngemuva kokuba zikhishwe.
Bahlangana abaphathi bamaFilisti, ukuba balungiselele isibingelelo esikhulu kuDagoni uzimu wabo, begodu bona baphumule; ngombana bathi, uzimu wethu unikeze esandla sethu uSamsoni umnakwabo.
Kwathi lapho abantu bekubona, babonga uzimu wabo, bathi: "uzimu wethu ubeke emandleni ethu umnakwabo wethu, lowo obulalayo izwe lethu, nommelwane wethu omkhulu.
Bathi, uma inhliziyo sabo isendaweni ephakeme khulu, bathi: "Thindani uShamshon, ukuze adlala nathi!" Bemwisela uShamshon emgodini, wadlala kubo; babeka phakathi kwezinhlamvu.
Wathi uSamsoni kulowo mfundi owenza isandla sakhe, Nquma bona ngizibonele izikhonkwane ezigcina indlu, ukuze ngizibeke phezu kwazo.
Indlu yayigcwele amadoda nababhishobhi; bonke abaphathi bamaFilisti babekhona, begodu esitezi bekukhona abantu abangamakhulu amathathu amadoda nababhishobhi abheka uSamsoni.

Wathandaza uSamsoni kuYehova, wathi, Ngiyabonga, Kosi yami uThixouNkulunkulu, ngingathandabuzi ukungikhumbula; ngiyakucela, Kosi yami uThixouThixo, ngibe nokuzibophezela ngaleso sikhathi nje kuphela, ukuze ngibuyele ngamehlo ami amabini emaFilistini ngesandla esisodwa.
USamsoni wehlisa isandla sakhe, wafinyelela emikhondweni emibini ephakathini, eyayiyisisekelo sendlu, wabeka isandla sakhe sokudla phezu kwesinye sazo, nesandla sakhe sobunxele phezu kwesinye sazo.

Wathi uSamsoni, Ngizofa nami nabaseFilisti; washaya ngesandla sakhe samandla wonke, begodu ithempeli lawela phezu kwabaphathi kanye nabantu bonke abangaphakathi kulo. Wabulala abantu abaningi ngesikhathi sokufa kwakhe kunalapho ephila khona.

Baye ke abazalwane bakhe, nendlu yonke yobaba wakhe, bewuthatha, bawuthwala, bawufihla emgodini kaManowa ubaba wakhe, phakathi kweSora ne-Eshtaoli. UShamshon waba ngummeli wakwaSirayeli iminyaka emashumi mahlanu.
Kwabe kukhona umuntu okuthiwa nguMikha, owayehlala ezweni lemifula ka-Ephrayim.

Wathi kunkosikazi yakhe, "Umuntu uthathe kusuka kuwe amashekeli ayikhulu nesishiyagalombili egolide, begodu ngakulalela bona unqume lo mshayeli; namuhla ngithole lemali, ngiyitholile." Unkosikazi wakhe waphendula wathi, "uzimu akubabaze wena, mwana wami!"

Wathi uSirayeli kuyise: "Imali enjalo ngiyinikela kuYehova, umngane wami, ukuze enze itshe elicwebezelwe ngegolide; ngalokho-ke manje ngiyibuyisele kuwe." Wathi uSirayeli kuyise: "Imali enjalo ngiyinikela kuYehova, umngane wami, ukuze enze itshe elicwebezelwe ngegolide.
Wayibuyisela isiliva emnene wakhe. Wathi umnene wakhe, athathe ama-shekeli ayikhulu amabili, wamthumela kulowo osebenza ngegolide, wakwenza ngazo isithunzi; safakwa endlwini kaMika.
UMikha wayene-altare, wakwenza i-ephod nezinhlamvu zasekhaya; wamisa omunye wabonyana bakhe abe ngumpristi wakhe.
Ngaleso sikhathi, kwakungekho ukumkani ezweni lakwaSirayeli; wonke umuntu wayekwenza okulungile emehlo akhe.
Kwaba khona umuntu omncane waseLevi osuka eBethlehem, emzini wakwaYuda, osuka emndenini wakwaYuda, wahlala khona.
Washiya uBhetheleyimu waseYuda, efuna indawo yokuhlala kuyo; wafika ekhaya likaMikha ezweni eliphakeme laseEphrayimi.
Wathi kuye uMika, Uvela phi? Waphendula wathi, NginguLevi osuka eBhethele-yimu yaseYuda, ngifuna indawo yokuhlala kuyo.

Wathi kuye uMika, Uhlale nami, ube ngubaba wami nombingeleli wam; begodu ngizokunikela ngeshekeli eziyisithupha zesiliva ngonyaka ngamunye, nokugqoka izicathulo kanye nekudla kwakho. Wenza njalo lo mLevi.
Wavuma uLevi ukuba ahlale naye; waba ngumuntu omncane njengomunye wabantwana bakhe.
UMika wamisa uLevi, lo mshado waba ngumpristi wakhe, wahlala ekhaya lakhe.
Wathi uMikha: Manje ngiyazi bona ikosi uzongilungisa, ngombana lo mLevi ube ngumpristi wami.
Ngaleso sikhathi kwakungekho ukumkani eSirayeli, begodu ngaleso sikhathi isizwe samaDani safuna indawo esihlala kuyo; ngombana asikaze sithole inkontileka phakathi kwezizwe zakwaSirayeli.

Bathumela abantu abahlanu, amadodana kaDan, emindenini sabo, amadoda anamandla amakhulu, kusukela eZora ne-Eshtaoli, ukuba ahlolisise izwe, ukuze athole bona linjani. Bathi kubo, Yezani niphenye izwe. Bafika emadolobheni amahle aseEfraim, baphumula ekhaya likaMika.
Bafika efulethini likaMikha, bakwazi ilizwi lowesifazane waseLevi; bafike bathi kuye, Ubani owakulethela lapha? Yini oyenza kulo mhlaba? Kungani na ukhona lapha?
Wathi kubo lokho akwenzele uMikha, wathi, "Ungiqeshile, ngibe ngumpristi wakhe."
Bathi kuye: "Njengombana sicela uzimu wethu, uma uhambo lwethu lulungile."
Wabaphendula umbingeleli, wathi kubo, Yiya ngokuthula; indlela yenu ibhekene nozimu.

Basuka ke labo bantu bomibili, bafika eLayisi; babona bona abantu baseLayisi behlala khona ngokunethezeka, ngokwendlela yabaSidoni, bekhululekile begodu bephephile; babe nezinto zonke ezidingekayo kubo, kwakungekho muntu owenza lutho olubi kubo. Behlala kude nabaseSidoni, abazange benze noma yini nanoma ubani.
Baye bebuyela eSora nase-Eshtaoli, begodu abahlobo babo babuza labo bantu, bathi, Utholani yini?
Bathi kubo, Yeza, sizobhekana nabo; thina sabona izwe, bona lihle khulu. Kungani na ke nihlala khona? Musani ukulindela; chofoza, nithathe izwe.
Uma ufike khona, uzothola abantu abakwazi ukucabanga lutho, begodu izwe libanzi; begodu Allah uyinikeze ezandla zenu, izwe elinokuningi kunalokho okufunayo.
Basuka ke eSora ne-Eshtaoli abantu abangumakhulu ayisishiyagalombili, abalungiselelwe ukulwa, besuka ezweni likaDan.
Kwathi lapho behamba khona, bamisa isicampu eKiriyati-yearimi ezweni laseYuda; ngalokho kwabizwa igama lesicampu saseKiritayi-yearimi ngegama elithi Mahane-dan kuze kube manje.
Basuka khona bahamba befika ezweni eliphakeme lika-Ephrayim, befika endlini kaMikha.

Bathi labo bantu abahlanu abasuke bebhekele izwe laseLayisi, kubazalwane babo, bathi: Ingabe niyazi bona esinye sezindlu ezinjalo sine-ephod, ne-teraphim, nesithombe esicwebezelwe, esigqokwa ngegolide? Ngalokho-ke qaphelani bona yini okufanele niyenze.
Basuka khona, befika endlwini yowesifazane waseLevi, endaweni kaMikha, bacela usizo kuye.
Amadoda angumakhulu ayisishiyagalombili aseDani, agqoke izikhali zokulwa, ahlala emgwaqeni wokungena.
Amadoda amane asuke ebhekele izwe, afike, athathe isithunzi, ne-ephodi, nezidalwa zasekhaya; kodwana umbingeleli wahlala emgwaqeni wesango, nalabo abantu abangumakhulu amathandathu abagqoke izikhali.
Bafika endlwini kaMika, bathatha isithunzi, ne-ephod, nama-teraphim, kanye nesithombe segolide. Wathi kubo umbingeleli, Nikwenzani lokhu?

Bathi kuye, Khumbula, ungasho lutho; hlangana nathi, ube ngubaba wethu nombingeleli wethu. Akulungile yini bona ube ngumbingeleli wezwe lonke nendlu yonke yamaSirayeli, noma ukuba umbingeleli wendlu kamuntu oyedwa?
Wajabula umbingeleli khulu, wathatha i-ephod, nezinhlamvu zendlu kaThixo, nomfanekiso ongcwele, waya phakathi kwabantu.
Babuye basuka, bebeka izingane zabo, izilwane zabo kanye nempahla sabo phambi kwabo.
Basuka behamba kude khulu nendlu kaMikha, bahlangana abantu abahlala eduze kukaMikha, bafinyelela amadodana kaDan.
Kwathi, lapho bekhuluma kulandelana kwabo, abantu bakaDan babuyela emuva, bathi kuMikha: Uyini umehluko phakathi kwakho nomuntu othile, wukuthi umeme abantu bakho ukubhekana?
Wathi yena, Nithathe amadini ami engiwenzayo, namabhishobhi ami, nisuka; yini engase ngiyithole? Ingabe ukhuluma bona, Kuphi okumbi kuwe?
Bathi abantu baka-Dan, "Ungagxeki nathi, ukuze abanye abantu abakhohlakelayo bagweme wena, begodu wena nomndeni wakho ulahlekelwa ubomi bakho.
Baye ke abantu bakaDan behamba ngendlela sabo. Wabona uMika bona banamandla kunaye, wabuya waya ekhaya lakhe.
Bathi ke bona, bathathe izinto azenzayo uMikha, nakubabhishobhi wakhe, bafika eLayisi, kilabo bantu abaphilile, abangasazi lutho; babulala ngaso isandla sekhephu, bamisa umzi wabo.

Akukho muntu owabasiza, ngombana behlala eduze neSidon, begodu abazange babe nokuxhumana nanoma ubani ongaphandle kwalowo mzi. Ube efulethini eliphakathi kweBethe-Rehobhi. Bawukwakha lo mzi, bahlala khona.
Babiza igama lakhe bona iDan, ngokusho kwegama likaDan ubaba wabo, umfazi waseSirayeli; kodwana kuqala igama lomzi lalinguLayish.
Wathi uYonathan, unyana kaGershoni, unyana kaMoses, naye nomndeni wakhe babe abapristi ezweni laseDani, kuze kube yilapho izwe lithunyelwe emgodini.
Baqhubeka besebenzisa isithombe esifana nomlilo, uMikha abesenza, yonke isikhathi lapho indlu kaThixo ibe eShilo.
Ngaleso sikhathi kwakungekho ukumkani eSirayeli. Kwaba khona umLevi ohlala ezindaweni eziphakeme zaseEphrayim, wathatha indodakazi yowesifazane waseBethelehemu yaseYuda, waba ngumkakhe.
Yathi yena, iphikisane naye; yaphuma kuye, yabuyela endlwini yobaba wakhe, eBethelehemu yaseYuda. Yahlala khona izinyanga ezinhlanu.

Umfazi wakhe waphuma waya kuye, ekhuluma naye ngothando, ecela ukuba abuye. Wathatha nomkhonzi wakhe, namadodakazi akhe amabini. Wayemthwala endlwini yobaba wakhe; begodu ubaba wakhe, lapho ekubona khona, wamjabulela.
Nokho ubaba wakhe, oyise wesifazane, wamkhuthaza ukuba ahlale naye. Wahlala naye iminyaka emithathu, edla, edla, ephumula khona.
Ngosuku lwesine bavuka ekuseni, waqala ukuphuma. Wathi ubaba wowesifazane kundodakazi yakhe, Ukudlale kuqala, ukuze ube nenhliziyo enamandla; bese uzama ukubuyela.
Bahlala khona bedla, baphuze ndawonye. Wathi ubaba wendodakazi: "Njengombana uhlale lapha ekuseni," waphendula yena, "uzoba nokuthula."
Kwathi lapho lo mntu evuka esuka khona, ubaba wakhe wesifazane wamkhuthaza ukuba ahlale khona, wahlala khona nalolo busuku.
Kwathi lapho evuka ngobusuku obuyisihlanu ukuba ahambe, ubaba wakhe wathi kuye, "Ukudla, begodu uqinise inhliziyo yakho; ulinde kuze kube semini." Badla khona bonke.

Wavuka lowo muntu, naye umngane wakhe, nomkhonzi wakhe, ukuba ahambe. Wathi ubaba wakhe-ke, ubaba wesifazane, bona, Bheka, kufike isikhathi sokuphumula; ngikucela uhlale lapha ekuseni, ngombana usuku luphelile; hlala, ujabulele impilo yakho, bese uphuma emini, uye ekhaya lakho.
Wathi lowo muntu, engathandanga ukuphumula ekuseni, wavuka, waya eJebhusi (lapho iJerusalema likhona), naye namadodakazi akhe amabini, nenkosikazi yakhe.
Bafika eJebhusi, begodu usuku lwadlulile. Wathi umkhonzi kunkosi wakhe: Yiya, sihlale ekuseni kulo mzini wamaJebhusi, ukuze siphumule.
Wathi umnikazi wakhe, Akufanele sifike edolobhaneni lakwamanye amazwe, lapho kungekho abantu baseSirayeli; kodwana sizohamba kuze kube yiGibeha.
Wathi ke, Yeza, sifike eGibeha noma eRama, sihlale ekuseni ngalinye lalawo madolobha.
Baye behamba, begodu ilanga laphuma, bafika eGibiha, elingumBenjamini.
Bahlala khona eGibeha, baphumula khona. Baye behlala emgwaqeni womuzi; kodwana kwakungekho muntu owawuzowathatha ekhaya ukuze baphumule.
Kwathi ngobusuku, kwafika umuntu omdala osuka emsebenzini wakhe ezindaweni ezishisayo; lo muntu uvela emadolobheni asogwini lwaseEphrayim, wahlala eGibeha; abantu bendawo babenguBenjamin.
Kwathi lapho ebheka khona, wabona umuntu ohamba ngebhayisikili esitezi sedolobhana. Wabuza bona: "Uyaphi? Uvela phi?"

Wathi kuye, Sihamba sisuka eBhetheleyimu yaseYuda siye ezindaweni eziseduze zendawo entaba-mlilo kaEfrayim, lapho ngihlala khona; ngafika eBhetheleyimu yaseYuda, begodu manje ngiya endlini kaYehova; kodwana akukho muntu ongithathe ekhaya.
Sinezinkomo zethu imbewu nokudla, begodu sinenkomishi newayini nathi, nami umkhonzi wakho, nalowo mfundi ohamba nathi; akukho lutho esiludingayo.
"Ukwamukela ekhaya lami," kusho indodana encane. "Ngizobhekana nanoma yini oyidingayo. Kodwana-ke, awudingi ukuchitha ekuseni esitezi."
Wathi ke yena, wamngenisa endlwini yakhe, wamisa izinkomo zakhe; begodu bahlamba izinyawo zabo, badla, baphuze.

Begodu lapho bedlala khona, bona, abantu ababi edolobhaneni layo, bahlanganisa ikhaya, begodu baphoqa umnyango, watshonalela umuntu omdala, umnikazi wendlu, wathi, "Uzokhipha indodana yakho, owafika ekhaya lakho, ukuze sihlale naye."
Waphuma umnikazi wendlu, wathi kubo, Akunjalo, abazalwane bami, ningabi nalutho olubi; lo muntu ungumngane wami; ungenzi lokhu okumbi.
Bheka, inkosikazi yami, indodakazi yami, nomfazi wakhe; ngizobakhipha lapha kuwe; ukwenze konke okuthandekayo enhliziyweni yakho kubo; kodwana kulowo muntu akufanele wenze lutho olubi.
Amadoda awathandanga ukumlalela. Wathatha uLevi indodakazi yakhe, waphuma waya kubo; bona bayamshaya, bayambulalana naye yonke imini, kuze kube yilapho kuvuka khona, beyawushiya.
Usuku lufika, wabuyela uwesifazane ekhaya lapho umnikazi wakhe uhlala khona, wawela emgwaqweni, wahlala khona kuze kube yimini.
Wavuka unkosikazi wakhe ekuseni, wavula umbhoshongo wendlu ukuba ahambe indlela yakhe, yabona indodakazi yakhe encane ilele emgwaqweni wokungena, izandla zayo zisesigabeni somnyango.
Wathi kuye, Thola, sihambe. Kwangasekho impendulo yakhe; wamisa udadewabo phezu kwebhodlela lakhe, waphuma waya ekhaya.
Kwathi lapho efika ekhaya lakhe, wathatha isikebhe, wayihlukanisa ibe yizingxenye ezingu-12 ngazo zonke izingxenye zayo; wabathumela kiwo wonke amazwe aseSirayeli.

Wathi wonke umuntu okubonayo, omunye nomunye wakhe, Akukaze kwenzeke noma kubonakale lokhu, kusukela ngosuku abaSirayeli baphuma khona ezweni laseYiputa. Kuze kube manje, kufanele senze okuthile; sikhuluma!
Baphuma bonke amadodana aseSirayeli, asuka eDani kuya eBheri-shebha, kanye nezwe laseGiliyadi, bahlangana ndawonye njengomuntu owodwa phambi koYehova eMizpa.
Bathi abaholi bezizwe zonke zamadodana kaSirayeli, bafike engqungqutheleni yomphakathi kaThixo; kwaba ngumakhulu amane amawaka abantu abahamba ngezinyawo, abagqoka isandla.
Bathe amaBhenjamini ezwa bona abantu bakaSirayeli bafike eMizpa, bathi kubo: Sitshele bona kwenzeka kanjani lokhu okubuhlungu.
ULevi, indodana yowesifazane obulawayo, waphendula wathi, Ngiye eGibeha yaseBhenjamini, mina nenkosikazi yami, ukuze siphumule.
Bafika abantu baseGibeha emini, bengilandela, bajikelezisa indlu, befuna ukungibulala; begodu babhikishe indodakazi yami yowesifazane, yafa.
Ngayithatha, ngayiqoqa, ngayithumela emazweni onke aseSirayeli; ngombana bekwenze lokhu okumbi nokungathandeki eSirayeli.
Manje ke, nikhulumeni, nitsheleni ngitjho yini, bonke abantu bakaSirayeli.
Baphuma bonke abantu, besuka ndawonye njengendoda eyodwa, bathi, Akukho muntu ozayo ekhaya lakhe phakathi kwethu; akukho muntu obuyela endlini yakhe.
Le yinto esizoyenza eGibeha; sizonyuka siyihlasele, njengokuthi isinqumo sisho.

Sizothatha abantu abalishumi emashumini kiwo wonke amazwe kaSirayeli, begodu umuntu omakhulu ezigidini, nomuntu okhulu kumakhulu ayisishiyagalombili, ukuze bathuthe izinto ezidingekayo emkhosini; begodu uma umkhosi ufika eGibeha yaseBhenjamini, bazowubulala ngenxa yobugebengu bonke obubekiwe eSirayeli.
Bahlangana bonke amadoda aseSirayeli emzini, ehlanganisana njengendoda eyodwa.
Izizwe zakwaSirayeli zathumela abantu kuzo zonke izizwe zikaBhenjamin, zithi, Yini le ngozi enkulu eyenziwe phakathi kwenu?
Ngokuba namuhla, banikelani labo bantu ababi baseGibeha, ukuze sibashise, begodu sisuse lokhu okumbi emazweni aseSirayeli. Amadodana kaBhenjamini akhenge aphendule kilabo amadodana abo aseSirayeli;
Basuka emizini sabo, bahlangana eGibeha, ukuba bahlangane namadodana kaSirayeli.

Bathi amakhosi aseBhenjamin, emini leyo, baqoqa emazweni abo abantu abangumakhulu ayisishiyagalombili namashumi amabili anesithandathu amawaka, abanesandla esinamandla, ngaphandle kwabahlali baseGibeha abangamakhulu asixhenxe.
Ngaphakathi kwabo bonke abezobe bekhona amadoda amashumi ayisishiyagalombili akhethiwe, abasekhohlo; ngaye ngamunye wabo wayekwazi ukushaya itshe ngesandla sakhe esisodwa, begodu angabi nephutha.
Ngaphandle kukaBhenjamini, amaSirayeli aqoqe abantu abangumakhulu amane amaphesenti, bonke abaqeqeshiwe.
Baya eBhetheleli, babuza uzimu, bathi, Nguwubani phakathi kwethu ozohamba kuqala ukubhekana noBenjamini? Waphendula ikosi wathi, UYuda uzohamba kuqala.
Kwathi ekuseni kwavuka amaSirayeli, bamisa isikhashana eGibeha.
Baphuma amaSirayeli, babhekana nabantu bakaBhenjamini, bamisa isikhundla sokulwa nabo eGibeha.
Baphuma abantu bakaBhenjamin eGibeha, babulala amadodana kaSirayeli amashumi amabili nambili amawaka emgwaqeni ngalolusuku.
Amadodakazi aseSirayeli, eqinisa amehlo abo, babuyela endaweni sabo, lapho babehlala khona ngosuku lokuqala.
Baphuma ke amadodana aseSirayeli, bavuma phambi koYehova kuze kube sebusuku; babuza ikosi, bathi, Ingabe sizobuyela ukuyobhekana noBenjamini, odadewethu? Waphendula ikosi wathi, Yeka ukubopha.
Kwathi ngosuku olulandelayo, abaSirayeli bafika bahlasela uBhenjamin.
Amadodana kaBhenjamin aphuma eGibeha, awabhekane nabo ngaleso sikhathi; babulala abantu baseSirayeli abangumakhulu ayisishiyagalombili anamashumi asibhozo. Bonke labo abagqoka ikhebula.

Baye ke bonke amadodana aseSirayeli, izwe lonke, bafika eBhetheleli, bekhala khona phambi koYehova; baphumula ngalolusuku kuze kube sebusuku, banikela ngenhlanhla ngomnikelo wokushiswa nomnikelo wokuthula kuYehova.
Baye babuza amadodana aseSirayeli ikosi bona angakwenzani. Ezikhathini zalo, ibhokisi lesivumelwano sikaThixo lahlala khona,

begodu uPhinehasi, unyana ka-Eleazaru, unyana ka-Aron, wahlala phambi kwayo. Bathi ke kubo: Ingabe sizobuyela ukubhekana nomndeni wethu, oonyana bakaBhenjamin, noma sizoyeka? Waphendula ikosi wathi, Yiya; ngombana kusasa ngibanikela esandla sakho.
Wabeka amaSirayeli abantu abafihlakele eGibeha yonke.
Ngosuku lwesithathu benyuka babhekana namadodakazi kaBhenjamin, bamisa isikhundla esibhekene neGibeha, njengokuba babekwenzele ngaphambili.

Baphuma amadoda aseBhenjamini abhekane nabo, waqhutshwa esuka kulo mzi; baqala bebulala abantu baseSirayeli, njengangaphambilini, ezindaweni ezivulekile, nasezinxanxatheleni, enye ihamba eBheteli, nenye ihamba eGibeha, abantu abangumashumi amathathu.
Bathi abantu bakaBhenjamini, Sizowahlasela njengaleso sikhathi sangaphambilini. Amadodana kaSirayeli athi, Siyahamba, siyisuse idolobha ezindaweni zokuhamba ngezinyawo;
Basuka bonke amadoda aseSirayeli ezindaweni zabo, bamisa amaqembu abo eBhaali-thamari; begodu abantu baseSirayeli abafihlakele baphuma ezindaweni zabo enyakatho yeGibeha.
Kwathi lapho, amashumi amabili amawaka amadoda amakhulu eSirayeli wahlasela Gibeah. Ukulwa kwaba nzima khulu, begodu abantu Benjamini awazi bona ingozi yafika.
UYehova wahlasela uBhenjamin phambi kwaSirayeli, begodu amaSirayeli abulala abantu abangumashumi amabili anesihlanu anamakhulu ayisishiyagalombili eBhenjamin ngalolu busuku, bonke abagqoka ikhanda.
Amadodana kaBhenjamin akubona bona bahlaselwe; ngombana amadoda aseSirayeli ayewashiya amaBhenjamini, thisha abantu ababezifihla eGibeha.
Bathi labo abafihlakele, bafika eGibeha ngaso soke isikhathi, basakazeka, babulala bonke abahlala kulo mzi ngeqhwa.
Amadodakazi kaSirayeli ayesho nalabo abafihlakeleyo bona bazothumela umsindo omkhulu osuka kulo mzi, njengophawu.
Amadoda aseSirayeli abuyela emuva emdlalweni; begodu amaBhenjamini ayeqala ukuhlasela amadodana aseSirayeli, abe ngamaphesenti angama-30. Bathi ke: Sizowabulala njengasempini yokuqala;
Kwathi lapho isibhakabhaka somlilo siqala ukunyuka ezweni, abantu bakaBhenjamin babheka emuva, bebona bona isibhakabhaka sezwe lonke sikhuphuka esibhakabhakeni.
Amadoda aseSirayeli abuyela kubo, begodu amadoda aseBhenjamini akhathazekile; ngombana bebona bona ubuhlungu bufike kubo.
Baye babaleka phambi kwamadodana aseSirayeli, besuka esiqhingini; kodwana abakwazi ukuphuma emdlalweni. Amadodana aseSirayeli aphuma emizini sabo, waqala ukuwabulala khona.
Babhekene nabantu bakaBhenjamini, baphoqeleka ukuba bahambe eduze kwabo, begodu baphazamiseka khulu ezindaweni ezisentshonalanga yeGibeha.
Bafa abantu abangu-18 baseBhenjamini, bonke abesilisa abanamandla.
Amanye amaSirayeli abuye, wabaleka waya esiqhingini, waya emfuleni i-Rimon. Babulala abantu abangumakhulu amahlanu emigwaqweni, balandela kuze kube yiGidomu, babulala abantu abangumakhulu amabili.
Ngawo wonke amaBhenjamini abulawa ngalolusuku abantu abangu-25 abagqoka ikhebula, bonke abesilisa abanothando.
Ke kaloku abantu abangumakhulu amathandathu babuyela, babaleka besuka ezweni laseNdiya, befika emfuleni iRimoni; bahlala eMfuleni iRimoni iminyaka emihlanu.
Baphinde babuyela ezweni likaBhenjamini, babulala zonke izingxenye zazo ngesandla sekhephu, nabantu, nenyama, nanoma yini ebeyitholayo; begodu yonke idolobhana labo lafika kulo, lalibabula ngomlilo.
Amadodakazi aseSirayeli abeke isibopho eMizpa, bathi, Wonke umuntu wethu ngeke anikeze intombi yakhe indodana kaBhenjamin.
Bahamba abantu, bafika eBheteli, behlala khona phambi kukaThixo kuze kube sebusuku, bekhala ngezwi elikhulu khulu.
Bathi, Kosi, uzimu kaSirayeli, kungani kwenzeka lokhu kuSirayeli? Kungani ke bona kube nezwe elilodwa eliseSirayeli namuhla?
Ngosuku olulandelayo, abantu bavuka ekuseni, bakwakha khona isibingelelo, banikela ngenhlanhla ngomnikelo wokushiswa, nenhlanhla yokuthula.

Bathi ke amadodana aseSirayeli, Nguwubani phakathi kwezizwe zonke zamadodana aseSirayeli ongeke afike engqungqutheleni phambi koYehova? Bebebeke isibopho sokuthi wonke umuntu ongeke afike phambi koYehova eMizpa, kumele aphele.
Bathi ke amakhosikazi aseSirayeli, bakhathazeka ngenxa yabangani babo, amadodana kaBhenjamin, bathi: Namuhla kutholwe isizwe esisodwa eSirayeli.
Ngabe sizothola kanjani abesifazane labo abashiwo, uma sesivumile ngeNkosi bona asize sibe nendodana yethu ibe ngumfazi wabo?
Bathi ke, Yimiphi imiphakathi yamaSirayeli engafikanga kuYehova eMizpa? Bebona bona akukho muntu osuka eYabhesi-gileyadi owafika emgodini ukuze ahlangane.
Bathe babala abantu, begodu bona, kwakungekho muntu eJabhesi-Gileyadi.
Bathuthela khona abantu abangu-12, abakhethiwe phakathi kwamadodana abo, bathi kubo: "Niya eYabhesi iGiliyadi, nibulala wonke umuntu ohlala kuyo ngeqhwa, nabesifazane nezingane.
Bathi: "Kulokhu okufanele ukwenze," bathi, "ukubulala wonke indoda nomfazi oneminyaka engamashumi ayisishiyagalombili ubudala.
Bathola phakathi kwalabo abahlala eYabheshi-gileyadi amadodakazi angamakhulu amane, angeke abe nomfazi, bawathatha waya esibhedlela eShilo, ezweni laseKanana.
Kwathi ibandla lonke lithuthela ezweni laseBhenjamini, bekhuluma nabo ngokuthula, ehlathini leRimoni.
Babuya ke abantu bakaBhenjamin ngaleso sikhathi, banikezwa abesifazane baseYabhesi-Gileyadi, labo ababoshwe; kodwana kwakungekho okunembile kubo bonke.
Bathi abantu bakhathazekile ngoBhenjamini, ngombana ikosi ubewenza isikhala phakathi kwezizwe zakwaSirayeli.
Bathi abakhulu bebandla, Amadodakazi aseBhenjamini abulawe; kungani sizothola amadodakazi kwalabo abaseleyo?
Bathi, "Kumele kube nomzali kilabo abasele eBhenjamini, ukuze isizwe esiseSirayeli singasuswe."
Kodwana-ke, asikwazi ukuwanika izingane zethu ukuba zibe ngamadodana; ngombana sithe sathi, Ubani na onikela indodakazi yakhe kuBhenjamin?
Kodwana bona, kukhona isikhumbuzo sonyaka sikaNkulunkulu eSilo, esisenyakatho yeBhetelehem, enyakatho-mpumalanga yendlela esuka eBethelehem iye eShechem, nasenyakatho yeLebona.
Bathi ke kumadodana kaBhenjamini, Yeza ufihla ezindaweni zokutshala izithelo
bese ubheka, lapho izintombazane zaseShilo ziphuma zidlale, zulazula ezindaweni zokutshala iwayini, nithatheni wonke umuntu indodakazi phakathi kwabesifazane baseShilo, niye ezweni likaBhenjamin.

Uma ubaba babo noma abazalwane babo bafika bekhala nathi, sizothi, 'Nceda ube nobulungisa kubo ngenxa yethu. Siyazi bona asizange sithathe amadoda labo emdlalweni, begodu awunikeze izingane zakho kubo; ngalokho akuyona iphutha lakho ukuphula isivumelwano sakho.' "
Bakwenza njalo amadodana kaBhenjamin, wathatha wonke umuntu umfazi wesifazane esidlangalaleni, wamthatha abe ngumfazi wakhe; babuyela ezweni labo, baphinde bakwakha imiphakathi sabo, bahlala kuyo.
Kwathi lapho, abaSirayeli basuka khona, bebuyela ezweni labo, wonke umuntu ezweni lakhe, kiwo wonke umndeni wakhe.
Ngaleso sikhathi, kwakungekho ukumkani ezweni lakwaSirayeli; wonke umuntu wayekwenza okulungile emehlo akhe.
Ruth: Ngosuku lwama-Israyeli, lapho amajaji elawula khona izwe, bekukhona undlala ezweni. Wahamba umuntu othile waseBethelehemu yaseYuda, wahlala ezindaweni zaseMowabi, yena nomfazi wakhe, nabantwana bakhe ababi.

Igama lomuntu lalinguElimeleki, negama lenkosikazi yakhe nguNaomi, namagama oonyana bakhe ababili nguMahloni noKilyoni; babe yimi Ephrathi abasuka eBethlehem yaseYuda. Baye emazweni aseMowabi, bahlala khona.
Wafa uElimeleki, indodana kaNaomi; washiywa yena nonyana bakhe ababi.
Bathatha izingane zakwaMowabi; igama elilodwa liyi-Orpa, elinye liyi-Ruthi. Bahlala khona iminyaka eyishumi.
begodu uMahlone noKilyone bafa. UNaomi washiywa kuphela, ngaphandle kwabantwana bakhe ababi kanye nomkakhe.
UNaomi, lapho uhlala khona eMowabhi, walalela bona ikosi usevele waveza isipho sakhe abantu bakhe; wavuka ke yena nabangane bakhe ababili, babuyela ezweni laseMowabi.
Waphuma khona lapho uhlala khona, yena nezingane zakhe ezimbili ezincane, wathatha isinqumo sokubuyela ezweni lakwaYuda..
Wathi uNaomi kuzinkanyezi zakhe ezimbili, Yeni nibuye, inene ngayinye endlwini yomkakhe; ikosi anibonise inhlonipho, njengokuba ningabonisi inhlonipho kubantu benu abafileyo, nami.
UYehova aninikeze nihlale ndawonye endlu yowesifazane omusha. Wathi uSirayeli, "Ngubani na lowo muntu?" Yathi, "Ngingu-Abrahama."
Bathi kuye: "Akekho, thina sizobuyela nawe ezweni lakho."
Wathi uNaomi, Yeni, izingane zami; kungani ningahamba nami? Ingabe ngizothola abanye oonyana ukuba babe amadodana yenu?
Yiya ekhaya, izingane zami. Ngikhulu khulu bona ngibe nomfazi othile. Nakuba ngicabanga bona kukhona ithemba lami, nakuba ngibe nomfazi ngoLwesihlanu begodu ngazala amadodana,
Ingabe ungeke ulinde kuze bakhule? Ingabe uzohlala ungashadile ngenxa sabo? Akunjalo, izingane zami, ngombana inhliziyo yami ibuhlungu khulu kunenu; ngombana isandla sikaYehova sisemandleni ami.
Wathi u-Orpa, ephoqelela inkosikazi yakhe; kodwana u-Ruthi waqhubeka naye. U-Orpa wathi ku-Ruthi: "Kulungile.
Wathi uNaomi, Yabona, inkosikazi yakho ibuyela kubomi bayo, nozimu wayo; buye ulandele inkosikazi yakho.

Wathi uRuthi, Ungangitshela bona ngikushiye, noma bona ngibuye ngalokho; ngombana lapho uzoya khona ngizoya, begodu lapho uzohlala khona ngizohlala; abantu bakho bazoba ngabantu bam, nozimu wakho uzoba uzimu wam.
Ngizofa lapho ufile khona, begodu ngizibulale khona; ikosi angihloniphe ngalokhu, angihloniphe ngokunye, uma kukhona okuzomisa wena nomi ngaphandle kokufa.
UNaomi, lapho nakabona bona uRuthi unesinqumo sokuthi ahambe naye, wayeka ukumcela.
Bahamba ke labo madoda amabili, kuze bafike eBethelehemu; begodu lapho befika khona, idolobha lonke laqhutshwa ngenxa sabo; kwathi amabhishobhi: Ingabe uNaomi lo?
Wathi kubo, Musani ukungibiza bona uNaomi; ngisabizwa bona uMara, ngombana uzimu Onamandla onke ungenza impilo yami ibe nobuhlungu.
Ngiye ngigcwele, kodwana ikosi ungibuyisele ngingenalutho. Yini bona ningazibiza bona nguNaomi? uzimu ukhuluma ngami; lowo Onamandla onke ungenza kube nzima kum."
Wabuya ke uNaomi eMowabhi, naye noRuthi umMoabithi, indodakazi yakhe; bafika eBhetheleyimu lapho kuqalwa khona ukuvuna isobho.
Wabe uNaomi unenkosikazi yomndeni wakhe, ebizwa bona nguBowazi, indodana ka-Elimeleki, indoda enamandla.
Wathi uRuthi, isiMowabhi, kuNaomi, Ngizophuma ngiya ezweni, ngiqoqe izithelo ezishisayo, ngemuva komuntu ongithandela. Wathi uNaomi kuye, Iya, inkosikazi yami.
Waphuma ke, waqala ukuqoqa ezindaweni ezingaphansi kwalabo abavuna; kwathi lapho ethola khona isitshalo sikaBowazi, umfazi wase-Elimeleki, waqala ukuqoqa.
Ngalokhu uBhohazi efika eBethlehem, wathi labo abavuna: UYehova abe nani. Baphendula bathi: UYehova akubabaziseni.
Wathi uBhohazi kulowo ophethe izisebenzi zakhe, Ubani lo mfana?
Waphendula lo muntu, wathi, Lowo nguwesifazane waseMowabhi, owabuya noNaomi eMowabi.

Wayethi, 'Nceda ngizoqoqa izithelo ezishisayo phakathi kwamabhande angaphasi kwalabo abasebenzayo.' Yafika ezweni, yaqhubeka isebenze kusukela ekuseni kuze kube manje, ngaphandle kokuphumula okuncane emgodini.
Wathi uBhoazi kuRuthi, Ngikutshele, inkosikazi yami; ungaya ezweni elilodwa ungenzi isivuno, begodu ungasuka lapha, uhlale nabangani bami.
Uzobona lapho amadoda avuna khona, bese ulandela ngemuva kwabesifazane. Ngitjho kumadoda bona angakuthintani; begodu uma uthandana, ungaya uphuze amanzi ezitsheni abantu abagcwele. "
Uthe yena, "Injani le nto oyenzayo, bona ungazizwa ngami, nami sengumzweli?"

Waphendula uBhohazi, wathi: Kuroziboshwa kimi konke okwenzele umkakhe, kusukela lapho indodana yakho iphele; bona washiya ubaba wakho nomama wakho, nezwe lakho, waya kwabanye abantu ongawazi ngaphambilini.
UYehova akuhlole umsebenzi wakho, begodu ukhokhelwe ngokupheleleko nguYehova, uzimu wakwaSirayeli, owafika ukuzohlala ngaphasi kwamaphiko akhe.
Wathi yena, Ngatholakele inhlonipho phambi kwakho, kosi yami; ngombana ungisindisele, begodu ukhuluma ngothando nomkhonzi wakho, nakuba angiyena umkhonzi wakho.

Wathi yena uBhohazi, ngesikhathi sokudla, Hamba uye lapha, uphuze inkomishi yenkomo, uyifake emlilweni. Se ihlala ndawonye nalabo abavuna, wanikela kuyo izithelo ezithosiwe; yadla konke okufunayo, begodu kwashiya okusele.
UBowashi wathi kilabo abahamba naye, Uma evuka eqoqa izithelo, ayisekho ubuhlungu kuye; uma ephuma eqoqa izithelo phakathi kwezinkomishi, angeke abe nobunzima.
Naphezu kwalokho, khipha ezinye izihlahla zakhe ezisuka emigodini begodu uzishiye aze azithole. Ungamtshela bona ahambe."
Wathi uRuthi, waqoqa izithelo ezweni kuze kube sebusuku; washaya imbewu yakhe, yafika ibe ngamakhilogremu ayisishiyagalombili.
Wathi uRuthi, uma efika enkabeni yedolobha, inkosikazi yakhe yabona bona waqoqa kuphi. URuthhi naye wakhipha, wamnika okushiwo uRuthi, ngemuva kokuba ephuze.

Wathi udadewabo, "Uyaphirozi?" Udadewabo wathi kuye, "Uyaphi udadewabo?" Wathi udadewabo, "Uyaphi udadewabo?" Udadewabo wathi, "Udadewabo," waphendula uRubheth, "ukhuluma ngomuntu osebenza naye; igama lakhe nguBhowazi.

Wathi uNaomi kunkosikazi yakhe,rozibopheke yena ikosi; ngombana akhenge agweme ukukhombisa uthando lwakhe kubantu abaphilayo nalabo abafileyo. Yathi yena, Lo muntu ungumngane wethu othile, begodu ngumunye wabahlobo bethu, uzosilungisa.
Wathi uRuthi umMowabhi, "Uthi begodu kuye: 'Qhubeka nabangani bam, kuze baqedele yonke imbewu yami.' "
Wathi uNaomi kuRuthi inkosikazi yakhe, Kulungile kuwe, intombi yami, ukuba ukhambe nalabo abasebenza naye, ukuze ungabi necala ezweni lomuntu othile.
Wahlala ke uRuthi eduze kwamadodakazi kaBowazi, eqoqa izithelo, kuze kube sekuphele ukuvuna imbewu yeshubhu nokudla kwengulube; wahlala naye nomkakhe.
Wathi uNaomi, umkakhe kaRuthi, kuye, Inkosikazi yami, ngizokuthola indlu lapho uzohlala khona, ukuze uhlale khona.
UBowazi, umfazi owasebenza naye, ungumngane wethu; namuhla uzoba ehlukanisile imbewu nofulawa emgodini wokulima.
Ngalokho, ukugeza, begodu ugqoke iphunga, begodu ugqoke izicathulo zakho ezingcono khulu. bese uya esitezi sokudla; kodwana akusho bona uzokwazi bona ukhona, kuze kube sekuphele ukudla notshwala.
Uma ephumula, qaphela indawo lapho ephumula khona; bese uya, uvule izinyawo zakhe, uphumule; yena uzokutshela bona yini ongayikwenza.
Waphendula uRuthi wathi, Ngizokwenza konke okushoyo.
Wayehamba ehlathini lamahhashi, wakwenza konke umfazi wakhe wayemtshela bona akwenze.
UBhohazi, lapho eqedile ukudla nokuphuza, waphuma, waya embhedeni, wahlala eduze kwengcindezi yengulube. Wafika uRuthi ngokuthula, waveza izinyawo zakhe, walala.
Ephakathi kobusuku, kukhona okungenzeka bona kube yingozi kulowo muntu. Ushintshile, begodu bekukhona indoda uhlala emadolo akhe!
Wathi yena, Ngiwubani wena? Wathi yena, Ngami uRuthi umkhonzi wakho; cindezela phezu kwami isibambo sendwangu yakho, ngombana ungumzali wami, begodu ungangisindisa.
Wathi yena, UYehova akubabale wena, intombi yami; le nto yothando ingaphezu kwayo yonke eyangaphambilini; ngombana awuzange ulandele abancane, noma abakhulu noma abancane.
Ngalokho manje, inkosikazi yami, ungakhathazeki; konke okushoyo ngizokwenza kuwe; ngombana bonke abantu edolobhaneni lami bayazi bona wena uwesifazane onengqondo.
Kuyiqiniso bona ngiwumuntu ovikela imindeni yenu angakusindisa, kodwana kukhona omunye umuntu onemindeni eminingi engifana nayo.

Uhlale lapha ekuseni, uma efuna ukukwenza umsebenzi wakhe wokuvikela imindeni yakho, kulungile. Ake akubuyisele wena; kodwana uma engathandanga, njengombana unguNkulunkulu ophilayo, ngizokwenza. Uhlale lapha kuze kube kusasa.
Wahlala emadolo akhe kuze kube ekuseni, wavuka ke ngaphambi kokuba umuntu akwazi ukuwaqonda. Uthe yena, "Akukho muntu ozokwazi bona indodana ifike esitezi sokudla."
Wathi ke yena, Nciphisa ngezansi isigqoko sakho, begodu ubeke phezu kwayo. Yakwenza njalo; wafaka kuyo amaphesenti ayisishiyagalombili embewu yengulube, wayibeka phezu kwayo, wabuyela edolobhaneni.
Wafika uRuthi kunkosikazi yakhe, wabuza uNaomi, ethi, Kube kanjani, inkosikazi yami? Yathi ke yena kuye zonke izinto azenzayo yena uBowasha.
Wathi, "Unginikeza lezi zinkomishi eziyisishiyagalombili zezinkomo, wathi: 'Ungaya kunkosikazi yakho ngesandla esingenalutho.'"
Wathi uNaomi, Uhlale lapha, intombi yami, kuze wazi bona kwenzekani; ngombana lo muntu ngeke aphumule, kuze kube sekuphele le nto namuhla.
UBhohazi wehla emnyango, wahlala khona; kwafika udadewabo owaziwayo, wathi kuye: "Hlela lapha, nkosikazi yami, uhlale." Wahamba ke, wahlala khona.
Wathi uBhohazi, ethatha abantu abalishumi phakathi kwabakhulu bedolobhana, wathi, "Nihlale lapha." Bahlala khona.
Wathi kulowo olawula imindeni, ethi, UNaomi, owabuya eMowabhi, uthengisa inqwaba yembewu, eyayingu-Elimeleki, umngane wethu.

Ngicabanga bona kufanele ngikutshele ngalokho, futhirozindela bona uyithengise phambi kwalabo abantu abahlala lapha, kanye nangaphambili kwezikhulu zabantu bam. Uma ufuna ukuyithenga, yenza njalo; kodwana uma awufuni ukuyithenga, khuluma nami, ukuze ngikwazi. Akukho muntu onelungelo lokuyithenga ngaphandle kwakho, begodu mina ngilandelayo emgqeni." Wathi: "Ngizoyithenga,"
Wathi uBhoazi, Ngosuku oluthile lapho uthenga khona imbewu kuNaomi, kufanele uthathe noRuthi isiMowabhi, indodakazi yowesifazane, ukuze igama lowesifazane ligcinwe phezu kwempahla yakhe.
Kulesi, umndeni ovikela wathi, "Ngalokho-ke angikwazi ukuyithenga, ngombana ngizobeka imali yami engozini. Ungayithenga wena ngokwakho. Angikwazi ukuyenza."

Ezikhathini ezedlule eYisrayeli, lokhu kwakuyisiko lokubuyisa kanye nokuhweba ngempahla: ukuze kube yiqiniso, umuntu owodwa wasusa isiketi sakhe begodu wamnika omunye. Lokhu kwaba yindlela izinqumo zakwenziwa ngayo eYisrayeli.
Wathi umphathi wendlu kuBowazi, Yithenge wena. Wakhuphula khona isigqoko sakhe.
Wathi uBhoazi kwabakhulu, nakubo bonke abantu, Niyibo abavikeli namuhla, bona ngithengise yonke into ka-Elimeleki, neKilyoni, neMahloni, esandla sikaNaomi.

Ngiyathenga begodu uRuthi umMowabhi, indodana kaMahloni, ukuba ube nguwesifazane wami; ukuze igama lokufa ligcinwe phezu kwempahla yakhe, ukuze igama lakhe lingagcini emndenini wakhe, noma edolobhaneni lakhe. Niyisihlalo namhlanje.

Bathi amadoda amakhulu, nalabo bonke abantu erozina isango, Siyishushisi; ikosi akwenze indodakazi yakho efika ekhaya lakho ibe njengoRakeli noLeya, abasungule ikhaya lakwaSirayeli; ube nempumelelo eEfrata, ube negama eBethlehem.
Umndeni wakho ube njengomndeni kaPerezi, owazalwa nguThamari kuYuda, ngenxa yabantwana abazokunika ikosi ngalo mntwana.
Wathatha uBhoazi uRuthi, waba nguwesifazane wakhe. Wathandana naye; begodu ikosi wamvumela ukuba akhulelwe, wazala indodana.
Bathi amadodana akhe kuNaomi, Kuhloswe ikosi, ongeke akushiyele wena namuhla umngane womndeni, ukuze kube negama lakhe eSirayeli.
Uzowuvuselela umphefumulo wakho, begodu uzoba ngumlingani wakho emshadweni wakho; ngombana inkosikazi yakho, oyithandayo wena, engcono kuwe kunezingane ezisixhenxe, ikhulela yena.
Wathi uNaomi, wathatha ingane emlenzeni wakhe, wamsiza.
Bathi amadodana abo, UNaomi unendodakazi; babiza igama lakhe bona u-Obedi. Wabe nguyise kaYese, owayengubaba kaDavide.
Lokho wumndeni kaPerezi: uPerezi waba ngumzali kaHeshroni,
uHeshron waba ngumzali ka-Ram, u-Ram waba ngubaba ka-Aminadabhi,
u-Aminadabhi waba ngubaba kaNahashon, u-Nahashon waba ngubaba kaSalmon;
uSalmon waba ngubaba kaBohazi, uBohazi waba ngubaba kaObedi,
U-Obedi waba ubaba kaYese, no-Jese waba ubaba kaDavide.
